title: Regional Field Marketing, India
description:
ClickHouse is hiring for our Regional Field Marketing, India role to lead our regional field marketing strategy in India. This is a foundational role responsible for building awareness, generating pipeline, and accelerating revenue in the region.
  
  
In this role, your mission will be to define and scale the India regional field marketing engine. You will own the regional field marketing strategy, partner closely with India sales leadership, and adapt global campaigns to the needs of the India market. You will be measured on enterprise pipeline and self-service revenue (MRR), working across both our self-serve product-led motion and our sales-led enterprise motion.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**

* Own the India regional field marketing strategy, annual plan, and budget, aligning field programs to regional pipeline and revenue targets with sales leadership.
* Act as the marketing counterpart to India sales leadership, joining regional forecasting, QBRs, and account planning so marketing investment maps to sales priorities.
* Partner with demand generation and growth to build programs for strategic verticals and AI-native sales teams, and to convert self-serve usage into commercial pipeline and expansion revenue.
* Build an integrated regional program mix spanning first-party hosted events, third-party conferences, virtual events, ABM plays, digital advertising, and partner marketing.
* Adapt global campaigns, messaging, and content for the India market.
* Establish scalable processes for campaign planning, lead management, and follow-up with marketing operations and global demand generation, so every program has a clear path from engagement to pipeline. Report on pipeline generated and influenced revenue.
* Identify emerging opportunities across India, make the case for new investment in geographies, verticals, or channels, and represent the region in global planning cycles.

**What You Bring Along**

* 10+ years of experience in field, regional, or integrated marketing within the database, data analytics, infrastructure, or developer tooling space
* Deep experience marketing in India
* Demonstrated success owning a pipeline number and driving measurable revenue impact through regional marketing programs
* Proven ability to partner with sales leadership at the VP level
* Experience working in a remote-first, globally distributed organization, collaborating across time zones
* Comfortable with ambiguity and energized by building in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
* Able to travel at least 2 times per month across India

**Perks**

* Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.
* Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.
* Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.
* Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.
* A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.
* Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It
  
  
As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.
  
  
Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here. Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.
  
  
Equal Opportunity & Privacy
  
  
ClickHouse provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type based on factors such as race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.
  
  
Please see here for our Privacy Statement.

title: Manager - Category (Sell Side)
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

* Data-driven with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

title: Unit Head
description:
Unit Head – Credit Line on UPI
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
The Unit Head will own the end-to-end business performance of the Credit Line on UPI (CLoU) portfolio. This includes growth strategy, acquisition funnels, partner ecosystem management, monetisation, unit economics, and lifecycle optimization.
  
  
The role is deeply P&L-oriented, requiring strong cross-functional collaboration with product, risk, operations, finance, and partner-bank teams to drive scalable and sustainable business outcomes.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Business Growth & Strategy
* Own overall business performance for Credit Line on UPI—including lines created, active users, activation %, throughput, and revenue generation.
* Craft the go-to-market (GTM) strategy across target customer segments (merchant & consumer), use cases, and distribution channels.
* Develop and execute strategies to grow P2M adoption, repeat usage, frequency, and wallet share.
* Evaluate market trends, competitive landscape, and regulatory context to shape business priorities.
* Ensure predictable, controllable growth aligned with portfolio health and partner expectations.
* Partner & Ecosystem Management
* Manage relationships with partner LSPs, PSPs, TPAPs, distribution partners, and ecosystem players.
* Drive partner onboarding, integration planning, scale-up, and ongoing performance management.
* Align incentives, revenue models, and commercial structures to optimise partner throughput and profitability.
* Lead governance forums with partners—reviewing business volumes, operational issues, funnel leakages, risk metrics, and revenue outcomes.
* Ensure stable and high-performing partnerships that enable predictable business scaling.
* Acquisition & Post-Acquisition Ownership
* Work with growth, marketing, product, and channel partners to optimise acquisition funnels end-to-end.
* Identify drop-off points across onboarding, activation, and early-usage stages; drive initiatives to improve activation and engagement.
* Own lifecycle interventions post-acquisition—nudges, journeys, campaigns, and partner-led programs to improve usage and repeat transactions.
* Drive funnel improvements that translate into higher active base, improved retention, and stronger unit economics.
* Revenue, Monetisation & Unit Economics
* Own all monetisation levers including interchange, MDR, interest income, late fees, and partner-linked revenue streams.
* Analyse and manage CAC, cost-to-serve, collection efficiency, risk-adjusted contribution margin, and overall P&L sustainability.
* Balance growth with portfolio quality, working closely with Risk teams to maintain controlled delinquency and financial discipline.
* Build revenue forecasts, P&L models, and commercial scenarios for planning and partner negotiations.
* Ensure strong visibility into revenue performance, profitability, and economic drivers across customer cohorts.
* Data, Analytics & Performance Management
* Monitor dashboards tracking lines created, activations, active users, repeat usage, transaction value, risk metrics, and revenue.
* Identify performance patterns and proactively address early-warning signals related to risk, conversion, or partner issues.
* Lead business reviews with leadership, presenting insights, strategic decisions, and data-driven action plans.
* Drive controlled experiments, pilots, and A/B tests to unlock new segments, use cases, and monetisation opportunities.
* Use analytics to forecast performance, optimise growth levers, and improve portfolio profitability.

title: Senior Sales Manager (B2B SaaS)
description:
**Company Description**
ProjectStudio.ai is an AI-native execution suite built specifically for interior design and fit-out businesses, helping studios reduce project value loss from rework, idle time, delayed approvals, and fragmented coordination. The platform unifies projects, contracts, people, materials, designs, clients, and sales into a single operating system with AI embedded across workflows. It offers capabilities across project management, contracts and milestones, client selections and approvals, HRMS, inventory and warehouse, design and survey technology, CRM, and autonomous AI employees in functions such as project management, finance, design, and sales. Used by more than 150 studios, ProjectStudio.ai powers live, mission-critical operations daily and enables customers to start with execution ERP and expand into AI roles that reduce manual coordination and protect margins. The company is building the operating system for how physical spaces are designed and built.

**Role Description**
The Senior Sales Manager role is a full-time, on-site position based in Mumbai, focused on driving revenue growth and market expansion for ProjectStudio.ai. This role involves owning the end-to-end sales cycle, including prospecting, qualifying leads, conducting product demos, preparing proposals, and negotiating and closing deals with interior design and fit-out studios. The Senior Sales Manager will develop and execute sales strategies, build and manage a robust pipeline, and collaborate closely with marketing, product, and customer success teams to refine messaging and improve conversion. Day-to-day responsibilities include establishing and nurturing long-term client relationships, understanding customer workflows and pain points, and positioning ProjectStudio.ai’s AI-native suite as a strategic solution. The role also includes tracking sales performance metrics, forecasting, contributing to pricing and go-to-market decisions, and mentoring junior sales team members as the organization scales.

**Qualifications**

* Strong B2B sales and account management skills, including prospecting, pipeline management, solution selling, and deal negotiation.
* Experience with SaaS or technology products, ideally in ERP, project management, Interiors Design, construction, or related industries.
* Ability to understand complex customer workflows, translate business needs into product value propositions, and conduct compelling product demos.
* Skills in sales forecasting, CRM usage, and data-driven decision-making to optimize performance and reporting.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and decision makers.
* Demonstrated leadership capabilities, including mentoring sales colleagues and contributing to team processes and playbooks.
* Comfort working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, with adaptability, ownership mindset, and strong problem-solving skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, or a related field; an MBA or equivalent experience

title: Business Development Associate
description:
**Key Account Manager — Battery IoT**

**B2B Enterprise Sales**  **Mumbai / Travel Required**  **₹14–18L Fixed + Variable (Total ₹28–36L)**

**About Ajjas**

Ajjas (HPS Lab Designs Pvt. Ltd.) is a connected-asset IoT company based in Navi Mumbai. We build the hardware, write the firmware, and run the data platform — so nothing gets lost in translation between the device in the field and the dashboard on your desk.

In our battery IoT vertical, we track battery packs for OEMs and energy storage players, enabling warranty odometry, health monitoring, and theft prevention on distributed battery assets. It's a commercially active vertical with paying clients that needs focused expansion. That's where you come in.

We are a small, focused team working with mid-market and enterprise clients. You will work directly with the founding team.

**The Role**

We are hiring a Key Account Manager (KAM) to drive commercial expansion of our battery IoT vertical. You will be scaling existing deployments and landing new logos with battery OEMs, pack manufacturers, and energy storage providers.

This is a field-intensive, founder-coached role. You will prospect, qualify, run product demonstrations, anchor pilots, and convert pilots into commercial contracts. The founding team will co-sell with you on key accounts and provide full technical support — your job is to move deals forward consistently and close.

**What You Will DoProspecting & Pipeline**

● Build and manage a named-account pipeline across battery OEMs, pack manufacturers, and energy storage providers.

● Generate qualified meetings through referrals, warm introductions, industry networks, and LinkedIn — not spray-and-pray cold outreach.

● Attend relevant battery and energy storage trade events, industry associations, and OEM factory visits to build relationships and generate leads.

**Discovery & Qualification**

● Run structured discovery calls to identify the real operational problem — warranty fraud, theft, compliance — before pitching.

● Qualify rigorously against budget, decision authority, timeline, and technical feasibility before investing in a pilot.

**Demonstrations & Pilots**

● Deliver live platform demonstrations to operations, supply chain, and technology stakeholders.

● Anchor every pilot to a Mutual Success Matrix — agreed success metrics, review timelines, and escalation contacts — so the proof of concept has a defined path to a commercial decision.

● Coordinate hardware deployment, field visits, and dashboard access with the internal team during pilots.

Closing & Expansion

● Own the commercial proposal and close the first contract on pilot accounts.

● Identify and pursue expansion opportunities on live accounts — additional SKUs, product lines, or geographies.

● Hand off to Customer Success post-onboarding while retaining the senior commercial relationship.

Market Intelligence

● Feed back insights on competitor products, OEM roadmaps, and client requirements to the product and strategy teams.

What We Are Looking For

Must-Have

● Experience in B2B enterprise sales, account management, or business development — battery or energy storage industry background strongly preferred.

● Outcomes-driven: you measure yourself by pipeline converted and revenue closed, not by calls made or emails sent.

● Consultative, problem-first sales style — you ask before you pitch, and you qualify hard before you invest time.

● Willingness to travel for client visits, OEM factory calls, and field deployments across India.

● Strong written and verbal communication — crisp follow-up emails, comfortable in a boardroom with a VP.

● Self-starter who manages a pipeline without daily supervision.

Strong Plus

● Existing relationships with procurement, supply chain, or engineering contacts at battery OEMs or energy storage providers.

● Familiarity with proof-of-concept / pilot-driven enterprise sales cycles.

● Experience using a CRM (any) for pipeline and activity tracking.

Mindset

● You do thorough pre-meeting research — on the company, the business problem, and the person sitting across from you — before every client interaction.

● You are cognitively agile: you can draw on past experience and new learning to answer questions on the fly, even when the ask was not anticipated.

● You believe in building lasting relationships, not just closing commercial transactions — you want the client to call you first when something goes wrong.

● You do not disappear after a proposal goes out. You own the follow-through.

● You are comfortable selling a product that asks the client to change how they think about their asset — not just bolt on a tracker.

● Market intelligence from the field goes back to the team. You treat what you hear in client meetings as product input, not just sales noise.

What We Offer

● Fixed compensation of ₹14–18L per annum based on experience, plus a performance variable that can match the fixed component — total potential of ₹28–36L.  
● Direct mentorship and co-selling from the founder (Shailendra Singh, IIM Kozhikode, 10+ years building Ajjas).

● Real ownership of a rapidly growing vertical with paying clients from day one.

● Fast career growth: as Ajjas scales, this role scales with it.

● Live deployments and real revenue — you are not selling vapourware.

**Location & Travel**

Base: Navi Mumbai (Ajjas HQ). Travel required across India for client visits, OEM factory calls, and pilot deployments. Remote flexibility is available once you have achieved your Key Result Areas (KRAs) — until then, base location is expected.

**How to Apply**

Send your CV and a short note (3–5 sentences) on the most complex B2B deal you have worked on — what made it hard, and how it closed (or did not). Email: hr@ajjas.com

Warm referrals are welcome and given priority. If someone in your network knows Ajjas, mention their name

title: Lead- New Initiatives
description:
At Aftershoot, we’re building a global community of photographers who spend less time behind their screens and more time behind the lens. Every feature we create, every update we ship, is designed to make post-processing easier, faster, and smarter for photographers around the world.
  
  
From culling to editing to retouching. Our AI tools do all the heavy lifting, so photographers can focus on what they do best: capturing moments, telling stories, and creating magic.
  
  
We’re a fast-growing, passionate team backed over 200K+ active users globally. Double-digit ARR in less than 4 years, amazing investors and team who truly believe in our mission.
  
  
Our mission is clear: Become the default companion for every photographer in the world.
  
  
If you care deeply about building meaningful products, working with curious and driven teammates, and being part of a team that genuinely loves what they do, we’d love to meet you.
  
  
Let’s create the future of AI in photography, together.
  
  
🚀
**Your Mission:**
You own Photon's marketing end to end. Positioning, growth, channels, and the team behind it.
  
  
Photon is a different business from our flagship product. The audience is broader, the product is free, and the measure of success is people using it rather than a subscription funnel. Your first job is to scale what is already working, find what comes next, and build the activation and retention motion that turns downloads into an active user base.
  
  
You will also own marketing for Mastin Labs, sustaining the preset business and building the path that brings its customers into the wider Aftershoot ecosystem.
  
  
🎯
**What You Will Do:**

* Photon growth. You carry the user growth numbers. You define the metrics Photon is judged on and the benchmarks for activation and retention.
* Positioning and brand. Photon speaks to enthusiasts, not professionals. You define what the brand stands for, who it serves, and how it differs from Aftershoot, and you hold the standard for how that shows up on every surface.
* Acquisition and channel strategy. Scaling the channels already showing signal, opening the next ones, and deciding where Photon invests. Content, community, creators, app store, lifecycle, and paid where it earns its place.
* Go-to-market. Release and feature marketing, from positioning through to the campaigns behind each launch.
* Analytics and insight. Product usage and behavioural data, cohort analysis, and competitive and category tracking, translated into where the product and the marketing go next.
* Mastin Labs. Running the preset business through releases, catalogue marketing, and retention, while preserving the brand's identity, and building and measuring the migration path from Mastin Labs customers into the Aftershoot ecosystem.
* Cross-functional collaboration. Working with Product, Design, and Aftershoot's central marketing teams across paid, product marketing, content, brand, and partnerships to deliver work beyond what a small team could produce alone.
* Team leadership. Managing, coaching, and developing your team, and building it out as Photon scales.

💪
**What We're Looking For:**

* 8+ years in marketing, with a track record of growing a consumer or prosumer product where the audience is broad and adoption is driven by product experience rather than a sales motion
* Experience owning user growth numbers for a product rather than a single channel
* Breadth across positioning, content, community, lifecycle, and enough paid media literacy to brief and evaluate campaigns
* Strong grasp of activation and retention, and the analytical ability to work in cohorts rather than campaign reports
* Strong messaging and editorial judgement, with the ability to set the standard for copy rather than write all of it
* Comfort operating with ambiguity and the judgement to decide what not to do
* Experience managing and developing marketers

**What happens after you apply?**

* Step 1: If your profile aligns with our vibe and requirements for the role, our people team will reach out to you for a brief phone call.
* Step 2: If everything aligns, your next chat will be with one of your future team members to better understand the role and your experience.
* Step 3: You will then be given a task - this helps us evaluate your thought process and help you showcase your expertise.
* Step 4: If everything goes well, you will meet the leadership for a quick bar-raiser round.
* Step 5: If you do manage to clear all rounds, this is the point we make an offer, shake hands, and welcome you to the team.

**You will work with:**

* Captain: Rasheed
* Team Members: Sounak, Vasundhara and the rest of the Aftershoot team.

Key Responsibilities1. Account Ownership & Client Management

* Manage end-to-end Amazon operations for all Platinum clients.
* Be the primary point of contact; run review calls and share weekly and monthly performance reports.
* Build growth plans with clear targets and handle escalations quickly.

2. New Seller Onboarding & D2C Launch

* Help new sellers and brands start their ecommerce journey, from idea to first sale.
* Identify the right category by analysing demand, competition, margins and the client’s budget.
* Shortlist first products and choose the right manufacturer or supplier (quality, MOQ, pricing, compliance).
* Advise on inventory: initial order quantities, reorder planning and stocking.
* Guide the entire D2C launch: brand setup, website/Shopify store, Amazon account and Brand Registry, listings, pricing, launch ads and go-to-market plan.
* Set launch milestones, track progress and hand over to ongoing account management.

3. Listing & Catalog Management

* Oversee new listings, SKU creation, variations and bulk uploads.
* Ensure titles, bullets, descriptions, keywords and images are SEO-optimized and Amazon-compliant.
* Plan A+ Content, Brand Story, Storefronts and video content.
* Fix suppressed listings, catalog errors, hijackers and content mismatches; run regular audits to improve conversion.

4. Advertising (Amazon Ads)

* Plan, launch and optimize Sponsored Products, Brands and Display campaigns (DSP where relevant).
* Manage budgets, bids, targeting and negative keywords.
* Track and improve ACoS, TACoS, ROAS, CTR and CVR, and share optimization actions with clients.

5. FBA Inventory, Inbound & Operations

* Monitor stock levels, plan replenishment and avoid stock-outs and excess inventory.
* Manage inbound shipment plans, FNSKU labeling, prep requirements and dispatch to Amazon fulfilment centres.
* Track IPI score, storage fees and aged inventory; plan removals and liquidation.
* Audit FBA fees and file claims for lost/damaged inventory and overcharges.
* Coordinate with client warehouses and 3PLs; resolve stranded inventory, receiving delays, returns, cancellations and late shipments.

6. Pricing, Promotions & Growth

* Manage pricing, Buy Box performance and competitor monitoring.
* Plan deals and promotions: Lightning Deals, coupons, Prime Day, Great Indian Festival.
* Identify growth opportunities: new categories, ASINs, bundles and Brand Registry benefits.

7. Account Health & Compliance

* Keep Seller Central accounts healthy: ODR, policy compliance, IP complaints and notifications.
* Prepare Plans of Action (POA) and appeals for warnings, suspensions or deactivations.
* Manage Brand Registry, Transparency, GST documents and category approvals.
* Handle ratings and reviews; use Vine and Request-a-Review correctly.

8. Reporting & Analytics

* Build dashboards for sales, traffic, conversion, ad spend, returns and profitability.
* Use Business Reports, Brand Analytics and Ads reports to drive decisions.
* Prepare monthly client performance decks with insights and next steps.

9. Team Leadership

* Lead, train and monitor the listing, ads and catalog executives.
* Set daily/weekly targets, review work quality, maintain SOPs and support new joiners.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

* Graduate in any stream (MBA/BBA in Marketing or Ecommerce preferred).
* 2–7 years of hands-on experience managing Amazon seller accounts; team lead or manager experience preferred for senior profiles.
* Strong knowledge of Seller Central, Amazon Ads console and Brand Analytics (Vendor Central preferred).
* Proven end-to-end FBA experience: inbound shipments, inventory planning, fee audits, reimbursement claims, listing optimization, PPC and account health recovery.
* Hands-on knowledge of product research, category selection, manufacturer sourcing and D2C launch planning.
* Good Excel / Google Sheets skills (pivot tables, lookups, reports).
* Strong communication in English and Hindi.
* Good problem-solving and ability to handle multiple clients at once.

**Good to have:**

* Experience with Flipkart, Myntra, Meesho or Shopify/D2C.
* Tools such as Helium 10, Jungle Scout, Data Dive, Power BI or Looker Studio.
* Agency or client-servicing experience.
* Basic Photoshop/Canva for image and A+ briefs.

**Key performance Indicators:**

* Month-on-month sales growth of Platinum accounts against agreed targets.
* ACoS / TACoS within the range agreed with each client.
* At least 90% of active listings fully optimized and error-free.
* Account health and FBA inventory health (stock-outs, IPI score, aged inventory) within agreed ranges, with no critical policy issues left unresolved beyond the agreed turnaround time.
* Weekly and monthly client reports delivered on time.
* Client satisfaction and retention.
* Team output and quality of work.
* New seller launches completed on time and as per plan.

**What we offer:**

* Ownership of high-value Platinum accounts with real decision-making power.
* Growth path to Head of Ecommerce / Operations.
* Performance-based incentives

title: Chief Executive Officer
description:
Key Role & Responsibility

**Key responsibilities**

A. Strategic leadership and business transformation

• Develop and execute a comprehensive three-to-five-year strategic growth plan.

• Build Primenet into a ₹150–200 crore enterprise through organic expansion, strategic alliances and selective acquisitions.

• Transition the business from bandwidth-led revenue to higher-value managed services and recurring subscription models.

• Identify emerging opportunities in cybersecurity, SASE, SD-WAN, NaaS, AI-enabled security, cloud and data center connectivity.

• Create independent, accountable business verticals with clearly defined revenue, EBITDA and customer acquisition targets.

• Build a strong second-line leadership team and establish a performance-driven culture.

• Prepare the company for potential private equity investment, strategic partnerships or future capital raising.

**B. Cybersecurity business development**

The CEO must have a strong understanding of enterprise cybersecurity and the commercial ability to build a significant managed security business. Core responsibilities:

• Establish and scale a Managed Security Services Provider (MSSP) vertical.

• Develop SOC-as-a-Service offerings, using in-house capabilities or strategic SOC partners.

• Build managed offerings around:

o Managed Detection and Response (MDR) o Extended Detection and Response (XDR)

o Managed Firewall and Next-Generation Firewall

o SASE and Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA)

o DDoS protection o Security Information and Event Management (SIEM)

o Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT)

o Cloud security and endpoint security

• Develop annual and multi-year subscription contracts with enterprises and government customers.

• Establish technology alliances with leading cybersecurity OEMs such as Palo Alto Networks, Fortinet, Cisco, CrowdStrike and Check Point Software Technologies.

• Develop a cross-selling strategy for Primenet's existing enterprise customer base.

• Ensure delivery quality, incident-response readiness, regulatory compliance and security governance. Expected outcome: Establish cybersecurity as a major independent revenue and EBITDA contributor within three years.

C.
**Network-as-a-Service**
(NaaS) and managed connectivity The CEO will lead the transformation of Primenet's connectivity business into a scalable, recurring managed network services platform. Key areas:

• Launch NaaS solutions for enterprises with multi-location operations.

• Build managed SD-WAN, managed LAN, Wi-Fi-as-a-Service and Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) offerings.

• Integrate connectivity, networking equipment, monitoring, security and support under monthly or annual subscription models.

• Develop multi-branch connectivity solutions for banks, NBFCs, retailers, hospitality chains and manufacturing companies.

• Leverage Primenet's ISP licence, existing points of presence, network operations capabilities and infrastructure partnerships.

• Establish carrier-neutral and multi-operator connectivity options with SLA-backed uptime commitments.

• Build OEM partnerships with Cisco, Juniper, HPE Aruba, Fortinet and other networking providers.

• Drive automation in provisioning, monitoring, billing, customer service and network assurance.

• Improve utilization of existing network infrastructure while optimizing bandwidth procurement and operational costs.

Commercial focus: Increase average revenue per enterprise customer through bundled connectivity, managed networking and security services.

D. Cloud, data centers and digital infrastructure

• Scale cloud hosting, hybrid cloud, private cloud and managed cloud services.

• Develop partnerships with AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud and established Indian data center operators.

• Build cloud connectivity solutions, including direct connectivity and hybrid-cloud networking.

• Develop managed backup, disaster recovery and business continuity offerings.

• Identify opportunities in cloud security, colocation and infrastructure management.

• Expand relationships with government agencies and large enterprises requiring compliant hosting and managed infrastructure.

**E. Enterprise sales and market expansion**

The CEO must be a commercially driven leader capable of personally developing large strategic accounts.

• Build a national enterprise sales organization across North, West and South India.

• Drive C-level relationships with CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, CFOs and procurement heads.

• Target BFSI, GCCs, IT/ITES, manufacturing, healthcare, hospitality, education and government/PSU customers.

• Establish strategic account management for the top 100 enterprise customers.

• Create a dedicated enterprise hunting team and a separate customer expansion team.

• Develop channel partnerships, system integrator alliances and referral networks.

• Lead high-value contracts, strategic negotiations and complex solution-selling opportunities.

• Implement disciplined CRM management, sales forecasting and pipeline reviews. Priority: Move from transaction-based selling to long-term enterprise contracts with higher customer lifetime value. F. F.
**Financial management and profitability**

• Take full P&L responsibility across revenue, gross margin, EBITDA, cash flow and return on invested capital.

• Improve profitability through a higher share of cybersecurity, NaaS and managed services.

• Establish service-level profitability and customer-level contribution reporting.

• Optimize working capital, collections, vendor payments and capital expenditure.

• Introduce standardized commercial approval, pricing and discounting frameworks.

• Develop a disciplined acquisition and investment evaluation process.

• Prepare monthly operating reviews and quarterly board-level performance reports.

G.
**Strategic partnerships, M&A and capital raising**

• Identify strategic partners for cybersecurity, cloud, networking, SOC and managed services.

• Evaluate acquisitions of regional ISPs, MSSPs, cybersecurity integrators and cloud service providers.

• Establish OEM relationships that provide preferred commercial terms, technical certifications and joint go-to-market support.

• Develop relationships with private equity funds, strategic investors and institutional capital providers.

• Build an investment-ready organization with transparent reporting, predictable revenue and strong corporate governance.

title: Senior Manager – Growth (B2B)
description:
We are hiring a
**Senior Manager, Growth (B2B**
) to build the pipeline for MedhaviOne. You own go-to-market, demand generation, funnel, CRM and analytics across the University’s business verticals, and hand sales-ready opportunities to Business Development and Presales.

**Why now?**

Employers want job-ready talent, and skills are counting for more than degrees. Most are still finding out who can supply it.

* A pipeline that is predictable, not a lucky quarter.
* Every lead scored, routed and followed up.
* Every rupee of spend tied to an opportunity.

The base is built, with 600+ enterprise partners. We now need a growth engine that finds the next ones, and shows what works.

**What you will do?**

You own the B2B growth engine, from first touch to sales-ready.

* Write the go-to-market plan: target markets, ideal customer profiles, buyer personas, and annual and quarterly growth plans.

* Manage the whole funnel, from awareness to nurture to conversion, and fix the leaks.

* Run B2B campaigns with internal teams and agencies. Test constantly, and track attribution and ROI.
* Build target account lists, map stakeholders, enrich data, and qualify prospects on BANT using research and AI-assisted methods.
* Hand sales-ready prospects to Business Development and Presales, with the account intelligence they need.
* Track market and competitor moves, and bring insight to business leaders.
* Report weekly and monthly: dashboards, funnel analytics and recommendations. Numbers first, with the insight beside them.

**What you will deliver:**
MQLs, cost per lead, cost per opportunity, marketing-sourced pipeline, conversion at every funnel stage, and campaign ROI.

**Who we are looking for?**

**Must have**

* 6–9 years of work experience in B2B growth or marketing.
* A B2B pipeline you have owned end to end, with numbers you can show.
* Hands-on CRM and marketing automation experience (Zoho or equivalent).
* Comfort with analytics: funnel metrics, attribution, cost per lead and ROI.
* Experience managing agencies and performance channels.
* Clear, sharp writing and thinking.

**Good to have**

* Experience with ABM and outbound programmes.
* Experience building lead scoring and automation from scratch.
* Experience using AI tools for account and market research.

**How you work?**

* **Numbers-first.**

  You keep CRM data clean, and you meet deadlines.

  You test, learn, and drop what does not work.

  Strategy, funnel, CRM and pipeline, all in one role.
* **A real base.**
  You work with 600+ enterprise partners across 30+ sectors and a university campus.
* **Direct access.**
  You work with Business Heads and the leadership team.
* **A team behind you.**
  CRM, performance marketing, content, technology and agency partners.
* **Results you can see.**

Apply directly through this platform. Please do not email your application separately.

title: Sr Operations & Logistics Manager
description:
**Sr. Business Operations Manager – Rider Experience & Consumer Insights**
**Uber | India & South Asia**
**About The Role**
At Uber, millions of riders trust us to get them where they need to go, every day. But what makes a great ride experience? What frustrates riders, what builds their trust, and what makes them choose Uber again and again?
  
  
We are looking for someone who is
**obsessed with understanding consumers**
— someone who is endlessly curious about what riders think, feel and experience, and passionate about turning those insights into meaningful change.
  
  
In this role, you will be the
**champion of the rider's voice within Uber**
, ensuring that consumer needs, expectations and pain points are at the heart of how we build products, design experiences and make business decisions.
  
  
You will shape Uber's Rider Experience strategy across India & South Asia, working closely with Product, Operations, Marketing and Marketplace teams to make Uber the most trusted and preferred mobility platform.
  
  
This is a unique opportunity to combine deep consumer understanding with strategic thinking and real business impact — moving beyond understanding what riders want to actually making it happen.
  
  

* Drive Consumer Insights & Problem Solving: Bring structure to ambiguous consumer problems, triangulating quantitative data, qualitative research and field insights to uncover root causes, size opportunities and drive actionable recommendations.
* Reimagine the Rider Experience: Identify and prioritize friction points across the end-to-end rider journey, with a focus on new rider experience, satisfaction and retention. Partner with cross-functional teams to drive measurable improvements.
* Build & Scale Rider Value Propositions: Identify opportunities for differentiated consumer propositions, validate them through research and experimentation, and partner with Product and Marketing to launch and scale impactful solutions.
* Own Critical Consumer Journeys: Drive improvements across priority areas including payments, rider communications and engagement programs, balancing consumer experience, business impact and investment efficiency.
* Champion the Voice of the Rider: Build a deep understanding of rider needs, frustrations and unmet expectations by combining consumer research, VOC and behavioral data. Translate insights into clear priorities that influence business and product decisions.
* Embed Consumer Obsession Across Uber: Bring compelling consumer insights and data-backed recommendations into leadership discussions, challenge assumptions and mobilize teams to act on what matters most to riders.

**What You'll Need**

* 5+ years of experience in consumer insights, customer experience, consumer strategy, product, growth or related fields.
* Consumer obsession: Deep curiosity about human behavior, strong empathy and a natural instinct to uncover what consumers really need.
* Analytical rigor & structured problem solving: Ability to bring clarity to ambiguous problems, synthesize complex datasets and marry quantitative evidence with qualitative insights.
* Insight-to-action orientation: Proven ability to translate consumer understanding into sharp strategic recommendations, prioritized initiatives and measurable business outcomes.
* Strong ownership & execution: Comfortable navigating ambiguity, driving cross-functional initiatives and moving from problem identification to implementation.
* Storytelling & influence: Ability to simplify complex insights, build compelling narratives and influence senior stakeholders to champion the consumer perspective.

**Ready to Ride?**
This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.
  
  
Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.
  
  
Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.

title: Sr.Analyst/ Associate Manager- Growth & Strategy
description:

This role is about 50% thinking and 50% doing. You will build the analysis, and you will also drive the work that follows from it.
  
  
What you'll do

* Break markets into segments and adjacencies, build market maps and sizing views
* Build business cases and financial models for new products, segments, and support pricing or packaging decisions.
* Support go-to-market for new products through ICP definition, target-account research, design-partner pipelines, and positioning inputs.

**Competitive & market intelligence**

* Track competitors across in target areas, find adjacent players, covering positioning, pricing, product, GTM motion, and disclosures.

**Strategic programs & execution**

* Own execution of one or two cross-functional initiatives at a time: planning, milestones, tracking, flagging risks early, and seeing them through to closure.

**Synthesis & communication**

* Write crisp notes, one-pagers, and presentations for leadership

Build reusable frameworks and templates so recurring analysis gets faster and more consistent.

* MBA from a Tier-1 or Tier-2 institute (preferred not must have)

* Strong analytical and financial modeling skills

experience in B2B SaaS or education, and exposure to GTM, pricing, or M&A/diligence work.

description:
**It’s a good feeling to know you're doing your best with purpose every day.**
At Artivion, we manufacture high-quality products and solutions for the treatment of aortic diseases. Together with surgeons worldwide, we save lives. In doing so, we rely on the strengths of each and every employee. Your strength counts, too: As an important link in the chain, you make a contribution to saving lives together with us. Contribute your strengths and let us grow together.
  
  
**We are hiring**
**Sales Manager, India Subcontinent**
**Location: Mumbai, India**
**Your strength**

* Bachelor's degree in Science or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience
* 5–8 years of relevant experience in the medical device industry, preferably with expertise in complex aortic technologies
* Strong clinical knowledge of cardiovascular surgery, endovascular interventions and stent graft technologies
* Experience in medical device sales, business development and clinical case support
* Knowledge of CT imaging, case planning and peripheral interventional procedures is an advantage
* Proven ability to develop customer relationships, identify business opportunities and achieve sales targets
* Strong clinical and analytical problem-solving skills, with the ability to address complex, patient-specific clinical situations
* Experience engaging with cardiovascular surgeons, physicians and Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs)
* Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills
* Highly motivated, results-oriented and able to work independently in a demanding commercial environment
* Good IT literacy, including proficiency in Microsoft Excel and presentation tools
* Willingness to travel regularly and provide clinical support outside standard working hours, including weekends and holidays when required

**Your contribution**

* Drive sales growth and business development across the India Subcontinent, strengthening Artivion's market presence and achieving monthly, quarterly and annual revenue targets
* Develop and execute sales strategies based on customer needs, market opportunities, competitive dynamics and pricing considerations
* Identify and develop new hospital accounts while expanding the adoption of Artivion technologies within existing customers
* Promote the Artivion portfolio, including On-X Mechanical Heart Valves, BioGlue and Stent Grafts, through targeted commercial and clinical initiatives
* Build and maintain strong relationships with cardiovascular surgeons, interventional specialists, hospital stakeholders and Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs)
* Develop KOL engagement plans and strategic account initiatives to support sustainable business growth
* Provide clinical and technical support during cardiovascular and endovascular procedures, including in operating rooms and cardiac catheterization laboratories
* Support physicians with CT imaging assessments, stent graft case planning and product selection to help achieve optimal clinical outcomes
* Drive awareness, education and adoption of endovascular and complex aortic technologies through clinical workshops, case support and peer-to-peer discussions
* Support educational initiatives addressing the management of Acute Type A aortic dissections and contribute to the development of targeted Centers of Excellence (COEs)
* Organize and participate in product presentations, physician training sessions, webinars, workshops and professional society initiatives
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders to implement marketing programs and increase awareness of Artivion's therapies
* Develop customer-specific pricing proposals in accordance with company policies and commercial guidelines
* Manage product inventory, sales forecasting, stock planning and expiry monitoring for directly managed accounts
* Respond proactively to customer needs, product inquiries and complaints while maintaining high standards of customer service
* Provide timely clinical support for emergency procedures when required, including outside regular working hours
* Ensure compliance with Artivion's quality policies, procedures and applicable regulatory requirements, maintaining a strong commitment to patient safety and product quality

**Our strength**

* An international team with a strong focus on quality, innovation and collaboration
* Comprehensive onboarding and continuous professional development opportunities
* A commercially impactful role combining sales development, clinical expertise and market expansion
* The opportunity to drive the adoption of innovative cardiovascular and endovascular technologies across the India Subcontinent
* Close collaboration with leading cardiovascular surgeons, KOLs and healthcare institutions
* An innovative portfolio of life-saving cardiovascular and aortic technologies
* A meaningful career with a clear mission: saving lives

**Apply now and become part of the Artivion team.**
We look forward to receiving your application in English.
  
  
**Contact**
Brian Russo – T: +41 435 08 39 01
  
  
Artivion, Inc.
  
  
www.artivion.com

description:

title: Business Travel Sales Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Plan Journeys Pvt. Ltd., founded in 2011, is an IATA-recognized corporate travel provider specializing in tailored business travel solutions. The company offers personalized air ticketing, domestic and international travel bookings, hotel reservations, and consulting support to optimize travel plans. With a focus on cost-effective itineraries, Plan Journeys designs travel programs that align with client budgets and business objectives. The team collaborates closely with corporate clients to ensure efficient, reliable, and well-managed travel experiences.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Business Travel Sales Manager role based in Delhi, India. The Business Travel Sales Manager will identify and develop new corporate accounts, nurture relationships with existing clients, and promote the company’s business travel services and solutions. Daily responsibilities include understanding client travel requirements, preparing proposals and quotations, negotiating contracts and rates, and ensuring adherence to client budgets and travel policies. The role also involves coordinating with operations and ticketing teams to deliver seamless service, monitoring account performance, and preparing regular sales reports and forecasts. The manager will stay updated on industry trends, airline and hotel offerings, and travel regulations to provide informed guidance to clients and support long-term business growth.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong Travel Sales and Business Travel expertise, with the ability to understand corporate travel needs and solutions.
* Proven experience in Sales and Sales Management, including pipeline development, client relationship management, and negotiation.
* Ability to manage Budgeting aspects of corporate travel programs, ensuring cost-effective and value-driven itineraries.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with a customer-focused and consultative approach.
* Relevant experience in corporate or business travel agencies; familiarity with IATA processes is an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Tourism, Hospitality, or a related field is preferred.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and proficiency in common office and CRM tools.
* Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and adapt in a fast-paced environment.

title: MIS Analyst
description:
**Company:** Immunosciences  
**Location:** Okhla Phase 3, New Delhi  
**Experience:** 4–9 Years (Relevant hands-on experience mandatory)  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Working Days:** 6 Days a Week

Job Summary

Immunosciences is looking for a highly analytical and technically skilled MIS & Data Analyst to manage, analyse and interpret large volumes of business data, particularly across D2C (Direct-to-Consumer) and e-commerce operations.

The candidate will be responsible for developing automated reports, creating interactive dashboards, analysing sales and marketing performance, tracking business KPIs and providing actionable insights to support business decisions.

We are looking for someone with strong expertise in Advanced Excel, SQL, Python, Tableau/Power BI and hands-on experience working with D2C, e-commerce and marketing data.

Key Responsibilities1. MIS Reporting & Data Management

* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly MIS reports for management.
* Manage, consolidate and analyse large datasets from multiple business sources.
* Maintain sales, revenue, order, inventory, customer and marketing performance reports.
* Develop automated reporting systems to reduce manual efforts.
* Ensure data accuracy, consistency and timely reporting.
* Build and maintain centralised databases and reporting structures.

2. D2C & E-commerce Data Analytics

* Analyse D2C sales performance across the company's website and online sales channels.
* Track orders, revenue, AOV (Average Order Value), conversion rates, cancellations, returns and refunds.
* Analyse customer acquisition, repeat purchases, retention and customer lifetime value (CLTV).
* Monitor SKU-wise, product-wise and category-wise sales performance.
* Track website traffic, conversion funnels and customer buying behaviour.
* Analyse COD vs prepaid orders, RTO (Return to Origin) and delivery performance.
* Monitor channel-wise revenue and profitability.
* Identify trends, gaps and opportunities to improve business performance.

3. Marketing & Performance Analytics

* Analyse digital marketing performance across Meta Ads, Google Ads and other marketing channels.
* Track CAC, ROAS, ROI, CPA, CTR, CPC and conversion rates.
* Prepare campaign-wise and platform-wise performance reports.
* Analyse marketing spend against revenue generated.
* Measure influencer and affiliate campaign performance wherever applicable.
* Provide insights on customer acquisition costs and marketing efficiency.

4. Dashboard Development & Data Visualisation

* Create interactive dashboards using Tableau and/or Power BI.
* Develop real-time or regularly refreshed business performance dashboards.
* Build management dashboards covering sales, marketing, inventory and operations.
* Connect multiple data sources for consolidated reporting.
* Present complex data in an easy-to-understand visual format.

5. Data Analysis & Automation

* Use Python for data cleaning, data processing, analysis and automation.
* Write SQL queries to extract, filter and analyse data from databases.
* Automate repetitive reports and data workflows.
* Identify data discrepancies and troubleshoot reporting issues.
* Perform trend analysis, customer segmentation and business performance analysis.
* Generate actionable insights and recommendations for management.

6. Cross-Functional Coordination

* Coordinate with marketing, sales, finance, operations and e-commerce teams.
* Understand business requirements and develop relevant reports.
* Support management with data-backed business decisions.
* Maintain proper documentation of reports, data sources and reporting processes.

Required Technical Skills & Tools

**Must-Have Skills:**

* Advanced MS Excel – Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP, VLOOKUP, INDEX-MATCH, Power Query, Power Pivot and advanced formulas.
* SQL – Data extraction, joins, subqueries, aggregations and query writing.
* Python – Pandas, NumPy, data cleaning, analysis and automation.
* Tableau / Power BI – Dashboard creation, data modelling and visualisation.
* Google Sheets – Advanced formulas, data management and reporting.
* Data analysis, interpretation and business reporting.

**D2C & E-commerce Tools (Preferred):**

* Shopify / WooCommerce
* Google Analytics 4 (GA4)
* Google Search Console
* Meta Ads Manager
* Google Ads
* CRM and customer data platforms
* Razorpay / payment gateway reports
* Shiprocket / courier and logistics dashboards
* Unicommerce / other order management systems
* Marketplace seller dashboards (Amazon, Flipkart, etc.)

**Additional Advantage:**

* Knowledge of ETL and data integration.
* Experience with APIs and automated data extraction.
* Knowledge of MySQL / PostgreSQL.
* Experience with BigQuery.
* Understanding of data warehousing and database management.
* Experience with forecasting, cohort analysis and customer segmentation.

Eligibility & Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Analytics, IT, Commerce or a related field.
* 2–4 years of relevant professional experience in MIS, Business Analytics or Data Analytics.
* Mandatory hands-on experience in Excel, SQL and Python.
* Practical experience in Tableau or Power BI.
* Prior experience handling D2C, e-commerce or retail business data is strongly preferred.
* Ability to independently manage large datasets and build automated reporting systems.
* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent attention to detail and communication skills.

What We Are Looking For

* A candidate who can independently handle end-to-end MIS and data analytics.
* Someone comfortable working with large volumes of D2C business data.
* Ability to convert raw data into meaningful business insights.
* Strong understanding of sales, marketing, customer and operational metrics.
* A proactive professional who can automate reports and build scalable dashboards.

title: Executive Director, Professional Programs

**Job Requirements**

* Demonstrated ability to build and execute a partner business plan across teams or regions, connecting client demand, offers, pipeline, capability investment and measurable results
* Working command of partner programs: co-selling, field incentives, funding, marketplace routes, competencies, certifications and partner standing Explain the mechanisms you personally used and their business value

* Commercial fluency in technology services: explain qualification, proposals, contracting, bookings, revenue, margin and delivery capacity, and show how your own decisions affected a pursuit or account

* A bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant professional experience
* **Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with enterprise AI platforms and the commercial and delivery choices behind workplace adoption, API applications and agent-based workflows
* Relevant graduate study, including an MBA, and advanced technical certifications are weighted favorably
* Experience engaging OpenAI or comparable AI-platform business and technical teams, translating their capabilities into services propositions and coordinating with hyperscaler partners
* Experience building a joint client proposition across an AI lab, a hyperscaler and a services firm, including marketplace transactions or co-sell execution
* Use AI and agents in your own work Show a workflow you personally built or configured, the tools and context it uses, how you evaluate results, where a person makes the decision and how you recover from failure Explain the measurable improvement, including review effort and cost

**How We Work**

Regular attendance at the designated Coforge office in Greater Noida or Bengaluru and in-person engagement with clients, partners and colleagues are part of the role Expect approximately 25–50% travel as the assignment requires Agree sustainable working hours that provide overlap with the markets supported

* Pending and ongoing deliverables.

* Ensure proper coordination between account management and internal execution teams.
* Conduct regular internal reviews of ongoing projects and client requirements.
* Ensure all briefs, approvals, feedback, and deliverables are documented.
* Monitor team productivity, timelines, and quality of output.
* Take ownership of escalations and ensure timely resolution.
* Maintain structured communication through official email channels and project management processes.

Required Skills & Competencies

* Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
* Strong understanding of digital marketing, advertising, and brand communication.
* Experience in managing multiple client accounts simultaneously.
* Ability to identify business opportunities and drive revenue growth.
* Strong analytical skills and understanding of social media and paid media metrics.
* Strategic thinking with an execution-oriented approach.
* Excellent project management and team coordination abilities.
* Ability to handle client escalations and challenging situations.
* Proficiency in PowerPoint, Excel, Google Sheets, and reporting tools.

Performance Area

Strong client relationships and account stability

Business Growth

Upselling, cross-selling and additional revenue

Monthly and quarterly growth plans

Client Satisfaction

Team Coordination

Ideal Candidate Profile

What We Expect from This Role

The Client Servicing Manager should not function merely as a communication bridge between the client and internal teams. The person must act as an account growth partner, taking complete ownership of client satisfaction, strategic planning, business expansion, and execution.

title: Manager Strategic and Partnership
description:
**Organisation: Triguna – The Science of Living

Position: Manager – Strategic and Partnership

Location: New Delhi

Experience Required: 3–5 Years

Salary: As per industry norms (commensurate with experience and expertise)

Employment Type: Full-Time

About Team Triguna

Triguna – The Science of Living is a Delhi-based not-for-profit organisation working towards building safe, skilled, and sustainable communities. The organisation focuses on creating meaningful social impact through initiatives in Education, Healthcare, Livelihood, Skill Development, Road Safety, Environmental Sustainability, and Community Development.

Team Triguna collaborates with corporates, CSR foundations, philanthropic institutions, government bodies, and implementation partners to design and execute impactful social development programmes.

Role Overview

Team Triguna is looking for a dynamic, result-oriented and experienced Manager – Strategic Partnerships to lead CSR partnerships, corporate fundraising, and institutional collaborations.

The ideal candidate must have hands-on experience in developing and managing CSR partnerships, identifying funding opportunities, preparing project proposals, engaging with corporate CSR teams, and securing CSR grants for social development initiatives.

The candidate will be responsible for building a strong partnership pipeline, developing long-term corporate relationships, and converting strategic opportunities into sustainable funding and implementation partnerships.

Prior experience in CSR partnerships, corporate fundraising, or CSR business development is mandatory.

Key Roles & Responsibilities

1. CSR Partnerships & Corporate Relations

A) Identify and develop strategic relationships with corporates, CSR foundations, PSUs, and philanthropic institutions.

B). Build and maintain relationships with CSR Heads, Corporate Affairs Heads, Sustainability Teams, and senior corporate leadership.

C). Identify potential CSR funding opportunities aligned with Team Triguna's thematic areas.

D). Develop and manage a robust pipeline of prospective CSR partners.

E). Represent the organisation in corporate meetings, networking events, CSR forums, and partnership discussions.

2. CSR Proposal Development & Fundraising

- Research and identify CSR funding opportunities through corporate websites, CSR portals, annual reports, and other relevant platforms.

- Develop concept notes, project proposals, budgets, presentations, and partnership pitches.

- Coordinate with internal programme teams to develop customised CSR proposals.

- Lead proposal submissions, negotiations, and partnership closures.

- Achieve assigned fundraising and partnership acquisition targets.

3. Partnership Management & Relationship Building

- Manage existing CSR partnerships and ensure effective communication with corporate partners.

- Coordinate with programme and implementation teams to ensure timely project updates and deliverables.

- Facilitate MoUs, agreements, work orders, and other partnership documentation.

- Ensure timely submission of progress reports, utilisation certificates, impact reports, and other donor requirements.

- Build long-term relationships to encourage repeat funding and multi-year partnerships.

4. Strategic Planning & Business Development

- Develop annual and quarterly CSR fundraising strategies.

- Explore new funding avenues and institutional collaborations.

- Identify opportunities for scaling existing programmes through corporate partnerships.

- Analyse CSR trends, corporate funding priorities, and emerging development sector opportunities.

- Maintain a comprehensive CRM/database of corporate prospects, meetings, proposals, and partnership status.

5. Internal Coordination & Reporting

- Work closely with the Founder/CEO and programme leadership on partnership strategies.

- Prepare weekly and monthly business development reports.

- Track fundraising targets, proposal conversion rates, and partnership performance.

- Ensure proper documentation and coordination throughout the CSR partnership lifecycle.

Required Qualifications & Experience

- Master's degree in Social Work (MSW), MBA, Development Studies, Social Sciences, Public Administration, devlopment communications or a related discipline.

- 3–5 years of relevant professional experience in CSR partnerships, corporate fundraising, or institutional business development.

- Mandatory hands-on experience working with corporate CSR teams and securing CSR funding.

- Strong understanding of CSR provisions under Section 135 of the Companies Act, 2013.

- Experience in preparing CSR proposals, project budgets, concept notes, and presentations.

- Established understanding of the development sector and NGO/CSR ecosystem.

- Excellent communication, negotiation, networking, and presentation skills.

- Proficiency in MS Office, Excel, PowerPoint, and online research.

Key Competencies

- Strategic thinking and business development orientation.

- Strong corporate networking and relationship management.

- Excellent written and verbal communication.

- Ability to independently manage multiple partnership opportunities.

- Strong negotiation and stakeholder management skills.

- Target-oriented approach with a focus on fundraising outcomes.

- Ability to work independently and collaboratively with cross-functional teams.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The performance of the Manager – Strategic Partnerships will be assessed on:

1. Number of new corporate CSR partnerships developed.

2. Total CSR funding mobilised against assigned targets.

3. Number of proposals submitted and conversion ratio.

4. Number of corporate meetings and qualified leads generated.

5. Successful closure of MoUs, agreements, and CSR projects.

6. Retention and expansion of existing CSR partnerships.

7. Timely submission of proposals, reports, and partnership documentation.

8. Quality and growth of the organisation's corporate partnership pipeline.

What We Offer

- Opportunity to work on meaningful social impact initiatives.

- Exposure to leading corporates, CSR foundations, and development sector stakeholders.

- An opportunity to contribute to organisational growth and strategic decision-making.

- Professional growth in the CSR and social development ecosystem.

- Competitive compensation as per industry standards.

Application Process

Interested candidates may share their updated CV along with a brief note highlighting their CSR partnership experience, key corporate associations, and fundraising achievements.

Email: info@teamtriguna.org

Subject Line: Application – Manager Strategic Partnerships – Team Triguna

Last date to Apply 30th November 2016**

title: Account Manager
description:
**Department:**
Commercial - Sales & Account Management

**Location:**
Gurugram, India

**Description**
**About the role:**
Aurora is an industry leader in providing energy market forecasts, analysis, insights, and consultancy due to two reasons – 1) a highly skilled technical team and 2) an active commercial team who are well integrated with our client base, helping them make better informed investment decisions. We are seeking an Account Manager to sell our products and services which help the transition towards a more sustainable world. You will work in a dynamic, multi-national team responsible for sales and account management activities of our subscription services. You will play a key role in all aspects of client interactions and business development. The role will focus on creating/ developing sales opportunities for our full range of products.
  
  
The successful candidate will combine a strong commercial mindset, great communication and relationship management skills, passion to develop new business, high eagerness to learn, and interest in energy markets. You will work in a young, dynamic, stimulating, demanding and collaborative environment.
  
  
You will join our APAC commercial team, which is expected to continue growing and offer potential for progression, including through international expansion and creating new data and software-based solutions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and manage a portfolio of approximately 50 clients across APAC and other global markets, serving as the primary relationship holder and day-to-day point of contact
* Drive revenue retention and growth through proactive account management, including renewal planning, price escalation management, and identification of cross-sell and upsell opportunities across Aurora’s data, analytics, and software product suite
* Conduct regular client engagement activities — including check-in calls, product demonstrations, business reviews, and on-site visits — to maintain high satisfaction and deepen account relationships
* Develop a thorough understanding of each client’s business, investment mandate, and decision-making structure to position Aurora’s products effectively and broaden stakeholder coverage within accounts
* Monitor account health indicators and proactively address risks to retention, escalating where appropriate and coordinating internally to resolve client issues
* Lead commercial negotiations and contracting for renewals and expansions, working within Aurora’s pricing and approval frameworks
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of account activity, pipeline, and renewal forecasts in Salesforce CRM
* Collaborate closely with Aurora’s research, product, and customer success teams to ensure clients are deriving maximum value from their subscriptions and are aware of relevant new content, tools, and platform features
* Represent Aurora at client meetings, industry events, and conferences across the APAC region, including periodic travel to key markets
* Contribute to team and regional commercial planning, sharing account insights and client feedback to support product development and go-to-market strategy

**Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**
**Required attributes:**

* Minimum of 3 years’ experience in account management, client success, or a similar client-facing commercial role, ideally within a data, analytics, research, or SaaS business
* Demonstrated ability to manage and grow a portfolio of clients, with a track record of strong retention and revenue expansion
* Strong commercial instincts and a consultative approach to client relationships — able to identify client needs and connect them to the right product or solution
* Excellent relationship management and communication skills, with the ability to engage credibly with senior stakeholders including investors, developers, and financial institutions
* Highly organised and self-directed, with the ability to prioritise across a large and diverse client portfolio
* Comfortable operating in a data-heavy, technically complex environment — able to communicate analytical content clearly to non-specialist audiences
* Motivated by hitting commercial targets and contributing to team performance
* A can-do attitude and willingness to contribute beyond core responsibilities, including improving internal processes and sharing market knowledge with colleagues
* Intellectual curiosity and an interest in the energy transition, power markets, and Aurora’s client base across APAC

**Desirable attributes:**

* Experience selling or managing accounts for subscription-based data, research, or software products
* Familiarity with energy markets, renewable energy, or the broader energy transition landscape in APAC
* Experience working with clients in financial services — including infrastructure investors, project finance banks, or energy developers
* Experience with Salesforce or another CRM platform

**What we offer**
Some of the benefits we include are:

* Accidental, term life and medical insurance
* Hybrid Work model
* Employee’s Provident Fund Scheme
* Maternity leave
* A fun, informal, collaborative and international work culture
* Access to the Aurora Academy, our training programme offering a range of opportunities to develop your skills within the responsibilities of your role and within the wider context of the industry.
* Access to our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP), offering a complete support network that offers expert advice and compassionate guidance 24/7/365, covering a wide range of personal and professional aspects

The Company is committed to the principle that no employee or job applicant shall receive unfavorable treatment on grounds of age, disability, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity.
  
  
To apply, please submit your Résumé / CV, a personal summary, your salary expectations and please inform us of your notice period.
  
  
Unfortunately, we are unable to accept applications via email, telephone, or social media platforms. To be considered for this position, please submit your application using the link provided. Applications submitted through any other channel will not be reviewed.

title: Associate Manager (Strategy & Growth)
description:
**Associate Manager (Strategy and Growth)**

**Department**
: Strategy & Growth

**Location:**
Gurgaon

**About Us**
: BharatRohan Airborne Innovations Ltd. is a leading Ag-tech firm based in India, committed to revolutionizing agriculture by empowering farmers with advanced technology solutions. Our mission is to ensure sustainable and secure food supply chains while enhancing farmers' profitability. With expertise in Hyperspectral Imaging and UAV-based decision support systems, we are reshaping agriculture and making a significant impact on the industry.

**About the role**

We are looking for a dynamic and result-oriented Associate Manager (Strategy & Growth) to drive business expansion across BharatRohan's agri-tech and agricultural value chain businesses. The role involves developing B2B partnerships, managing agri-input sales, generating business opportunities for drone monitoring and spraying projects, and coordinating procurement for D2C products.

The candidate will be responsible for identifying new markets, developing sales strategies, managing client relationships, driving revenue growth, and coordinating with internal teams to ensure successful business execution.

**Key Roles & Responsibilities**

1. Agri-tech Business Development & Sales

* Identify and develop new business opportunities across the agri-tech sector.

* Conduct client meetings, product demonstrations, and business presentations.

2. Agri-Input Sales Management

4. Agricultural Produce Procurement & D2C Business

* Understand customer requirements and provide suitable solutions.
* Maintain customer information and sales updates in the CRM.
* Ensure customer satisfaction and long-term business relationships.

7. Reports & Cross-Functional Coordination

* Maintain sales reports, customer databases, and sales pipeline records.
* Track leads, conversions, revenue, and business performance.
* Coordinate with procurement, farmer management, operations, and technical teams.
* Ensure timely execution of customer requirements and business commitments.
* Share regular progress updates with management.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong communication, negotiation, and business development skills.
* Experience in B2B sales, client management, and business growth.
* Understanding of agriculture, agritech, and agri-input markets.

* Understanding of procurement, vendor management, and supply chain operations.
* Strong market research, analytical, and strategic planning abilities.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and CRM tools.
* Strong coordination, problem-solving, and relationship management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple business activities and achieve revenue targets.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds to join our team and contribute to our mission of reshaping Indian agriculture through technology and innovation.*

title: Relationship Manager (Wealth Mgmt.)
description:
**About Turtle**

Turtle is a fee-only, SEBI-registered investment advisory firm serving returning NRIs and high-income Indian professionals with full-stack, cross-border financial planning. No commissions, no product-pushing, just a fiduciary practice built around one moment: when a client actually feels the value of the knowledge we've handed them.

**The Role**

Our tech team has automated most of the repeatable, standard-process work: reminders, document chasers, scheduling nudges. What's left is the part that actually needs a human, catching the situation that doesn't fit the standard flow, and making the right call on it.

You'll sit between clients and advisors, watching for the moments automation can't handle: a client going quiet before a renewal, an advisor stuck on an unusual case, a process that's technically "done" but the outcome doesn't feel right. You fix it, and you tell the tech team what to build next.

**What You'll Do**

* Handle the exceptions, escalations, and judgment calls that fall outside our automated workflows
* Watch client and advisor journeys for early signs of something going sideways, before it becomes a problem
* Design and implement playbooks for repeatable, efficient client-advisor interactions
* Step in directly with clients or advisors when a human touch actually matters
* Work closely with the tech team: flag what should be automated next, and test what they build
* Own the edge cases and one-off requests that don't have a system built for them yet

**Who We're Looking For**

* Sharp judgment: knows the difference between "follow the process" and "this needs a real decision"
* Comfortable being the last line of defence when automation doesn't cover it
* Clear communicator, equally at ease with clients, advisors, and the tech team
* Curious about where the real gaps are, not just executing what's already defined
* Calm under pressure, especially when several things need attention at once

**Qualifications**

***Required***

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline
* 3-5 years of experience in operations, client success, or relationship management
* Comfortable working alongside a tech team, translating real-world friction into clear requirements

***Preferred***

* Prior exposure to financial services, wealth management, or fintech
* Experience giving feedback that shaped a product, tool, or workflow

**What You'll Get**

* Real ownership of the human layer of client experience, not busywork the tech team has already solved
* A direct line to engineering; your feedback becomes their roadmap
* A close working relationship with founders and advisors, not a large hierarchy
* A front-row view of how a fiduciary advisory firm runs, end to end

Note: This is a work-from-office role based in New Delhi.
