title: Senior Specialist, Customer Data & AI (Gurgaon OR Noida)
description:
**About Amplify Health**

**Who We Are**

Amplify Health Asia Pte. Limited (Amplify Health) is a pan-Asian health technology and analytics company which brings together health technology assets, proprietary data analytics and healthcare expertise to support innovation across the healthcare value chain.

Headquartered in Singapore, Amplify Health operates in 10 markets across the region: Australia, Hong Kong, India, Indonesia, Malaysia, New Zealand, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam.

Amplify Health develops integrated solutions that empower healthcare payors, providers and policymakers across Asia to identify value and drive new partnerships, understand variation and address systemic inefficiencies—with the aim of improving outcomes for individuals and the sustainability of health systems.

Powered by a clinically enriched data foundation, Amplify Health’s health intelligence platform combines modular AI solutions, context-aware automation and deep regional insights to offer localised, AI-powered health solutions spanning health payment integrity to chronic disease management. The company’s technology has earned recognition at several industry competitions, including the Celent Model Insurer Awards, ITC Asia Awards and SBR Technology Excellence Awards.

As an ISO27001 certified organisation, Amplify Health maintains clearly defined policies, structured oversight mechanisms and ongoing risk assessments that ensure alignment with global best practices on enterprise data security.

**Our Vision and Ambition**

To build the leading healthcare AI and platform services company in Asia that transforms the delivery of health and wellness for patients and communities by combining and leveraging the distinctive and complementary assets and strengths of AIA and Discovery.

Amplify Health will simplify access to health data and AI Innovation to accelerate distinct and disruptive healthcare value insights and resulting improvements in health outcomes through value-based care, personalised care plans and aligning individuals’ lifestyle/ behavioural choices.

By 2028, Amplify Health will have in place one of Asia’s strongest health-tech and AI capabilities; a comprehensive, integrated health technology stack supported by precision insights derived from proprietary data pools.

**The Position**

We are hiring a Customer Data & AI Lead to serve as the single accountable owner of the Data & AI outcome for one customer, across every product they run. This role configures and fine-tunes product models to the customers’ reality, migrates legacy pipelines onto productised ones, and keeps everything healthy in production, without ever changing product code.

The ideal candidate combines depth in analytics, machine learning, NLP and generative AI with the integration judgement to make models/ insights work against real customer data, and the stakeholder confidence to say no to a scope request without damaging the relationship. The candidate leads all data scientists on the customer implementation team.

**Responsibilities**

**Customer Ownership and Technical Leadership**

* Own the end-to-end Data & AI outcome for one customer, across every product in scope.
* Act as senior technical authority for the customer implementation scope, leading all data scientists.
* Translate customer problems into solutions deliverable within the product's supported boundary.
* Decide customer-side technical direction; raise a change request rather than build beyond the boundary.

**Data Flow and Integration**

* Work with data engineering team to verify customer data against product data contracts, and drive conformance rather than absorb the gap.
* Migrate legacy customer -specific pipelines onto productised ones, without breaking live delivery.

**Model Configuration and Delivery**

* Configure and fine-tune ML, NLP and GenAI models using approved training code and artifacts, never new product code.
* Run the implementation-readiness gate before any customer commitment is made.
* Classify every customer request as configuration, enhancement, bounded extension or out-of-product before work starts.
* Own technical acceptance of the solution on behalf of the pod.

**Production Health and Monitoring**

* Own monitoring, drift detection, retraining triggers and named ownership for every live model at the customer.
* Diagnose degradation before the customer reports it, and lead incident response and rollback.
* Keep model documentation and customer -context knowledge current, so it does not leave when a person does.
* Re-check subgroup performance, oversight capacity and fairness evidence at the required cadence.

**Stakeholder Management, analytics and Value**

* Explain models, defend results and manage expectations with customer technical and business stakeholders.
* Work with Customer Success and the Implementation Lead on adoption and value realisation.
* Escalate product gaps into the roadmap rather than solving them locally.
* Communicate uncertainty, trade-offs and limitations honestly to non-technical audiences.
* Deliver ad-hoc analysis and insight for the customer, validate metrics against their data, and lead dashboards that track adoption and realised value.

**Capability Building**

* Build cross-product certification coverage, so the pod can work across all the products.
* Coach and develop the data scientists, raising delivery and scientific standards.
* Contribute customer learning and reuse opportunities back to the product teams.

**Candidate Profile**

**Required Qualifications**

* 8+ years delivering production machine learning and AI, with a record of deployments that reached real users.
* Practical breadth across predictive modelling and advanced analytics, plus hands-on NLP and LLM/RAG experience.
* Proven experience integrating models into complex customer environments: messy source data, incomplete fields, shifting definitions, fixed deadlines.
* Expert proficiency in Python, SQL, PySpark, Databricks, MLflow, PyTorch, cloud data and ML platforms, and LLM APIs.
* Strong grounding in production monitoring, drift detection, retraining and model troubleshooting — not only model building.
* Experience migrating bespoke analytics or pipelines onto a productised platform.
* Ability to lead a mixed technical team and hold delivery accountability across several products at once.
* Confident with customer stakeholders: able to explain a model, defend a result and decline a scope request without damaging the relationship.
* Excellent written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical audiences.
* Ability to influence executives and cross-functional leaders, and to develop senior technical talent.
* Experience working in a matrix organisation and demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced, demanding environment while managing stakeholder expectations, priorities and timelines.
* Strong awareness of emerging technology trends in AI, Generative AI and Agentic AI, and the ability to assess what they mean for health tech products from both opportunity and risk perspectives.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, statistics or a related technical field.
* Healthcare or health insurance domain experience: claims, payer or provider analytics, population health, care management or clinical operations.
* Experience with healthcare data standards, privacy requirements and regulated environments.
* Working knowledge of MLOps, CI/CD for ML, feature stores and model registries.
* Experience in a matrix organisation, balancing customer commitments against product constraints.

**What Good Looks Like**

* Is recognised as the organisation’s technical authority for ML, AI, NLP and agentic-system decisions.
* Shapes enterprise AI strategy while remaining credible in hands-on architecture and technical review.
* Delivers AI systems that are measurable, grounded, safe, secure, scalable and economically sustainable.
* Creates reusable platforms and standards that multiply impact across teams, products and markets.
* Builds a strong technical community and credible external reputation in healthcare AI.

**Join Us**

If you are passionate about leveraging data to drive healthier outcomes across Asia and thrive in a dynamic, mission-driven environment, we encourage you to apply.

Amplify Health is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

description:
**Designation- Vice President – Sales**

**Vice President – Sales (India & SAARC)**

**predictable, compounding growth machine**

**100% revenue growth year-on-year**
.

  and CRM discipline; run a tight weekly and monthly review rhythm across regions.

  within the existing customer base, expanding adoption across Threatcop's product suite —

  involving CISOs, CIOs, Risk, Compliance, and senior business buyers, and build lasting CXO-level relationships.

* **Own the regional partner strategy**
  — onboard new partners and manage the existing strong network across India, Nepal, Bhutan, and Sri Lanka.
* **Grow partner-led revenue**
  — with roughly 50% of business flowing through partners, ensure resellers and system integrators are enabled, activated, and consistently generating SQLs and closed business.
* **Run partner governance**
  — joint business planning, enablement, deal registration, and performance tracking to keep the channel a reliable, growing contributor to pipeline and bookings.

**Team Leadership & Scale:**

* **Lead the regional sales organization**
  — Regional Sales Directors (Bangalore, Mumbai, Hyderabad, Delhi) and the SDR Head report directly to you.
* **Grow and structure the team**
  — you inherit a 14-member team (4 SDRs and 10 BDs/AMs) and will scale it, including adding new Account Managers in Chennai and strengthening regional coverage.
* **Build and inspire a young, hungry, energetic salesforce**
  — recruit, mentor, and push a high-energy team to perform at their peak potential.
* **Set the operating system of sales**
  — clear KPIs, incentive structures, sales processes, playbooks, SOPs, and performance-management frameworks that scale.
* **Coach at every level**
  — enable leaders and individual contributors on consultative selling, enterprise deal management, and value-based conversations.

**Cross-Functional & Market Leadership:**

* **Partner with Marketing, Product, and Customer Success**
  to align messaging, buyer personas, demand-generation campaigns, and a seamless onboarding-to-renewal experience.
* **Feed market intelligence**
  back to product and leadership to influence roadmap, positioning, and pricing.
* **Represent Threatcop**
  at industry events, conferences, and partner forums, strengthening its positioning as a category leader in People Security Management across India & SAARC.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)-**

This role is measured on the health and predictability of the revenue engine — not just the headline number. Core KPIs include:

  — a steady, predictable volume of qualified leads from SDRs, events, and partners.

* **Quarter-on-quarter growth**
  in order booking and revenue, tracking to 100% YoY.

  performance across the installed base.

  contribution and partner activation rates.
* **Forecast accuracy, funnel conversion rates, and CRM hygiene**
  across all regions

.

**What You Bring-**

  — cybersecurity domain experience is mandatory.
* **5+ years leading and scaling sales teams**
  , including managers and multi-region structures.
* **Proven experience managing a young, hungry, and energetic sales team**
  — someone who knows how to push their people to their best potential.
* **A technology-enabled, AI-forward sales leader**
  — well-versed with the latest AI tools and modern sales tech, and able to embed them into the team's daily workflow to raise productivity and win rates.
* **Demonstrated track record**
  of owning and exceeding large revenue targets and building a predictable pipeline.

  — onboarding and managing resellers, SIs, and channel partners at scale.
* **Excellent leadership, negotiation, executive communication, and strategic-planning skills.**
* **Bachelor's or Master's degree**
  in Business, Technology, or a related field.
* **Experience selling into BFSI, Healthcare, Manufacturing, Telecom, or regulated industries**
  is a strong plus.
* **Willingness to travel**
  within India and the SAARC region as required.

**Why You'll Enjoy Working at Threatcop-**

* **Experience the speed and ownership of a high-growth cybersecurity company**
  with the stability of a mature, public and profitable organization.
* **Build and lead the India & SAARC sales engine**
  at a global cybersecurity product company from the front.
* **Competitive compensation**
  with leadership-level growth opportunities.
* **Comprehensive benefits**
  including health insurance, gratuity, and Employees' Provident Fund.
* **A collaborative, merit-driven, and inclusive workplace.**

**About Threatcop-**

**Threatcop**
is a leading People Security Management (PSM) company and a sister concern of
**Kratikal Tech Limited**
. We help organizations reduce cyber risk by strengthening the human layer of security — transforming employees from the weakest link into the strongest line of defense against social engineering and email-based threats.

* **Serving 450+ large enterprises and 1800+ SMEs**

* **Company headquartered in Noida(India) and Cupertino(US)**

Using our People Security Management(PSM)
**A-A-P-E framework (Assess, Aware, Protect, Empower)**

Learn more:
**www.threatcop.com**

description:
**Position Summary**

As the Head of Veterinary & Breeder Channels for Purina India, you will lead the development and growth of Purina's professional channels through veterinarians, breeders, veterinary institutions, and key petcare influencers.

The role is responsible for delivering business in these channels through advocacy, strengthening customer relationships, commercial plans, driving channel activation, and increasing recommendation and brand preference within the petcare ecosystem. You will own the strategy and execution of engagement programs, events, partnerships, and channel development initiatives that enhance Purina's visibility and be responsible for the commercial performance.

Working closely with Sales, Marketing and external stakeholders, you will establish Purina as the preferred partner across the veterinary and breeder communities while delivering business growth through these strategic channels.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Veterinary & Breeder Channel Strategy**

* Responsible for delivering the business targets for this channel
* Develop and execute the commercial & growth strategy for veterinary and breeder channels across India.
* Drive brand recommendation, advocacy, and customer acquisition through professional petcare networks.
* Identify and prioritize key veterinary clinics, hospitals, breeders, institutions, and influencers that can accelerate channel growth.
* Build sustainable engagement models to increase Purina's relevance and presence within the professional petcare ecosystem.
* Establish channel-specific goals, engagement plans, and commercial growth initiatives.

**Advocacy & Relationship Management**

* Develop strong relationships with veterinarians, breeders, academicians, institutions, associations, and industry influencers.
* Build and manage a robust network of Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and channel advocates.
* Create partnership programs that strengthen Purina's visibility and reputation among professional stakeholders.
* Drive initiatives that increase recommendation, trial, and adoption of Purina products within veterinary and breeder communities.

**Events & Customer Engagement**

* Own Purina India's veterinary and breeder engagement calendar.
* Plan and execute participation in:
* + Veterinary congresses
  + Industry conferences
  + Petcare exhibitions
  + Breeder forums
  + Association events
  + Regional customer engagement programs
* Lead Purina-hosted conferences, KOL forums, advisory boards, customer meets, and networking events.
* Ensure high-quality execution and measurable commercial outcomes from all channel events and activations.
* Develop innovative engagement platforms that strengthen relationships and improve advocacy.

**Commercial Activation & Business Development**

* Partner with Sales and Marketing teams to design and execute channel-specific growth initiatives.
* Develop programs that improve conversion, retention, and recommendation within veterinary and breeder channels.
* Support commercial planning and expansion opportunities within the professional petcare ecosystem.
* Track channel performance and identify opportunities to increase penetration and business impact.
* Translate stakeholder insights into actionable business opportunities and market development initiatives.

**Strategic Partnerships**

* Build partnerships with veterinary colleges, universities, professional associations, breeder networks, and industry bodies.
* Identify collaboration opportunities that enhance Purina's reach, visibility, and credibility.
* Strengthen Purina's presence across key professional and industry platforms.
* Represent Purina at external events, industry forums, and stakeholder engagements.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Corporate Communications, Regulatory Affairs, and Consumer Engagement teams.
* Support product launches, category development initiatives, and business growth plans through channel advocacy programs.
* Provide insights on customer needs, market trends, competitive activity, and channel dynamics.
* Contribute to annual business planning and channel growth strategy.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Veterinary Science, Animal Sciences, Life Sciences, or a related field.
* MBA or postgraduate qualification preferred.

**Experience**

* 8-12 years of relevant experience in sales, channel development, customer marketing, trade marketing, business development, advocacy, or stakeholder management.
* Experience in pet food, animal health, pharmaceuticals, healthcare, FMCG, consumer products, or related industries preferred.
* Demonstrated success in managing professional customer networks, partnerships, or influencer ecosystems.
* Proven experience in planning and executing events, conferences, customer engagement programs, and partnership initiatives.
* Experience working in highly cross-functional commercial environments.

* Develop strategies to improve client conversion rates and average deal value.
* Monitor monthly revenue performance and take corrective action when targets are not being met.

**4. Sales Strategy & Market Research**

* Identify new industries and business opportunities for digital marketing services.
* Develop effective sales strategies to expand the company's market presence.
* Explore new channels and partnerships to generate qualified business leads.

* Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective clients.
* Coordinate with the digital marketing and operations teams to ensure smooth service delivery.
* Follow up with clients regarding proposals, negotiations, renewals, and payments.
* Maintain high client satisfaction to encourage retention, referrals, and recurring revenue.

**6. Reporting & Performance Management**

* Maintain accurate records of leads, meetings, proposals, conversions, and sales revenue.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly sales performance reports.
* Track sales pipeline progress, conversion rates, and revenue growth.
* Provide regular updates to management regarding achievements, challenges, and upcoming business opportunities.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* 7–10 years of experience in digital marketing sales or business development.
* Proven track record of acquiring new clients and achieving revenue targets.
* Strong understanding of digital marketing services and their commercial value.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and closing skills.
* Ability to generate leads independently and manage the complete sales cycle.
* Strong networking, relationship-building, and problem-solving abilities.
* Proficiency in CRM tools, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, and sales reporting.
* Self-motivated, target-driven, and capable of working in a revenue-focused environment.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* **New Client Acquisition:** Number of new paying clients acquired every month.

* **Revenue Growth:** Consistent month-on-month growth in business revenue.
* **Lead Generation:** Number and quality of qualified leads generated.
* **Conversion Rate:** Percentage of qualified leads converted into paying clients.
* **Deal Closure:** Number and value of deals successfully closed.
* **Client Retention:** Repeat business, renewals, and long-term client relationships.
* **Sales Reporting:** Timely and accurate submission of sales reports and pipeline updates.

What We Are Looking For

We need someone who can **bring business, acquire new clients, close deals, and increase monthly revenue** rather than simply manage existing accounts or generate leads without conversions.

The ideal candidate should take ownership of sales performance, work proactively toward ambitious targets, identify new revenue opportunities, and contribute directly to the company's business growth.

* Ability to handle employee grievances and engagement independently.

title: Senior HR Operations Lead

OneByZero
  
  
Location: Bengaluru — supporting 7 offices across APAC
  
  
Reports to: Head of HR
  
  
Function: HR Operations — sole HR hire, owning the function end to end
  
  
Experience: 6+ years
  
  
**About OneByZero**
OneByZero is a Frontier Systems Integrator building agentic AI systems for leading banks,
  
  
telecommunications companies, insurers, and retailers across Asia Pacific. We work on
  
  
high-impact problems for institutions operating the financial and digital infrastructure of
  
  
the region.

reach, funded innovation opportunities, and delivery credibility across multiple markets.

systems, policies, and compliance backbone our people function needs at this stage, with
  
  
full autonomy and no team beneath them (yet).
  
  
This isn't a maintenance role. You'll be building from a partial foundation, prioritising
  
  
ruthlessly, and making judgment calls without a legal or HR team to lean on.
  
  
What You Will Own
  
  

* HRIS & systems — select, implement, and administer our home-grown HR system as

the single source of truth for people data.
  
  

* Multi-jurisdiction compliance — own statutory leave, termination rules, and worker

classification (employee vs. contractor) across all 7 office locations.
  
  

* Payroll & vendor management — coordinate payroll vendors and EOR (Employer of

Record) providers across geographies; you won't run payroll by hand, but you're
  
  
accountable for accuracy and timeliness everywhere we operate.
  
  

* People analytics — build and maintain headcount, attrition, and comp benchmarking

dashboards that leadership and the board actually use.
  
  

* Policy & documentation — write and maintain the employee handbook, leave

policies, offer letter templates, and onboarding/offboarding processes, built for a
  
  
lean company without in-house legal backing every clause.
  
  

* Process design — create the operational rhythm (onboarding, performance cycles,

exits) from scratch or refine what exists.What We Are Looking For
  
  

* 6+ years in HR operations, with at least part of that as the sole or founding HR ops

function at a startup (150–500 headcount stage strongly preferred).
  
  

* Proven experience managing HR/payroll/compliance across multiple countries or

entities — ideally including Southeast Asia (Singapore, Vietnam, Malaysia or similar).
  
  

* Direct ownership of an HRIS implementation or migration, not just usage.
* Working knowledge of EOR models and when to use them vs. direct entities.
* Comfortable writing policy and legal-adjacent documentation without a legal team's

sign-off on every line.
  
  

* A track record of pushing back on leadership when compliance or people-risk is at

stake.
  
  
What We're Not Looking For
  
  

* Someone who's only operated inside a mature HR team with specialists to hand off

to — you need to be the specialist.
  
  

* A perfectionist who won't ship an 80%-good system fast.

What Success Looks Like in 90 Days
  
  

* Full audit of current HR ops (systems, policies, compliance gaps) delivered with a

prioritised fix plan.
  
  

* HRIS either selected or fully adopted as the system of record.
* Handbook and core policies drafted or updated for every active jurisdiction.

Why OneByZero
  
  
OneByZero is scaling a 200-person, 7-office AI consulting business — and its people
  
  
foundations need to scale with it. This role offers full ownership of that foundation from
  
  
day one, direct visibility to leadership and the board, and the chance to shape how the
  
  
company operates as it grows.

* 6+ years in HR operations, with at least part of that as the sole or founding HR ops

function at a startup (150–500 headcount stage strongly preferred).
  
  

* Proven experience managing HR/payroll/compliance across multiple countries or

title: Graduate Apprentice Trainee
description:
Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.
  
  
**About The NATS Program**
This role is offered under the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS), a flagship initiative of the Government of India designed to equip Indian youth with practical, trade-specific skills. Administered under the provisions of the Apprentices Act, 1961 (amended in 1973), this program at Volvo Group offers engineering graduates and diploma holders a structured, 1-year practical, hands-on On-the-Job Training (OJT) opportunity to build industry-ready capabilities.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Plant Absenteeism Management: Prepare and present day-to-day absenteeism and support to ensure 100% availability of people in coordination with all stake holders.
* Support Recruitment, onboarding & Induction of Fixed term employees, Graduate Apprentice trainees.
* Contract labour Management: Recruitment, Onboarding, Induction, Attendance Management. (Biometric and monthly reports), Statutory compliance, Dashboard preparations, Job rotation, Awareness activities.
* NTTF training coordination for Land contributor trainees.
* Support in developing Policy related to Employee Relations.
* Support in Salary & Wage administration (Support to prepare monthly Payroll input).
* Support employee initiatives & welfare activities such as Birthday celebrations, Transportation, family day celebration, sports day, Ayudha pooja, Karnataka Rajyotsava etc.
* Support Industrial Visits, Internship & project trainees.

Educational : BBA or any relavent qualification
  
  
Preferred skills : Microsoft office (Excel, Powerpoint) and Power BI
  
  
We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.
  
  
**Who We Are And What We Believe In**
We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.
  
  
Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join
**Volvo Group**
. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment.
  
  
**Trucks Technology & Industrial Division**
hire team players who are ready to create real customer impact. Our decentralized teams work close to our customers, with speed and autonomy, to build what they truly need.
  
  
Join us to collaborate on innovative, sustainable technologies that redefine how we design, build, and deliver value. Bring your curiosity, your expertise, and your collaborative energy, and together, we’ll turn bold ideas into tangible solutions for our customers and contribute to a more sustainable tomorrow.

title: Frontier Transformation leader
description:
**Frontier Transformation Lead**
**About The Role**
As a
**Frontier Transformation Lead**
, you will make an impact by leading the transformation of a global engineering workforce toward AI-native ways of working and accelerating the adoption of frontier capabilities across client engagements. You will work collaboratively with senior business, delivery, solutioning, operations, talent, and capability leaders to translate AI offerings and accelerators into new ways of working, strengthen workforce capability, and enable outcome-based delivery.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Lead the transformation of software engineering talent toward AI-native roles and ways of working, including career pathing, reskilling, certifications, and capability development.
* Drive the adoption and diffusion of AI offerings, assets, toolkits, and accelerators into live client engagements, working closely with sales, solutioning, and account management teams.
* Build and scale frontier delivery teams and capability communities, enabling effective deployment of talent across new and existing client opportunities.
* Own workforce planning, staffing, fulfilment, utilization, and talent mobility, partnering across a highly matrixed global organization to align capability supply with business demand.
* Lead and influence senior stakeholders to accelerate workforce transformation, AI adoption, and the transition toward scalable, outcome-based delivery models.

**Work model: Work from Office**
At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible, and we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is an onsite position requiring
**4 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in [Chennai/Hyderabad/Bangalore/Mumbai]**
.
  
  
The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you’re engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.

description:
**Recruitment Coordinator (6-Month Contract)**
==============================================

**About Redwood Software**
--------------------------

Redwood Software is a global leader in enterprise automation, helping organizations streamline mission-critical business processes through innovative automation solutions. We are committed to building high-performing teams and delivering an exceptional experience for our candidates, employees, and hiring stakeholders.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

We are looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive **Recruitment Coordinator** to join our Talent Acquisition team in Hyderabad on a six-month contract. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience managing high-volume interview scheduling, coordinating with multiple stakeholders, and working with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS). This role requires strong communication skills, excellent time management, and the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced recruitment environment.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **1. Interview Scheduling & Coordination**

* Manage end-to-end interview scheduling across multiple roles, departments, and interview stages.
* Coordinate interviews involving candidates, recruiters, hiring managers, and technical interview panels.
* Schedule virtual, onsite, and panel interviews across different time zones, including India and the US.
* Manage interviewer calendars, availability, scheduling conflicts, cancellations, and rescheduling requests.
* Coordinate high-volume hiring drives, walk-in interviews, and campus recruitment events.
* Ensure interview invitations contain accurate meeting links, interview rounds, panel details, and candidate information.
* Proactively follow up with interviewers and candidates to ensure interview readiness.

### **2. Applicant Tracking System (ATS) Management**

* Manage interview scheduling and candidate-stage updates within Greenhouse or similar ATS platforms.
* Maintain accurate interview schedules, interviewer assignments, and candidate records.
* Track interview completion, cancellations, rescheduling, and pending feedback.
* Ensure timely updates to interview statuses and scheduling-related information.
* Support the recruitment team with ATS data accuracy and process compliance.

### **3. Candidate Experience & Communication**

* Serve as a key point of contact for candidates throughout the interview coordination process.
* Communicate interview schedules, instructions, meeting details, and changes professionally.
* Ensure timely candidate communication and minimize scheduling delays.
* Handle candidate queries and last-minute scheduling challenges with professionalism.
* Deliver a consistent and positive candidate experience.

### **4. Stakeholder & Panel Management**

* Partner closely with recruiters, hiring managers, interviewers, and external recruitment partners.
* Collect and maintain interviewer availability for current and upcoming weeks.
* Monitor interview slot utilization and identify scheduling bottlenecks.
* Coordinate with interview panels to ensure adherence to confirmed schedules.
* Escalate scheduling challenges and delays to the appropriate stakeholders.

### **5. Recruitment Operations & Reporting**

* Maintain interview scheduling trackers and daily coordination reports.
* Track interview volumes, scheduling turnaround time, cancellations, and no-shows.
* Support weekly recruitment reporting and interview coordination dashboards.
* Identify opportunities to streamline scheduling workflows and improve operational efficiency.
* Support recruitment process documentation and scheduling best practices.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**
------------------------------------

* Bachelor's in Any Degree..
* **5+ years of experience** in recruitment coordination, talent acquisition operations, or recruitment support.
* Hands-on experience with ATS platforms such as Greenhouse, Workday, Lever, or similar systems.
* Experience scheduling interviews using Outlook, Zoom, Microsoft Teams, or Google Calendar.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and recruitment tracking.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple interview schedules simultaneously.
* Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and stakeholder management.
* Ability to work independently in a fast-paced hiring environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Prior experience with **Greenhouse ATS**.
* Experience coordinating interviews across India and US time zones.
* Exposure to high-volume technical or engineering recruitment.
* Experience coordinating campus hiring drives or onsite interview events.
* Familiarity with interview scheduling automation and ATS reporting.
* Experience working with recruitment agencies or RPO partners.

  

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* Opportunity to work with a global Talent Acquisition team.
* Hands-on exposure to recruitment operations and Greenhouse ATS.
* Experience coordinating technical hiring and recruitment initiatives.
* A collaborative, fast-paced environment focused on operational excellence.

*If you like growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!*

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**About Aria**

Aria Intelligent Solutions is a global AI technology and consulting firm that partners with leading retailers and consumer brands to deliver measurable commercial impact. We combine deep industry expertise with advanced AI and analytics to help clients transform how they plan, trade and grow.

Alongside our consulting business, we are developing HarmonIQ, our own agentic AI platform. As Aria continues to grow across geographies and business lines, we are strengthening our People function to build consistent, effective HR practices and an engaged, high-performing workplace.

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on HR Manager to manage and strengthen the HR function at Aria. This is a hybrid role requiring accountability for across the employee lifecycle, with the ability to balance operational execution with sound people’s judgement and process improvement.

Working closely with the global HR Lead, local leadership and employees across India and other geographies, you will oversee the implementation of global HR strategies and local initiatives that support business priorities, provide a consistent employee experience and scale with the organisation. The ideal candidate is proactive, approachable, commercially aware and comfortable working independently in a fast-moving technology environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**HR Operations & Employee Lifecycle**

* Oversee the employee life-cycle for the India team, including onboarding processes, employee documentation, transfers, confirmation, exits and full-and-final coordination.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date employee records, HR systems (Bamboo HR) and personnel documentation, ensuring confidentiality and appropriate access controls.
* Manage HR operations and employee queries in a timely, consistent and employee-friendly manner.
* Review global policies and initiatives with global HR Lead, to ensure they are fit for local use with regard to legislation and best practices.
* Support the development and continuous improvement of HR policies, processes, templates and standard operating procedures.
* Coordinate monthly payroll inputs with Finance and external partners, ensuring changes, attendance, leave, incentives and employee data are accurate and submitted on time.

**Performance, Talent & Development**

* Coordinate the annual performance management processes for the India team, advising and supporting local leadership on goal setting, review cycles, feedback, performance improvement and promotion processes.
* Work with managers to establish clear role expectations, support performance conversations and address employee performance concerns fairly and consistently in line with global Aria policies.
* Identify learning and development needs and coordinate relevant training, manager enablement and capability-building initiatives.
* Support career development, succession planning and employee growth initiatives as the organisation evolves.

**Compensation, Benefits & Employee Engagement**

* Coordinate annual compensation reviews, increments, performance bonuses, promotions and benefits administration in line with global policies and regional budget.
* Maintain clear and consistent communication of compensation and benefits policies, ensuring decisions are documented and appropriately approved by regional and global leadership.
* Plan and drive local employee engagement initiatives, feedback mechanisms, recognition activities and internal people communications.
* Support the planning of regional events, team connects and culture-building initiatives for a distributed workforce.

**Employee Relations, Compliance & Governance**

* Act as a trusted first point of contact for employee relations matters, handling concerns with discretion, fairness and sound judgement.
* Advise managers on day-to-day people matters, including attendance, leave, conduct, grievances, disciplinary processes and performance concerns.
* Ensure HR policies and practices comply with applicable Indian employment laws and statutory requirements, coordinating with local specialists as required.
* Maintain appropriate HR documentation, support audits and ensure employee data is handled in line with applicable privacy and data-protection requirements.
* Coordinate with external consultants, payroll providers, benefits partners and other HR service providers as required.

**People Insights & Workforce Planning**

* Prepare and maintain HR dashboards and periodic reports covering headcount, attrition, employee movement, leave, performance and other relevant people metrics.
* Work with leadership and functional managers to understand skill gaps and emerging people risks.
* Use employee feedback and people data to identify trends and recommend practical improvements to global HR lead.
* Ensure HR processes, records and reporting are scalable and support informed business decisions.

**Skills & Experience**

**Essential Experience**

* 8+ years of progressive HR experience, with strong exposure to HR generalist responsibilities and end-to-end employee lifecycle management.
* Experience independently managing or leading HR operations in a technology, consulting, professional services or other fast-paced organisation.
* Strong working knowledge of Indian employment law, statutory compliance and HR best practices.
* Hands-on experience with performance management, compensation and benefits, employee relations, onboarding and employee engagement.
* Experience coordinating payroll, HR administration, employee records and HR systems.
* Ability to work with senior stakeholders and managers, exercise sound judgement and handle confidential matters with discretion.
* Strong communication, interpersonal and problem-solving skills, with the ability to build trust across all levels of the organisation.
* Comfort working independently in a hybrid environment, managing priorities and delivering outcomes with limited day-to-day supervision.
* Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a growing business.

**Desirable Experience**

* Experience supporting international or geographically distributed teams, particularly across India, the UK and/or the US.
* Experience in an AI, SaaS, technology, consulting or product-led organisation.
* Familiarity with HR platforms such as BambooHR or similar tools, and with HR analytics and reporting.
* Experience designing or improving HR policies, frameworks and processes in a growing organisation.
* Relevant postgraduate qualification or professional HR certification.

**Working Model**

This is a hybrid-based position in India. The role will involve regular collaboration with colleagues across locations and time zones, with occasional travel for business meetings, team events or leadership offsites.

**Why Join Aria**

You will join a growing global AI business at an important stage of its journey. The role offers the opportunity to play a key role in the growth and development of our India operations, work closely with the leadership team and shape an employee experience and People function that can deliver Aria’s exciting growth ambitions.

You will work directly with the founder, identify and onboard new clients, understand their hiring needs, source and evaluate candidates, and manage recruitment mandates through to successful placements.

We are looking for someone who is commercially driven, confident in client-facing situations, and willing to take responsibility for results.

**This is not a laid-back or purely administrative role.**
It is a fast-paced opportunity for someone who enjoys targets, takes initiative, and wants their performance to translate directly into higher earnings and career growth.

Key Responsibilities1. Client Acquisition & Business Development

* Identify and approach potential clients across industries through LinkedIn, cold outreach, referrals, and other business development channels.
* Generate qualified business leads and initiate conversations with decision-makers, founders, and HR professionals.

2. End-to-End Recruitment & Talent Solutions

* Independently manage recruitment mandates from initial requirement gathering to successful candidate placement.

* Identify opportunities to improve sourcing efficiency, client conversion, and recruitment processes.
* Collaborate directly with the founder on business growth initiatives and operational priorities.
* Contribute ideas and take initiative beyond assigned responsibilities to support the firm's expansion.

Candidate Requirements

* **1–2 years of relevant professional experience is mandatory. Freshers will not be considered.**

title: Senior Associate - Talent Researcher
description:
**Senior Associate, Talent Researcher**

**Location:**
Gurgaon, Haryana, India

**Experience:**
5–8 years of relevant experience in Talent Research, should be coming with a Search & Recruitment (SHREK) firm or a recruitment agency background.

**About the Company**

Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global professional services firm providing advisory, business performance improvement, turnaround management and interim leadership services to companies, investors and government entities. Founded in 1983 as a restructuring boutique, A&M is known for practical, action-oriented solutions that improve performance, create value and accelerate results across six continents. Its mission is to help organizations tackle complex business issues, boost operating performance and maximize stakeholder value. In 2023, A&M established a Global Capability Center in India to support global business units, case delivery and thought leadership across the Americas, EMEA and APAC. The Gurgaon center partners with teams across Consumer and Retail, Healthcare, Software and Technology, Automotive and Industrials, Hospitality and Leisure, Energy and Natural Resources, and Financial Services. A&M values integrity, quality, objectivity, fun, personal reward and inclusive diversity, guided by leadership, action and results.

**About the Role**

As Senior Associate, Talent Acquisition Researcher, you will own high-quality talent research and intelligence for priority hiring across Alvarez & Marsal globally. You will partner with recruiters, hiring managers, senior stakeholders and fellow Researchers to translate search objectives into focused market maps, target company lists, executive pipelines and actionable sourcing insights. The role is centered on the core talent research process, with particular emphasis on talent intelligence and mapping professionals from SHREK organisations, including recruitment firms and executive search firms. You will use LinkedIn Recruiter, X-Ray search, Lusha, ContactOut, company websites, industry sources, conference materials, executive biographies, web research and AI tools such as Claude and Copilot. Your work will improve search precision, shorten research cycles and strengthen delivery for business-critical roles across functions and geographies.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own target company lists, talent maps and executive pipelines for priority searches, focusing on SHREK organisations and converting fragmented market information into qualified, actionable talent pools.
* Participate in search kick-offs with recruiters and hiring managers, clarifying target profiles, relevant organisations, sourcing channels and research plans that improve search focus from the outset.
* Conduct structured executive research across social networks, search engines, company websites, conferences, publications, referrals and biographies to identify niche and hard-to-find professionals.
* Apply Claude, Copilot and other AI tools to accelerate candidate research, market mapping and sourcing insight while preserving accuracy, discretion and sound judgement.
* Build dashboards and reports covering talent availability, candidate movement, company activity and market trends so stakeholders can make better-informed search decisions.
* Maintain intelligence on mergers and acquisitions, private equity transactions, competitor activity and wider talent trends, translating developments into relevant implications for active searches.
* Partner with recruiters and Researchers to maintain accurate, consistent candidate information across recruiting systems and research tools, protecting data quality throughout delivery.

**Essential Skills & Technologies**

* Demonstrated expertise in core talent research, talent intelligence, executive search research and end-to-end market mapping, particularly across recruitment firms and executive search firms.
* Strong research, information synthesis and data organisation skills, with the ability to turn competitive landscape and candidate intelligence into concise sourcing recommendations.
* Hands-on proficiency with LinkedIn Recruiter, X-Ray search, Lusha, ContactOut, company websites, industry publications, conference research and broader web searches.
* Practical experience using AI tools such as Claude and Copilot to improve research targeting, repeatability and cycle time without compromising judgement or confidentiality.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, enabling effective partnership with recruiters, hiring managers, Researchers and senior stakeholders across geographies.
* Advanced working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word and PowerPoint for analysis, reporting and presentation; Power BI or comparable visualisation experience is advantageous.

**Additional Plus**

* Experience supporting executive searches in professional services, consulting, finance, tax or private equity environments, with awareness of relevant talent pools and market dynamics.
* Experience tracking mergers and acquisitions, private equity transactions, competitor activity or other market signals that influence executive talent availability.
* Exposure to Power BI or other data visualisation tools for presenting talent market trends, company intelligence and candidate movement clearly.

**What You'll Bring**

* A Bachelor's degree in Business Management, Human Resources, or a related discipline, combined with 5–8 years of relevant talent research experience; total experience may range from 6–10 years.
* Deep ownership of the core talent research process, including talent intelligence, target organisation mapping, executive pipeline development and research-led sourcing strategy.
* Proven ability to find niche profiles through disciplined investigation, connect disparate information sources and deliver reliable insights under demanding timelines.
* High attention to detail, discretion and sound judgement when handling confidential searches and candidate information, supported by strong prioritisation and deadline management.
* A collaborative, proactive working style that builds trust with recruiters, hiring managers, senior stakeholders and research colleagues across international teams.
* Curiosity about organisations, industries and professional networks, with the resilience to pursue difficult searches until the market picture is sufficiently complete.
* Commitment to accurate recruiting data, consistent documentation and candidate experience throughout each search, ensuring research quality directly strengthens hiring outcomes.

**Why Join Us**

At Alvarez & Marsal, your research will directly influence how a global professional services firm builds teams for complex, high-impact work. The Talent Acquisition Research team is central to priority hiring, giving you ownership of market intelligence, executive pipelines and search strategy rather than limiting the role to transactional sourcing. You will work with recruiters, hiring managers and senior stakeholders across the Americas, EMEA and APAC, gaining exposure to varied functions, industries and geographies. A&M’s entrepreneurial culture values independent thinkers who take action and deliver results, while its inclusive environment respects different perspectives and encourages strong collaboration. The India Global Capability Center offers the scale of an international platform with meaningful proximity to case teams and business leaders. Through mentorship, A&M University, formal training, on-the-job learning, internal mobility and performance development, you can deepen your research craft and broaden your career. The firm also invests in wellbeing, employee resource groups, community contribution and flexible support practices. You will join a growing organization where practical insight, professional judgement and high-quality delivery are visible and valued.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to support global, business-critical hiring across multiple functions, industries and geographies while working alongside experienced recruiters, Researchers and senior stakeholders.
* Structured development through A&M University, formal training, on-the-job learning, mentorship, internal mobility and a performance process that recognizes meaningful contributions.
* A collaborative and inclusive environment with wellbeing resources, employee resource groups, comprehensive benefits and opportunities to contribute through community programs.
* Competitive compensation within a culture that combines early responsibility, entrepreneurial ownership, professional growth and practical impact.

description:
**About LoglineAI**

LoglineAI is an AI-powered creative studio helping content studios, brands, and agencies go from pitch to fully packaged content — faster, smarter, and leaner. Part of the SVF ecosystem alongside hoichoi (India's leading Regional OTT platform) and Sooper (AI-led micro-drama OTT)

**The Opportunity**

LoglineAI is growing, and every new hire shapes how the studio works. In this role, you will own hiring from start to finish across creative, tech and client-facing teams — this is about 80% of the job. The other 20% is core people operations: onboarding, documentation, employee queries and exits.

You will work closely with founders and hiring managers, and you will be the person who makes sure we hire the right people, quickly and fairly.

**What you'll do**

* Own end-to-end hiring for creative, tech and client-facing roles, closing each role within an agreed time-to-hire target.
* Build a strong pipeline for every open role through LinkedIn, job portals, referrals, creative communities and direct outreach, so each role has a qualified shortlist within the first week.

* Run structured interviews — screens, scorecards, panel scheduling and debriefs — so every hiring decision is backed by clear evidence.
* Track and share hiring metrics every week (time-to-hire, offer acceptance rate, source quality, pipeline health) and use them to fix slow stages.
* Manage offers and pre-joining, keeping candidates engaged until Day 1 to keep offer drop-offs low.
* Make sure every new joiner has access, tools, a buddy and a 90-day plan in their first week.
* Handle core people operations — employee records, letters, policy queries and exits — accurately and on time.
* Be the go-to partner for managers and team members on everyday people matters, raising issues early before they grow.
* Use AI tools to speed up sourcing, screening and documentation, cutting time spent on repeat task.

**Must-Have Qualifications**

* A track record of owning hiring for several roles at once, with numbers to show it — roles closed, time-to-hire, offer acceptance.
* Strong sourcing skills: you can find and engage passive candidates, not just post jobs and wait.
* Experience running structured interviews and working closely with hiring managers.
* Working knowledge of core HR operations — onboarding, employee documentation, lifecycle letters and exits.
* Clear, warm communication with candidates, managers and leadership.
* Uses AI tools to summarise data, draft documents, and explore process improvements — and knows how to verify and correct AI outputs.

**Good to Have**

* Experience hiring for creative roles (writers, designers, editors, producers) or AI/tech roles.
* Hands-on use of an ATS or async screening tools
* Basic understanding of Indian labour law and HR compliance.
* Experience building employer brand content for a young company.

**Culture & How We Work**

At LoglineAI, the best idea wins, not the biggest title. We operate in small, cross-functional teams where content, product, growth, and tech sit close together, argue productively, and occasionally steal each other's snacks. It's a lot like a kitchen during a house party: slightly chaotic, everyone's doing three things at once, but somehow the food comes out great.

Ownership here isn't a buzzword; it's the default setting. If something's broken, you don't file a ticket and wait. You're the person who notices the printer is jammed and just fixes it instead of pretending you didn't see it. We ship fast, measure what works, and iterate. Think less 'perfect deck' and more 'let's see if real viewers actually care.'

When big moments arrive, we stretch. But we're equally serious about keeping the pace sustainable, because burnt-out teams build neither great products nor great stories. If that sounds like your kind of chaos, we should talk.

description:
**[ WHO WE ARE**
**]**
Based out of South Korea, KRAFTON, Inc. is committed to discovering and globally publishing games that deliver a uniquely fun experience with global production studios known for distinctive creatives. Founded in 2007, KRAFTON consists of PUBG STUDIOS, Bluehole Studio, RisingWings, Striking Distance Studios, Dreamotion, Unknown Worlds, 5minlab, Neon Giant, KRAFTON Montréal Studio and ReLU Games, each trying to innovate the enjoyment of games through continuously embracing challenges and new technologies, expanding our platforms and services to win the hearts of more fans.
  
  
KRAFTON India has established itself as a trailblazer in the gaming industry, driven by its unwavering commitment to delivering distinctive and enjoyable gaming experiences. At the heart of KRAFTON India's success lies a deep understanding of the Indian gaming community.
  
  
The company takes immense pride in its premier entertainment properties, which include highly popular titles like BATTLEGROUNDS MOBILE INDIA (BGMI), CookieRun India, Road To Valor: Empires, Defense Derby, and New State Mobile. These games have not only captured the hearts of Indian players but have also played a pivotal role in fostering a thriving e-sports ecosystem in the country.
  
  
With a focus on India, KRAFTON is dedicated to nurturing the gaming and start-up ecosystem. In line with this commitment, KRAFTON initiated the KRAFTON India Gaming Incubator (KIGI) in October 2023. KIGI aims to support 6-10 teams annually, with program durations ranging from six months to one year. Additionally, KRAFTON India has invested over $150 million in the Indian market in the past two years. It has committed an additional $150 million to the Indian start-up ecosystem over the next three years.
  
  
**[ ABOUT THE ROLE ]**
As a Senior Legal Counsel at Krafton, you will play a pivotal role in providing strategic legal guidance and ensuring compliance across our various and expanding business functions. You will be responsible for handling corporate legal matters, regulatory compliance, intellectual property, commercial contracts, and dispute resolution. This role requires a deep understanding of entertainment and media, technology, and corporate laws, along with strong analytical and communication skills to collaborate with internal and external stakeholders. This is a great opportunity to join a collaborative team, think independently, take initiative of legal affairs, and work in one of the most exciting industries in the world. As Senior Legal Counsel, you will be part of a fast-growing legal department and will report directly to the Head of the Legal East Team.
  
  
**[ REQUIREMENTS ]**

* Bachelor's Degree in Law (LL.B.) from a recognized university in India and licensed to practice law in India.
* Ideally 7–10 years of post-qualification experience, including meaningful experience at a leading law firm or as in-house counsel in a multinational corporation, preferably in media/entertainment/fintech or any other technology industry.
* Strong, well-rounded commercial contracting experience, particularly in technology, licensing, intellectual property, marketing and partnership arrangements, and a grounding in corporate law.
* Strong understanding and experience in highly regulated areas such as payments, e-commerce, data protection, content regulation, and telecommunications, and an understanding of the general legal and regulatory landscape for digital businesses in India.
* Able to work independently and handle day-to-day legal tasks.
* Flexibility to work with different time zones.
* Team player capable of working both independently and with others.
* Strong sense of customer support and excellent interpersonal/communication skills with the ability to distil complex legal analysis into clear, concise advice for non-lawyers.
* Strategic mindset with the ability to manage complex legal issues and support multiple businesses with shifting priorities.

description:

The ideal candidate will have at least 2-3 years of hands-on experience in drafting, reviewing, negotiating and managing commercial agreements, preferably within the FinTech, banking, payments, technology or financial services sectors.

The role involves working closely with business development, commercial, operations, compliance and senior management teams to support contractual negotiations, mitigate legal risks and facilitate business partnerships across multiple jurisdictions.

· Master Services Agreements (MSAs)

· Support improvements to internal contract approval and execution processes.

• Experience working with international commercial agreements, particularly involving the UK, UAE, Singapore, Hong Kong, Canada or other major financial markets.

• Familiarity with payment processing, cross-border remittances, foreign exchange and financial institution partnerships.

• Understanding of data protection, AML/KYC and financial services regulatory frameworks.

• Experience coordinating with external legal counsel and cross-border commercial teams.

Important Notice for Candidates

· Only candidates with a minimum 2-3 years’ experience in contract review will be considered.

title: Manager, Licensing & Partnerships
description:
[ WHO WE ARE ]
  
  
Based out of South Korea, KRAFTON, Inc. is committed to discovering and globally publishing games that
  
  
deliver a uniquely fun experience with global production studios known for distinctive creatives. Founded in
  
  
2007, KRAFTON consists of PUBG STUDIOS, Bluehole Studio, RisingWings, Striking Distance Studios,
  
  
Dreamotion, Unknown Worlds, 5minlab, Neon Giant, KRAFTON Montréal Studio and ReLU Games, each
  
  
trying to innovate the enjoyment of games through continuously embracing challenges and new
  
  
technologies, expanding our platforms and services to win the hearts of more fans.
  
  
KRAFTON India has established itself as a trailblazer in the gaming industry, driven by its unwavering
  
  
commitment to delivering distinctive and enjoyable gaming experiences. At the heart of KRAFTON India's
  
  
success lies a deep understanding of the Indian gaming community.
  
  
The company takes immense pride in its premier entertainment properties, which include highly popular
  
  
titles like BATTLEGROUNDS MOBILE INDIA (BGMI), CookieRun India, Road To Valor: Empires, Defense Derby,
  
  
and New State Mobile. These games have not only captured the hearts of Indian players but have also played
  
  
a pivotal role in fostering a thriving e-sports ecosystem in the country.
  
  
With a focus on India, KRAFTON is dedicated to nurturing the gaming and start-up ecosystem. In line with
  
  
this commitment, KRAFTON initiated the KRAFTON India Gaming Incubator (KIGI) in October 2023. KIGI aims
  
  
to support 6-10 teams annually, with program durations ranging from six months to one year. Additionally,
  
  
KRAFTON India has invested over $150 million in the Indian market in the past two years. It has committed
  
  
an additional $150 million to the Indian start-up ecosystem over the next three years.
  
  
Nautilus Mobile is an Indian game development studio based in Pune, known for building Real Cricket —
  
  
India's most popular mobile cricket gaming franchise. Founded in 2013, the studio has consistently delivered
  
  
authentic, high-quality cricket simulation experiences to millions of players across India and beyond. Its
  
  
successful titles include Real Cricket 24, Real Cricket 22, Real Cricket GO, and the legacy favourite Real Cricket
  
  
Premier League. In April 2025, KRAFTON acquired a majority stake in Nautilus Mobile. This investment
  
  
reflects its commitment to unlocking opportunities for Indian game developers and supporting the growth of
  
  
India's gaming ecosystem. Through this partnership, Nautilus Mobile continues to innovate at the
  
  
intersection of sport and gaming, shaping the future of interactive cricket entertainment.
  
  
[ ABOUT THE ROLE ]
  
  
We are seeking a highly experienced and motivated professional to lead our licensing and partnership efforts
  
  
related to the cricket ecosystem in India, with potential to expand into broader regional and global cricket
  
  
gaming rights. This individual will be responsible for identifying, evaluating, and securing licensing
  
  
opportunities ranging from smaller, tactical agreements to complex multi-party, multi-regional deals. The
  
  
pivotal to building a differentiated and authentic cricket gaming experience.

* Own end-to-end responsibility for licensing and partnership activities related to cricket teams,
* leagues, players, stadiums, and associated IPs.
* Identify, assess, and negotiate licensing opportunities in alignment with the company's business
* and product goals.
* Drive and close deals with a wide range of stakeholders including cricket boards, clubs, players'
* associations, sports agencies, and rights holders.
* Build and nurture long-term strategic relationships across the cricketing ecosystem in India and
* beyond.
* Provide strategic insights on cricket licensing trends, competitive landscape, and market dynamics.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with product, legal, marketing, and publishing teams to align on deal
* terms and execution plans.
* Maintain an up-to-date repository of licensing agreements, rights coverage, and performance metrics.

[ REQUIREMENTS ]
  
  

* Minimum 10 years of experience in licensing, partnerships, or rights management within the gaming,
* sports, or entertainment industry.
* Demonstrated success in managing end-to-end licensing deals – from identification and evaluation
* to negotiation and closure.
* Strong understanding of the cricket landscape in India, including key stakeholders, regulatory bodies,
* and media rights.
* Proven track record of developing long-term strategic partnerships in a highly dynamic and
* competitive environment.
* Excellent negotiation, communication, and relationship management skills.
* Deep business acumen with the ability to align licensing strategy with company goals.
* Demonstrated ability and commitment to build and sustain long-term relationships with cricket
* boards, clubs, sports agencies, and rights holders

[ PREFERRED ]
  
  

* Prior experience working directly with cricket boards or associations.
* Background in video game publishing or mobile game licensing, particularly in the sports or cricket
* genre.
* Understanding of IP law and licensing frameworks in gaming and sports media.

title: Senior Deal Operations Analyst
description:
**Who Are We?**
Postman is the world’s leading API platform, used by more than 45 million+ developers and 500,000 organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500. Postman is helping developers and professionals across the globe build the API-first world by simplifying each step of the API lifecycle and streamlining collaboration—enabling users to create better APIs, faster.
  
  
The company is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Boston, New York, Austin, Tokyo, London, and Bangalore - where Postman was founded. Postman is privately held, with funding from Battery Ventures, BOND, Coatue, CRV, Insight Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners. Learn more at postman.com or connect with Postman on X via @getpostman.
  
  
P.S: We highly recommend reading The "API-First World" graphic novel to understand the bigger picture and our vision at Postman.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking a passionate and highly driven individual to join the TDeal Operations team at Postman. The Deal Operations team is integral to the success of the Sales organization by helping to drive revenue for the sales and renewals teams at Postman. This role is the subject matter expert crossed trained and highly skilled in legal, revenue, deal management and Quote to Cash disciplines. The Deal Manager engages with Sales as a single point of contact to support highly negotiated, strategic ELA business arrangements from inception of a sales opportunity to booking. They will advise and coach Sales Reps to efficiently work within Quote to Cash process, policies and guidelines. The Senior Deals Operation Analyst will possess extensive deal structuring, revenue recognition, and commercial contract experience. The Deal Manager is expected to own and manage the deal process from end to end and help drive efficiency and improvements in the deal making process.
  
  
This is a hybrid position - 3 days required in office.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Serve as the trusted advisor and go-to resources to the Sales and Renewals teams for solving complex problems across the Opportunity to Cash processes
* Serve as an expert in advanced Deal Process activities, which impact quota setting, bookings attainment, and complex deal structuring
* Educate Sales teams on changes in processes, policies, and best practices to improve performance
* Assist with projects with cross-functional teams in support of Sales, in the rollout of new products and policies, and in the improvement of our OTC processes
* Ensure Sales teams are operating within the deal guidelines, directly partnering with cross-functional teams to ensure compliance with policies
* Responsible for ensuring that Sales and contract data is accurate in CRM and other systems, partnering with cross-functional teams to reconcile downstream processes and Reporting
* Identify, scope, and deliver process and systems changes that improve operations for the Sales organization
* Work in a dynamic environment and adapt to new business processes in a fast paced environment
* Ability to travel to regional offices to meet directly with Sales teams and cross-functional leaders
* Serves as a coach and mentor to other team members, assisting with onboarding, day-to-day training, coaching, and collaborating to solve business problems
* Understand end-to-end processes across OTC and serve as an expert on the roles and responsibilities of cross-functional support teams, resulting in accelerated resolution of issues
* Take ownership and program manage issue resolution across all back-office teams, performing initial triage of issue identified by Sales and managing issue until it is fully resolved
* Assess recurring issues to identify opportunities for improving the overall OTC process and make recommendations on process and system changes
* Engage directly with clients as necessary through both written and verbal communications, helping to resolve OTC issues directly
* Manage escalations of all OTC issues from Sales and clients
* Demonstrate the ability to go “above and beyond” in the support of our Sales teams and clients

**About You**

* 8 + years of operations experience with technology companies in functions such as deal desk, finance, revenue, deal operations, contracts operations, or contracts management.
* This is not a standard 9-5 job, hours are based around business needs. The right fit for this role will have flexibility around month-end and quarter-end business needs
* Able to work in ambiguous environments under tight and unpredictable timelines
* Experience with CPQ and Ironclad preferred
* Has developed and maintained standard deal operations processes, approval matrixes and order terms.
* Strong structured problem-solving skills along with ability to demonstrate practical judgment in complex situations
* Able to work with a high degree of autonomy
* Willing to work in a highly demanding and results-oriented team environment

**What Else?**
In addition to Postman's pay-on-performance philosophy, and a flexible schedule working with a fun, collaborative team, Postman offers a comprehensive set of benefits, including full medical coverage, flexible PTO, wellness reimbursement, and a monthly lunch stipend. Along with that, our wellness programs will help you stay in the best of your physical and mental health. Our frequent and fascinating team-building events will keep you connected, while our donation-matching program can support the causes you care about. We’re building a long-term company with an inclusive culture where everyone can be the best version of themselves.
  
  
At Postman we value in person collaboration. We are in office 5 days a week for all roles based out of our hubs in San Francisco Bay Area, Boston, Austin, New York City, Tokyo and London. For roles based in Bangalore, employees currently work in the office three days a week and will transition to five days per week by the end of the year. We were thoughtful in our approach which is based on collaboration and grounded in feedback from our workforce, leadership team, and peers. The benefits of our in office model will be shared knowledge, brainstorming sessions, communication, and building trust in-person that cannot be replicated via zoom.
  
  
**Our Values**
At Postman, we create with the same curiosity that we see in our users. We value transparency and honest communication about not only successes, but also failures. In our work, we focus on specific goals that add up to a larger vision. Our inclusive work culture ensures that everyone is valued equally as important pieces of our final product. We are dedicated to delivering the best products we can.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity**
Postman is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. Postman does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes. Postman will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with Postman.

title: Senior GRC Consultant
description:
