You will lead regulatory compliance and audit engagements for banks, NBFCs, payment system operators, fintechs, stock brokers and their technology service providers, covering RBI, NPCI, SEBI, CERT-In and DPDP Act requirements alongside ISO 27001, ISO 22301 and PCI DSS.

You will own client engagements from scoping to closure, be the main point of contact for client CISOs, compliance and IT teams, review the work of GRC Analysts, and present findings to senior management and board committees. The role is full-time and work from office only in Bangalore (no hybrid or remote option), and we are looking for candidates who can join immediately or within 15 days.

What you will do

Regulatory compliance (RBI, NPCI, SEBI and others)

• Run gap assessments and compliance reviews against RBI directions, including the Master Direction on IT Governance, Risk, Controls and Assurance Practices, the Cyber Security Framework, Outsourcing of IT Services, Digital Payment Security Controls, Payment Aggregator guidelines and Cyber Resilience for PSOs.

• Carry out NPCI compliance reviews and member audits for UPI, IMPS, NACH, AePS, RuPay and BBPS participants, and prepare annual system audit and certification reports.

• Assess SEBI regulated entities against the Cybersecurity and Cyber Resilience Framework (CSCRF) and related circulars, and support cyber audit and VAPT reporting to SEBI and the exchanges.

• Support CERT-In directions (incident reportsync), UIDAI AUA and KUA requirements and DPDPAct compliance programmes.

• Track new regulatory circulars, assess theidate compliance checklists and controllibraries.

• Prepare responses to regulator inspections ns, such as RBI IT examinations and SEBIinspections, and drive Risk Mitigation Plans to closure.

Governance and frameworks

• Design and implement ISMS, BCMS and PIMS programmes aligned to ISO 27001, ISO 22301 and ISO 27701, and support PCI DSS and SOC 2 readiness.

• Draft and review board-approved policies such as information security, cyber security, IT outsourcing, cyber crisis management and business continuity policies.

• Build integrated control frameworks that map RBI, NPCI, SEBI, CERT-In, ISO and PCI DSS requirements to one common set of controls.

Risk, audit and third parties

• Lead IT and cyber risk assessments, maintain risk registers and present the risk posture to the IT Strategy Committee, Risk Management Committee and senior management.

• Plan and lead internal audits, IS audits and regulatory audits, and write audit reports with risk-rated observations and agreed remediation.

• Run third-party and outsourcing risk assessments in line with RBI and SEBI requirements, including due diligence, contract clauses and periodic reviews.

• Review technical evidence such as access reviews, VAPT and configuration audit reports, SOC and log monitoring, and backup and DR drill results.

Ongoing compliance maintenance

• Maintain a compliance calendar for each client covering regulatory submissions, audits, policy reviews, drills and renewals.

• Run quarterly compliance reviews and periodic control testing, and keep evidence ready for regulator and auditor requests.

• Support management reviews, committee meetings and board reporting with compliance dashboards, KRIs and action trackers.

Engagement leadership and reporting

• Lead client engagements from scoping to closure, manage timelines and deliverables, and be the main contact for client CISOs and compliance heads.

• Review and quality-check the work of GRC Analysts, and mentor them on regulations and audit practice.

• Maintain a tracker of all open gaps, observations and action items, follow up with owners and drive every open point to closure within the agreed timeline.

• Share weekly status reports with clients and a monthly summary for management, and escalate overdue and high-risk items early.

What you bring

• Minimum 4 years of hands-on experience in GRC, IS audit or regulatory compliance, with at least 2 years in BFSI, payments or capital markets.

• Strong working knowledge of RBI cyber security and IT governance directions, and practical exposure to NPCI and SEBI CSCRF requirements.

• Working knowledge of CERT-In and DPDP Act requirements.

• Hands-on experience implementing or auditing ISO 27001, with exposure to ISO 22301, ISO 27701 and PCI DSS.

• Experience leading audits or regulatory assessments and writing clear, risk-rated reports.

• Good understanding of IT and security controls across infrastructure, applications, cloud, payments and data protection.

• Confident communicator who can present to CISOs, senior management and board committees.

• Experience managing multiple engagements at the same time and mentoring junior team members.

• Disciplined follow-up, with experience tracking open items to closure and sharing regular status reports.

• Immediate joiner or notice period of up to 15 days.

• Able to work from our Bangalore office full-time, as this role has no hybrid or remote option.

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Electronics, Commerce or equivalent, a postgraduate degree is a plus.

Frameworks and tools

• RBI and NPCI: IT Governance Master Direction 2023, Cyber Security Framework, IT Outsourcing Master Direction 2023, Digital Payment Security Controls, PA and PSO guidelines, NPCI UPI and member audit requirements

• SEBI and others: SEBI CSCRF 2024, CERT-In directions 2022, UIDAI AUA and KUA requirements, DPDP Act 2023

• Frameworks: ISO 27001:2022, ISO 22301:2019, ISO 27701:2019, PCI DSS v4.0, SOC 2, NIST CSF

• Risk and audit: Risk registers, control libraries, audit programmes, Risk Mitigation Plans, KRIs, BIA

• GRC and reporting: ServiceNow GRC, MetricStream, Archer or similar, Jira, Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI

Good to have

• Experience working in or with a fintech company (payments, lending, wealth or insurtech) will be a valued advantage.

• Certifications such as CISA, CISM, CRISC, CDPSE, ISO 27001 or ISO 22301 Lead Auditor, or PCI DSS QSA or ISA.

• Experience with a CERT-In empanelled audit firm, a Big 4 firm or an in-house compliance team at a bank, NBFC, payment company or broker.

• Exposure to RBI IT examinations, SEBI inspections or NPCI audits.

• Experience with GRC platforms such as ServiceNow GRC, MetricStream or Archer.

Why HTS Consulting

• Lead regulatory and cyber compliance engagements for banks, NBFCs, payment companies, fintechs and brokers.

• Sponsored certifications (CISA, CISM, CRISC or Lead Auditor) and a training budget.

• A clear growth path to GRC Lead, Practice Lead and vCISO roles.

• Salary band will be discussed at the time of interview.

How to apply

Apply through LinkedIn, or share your profile with ashok@hts.consulting with the subject "Senior GRC Consultant – <Your Name>". Please mention your current CTC, expected CTC and notice period.

title: IT Compliance Specialist
description:
**IS/IT COMPLIANCE SPECIALIST**
**We are looking for a IS/IT Compliance Specialist to be part of our Nestlé Nespresso Digital and Tech Team. At Nespresso, our Digital & Tech teams are at the heart of our innovation journey, a space where we continue to invest, evolve, and grow.**
**Position Snapshot:**

* Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
* Type of Contract: Permanent
* Grade: Band 2
* Type of work: Hybrid
* Work Language: Fluent Business English

**The Role:**
*The primary responsibility of the Compliance Specialist is to ensure adherence to Nespresso and Nestlé Information Security policies and IT regulatory standards.*
*By supporting the implementation of integrated risk, compliance, and security management systems in alignment with the business risk appetite, the Compliance Specialist will provide essential knowledge to aid in the design of solutions, contractual agreements, and necessary controls.*
*The Compliance Specialist's responsibilities include assisting teams in navigating their risk, compliance, and security requirements through Nestlé's Information Security Management System (ISMS) to ensure that products and platforms are compliant and secure, meeting the business risk appetite. This role involves collaborating with business and IT teams across various Nespresso markets to educate them on the tools, processes, and frameworks necessary for ensuring compliance with internal standards and external regulations.*
**In This Role, You Will:**

* Ensure compliance with relevant laws, regulations, and internal policies and standards, including data protection and privacy laws, to protect organizational integrity.
* Conduct management system reviews, including control assessments for third-party SaaS solutions, to identify and report compliance gaps and potential risks in business operations and IT systems.
* Coach teams in effectively managing risk and compliance gaps through documented corrective and preventative actions.
* Support training initiatives for employees on security and compliance policies, procedures, and best practices to foster a culture of compliance within the organization.
* Assist in the implementation of various compliance initiatives and help manage the Nespresso Information Security Management System (ISMS) to ensure alignment with organizational policies and regulatory standards.

**What We’re Looking For:**

* Bachelor’s degree, related to Information Technology security, risk and compliance
* 2+ years of expertise in IT Risk and Compliance
* Familiarity with relevant laws and regulations, including data protection laws (e.g., GDPR, CCPA), PCI-DSS, and industry-specific compliance standards.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess compliance risks and recommend appropriate actions.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively convey compliance concepts to diverse audiences and work collaboratively across cross-functional teams.
* High level of attention to detail and accuracy in documentation and reporting.

**Extra Skills That Set You Apart:**

* Relevant certifications (e.g., CISA - Certified Information Systems Auditor)
* Knowledge of data privacy regulations (such as GDPR and CCPA) and ISO 27001 standards, ensuring effective compliance and risk management practices

**We Offer You:**
We offer more than just a job. We put people first and inspire you to become the best version of yourself.
  
  

* Flexible work policies including core hours and options for working from home. Discuss with us during the recruitment process to understand what flexibility could look like for you!
* Genuine opportunities for career and personal development through ongoing training and constant career opportunities reflecting our conviction that people are our most important asset.
* Modern "smart office" locations providing agile workspaces. Our state-of-the-art campus is equipped with areas to co-create, network, and chill!
* International, dynamic & inclusive working environment with attractive additional benefits.
* The pride to work for a B Corp certified company and one of the world’s most trusted brands.

**The Hiring Process:**

* Your Application: Submit your application, and we'll review it carefully (make sure your CV is in English as the hiring team is international).
* Initial Screening: Relevant candidates will be contacted by our Talent Acquisition team for an initial interview.
* Hiring Manager Interview: Selected candidates will then meet with the hiring manager to discuss the role and their experience in more detail.
* Stakeholder Interview: Candidates will engage with potential team members to assess fit and collaboration.
* Leadership & HRBP Interaction: Candidates will have a discussion with our leadership team & HRBP.
* Feedback: After interviews, we provide feedback to all candidates.
* Job Offer: Successful candidates will receive a formal offer.
* First Working Day: Once the offer is accepted, we’ll welcome you on your first day!

**About Nespresso:**
The Nespresso story began with a simple but revolutionary idea: enable anyone to create the perfect cup of espresso coffee.
  
  
Since 1986, Nespresso has redefined and revolutionized the way millions of people enjoy their coffee.
  
  
We are a Company committed with the Climate change and we aim to achieve carbon neutrality as soon as possible and net-zero GHG emissions by 2050 at the latest.
  
  
In 2019 we created the digital hub in Barcelona to offer the best customer experience and innovation to B2C and B2B channels.
  
  
*We encourage the diversity of applicants across gender, age, ethnicity, nationality, sexual orientation, social background, religion or belief and disability.*
People are at the heart of our success – all 14,000 of them. We actively cultivate diversity, inclusion and belonging in the workplace. We celebrate individuality, believing that your authenticity and uniqueness can help us to grow and thrive together
  
  
Step outside your comfort zone; share your ideas, way of thinking and working to make a difference to the world, every single day. You own a piece of the action – make it count.
  
  
**Join Nestlé #beaforceforgood**
#Nespresso

title: Senior Investigation Professional Compliance
description:

title: EYP-DM-Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**GDS EYP – S&E – Legal entity integration/separation and operationalization – Manager– India**
Within EY Parthenon (EYP), Strategy & Transactions (S&E) team services clients with a full range of hands-on, operationally focused support and advice across the transaction life cycle, across buyers and sellers. We cover a wide range of operational aspects, including divestiture advisory services, carve-out readiness and support, operational due diligence, synergy assessment and delivery, day-one readiness assessment, 100day planning, integration process support, carve-out/stand-alone costs assessment and risks, and cost reduction.
  
  
Our professionals work on transactions and business development across the globe.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We’re looking for Managers with 8–10 years of experience in M&A life cycle, carve-out / integration of a business post-announcement of transaction, cross-border M&A who specializes in Legal entity operationalization planning and execution.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Demonstrate excellent skills in developing cross functional legal entity operationalization workplans, following a transaction (integration or separation) or transformation program
* Identifying critical legal entity stand-up milestones for Day 1 and highlight any risks, issues and workarounds in various countries and regions
* Developing readiness assessments for legal entities, with focus on end-to-end process, cutover and hypercare planning
* Facilitating country and regional workshops to identify the critical path to achieve legal entity operationalization by Go-live
* Build relationships with EY offices across the globe and demonstrate knowledge of regional practices. Responsible for high degree of GDS stakeholder Satisfaction with engagement process and work products
* Assist in business development activities including preparing presentations for client and internal pursuit meetings
* Provide guidance on projects and mentor a team of S&E professionals
* Conduct timely performance reviews for employees and develop other professionals by providing effective performance feedback and training. Lead by example
* Identify business development opportunities and assist Partners and Senior Managers on proposals and new business opportunities

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Good understanding of M&A life cycle, carve-out / integration of a business post-announcement of transaction, cross-border M&A
* Understanding of legal entity stand-up, transfer, restructuring and rationalization in different transaction types
* Ability to determine risks and opportunity areas
* Skill to synthesize approaches to complex carve-out and integration conflicts
* Excellent problem solving, project management, facilitation and interpersonal skills
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Strong executive presence with good networking and negotiation sills
* Excellent knowledge of MS Excel, Word and PowerPoint
* Working knowledge of analytical tools such as PowerBI, Smartsheets, Power Query, Python, Macros would be preferred
* Analytical capabilities – knowledge of how to synthesize large amounts of data, develop hypotheses, test those hypotheses and use them to facilitate conversations with client executives
* AI capabilities – demonstrate foundational AI literacy, including prompt engineering, understanding AI-driven insights, using AI tools to improve efficiency and decision-making, and applying critical judgment to interpret and validate AI outputs

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Post Graduate degree in business, accounting, finance, engineering, computer science or related field from a premier institute with 8-10 years of applicable industry and/or consulting experience
* Understanding of M&A life cycle, carve-out / integration of a business post-announcement of transaction, cross-border M&A who specializes in Legal entity operationalization planning and execution.
* Well versed with MS Excel and PowerPoint
* Willingness to undertake international travel as per business requirement

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Project management skills
* Strong communication and presentation skills
* Ability to adopt new tools and technology

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 3000 + professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EYP practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Proposal Administrator
description:
The Proposal Administrator provides high-quality administrative, coordination and document-management support throughout the opportunity and proposal lifecycle. The role helps the Work Winning and technical teams deliver compliant, accurate and professional submissions for Expressions of Interest (EOIs), Pre-Qualification Questionnaires (PQQs), Requests for Proposals (RFPs), Requests for Quotations (RFQs), tenders and other client opportunities.

The role is responsible for maintaining reliable bid information, managing tender communications and client portals, coordinating standard corporate content, and supporting submissions in accordance with client requirements, internal governance and agreed deadlines.

  

**1. Proposal and bid administration**  

* Provide day-to-day administrative support across multiple opportunities and proposals.
* Set up and maintain bid folders, document structures, templates, schedules, trackers and submission files.
* Coordinate inputs from technical, commercial and corporate contributors against agreed deadlines.
* Compile, format and consolidate proposal documents in accordance with company templates and client instructions.
* Support final compliance checks, confirming that forms, declarations, attachments and supporting documents are complete.
* Maintain auditable records of submitted documents, approvals and final correspondence.

**2. Client portals and tender communications**  

* Monitor the team inbox and client procurement or tender portals, and distribute communications promptly to relevant team members.
* Register opportunities and download tender documents, addenda, clarifications and submission instructions.
* Submit technical queries and clarification requests prepared by the bid team within stipulated deadlines.
* Coordinate portal registrations, access permissions and user information with internal stakeholders.
* Upload proposal documents under the direction of the responsible Proposal or Bid Manager and retain submission confirmations.

**3. EOI and PQQ coordination**  

* Coordinate routine EOI and PQQ responses using approved corporate information and standard content.
* Gather required information from Finance, HR, technical teams and other business functions.
* Coordinate signatures, declarations, certificates, policies and supporting documents.
* Maintain completed prequalification content for efficient and controlled reuse.

**4. Proposal development support**  

* Support proposal kick-off activities by preparing folders, templates, response schedules and coordination trackers.
* Collect technical inputs, CVs, project experience, case studies, organisation charts and supporting evidence.
* Help contributors comply with page limits, templates, naming conventions and submission requirements.
* Provide formatting, proofreading, version-control and quality-check support before internal reviews and final submission.
* Support post-submission archiving, outcome recording, feedback capture and lessons learned.

**5. Opportunity and bid tracking**  

* Maintain accurate opportunity and submission records in the bid tracker and relevant business systems.
* Record key data such as client, project, market, value, stage, submission deadline, status and responsible team members.
* Track milestones including registration, clarification, review and submission dates.
* Support regular reporting on live and upcoming opportunities and follow up on missing or outdated information.

**6. Content and knowledge libraries**  

* Maintain controlled libraries of staff CVs, project sheets, case studies, standard company information, policies, certificates and approved proposal content.
* Work with contributors to obtain updated project and personnel information.
* Apply clear naming conventions, version control and archive arrangements.
* Remove or archive superseded material to reduce the risk of outdated content being used.

**7. Stakeholder coordination**  

* Act as a reliable coordination point between Work Winning, technical teams, Finance, HR, IT, leadership and other stakeholders.
* Communicate requirements and deadlines clearly, follow up professionally and escalate risks or missing information promptly.
* Support collaboration across offices, geographies and time zones while handling commercially sensitive information appropriately.

  

* Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering.
* Typically 2–5 years of experience in proposal administration, bid support, business development administration, project administration or document control.
* Experience in an engineering consultancy, infrastructure, construction or professional-services environment is desirable.
* Experience using client procurement portals, document-management platforms or CRM/work-winning systems is advantageous.

Skills and competencies

**Organisation and delivery**

* Strong planning, administration and time-management skills.
* Ability to coordinate several deadlines and priorities simultaneously.
* High attention to detail, accuracy and process discipline.

**Communication**

* Clear professional written and verbal English.
* Confident follow-up with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong proofreading and document-consistency skills.

  

**Digital capability**

* Strong Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook and Teams skills.
* Working knowledge of SharePoint, OneDrive and PDF tools.
* Ability to learn CRM, opportunity and proposal-management systems.

* Proactive, dependable, collaborative and service-oriented.

We’re hiring a Senior Manager – Global Total Rewards M&A & Benefit Plans to join our Global Benefits team.

This is a high-impact individual contributor role for someone who can operate comfortably at the intersection of M&A, divestitures, global employee benefits, insurance, financial analysis, and senior stakeholder advisory.

The role will be primarily focused on supporting Total Rewards activity across mergers, acquisitions and divestitures, acting as the lead for transactions from due diligence through integration or separation. Working in close partnership with Regional Rewards teams, the role brings together global Total Rewards principles, deal objectives, local market expertise and employee considerations to determine the appropriate approach for each transaction. This includes assessing risks and liabilities, identifying opportunities and synergies, shaping integration or separation approaches, and ensuring compensation and benefits considerations are effectively reflected in deal decisions.

* Lead in collaboration with the regional reward team, the development of compensation and benefits approaches for acquired or newly established populations, partnering with Regional Rewards on market benchmarking and the design of pay structures, salary ranges, benefits offerings and transition arrangements
* Assess compensation and benefits risks, liabilities, costs, synergies and harmonization opportunities and determine appropriate recommendations and actions
* Provide Total Rewards support for divestitures, including employee transition requirements, separation considerations, data needs and coordination of benefits continuity through close and transition
* Coordinate across Global Compensation, Benefits, Regional Rewards, HR, Finance, Legal, HRIT and external advisors to ensure transaction decisions are translated into clear actions and delivered to required timelines
* Support new-market compensation and benefits implementation, including plan setup, vendor implementation and employee data/system requirements
* Manage global oversight of employee insurance programs, broker relationships, renewals, claims trends and multinational pooling arrangements
* Lead global benefits benchmarking and assess regional benefit proposals against market data and internal guidelines

* Support global benefits dashboards, reporting and decision-making through strong analytical insight. Other benefit projects as defined by the Global Benefits leader

**Qualifications**

* Strong multi-country employee benefits and broader Total Rewards experience.
* Demonstrated experience supporting M&A and divestiture activity across due diligence, integration and separation
* Experience designing or evaluating compensation structures and benefits programs in new or changing markets, in partnership with regional subject-matter experts
* Deep understanding of medical insurance, insured benefits, broker relationships and multinational pooling
* Strong benefits benchmarking, costing and financial analysis capability
* Proven ability to lead through influence across global and regional teams, bringing different perspectives together while maintaining clear accountability for decisions and outcomes
* Confidence working with senior stakeholders across Total Rewards, Finance, HR, Legal and transaction teams
* Strong ownership, judgment and commercial acumen, with the ability to make decisions in ambiguous, fast-moving transaction environments
* Experience with Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar reporting tools is an advantage, and AI fluency or literacy is a plus

title: Senior Manager — SAP GRC Solution Architect, Audit & Compliance Governance
description:
Xylem is a Fortune 500 global water solutions company dedicated to advancing sustainable impact and empowering the people who make water work every day. As a leading water technology company with 23,000 employees operating in over 150 countries, Xylem is at the forefront of addressing the world's most critical water challenges. We invite passionate individuals to join our team, dedicated to exceeding customer expectations through innovative and sustainable solutions.

**Access control architecture and role design**

* Own the global SAP role design strategy and architecture — business role catalog, derivation strategy, naming

standards, and the design principles that keep roles maintainable as segments and waves are added.

* Design and maintain the segregation of duties ruleset, aligned to business process risk and validated with

internal audit, external audit, and process owners rather than accepted as a vendor default.

* Own risk analysis, mitigation control design, and the remediation roadmap for SoD conflicts across the

landscape, including the standing view of accepted risk and who accepted it.

* Establish role lifecycle management: change control, testing, approval, and periodic recertification with

business role ownership that is named and accountable.

**SAP GRC solution ownership**

* Own SAP GRC design, configuration, and operations across Access Control — Access Risk Analysis,

Emergency Access Management, Business Role Management, and Access Request Management — and

Process Control where applicable.

* Operate GRC as a product with a backlog and release cadence: ruleset maintenance, workflow design,

connector management, and continuous improvement.

* Own Emergency Access Management end to end — firefighter provisioning model, allocation approach,

activity logging, and log review discipline enforced within required windows. Where review timeliness has

slipped in the past, you own the design change that makes it structurally difficult to slip again

* Ensure any provisioning path that operates outside GRC — cutover accounts, data load IDs, technical users

— is deliberately designed, time-bound, monitored, and formally closed, never left as an undocumented

residue after go-live.

* Own user provisioning and deprovisioning integration with identity management, joiner-mover-leaver

processes, and HR-driven access lifecycle.

**Audit and compliance governance**

* Own SOX IT general controls and application controls for the SAP landscape: access to programs and data,

program change, program development, and computer operations.

* Serve as primary interface to internal audit, external audit, and control owners — evidence provision,

walkthrough support, deficiency response, and remediation tracking to closure.

* Design controls so evidence is generated as a byproduct of the system operating correctly, rather than

assembled manually at audit time.

* Maintain continuous control monitoring across access, configuration, and financial process controls, with

exceptions routed to owners for action.

* Own the compliance framework for data privacy and regulatory requirements as they apply to SAP data across

regions.

**Deployment wave and program integration**

* Provide GRC and controls readiness as a formal go-live gate for every deployment wave: role build, SoD

analysis, mitigating controls in place, and clean provisioning before cutover.

* Partner with the ABAP and BTP team on SoD-safe development standards, custom transaction and Fiori app

risk classification, and authorization object design.

* Partner with the Basis Leader on technical security operations, privileged access, and audit logging.
* Partner with process owners and the Data Conversion and MDG leads so control design reflects the actual

process design, not an idealized version of it.

* Lead a global team of GRC and security consultants across onshore and offshore, and hold AMS and system

integrator partners accountable for role quality and control adherence.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* 15+ years in SAP security and GRC, with at least 5 years in a solution architect or global leadership capacity.
* Deep hands-on SAP GRC Access Control expertise — ARA, EAM, BRM, ARM — including ruleset design,

workflow configuration, and connector architecture in production.

* Expert-level S/4HANA authorization design: authorization objects, Fiori catalogs, groups and spaces, business

roles, and the differences from classical ECC role design.

* Proven ownership of SoD ruleset design and remediation on a global program, with demonstrated conflict

reduction rather than documented conflict.

* Strong SOX ITGC and application control experience in a publicly listed environment, with direct external audit

engagement.

* Demonstrated design of controls that are automated and continuously evidenced, not dependent on manual

periodic execution.

* Experience delivering security and controls through multi-wave global S/4HANA deployments, including cutover and hypercare.

* Ability to hold a control position under delivery pressure — the credibility to explain to a program leader why an

exception costs more than the delay.

Preferred

* SAP Identity Management, IAG, or third-party IAM integration (SailPoint, Saviynt, Okta).
* SAP Process Control, Risk Management, or continuous control monitoring platforms.
* RISE with SAP security and shared responsibility model experience.
* BTP security architecture, identity propagation, and authorization models.
* CISA, CISM, CRISC, or SAP security certification.
* Manufacturing or industrial sector control environment, including plant-level and trade compliance

considerations.

**Success in the First 12 Months**

A rationalized global role model with named business role owners and a validated SoD ruleset. Firefighter usage

under a controlled model with log reviews completed inside required windows, evidenced automatically. All

non-GRC provisioning paths inventoried, time-bound, and closed. Controls readiness established as a

non-negotiable go-live gate. Audit findings and deficiencies closed on schedule, with a measurable reduction in

repeat findings. And a control environment where evidence is produced by the system rather than assembled by

people.

**Operating Principles You Will Work Under**

* Products, not projects. Persistent teams aligned to value streams, funded by capacity rather than project

cycles, each paired with a business process owner accountable for the outcome.

* Clean core is non-negotiable. Extensions live on BTP, the core stays standard, and custom code is governed at the point of creation.
* Paved road, not toll booth. Golden paths, reference architectures, and reusable patterns, with guardrails

enforced in the pipeline rather than in a design authority meeting.

* Compliance by default. Controls are designed into the platform and evidenced automatically, so control

integrity holds at deployment scale.

* Accountable for value, not volume. Success is measured in business process KPIs, adoption, and realized

value, not tickets closed or hours delivered.

* Intelligent enterprise by design. AI and agent enablement, and the data readiness that makes both credible,

are owned capabilities.

* Global template authority, local execution. Template integrity is held centrally through the current

deployment horizon, with a defined path to greater product-team autonomy.

Join the global Xylem team to be a part of innovative technology solutions transforming water usage, conservation, and re-use. Our products impact public utilities, industrial sectors, residential areas, and commercial buildings, with a commitment to providing smart metering, network technologies, and advanced analytics for water, electric, and gas utilities. Partner with us in creating a world where water challenges are met with ingenuity and dedication; where we recognize the power of inclusion and belonging in driving innovation and allowing us to compete more effectively around the world.

description:
**About the Client:**

Our client is a global organisation headquartered in Europe, with a growing presence in India. It runs two legal entities in India, across Chennai, Mumbai and Gurgaon.

**Role Purpose:**

The Head of HR - India will be accountable for the client's whole HR function in India. The role will meet business needs in line with the client's global HR processes while keeping full compliance with local labour laws and HR practices. The incumbent will be a trusted HR advisor to leaders and employees across both legal entities.

**Key Responsibilities:**

The role leads the full HR lifecycle, from hire to retire.

**Business Partnership:**

- Act as a trusted business partner to the India Leadership Team on all people matters.

- Work with India leaders to build a culture that reflects the client's global values and fits local needs and practices.

- Work with local leaders and Business Line counterparts to shape an organisational structure that supports the strategy for India.

- Partner with Business Managers on business cases for new teams, then plan and carry out approved team ramp-ups.

**Compliance, Governance and Risk Management:**

- Lead HR compliance, governance and risk management so that people practices are effective, ethical and compliant across the employee lifecycle.

- Strengthen controls, policies and data governance across the employee lifecycle.

- Drive consistency, transparency and accountability in HR decisions.

- Manage people risks proactively and respond to changing regulations.

- Lead compliance with India's Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act.

**Talent Acquisition and Staffing:**

- Work with Business Managers on the overall budget, and drive a recruitment strategy that brings in the right capabilities on time.

- Lead the planned growth in headcount over the next two years.

**People Processes:**

- Implement and monitor local people processes in line with the client's global guidelines and local market practice. These include talent reviews, performance management, development programmes, recruitment, compensation and salary reviews.

- Develop and manage succession plans for key roles.

- Design benefits and policies that keep the organisation competitive.

**Employee Retention and Engagement:**

- Identify the main drivers of retention and engagement, then design and run initiatives that strengthen them.

- Drive the annual global employee engagement survey in India: launch, participation and results analysis. Then lead action planning with leaders to deliver measurable year-on-year improvement in engagement scores.

**HR Service Delivery:**

- Own HR service delivery in India.

- Manage relationships with functional stakeholders at global headquarters and across the client's Business Lines.

**Reporting, AI, Automation and HR Technology:**

- Lead AI and digital transformation across HR to improve workforce outcomes, employee experience and operational efficiency.

- Scale HR technology for talent, performance, workforce planning and employee services.

- Improve HR systems and data to streamline processes and support better insights and decisions.

- Partner with HR, Digital and business teams on innovation, automation and productivity.

**Payroll and Statutory Compliance:**

- Own the accurate running of monthly payroll and all required HR statutory compliance.

**Learning and Development:**

- Run the annual Training Needs Analysis (TNA) and prepare the learning calendar.

- Set up a learning framework and create opportunities for continuous learning and professional development.

**External Communication:**

- Work with the Group Communications team on messaging and on press conferences, press releases and other media activity, as required.

**People Management:**

- Make sure the HR team is properly staffed and builds the skills needed for the organisation's growth.

- Keep the team motivated.

**Education and experience:**

- Postgraduate qualification in Human Resources.

- At least 15 years of HR experience, including 6 - 8 years in leadership roles.

- HR generalist with deep exposure to talent management and the ability to manage payroll and HR compliance.

- Experience in a global, matrixed organisation, managing global stakeholders (required).

- End-to-end talent acquisition experience (an advantage).

- Certifications (an advantage): CIPD, SHRM, PMP, CCMP or Prosci.

- Languages: English required; Hindi and Tamil preferred.

title: Manager, Business Operations
description:
**The Company**
PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.
  
  
We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
  
  
We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.
  
  
Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.
  
  
**Job Summary:**
**What Do You Need To Know About The Role**
The Core Platforms Technology team is looking for a talented, self-driven, and analytically minded Business Operations professional. Reporting to the Chief of Staff, the Business Operations Analyst will partner with engineering leaders and cross-functional teams to improve operating discipline, generate actionable insights, and enable data-driven decision-making across the organization.
  
  
This role combines business operations, data analysis, workforce and capacity planning, portfolio governance, communications, and program execution.
  
  
Meet Our Team
  
  
The Business Operations team supports the Core Platforms Technology leadership team and helps the organization operate effectively at scale. We partner closely with Engineering, Product, Finance, People, Strategy, and other Business Operations teams to translate business priorities into measurable plans and coordinated execution.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**Essential Responsibilities:**

* Lead functional projects and programs to optimize operational processes.
* Identify issues and recommend best practices for process improvements.
* Partner with various departments to understand business trends.
* Drive business or process improvements within the function.
* Provide oversight and support for planning and management of financial, budget, and headcount targets.
* Act as a point of contact or liaison between business leadership, staff, and other key partners.
* Promote transparent reporting and foster a culture of data-driven decision-making by defining key metrics and evaluating progress.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* 5+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:**
**Your Day-to-Day Responsibilities**
In this role, you will:
  
  

* Prepare, analyze, and interpret organizational and operational data, including workforce census, OKRs, KPIs, capacity, investment plans, roadmaps, delivery health, and other leadership reporting.
* Translate data into actionable insights, clearly identifying trends, risks, dependencies, and opportunities for leadership consideration.
* Create dashboards, executive presentations, and decision-support materials that communicate complex information clearly and concisely.
* Partner with engineering and product teams to maintain data quality, reporting accuracy, and consistent operating metrics.
* Support annual and quarterly planning processes, including workforce planning, capacity planning, resource allocation, and scenario modelling for employees and contingent workers.
* Support portfolio and operating reviews by tracking priorities, milestones, risks, dependencies, decisions, and follow-through.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and improve recurring operational processes and reporting.
* Use company-approved AI and automation tools to accelerate analysis, generate initial insights, synthesize information, and improve the efficiency of reporting and communications.
* Evaluate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, relevance, bias, and business context, while adhering to applicable data privacy, security, and responsible-AI requirements.

title: Employee Central specialist
description:
**Are you the kind of person who slows down before making a foundational change, thinks through the downstream consequences, and finds satisfaction in building HR data structures that hold up over time?** Then join our mission to pioneer smarter water solutions that reduce energy use and improve lives.

As our new **Employee Central Specialist**, you'll be safeguarding and evolving the SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central foundation—position management, data model integrity and job catalogue structures—that underpins every downstream HR module, integration and report across our global landscape. You'll be part of a diverse, supportive and inclusive culture, that celebrates our differences and puts people first by fostering growth, well-being, and a sense of belonging.

**What you will be doing**
==========================

As a key part of the HR Platform Solutions team, you'll create impact by ensuring that foundational Employee Central configurations are robust, well-documented and future-proof, so module specialists, integrations and reporting all work seamlessly as Grundfos scales.

Your main responsibilities include:

* Own the Employee Central foundation layer—data model, position management and job catalogue—ensuring changes land without breaking downstream modules, integrations or reporting
* Model consequences across modules before configuring, proactively identifying risks rather than discovering them after deployment
* Support the India rollout by implementing global standards for Employee Central while respecting local legal and regulatory requirements
* Document every structural decision with its reasoning so future changes build on knowledge rather than repeat past mistakes
* Partner with module specialists to provide the foundation data and structures they need, staying accessible and collaborative without gatekeeping
* Drive continuous reduction of known foundation problems, replacing accumulated workarounds with clean, sustainable solutions

**What makes you a great fit**
==============================

Above all, you're a meticulous, systems-minded HR technology professional who combines deep Employee Central expertise with the patience and influence to hold data model integrity against pressure for quick fixes—someone trusted enough that when you say a change will take longer, people believe you. We'd also imagine that you are/have:

* 3+ years of hands-on experience with SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central, including position management and foundation data model configuration
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in HR, IT, Business or equivalent practical experience
* Demonstrated ability to lead HR process or configuration projects with cross-module impact
* Strong understanding of how Employee Central foundation choices affect downstream modules such as Compensation, Time, Payroll and integrations

It's a plus if you also:

* Experience supporting large-scale SuccessFactors rollouts in complex, multi-country environments
* Familiarity with Indian HR regulations and statutory requirements within Employee Central
* SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central certification

**Why you'll love working here**
================================

Day to day, you can look forward to:

* A working environment built around your needs, with flexible hours, home working opportunities and parental support.
* Annual bonuses, health insurance and a strong focus on well-being activities.
* Three days' additional paid leave for volunteering.
* On-demand training and structured development programmes to support your growth.

Valuing our differences helps us see possibilities where others can't. We therefore welcome and encourage applications from all abilities, experiences, and backgrounds. As part of our commitment to a safe and compliant hiring process, final candidates may be required to undergo a background check, subject to applicable local laws and regulations.

**Join Grundfos, apply today!**

Evernorth Health Services is the pharmacy, care and benefits solution division of The Cigna Group.
  
  
HIH - Program Management Lead Analyst (Workforce Management)
  
  
**Position Summary:**  
The Program Management Lead Analyst (Workforce Management) will support Hyderabad leadership in driving workforce planning, capacity management, capability development, talent readiness, and workforce insights. The role will partner with business leaders, HR, Talent Acquisition, Learning Development, and functional teams to align talent supply and workforce capabilities with business priorities and growth objectives. The advisor will bring structure, analytics, and governance to workforce decisions in a complex, matrixed environment.
  
  
**Job Description Responsibilities:**  
Workforce Planning Capacity Management
  

* Lead workforce management and capacity-planning processes to align talent supply with current and future business demand.
* Develop workforce forecasts, capacity plans, hiring outlooks, and resource recommendations aligned with business priorities.
* Partner with business leaders and functional teams to translate growth, transition, and transformation priorities into workforce requirements.
* Maintain workforce-planning assumptions, demand inputs, governance routines, and readiness views.

Capability Management Skills Frameworks
  

* Develop and maintain the enterprise capability taxonomy, skill frameworks, competency models, and role architecture.
* Create and maintain skills inventories and capability maps to improve visibility into workforce strengths and development needs.
* Support role standardization, workforce segmentation, career pathways, and future capability requirements.
* Ensure capability and skill frameworks remain aligned with evolving business priorities.

Workforce Readiness Stakeholder Partnership
  

* Partner with business leaders, HR, Talent Acquisition, Learning Development, and functional teams to identify skill gaps and workforce risks.
* Drive workforce-readiness initiatives focused on critical skills, emerging capabilities, talent mobility, upskilling, and reskilling.
* Facilitate workforce governance forums and ensure clear ownership and follow-through on agreed talent actions.
* Influence workforce and capability strategies through structured recommendations and stakeholder alignment.

Workforce Analytics, Insights Governance Reporting
  

* Produce talent insights, workforce analytics, scorecards, and governance reports to support strategic decision-making.
* Analyze workforce capacity, skill gaps, capability maturity, hiring outlook, and talent-readiness indicators.
* Translate workforce data into concise executive insights, planning materials, and investment recommendations.
* Maintain consistent definitions, data quality, and reporting discipline across workforce metrics.

Success Measures
  

* Accurate workforce forecasts and capacity plans that support business priorities and growth objectives.
* Enterprise-wide adoption and maintenance of capability taxonomy, role architecture, and skills frameworks.
* Improved visibility into workforce capabilities, skill gaps, and talent readiness across functions.
* Delivery of actionable talent insights that enable informed workforce and capability investment decisions.

Qualifications
  
  
**Competencies / Skills:**  

* Workforce Planning Capacity Management
* Capability Taxonomy, Skills Frameworks Role Architecture
* Workforce Analytics Executive Reporting
* Talent Strategy, Organizational Design Workforce Readiness
* Stakeholder Management and Influence Without Authority
* Analytical Thinking, Structured Problem Solving Decision Support
* Governance, Facilitation Cross-Functional Program Management

**Education:**  

* Bachelors degree or higher in Human Resources, Business, Organizational Development, Analytics, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered.
* Professional certification in workforce planning, talent management, HR analytics, organizational development, or program management is preferred but not mandatory.

Experience
  
  
**Required:**  

* 8 - 10 years of experience in Talent Management, Workforce Planning, HR Analytics, Capability Management, or related disciplines.
* Strong experience in workforce planning, skills inventory, capability mapping, capacity planning, and organizational design.
* Proven ability to work with senior stakeholders and influence talent and workforce strategies.
* Experience leveraging workforce data and analytics to drive talent decisions and business outcomes.
* Ability to operate independently, manage ambiguity, and bring structure to evolving workforce priorities.
* Strong proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint; experience with workforce analytics, HR reporting, or visualization tools is preferred.

**Desired:**  

* Experience supporting a large-scale GCC, shared-services, technology, healthcare, or enterprise workforce environment.
* Exposure to enterprise capability frameworks, skills-based workforce practices, workforce transformation, and future-of-work initiatives.
* Demonstrated discretion in handling sensitive workforce information and leadership communications.

Equal Opportunity Statement
  
Evernorth is an Equal Opportunity Employer actively encouraging and supporting organization-wide involvement of staff in diversity, equity, and inclusion efforts to educate, inform and advance both internal practices and external work with diverse client populations.
  
  
About Evernorth Health Services
  
Evernorth Health Services, a division of The Cigna Group, creates pharmacy, care and benefit solutions to improve health and increase vitality. We relentlessly innovate to make the prediction, prevention and treatment of illness and disease more accessible to millions of people. Join us in driving growth and improving lives.

**HIH - Program Management Lead Analyst (Workforce Management)**
****Position Summary:****
The Program Management Lead Analyst (Workforce Management) will support Hyderabad leadership in driving workforce planning, capacity management, capability development, talent readiness, and workforce insights. The role will partner with business leaders, HR, Talent Acquisition, Learning & Development, and functional teams to align talent supply and workforce capabilities with business priorities and growth objectives. The advisor will bring structure, analytics, and governance to workforce decisions in a complex, matrixed environment.
  
  
****Job Description & Responsibilities:****
**Workforce Planning & Capacity Management**

* Lead workforce management and capacity-planning processes to align talent supply with current and future business demand.
* Develop workforce forecasts, capacity plans, hiring outlooks, and resource recommendations aligned with business priorities.
* Partner with business leaders and functional teams to translate growth, transition, and transformation priorities into workforce requirements.
* Maintain workforce-planning assumptions, demand inputs, governance routines, and readiness views.

****Capability Management & Skills Frameworks****

* Develop and maintain the enterprise capability taxonomy, skill frameworks, competency models, and role architecture.
* Create and maintain skills inventories and capability maps to improve visibility into workforce strengths and development needs.
* Support role standardization, workforce segmentation, career pathways, and future capability requirements.
* Ensure capability and skill frameworks remain aligned with evolving business priorities.

**Workforce Readiness & Stakeholder Partnership**

* Partner with business leaders, HR, Talent Acquisition, Learning & Development, and functional teams to identify skill gaps and workforce risks.
* Drive workforce-readiness initiatives focused on critical skills, emerging capabilities, talent mobility, upskilling, and reskilling.
* Facilitate workforce governance forums and ensure clear ownership and follow-through on agreed talent actions.
* Influence workforce and capability strategies through structured recommendations and stakeholder alignment.

**Workforce Analytics, Insights & Governance Reporting**

* Produce talent insights, workforce analytics, scorecards, and governance reports to support strategic decision-making.
* Analyze workforce capacity, skill gaps, capability maturity, hiring outlook, and talent-readiness indicators.
* Translate workforce data into concise executive insights, planning materials, and investment recommendations.
* Maintain consistent definitions, data quality, and reporting discipline across workforce metrics.

**Success Measures**

* Accurate workforce forecasts and capacity plans that support business priorities and growth objectives.
* Enterprise-wide adoption and maintenance of capability taxonomy, role architecture, and skills frameworks.
* Improved visibility into workforce capabilities, skill gaps, and talent readiness across functions.
* Delivery of actionable talent insights that enable informed workforce and capability investment decisions.

****Qualifications****
**Competencies / Skills:**

* Workforce Planning & Capacity Management
* Capability Taxonomy, Skills Frameworks & Role Architecture
* Workforce Analytics & Executive Reporting
* Talent Strategy, Organizational Design & Workforce Readiness
* Stakeholder Management and Influence Without Authority
* Analytical Thinking, Structured Problem Solving & Decision Support
* Governance, Facilitation & Cross-Functional Program Management

****Education:****

* Bachelor's degree or higher in Human Resources, Business, Organizational Development, Analytics, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered.
* Professional certification in workforce planning, talent management, HR analytics, organizational development, or program management is preferred but not mandatory.

****Experience****
**Required:**

* 8 - 10 years of experience in Talent Management, Workforce Planning, HR Analytics, Capability Management, or related disciplines.
* Strong experience in workforce planning, skills inventory, capability mapping, capacity planning, and organizational design.
* Proven ability to work with senior stakeholders and influence talent and workforce strategies.
* Experience leveraging workforce data and analytics to drive talent decisions and business outcomes.
* Ability to operate independently, manage ambiguity, and bring structure to evolving workforce priorities.
* Strong proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint; experience with workforce analytics, HR reporting, or visualization tools is preferred.

****Desired:****

* Experience supporting a large-scale GCC, shared-services, technology, healthcare, or enterprise workforce environment.
* Exposure to enterprise capability frameworks, skills-based workforce practices, workforce transformation, and future-of-work initiatives.
* Demonstrated discretion in handling sensitive workforce information and leadership communications.

**Equal Opportunity Statement**
Evernorth is an Equal Opportunity Employer actively encouraging and supporting organization-wide involvement of staff in diversity, equity, and inclusion efforts to educate, inform and advance both internal practices and external work with diverse client populations.
  
  
****About Evernorth Health Services****
Evernorth Health Services, a division of The Cigna Group, creates pharmacy, care and benefit solutions to improve health and increase vitality. We relentlessly innovate to make the prediction, prevention and treatment of illness and disease more accessible to millions of people. Join us in driving growth and improving lives.

title: Founder's Office
description:
**About Roligt Foods**

Roligt Foods is building a next gen clean label beverage brand out of Hyderabad. We make drinks with short, honest ingredient lists and nothing we cannot defend. We are pre-launch, running live activations across the city and rolling out smart vending kiosks. As we scale, we are building a small team that owns outcomes, not tasks.

**The role**

This role in the Founder's Office works directly with the founder and sees the whole business. Based in Hyderabad, you track every vertical (kiosks, events, brand, sales, production and finance), spot what is slipping and push it to closure. You run the operating rhythm of the company and take on the problems that do not have an owner yet. This role suits someone who wants to learn how a consumer business is run end to end, and is comfortable being held to outcomes early.

**What you will do**

* Track the weekly numbers of every vertical: kiosk sales and uptime, events and leads, brand, production and cash.
* Run the weekly leadership review. Prepare the dashboard, capture decisions and chase every action to closure.
* Own special projects for the founder: new channels, partnerships, pricing and launch plans.
* Do the first-pass analysis on business questions and come back with a recommendation, not just data.
* Work with the kiosk, events, brand and finance leads to unblock work that sits between teams.
* Prepare investor, board and partner material: decks, memos and updates.
* Lead the Generalist Interns in the Founder's Office and review their work.

**You will do well here if you have**

* An MBA (final year or recent graduate) or an undergraduate degree from a strong programme. Any stream. Up to 3 years of experience in consulting, startups, FMCG or operations is a plus.
* Strong Excel or Google Sheets and clear structured thinking. You can build a simple model and explain it.
* Clear, short writing. You can turn a messy discussion into a one-page note.
* Comfort moving between strategy and execution in the same day.
* High ownership and the discipline to follow up until things are done.

**What we offer**

* Fair, competitive pay in line with industry standards, based on your experience and track record.
* Fast-track growth. You work directly with the founder and see a consumer business built from zero.
* Broad exposure across product, brand, events, retail and operations.
* Real ownership. Small team, fast decisions. Your work shows up in the numbers.

**Please do not apply if**

* You are not based in, or not willing to relocate to, Hyderabad.
* You want a fixed job description that never changes.
* You are not comfortable working closely with the founder and being challenged on your work.

**How to apply**

Apply with your resume. At the top of your resume, add two lines on one problem you owned end to end and what the result was.

We are selective about who we hire. If you do not hear back within three weeks of applying, please assume your application has not been taken forward this time.

Our Culture

title: FGBS ACES Sr CI Expert, FGBS ACES
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

At Amazon we strive to be Earth’s most customer obsessed company. Our passion for invention leads us to continually pioneer and globalize new businesses and customer offerings. As a result, Amazon continues to grow and evolve across many different business lines.
  
  
In supporting this growth and evolution, Amazon Finance Operations (FinOps) goal is to deliver seamless procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, and payroll processes that enable geographic and market expansion across all Amazon’s businesses, from Retail, Digital, and Advertising through to AWS and Logistics, while ensuring regulatory and legal compliance. As part of this growth, we now seek a Customer Obsessed, Results Driven Sr Business Development Expert for our Amazon Customer Excellence Services (ACES) team within Finance Global Business Services (FGBS).
  
  
The ACES Business Development team is a project discovery task force that specializes in linking business strategy to opportunity identification and project selection. We believe the future of successful project management involves doing the right projects — not just doing projects right. That means making excellent decisions about which opportunities should become projects. The business development strategy uses a combination of voice of the customer, voice of the business, voice of the employee, and voice of the process to capture improvement opportunities in complex interdependent business functions.
  
  
This role leads the identification, quantification, and definition of project opportunities between FGBS verticals and FGBS ACES Black Belts. You will apply a mixture of qualitative, quantitative, networking, and leadership skills to drive a culture of exploration, opportunity creation, and continuous improvement. The program strategy is defined, but the business problem and solution may not be. You deliver independently, seeking direction on strategic priorities.
  
  
You will leverage AI as a force multiplier across the entire business development lifecycle — from AI-powered data mining and predictive opportunity identification, to automated process analysis and intelligent stakeholder engagement. You do not simply use AI; you deliver business development differently because of it.  
  
  
  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Your responsibilities will span the following core dimensions:
  
  
Strategic Opportunity Identification & AI-Augmented Discovery
  
  
Lead project discovery and define phases of high-impact Lean Six Sigma projects (DMAIC, DFSS, Kaizen, FMEA, etc.), partnering with FGBS business teams to identify opportunities related to cost saving, revenue leakage, and efficiencies.
  
  
Leverage AI tools to accelerate and enhance opportunity identification — using AI-powered data mining, predictive analytics, and automated process analysis to identify patterns and opportunities that manual analysis would miss.
  
  
Manage a portfolio of improvement projects, including auditing of transitioned projects to ensure that process improvements are sustained and benefits are realized.
  
  
Develop quantitative and qualitative process maps to describe how various people and teams within a business are involved in a process, objectively evaluating process workflows to understand the current state.
  
  
Discover and assess automation initiatives, regulatory compliance opportunities, and other critical business decisions.
  
  
Cross-Organizational Partnerships & Influence
  
  
Develop cross-organizational partnerships to drive identification, quantification, and definition of project opportunities between FGBS verticals and FGBS ACES Black Belts.
  
  
Work closely with FGBS and corporate partners (Finance, Accounting, Legal, HR, Facilities, Safety, IT, Customer Service) to secure support and resources for savings opportunities.
  
  
Represent FGBS ACES in local and global meetings/conference calls and with network-wide projects.
  
  
Influence customers, roadmap priorities, and decisions across multiple teams.
  
  
Data Analytics & Quantification
  
  
Conduct advanced data mining to conclude if defects will lead to excessive costs, reduced revenue/GMS, or increased audit/controllership risks.
  
  
Read and transform organizational data to evaluate process details, prioritize fixes, and continually track workflows.
  
  
Leverage AI to automate data extraction, pattern recognition, and predictive modelling for opportunity assessment.
  
  
Provide periodic updates to senior management, including opportunity pipeline metrics, impact projections, and strategic recommendations for project selection.
  
  
Training & Development
  
  
Mentor team members on business development methodology, data analytics, and AI-augmented discovery approaches.
  
  
Coach new team members on Lean, Six Sigma, and project management fundamentals.
  
  
Promote a culture of exploration, opportunity creation, and continuous improvement.
  
  
Share business development best practices and AI-augmented approaches across the ACES community.
  
  
Communication & Influence
  
  
Contribute to team and organization documents (e.g., opportunity assessments, project charters, MBR/QBR, roadmaps).
  
  
Translate complex data sets into actionable strategies and compelling narratives for stakeholders.
  
  
Influence managers and peer teams without authority, driving alignment on project selection and prioritization.
  
  
Communicate effectively across an increasing diversity of business and technical audiences.
  
  
A day in the life  
Lead project discovery activities — using AI-powered data mining and process analysis to identify high-value improvement opportunities.
  
  
Partner with FGBS business teams and ACES Black Belts to quantify and define project opportunities.
  
  
Manage the opportunity portfolio — auditing transitioned projects and tracking sustained benefits.
  
  
Develop comprehensive process maps and conduct advanced current-state analysis across value streams.
  
  
Mentor L4 team members on business development methodology and AI-augmented approaches.
  
  
Represent FGBS ACES in cross-functional forums and drive alignment on project selection.
  
  
Provide strategic recommendations to senior management on opportunity prioritization.
  
  
About the team  
  
FGBS ACES drives Operational Excellence (OE) across Amazon by delivering AI-enabled, data-driven solutions that reduce costs, improve quality, and build sustainable capabilities. Through strategic partnerships, intelligent automation, and innovative technology, we empower customers to achieve faster, smarter, and scalable results.
  
  
What are FGBS ACES central tenets  

* We design and develop sustainable and innovative solutions to reduce defect and improve performance.
* We embrace AI enabled data-driven approach to identify root causes and prevent reoccurrence.
* We relentlessly prioritize on the areas with the highest future impact.
* We create mechanisms, that sustain solutions and scale best practices.
* We mentor and train people across the Finance organization on six-sigma and lean methodologies.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of program or project management experience
* 5+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
* 2+ years of change management experience
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
* Experience in complex problem solving, and working in a tight schedule environment

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience building processes, project management, and schedules
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Six Sigma Black Belt certification
* Master's degree or above in business administration, finance, economics, computer science, data science, engineering, or other related field, or Master's degree in engineering, statistics, computer science, operations research, business analytics, information systems or equivalent
* Experience with data analysis tools such as Advanced Excel, SQL, Tableau, Python
* 5+ years of finance operations/shared services, accounts payable, account receivable (collections) or general ledger experience
* Experience in program or project management including the delivery of cross-functional projects
* Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (i.e. SQL, MS Power Query, Python), or experience with process improvement, Kaizan, and Six Sigma
* Knowledge of ERP systems (e.g. SAP, ORACLE, Coupa) in large organizations
* Experience working in large teams or at a national/multinational organization, or experience participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results
* Knowledge of BI analytics, reporting or visualization tools like Tableau, AWS QuickSight, Cognos or other third-party tools
* Experience designing AI-augmented business development workflows (e.g., AI-powered opportunity identification, predictive analytics for project selection, automated process analysis).

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Product Owner Finance & P&O
