description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Customer**
The Customer Team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, GenAI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We enable Deloitte client service teams to enhance customer experience and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital product and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects, balancing business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to help solve the biggest problems that impact customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce. We also offer Business Process as a Service, enabling organizations to streamline operations and achieve greater efficiency through scalable, technology-enabled managed insights that guide ongoing transformation and operational excellence.
  
  
**Position Summary**
Level: Manager or equivalent
  
  
We are seeking a Sales Operations Technologist Manager to lead the design and implementation of scalable Sales Operations solutions across CRM, CPQ, ERP, data, analytics, and AI platforms. This role combines deep Sales Operations domain expertise with solution architecture, systems integration, automation, delivery leadership, and practical application of Agentic AI.
  
  
The successful candidate will help life sciences organizations improve commercial effectiveness across pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, diagnostics, and healthcare businesses. The Manager will lead client engagements, shape solution strategies, develop high-performing teams, and contribute to the growth of our Sales Operations and commercial technology capabilities.
  
  
**Work you’ll do:**
As a Manager, you will lead multidisciplinary teams and work directly with client executives, commercial leaders, business stakeholders, IT organizations, data teams, and technology partners to deliver measurable business outcomes. You will be responsible for shaping solutions from strategy and discovery through design, implementation, adoption, and value realization.
  
  
You will lead and oversee work across the following areas:
  
  

* Translate Sales Operations requirements into scalable solutions supporting territory and account alignment, segmentation and targeting, quota and incentive planning, sales forecasting, pipeline and opportunity management, account planning, field productivity, pricing and quoting, approvals, and commercial performance reporting.
* Define enterprise solution architectures and delivery approaches integrating CRM, CPQ, ERP, data, analytics, workflow, and AI platforms.
* Lead implementations and solution delivery across platforms such as Salesforce, Veeva, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle, SAP, and other enterprise applications.
* Establish reusable integration patterns, APIs, data models, workflows, accelerators, and delivery standards that can be deployed across client environments.
* Identify, prioritize, and oversee practical Agentic AI use cases, including sales planning assistants, forecasting and pipeline analysis agents, next-best-action recommendations, account and territory intelligence, automated opportunity and CRM hygiene, quoting and approval support, and sales performance insights.
* Define and oversee human-in-the-loop controls, access controls, auditability, evaluation criteria, monitoring, and escalation paths for AI-enabled solutions.
* Lead discovery workshops, process assessments, design sessions, demonstrations, executive discussions, testing, deployment planning, and adoption activities.
* Build trusted relationships with client executives and key stakeholders, facilitate difficult decisions, manage expectations, and communicate risks, dependencies, and trade-offs clearly.
* Manage delivery quality, scope, schedule, resources, risks, issues, dependencies, and financial performance across workstreams or engagements.
* Coach and develop consultants and senior consultants through structured feedback, hands-on leadership, and opportunities to expand their domain and technology expertise.
* Establish solution roadmaps, implementation plans, operating models, adoption strategies, governance approaches, and measurable value cases.
* Support and lead pre-sales activities, including account planning, proposals, statements of work, solution demonstrations, estimates, client presentations, and pursuit strategy.
* Contribute to market eminence, intellectual capital, reusable assets, accelerators, and offerings that strengthen our Sales Operations and commercial technology portfolio.
* Ensure solutions reflect life sciences-specific requirements related to HCP/HCO data, field force structures, regulatory expectations, data privacy, commercial compliance, and data governance.

**The team:**
Step into our
**Sales & Service**
team, where technology powers business impact and innovation drives everything we do. As a global, dynamic group, we deliver seamless, end-to-end solutions—advising on strategy, implementing advanced CRM or back-office platforms, and enabling continuous business improvement. Here, you’ll collaborate with passionate, creative minds to transform sales models, elevate service excellence, and optimize customer operations. If you’re ready to grow your expertise, make bold ideas real, and help redefine the customer experience for leading organizations, this is your next big move. Join us and shape the future of sales and service!
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* 10+ years of consulting or industry experience, including significant experience leading Sales Operations, Commercial Operations, CRM, CPQ, business transformation, or technology implementation initiatives.
* Experience leading end-to-end client engagements or major workstreams, including delivery planning, team leadership, quality management, risk management, and executive communication.
* Strong understanding of Sales Operations processes and performance drivers, including territory and account alignment, segmentation, targeting, quota and incentive planning, forecasting, pipeline management, account planning, pricing, quoting, approvals, and performance reporting.
* Experience implementing or integrating two or more CRM, CPQ, ERP, data, or analytics platforms.
* Experience with APIs, middleware, data integration, workflow automation, enterprise solution architecture, and delivery governance.
* Practical knowledge of Agentic AI, generative AI, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, tool calling, AI orchestration, or related enterprise AI patterns.
* Ability to convert business requirements into solution strategies, functional designs, technical specifications, implementation plans, roadmaps, and value cases.
* Demonstrated ability to lead workshops, influence senior stakeholders, manage ambiguity, resolve issues, and make sound delivery decisions.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, presentation, relationship management, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience leading, coaching, and developing consulting or technology delivery teams
* Experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, diagnostics, or healthcare commercial operations.
* Knowledge of HCP/HCO master data, customer consent, field force effectiveness, promotional compliance, and commercial data governance.

**Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* Experience with Salesforce, Veeva CRM, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle CPQ, Salesforce Revenue Cloud, SAP CPQ, or similar platforms.
* Experience with cloud platforms, data warehouses, business intelligence tools, and low-code/no-code automation platforms.
* Familiarity with AI governance, model evaluation, prompt engineering, agent monitoring, responsible AI practices, and enterprise controls.
* Consulting, systems integration, product management, enterprise architecture, or operating model design experience.
* Experience developing proposals, estimates, solution demonstrations, reusable assets, or market-facing points of view.
* Relevant Salesforce, Veeva, CPQ, cloud, data, architecture, or AI certifications.

**Success Measures**
Success in this role will be measured by:
  
  

* Delivery of high-quality Sales Operations solutions that achieve agreed client outcomes, timelines, and quality expectations.
* Adoption, usability, and sustained business value of implemented solutions.
* Reduction in manual processes, disconnected workflows, and operational friction.
* Improved CRM, Sales Operations, and commercial data quality.
* Faster planning, forecasting, quoting, approval, and decision-making cycles.
* Reusability and scalability of solution components across platforms, business units, and clients.
* Demonstrated business value from AI-enabled capabilities with appropriate controls and monitoring.
* Effective management of data privacy, compliance, security, delivery, and operational risks.
* Strong client relationships, team engagement, talent development, and contribution to pursuit and practice growth.

**Education:**

title: Delivery Head, Business & IT Enablement
description:
**Role Overview**
The Delivery Head leads an enterprise managed-services portfolio covering procurement and asset management, order management, supplier and catalogue management, software asset and licence management, trade and compliance, financial reconciliation and continuous improvement, amongst other shared services functions. The role is accountable for delivery against agreed service levels and for the performance of the teams delivering these services.
  
  
The role is the senior point of accountability for the client, leading governance and working with service owners and stakeholders across procurement, finance, legal, security and compliance. The successful candidate will combine senior leadership with a strong understanding of operational processes, risks and exceptions.
  
  
The Delivery Head will also lead improvement and automation, develop the operating model, and contribute to new business through solution design, bids and client presentations. The role is based in Hyderabad and requires working from the office, client-site presence and escalation availability across a 24x5 operation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Service Delivery Leadership & Operational Excellence
* Own delivery across every service line in the portfolio, with accountability for service levels, quality, throughput and customer satisfaction.
* Run daily, weekly and monthly reviews, using trends and leading indicators to manage performance.
* Act as the senior escalation point for operational issues, ensuring issues are resolved at the appropriate level.
* Ensure each service line maintains current procedures, controls and audit evidence, with consistent quality assurance.
* Plan capacity and coverage across service lines and shifts to meet changing demand.
* Client Partnership & Governance
* Act as the single point of contact and accountability to the client for the portfolio, across service owners, procurement, finance, legal, security and compliance stakeholders.
* Chair operational, monthly service and quarterly business reviews, presenting performance, risks and corrective actions clearly.
* Translate client priorities into delivery commitments, and translate delivery constraints into language the client can act on.
* Build relationships with stakeholders responsible for the client’s budget and strategy.
* Gather client feedback, act on it and communicate progress.
* Commercial & Contractual Ownership
* Own the commercial performance of the portfolio — cost to serve, margin, and the committed productivity and efficiency targets across the contract term.
* Govern the service-level and service-credit regime: understand where exposure sits, prevent avoidable credits, and manage relief and remedy provisions correctly when performance slips.
* Own change control and scope discipline — recognise out-of-scope work, price it through the agreed mechanism, and prevent unbilled scope creep from accumulating.
* Maintain and apply the rate card for ad-hoc and project work, and keep the boundary between baseline service and chargeable work defensible.
* Support annual pricing, volume re-baselining and contract amendment discussions with evidence from the operation.
* Work within the organisation’s delegated authority and contractual obligations.
* Transition, Transformation & Partner Management
* Own the transition of scope into the portfolio — due diligence, knowledge transfer, shadow and reverse-shadow phases, gate criteria, cutover and the move into steady state.
* Ensure transition stages meet agreed acceptance criteria before progression.
* Manage subcontracted and partner-delivered service lines to the same standard as directly delivered ones, with a single accountable face to the client.
* Manage post-transition hypercare, including agreed specialist support, duration and exit criteria.
* Plan and execute structural change to the operating model, including consolidation of adjacent functions and the insourcing of scope where that is the agreed direction.
* Continuous Improvement, Automation & Innovation
* Maintain an improvement pipeline and measure benefits against an agreed baseline, including cost, effort, cycle time and quality.
* Set the automation agenda across the portfolio, prioritising on operational return, and sponsor the cases that need investment.
* Apply process automation, workflow tooling and applied AI to high-volume transactional work, with human control retained over anything carrying commercial or compliance consequence.
* Resolve the root causes of recurring exceptions, working with client and third-party teams where needed.
* Use relevant benchmarks and operational insight to recommend improvements to the client.
* Growth, Solutioning & Bid Leadership
* Identify and shape new opportunities in and around the account, converting operational insight into a credible commercial proposition.
* Contribute to formal bids — requests for information and proposal, solution design, delivery model, transition approach, assumptions and risk.
* Provide the operational and cost inputs that underpin pricing, and challenge commitments the operation cannot actually hold.
* Represent the delivery organisation in client presentations, site visits and orals.
* Carry agreed solutions into transition and ensure delivery commitments are understood and achievable.
* People & Capability
* Lead and develop a leadership team of function managers and team leads, and build the bench beneath them.
* Own succession for every critical role, so the portfolio does not depend on named individuals.
* Set the capability agenda — technical depth, certification, cross-training across service lines and shift patterns.
* Own hiring quality and onboarding at scale, including the ramp associated with new scope.
* Manage attrition actively, and build an operation people want to stay in.

PERFORMANCE & SERVICE LEVELS
  
  
Indicative performance targets for the role; final service levels are confirmed on engagement and measured per service line.
  
  

* Service delivery: meet agreed service levels and quality measures across the portfolio.
* Service credits: manage exposure, investigate any credit events and implement corrective actions.
* Client satisfaction: monitor feedback and deliver agreed improvements.
* Commercial Performance: deliver the portfolio to the agreed margin and cost-to-serve, and meet the committed annual efficiency target.
* Transition: meet agreed milestones and acceptance criteria.
* Improvement Pipeline: deliver the agreed annual benefit, evidenced against a pre-change baseline.
* Audit and compliance: maintain effective controls and address audit findings promptly.
* People: develop direct reports, maintain succession plans for critical roles and manage attrition against agreed targets.
* Growth: contribute to the agreed number of qualified opportunities or bid responses each year.

TOOLS & SYSTEMS
  
  

* ERP & Procurement: SAP and enterprise procurement and guided-buying platforms across the purchase-to-pay cycle.
* Service Management: enterprise IT service management platforms such as ServiceNow, covering request, incident, and hardware and software asset modules.
* Asset & Licence Tooling: software asset management platforms such as Flexera or ServiceNow SAM, and floating-licence server environments.
* Contract & Supplier Systems: contract lifecycle management and supplier performance platforms.
* Analytics & Reporting: business intelligence platforms and service-level dashboards used for governance reporting and trend analysis.
* Automation: workflow automation, robotic process automation and applied AI tooling for high-volume transactional processes.

**Required Skills & Experience**
Mandatory
  
  

* 15+ years in managed services, business process outsourcing or enterprise IT operations, including 7+ years leading multi-function delivery at scale.
* Proven ownership of a large managed-services engagement, including its service-level regime, service-credit exposure, cost to serve and margin.
* Delivery experience spanning several of: procurement and asset management, software asset and licence management, supplier and catalogue management, trade and customs compliance, and financial reconciliation.
* Track record of transition and transformation — due diligence, knowledge transfer, shadow and reverse shadow, gated cutover and the move into steady state.
* Experience managing subcontracted or partner-delivered scope while remaining the single accountable face to the client.
* Senior client relationship management at director and vice-president level, as the named point of accountability rather than a reporting conduit.
* Commercial literacy: statement-of-work interpretation, service levels and credits, change control, rate cards and scope management.
* Demonstrated continuous improvement and automation delivery with benefit quantified against a baseline.
* Contribution to bids and solutioning — proposal responses, delivery and transition design, pricing input and client presentations.
* Excellent written and spoken English, and the executive presence to hold a difficult conversation with a client without losing the relationship.

**Preferred**

* ITIL certification, project or programme management certification, or Lean Six Sigma Black Belt.
* IT asset management or procurement certification such as IAITAM or CIPS.
* Experience running a 24x5 or follow-the-sun operation delivered from India.
* Experience displacing an incumbent provider and insourcing previously subcontracted scope.
* Exposure to international trade compliance, customs and dangerous-goods regimes.
* Experience applying generative AI or robotic process automation to operational processes at scale.
* Background that includes hands-on operational delivery earlier in career, not solely governance roles.

* Develop and enhance Major Incident Management processes, governance, and operational excellence initiatives.
* Analyze incident trends and implement proactive measures to reduce recurring incidents and improve service stability.

title: People Operations Specialist
description:
TriNet is a leading provider of comprehensive human resources solutions for small to midsize businesses (SMBs). We enhance business productivity by enabling our clients to outsource their HR function to one strategic partner and allowing them to focus on operating and growing their core businesses. Our full-service HR solutions include features such as payroll processing, human capital consulting, employment law compliance and employee benefits, including health insurance, retirement plans and workers’ compensation insurance.  
  
TriNet has a nationwide presence and an experienced executive team. Our stock is publicly traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol TNET. If you’re passionate about innovation and making an impact on the large SMB market, come join us as we power our clients’ business success with extraordinary HR.  
  
**Don't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that many potential applicants discourage themselves from applying to jobs unless they meet every single requirement. TriNet always strives to hire the most qualified candidate for a particular role, ensuring we deliver outstanding results for our small and medium-size customers. So, if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every single qualification in the job description, nobody’s perfect – and we encourage you to apply. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles.**  
  
**Job Summary**  
  
The People Operations Specialist is an integral member of the People Team whose responsibilities span the full lifecycle of internal colleague and temporary workers. They will maintain the integrity and accuracy of all new hire, on-going data changes and offboarding requests within TriNet's system of record (Oracle Human Capital Management – HCM). This individual will interact with all levels of the business to effectively manage their data needs, share best practices for using our people tools and ensure sound compliance.  
  
**Essential Duties/Responsibilites:**

* Partner with Talent Acquisition Team to collect and enter all new colleague data into Oracle HCM, filing related paperwork within appropriate electronic files (document of record - DOR).
* Verify paperwork is complete and accurate (i.e., all the information matches such as compensation, physical work locations and social security numbers).
* Maintain new hire spreadsheets to support orientations and to complete audit procedures.
* Educate requestors with best practices for using appropriate workflow approvals via self-service functionality within Oracle HCM, auditing records for completeness and approve all transactions; requests could include manager changes, transfers, promotions, or salary changes.
* Respond to termination requests through Oracle HCM by collaborating with People Business Partners, Security, and line managers on timing of departures and capturing required documentation.
* Launch offboarding tasks to departing colleagues and provide related documentation, tracking requests to completion.
* Respond to and investigate inquiries from various teams such as People Business Partners, Corporate Payroll, and line managers both via email and through MYHR Service Requests.
* Support large organizational data changes that may be considered confidential or sensitive, using discretion in communicating updates.
* Coordinate workloads with global counterparts to ensure SLAs are met and consistent support is available to the business.
* Complete audits for individual compensation payouts, in partnership with People Operations and Corporate Payroll.
* Support internal audit walkthroughs by researching scenarios, providing samples, and attending sessions as a process SME, as needed.
* Maintain detailed SOPs, reference guides and workflows as department processes change and iterative improvements are released in our systems.
* Support TriNet’s contingent worker program by managing data changes, as needed.

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills to investigate discrepancies, rectify problems and provide feedback to colleagues at all levels of the organization.
* Ability to build relationships with cross functional TriNet colleagues.
* A demonstrated commitment to high professional ethical standards and a diverse workplace
* Excellent attention to detail with an ability to synthesize large requests often sensitive in nature and manage efficiently.
* Ability to adapt to a fast paced continually changing business and work environment while managing multiple priorities.
* Adhere to and strive to exceed established important metrics aligned to daily functions/activities both independently and collaboratively.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite

**Work Environment**

* Work in a clean, pleasant, and comfortable office work setting. The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable persons with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
* This position is 100% in office.

Please Note: TriNet reserves the right to change or modify job duties and assignments at any time. The above job description is not all encompassing. Position functions and qualifications may vary depending on business necessity.

title: Senior Manager, AI CoE
description:
**Senior Engineering Manager – AI CoE**

**About Redwood**
=================

Redwood Software helps the world's largest enterprises automate mission-critical business processes. Our platforms support complex enterprise workloads across ERP systems, business applications, cloud infrastructure, and on-premises environments.

Redwood is building reusable AI infrastructure, agentic capabilities, developer tools, and platform services that enable enterprise-ready AI features across its product portfolio.

**Role Mission**
================

As a Senior Engineering Manager, you will lead the engineering team responsible for delivering Redwood's shared AI platform and agentic capabilities.

You will translate the AI strategy into an executable engineering roadmap, build a high-performing team, and ensure the delivery of secure, scalable, observable, and commercially valuable AI systems. The role requires sufficient technical depth to guide architecture and challenge engineering decisions while remaining accountable for people's leadership, execution, team health, and delivery outcomes.

  

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Lead one or more engineering teams responsible for AI platform services, agentic capabilities, developer tools, and product integrations.
* Translate business and product priorities into a clear engineering roadmap, delivery plan, and team-level objectives.
* Recruit, onboard, manage, and retain engineers with the skills required to build production-grade AI and agentic systems.
* Establish clear ownership, performance expectations, decision-making responsibilities, and development plans across the team.
* Drive predictable execution through effective planning, dependency management, risk identification, and operational readiness.
* Partner with senior individual contributors to guide architecture and technical direction without becoming a bottleneck for engineering decisions.
* Ensure consistent engineering practices across AI evaluation, observability, model governance, security, reliability, performance, and cost management.
* Collaborate with Product, Architecture, Security, Data, Legal, and product engineering teams to deliver enterprise-ready AI capabilities.
* Balance shared platform investments with customer-facing requirements and immediate product priorities.
* Monitor delivery, quality, platform adoption, incidents, operational performance, and engineering effectiveness.
* Establish an engineering culture focused on ownership, accountability, continuous improvement, collaboration, and customer outcomes.
* Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, performance discussions, and career development planning.
* Communicate engineering progress, risks, dependencies, and investment requirements to senior stakeholders.
Maintain sufficient technical involvement to understand architectural risks, challenge decisions, and support critical engineering outcomes.  

**Scope and Expected Impact**
=============================

* Own engineering outcomes for a critical AI platform domain or multiple related engineering teams.
* Convert broad strategic priorities into measurable plans, milestones, and delivery commitments.
* Make organizational, staffing, prioritization, and delivery decisions with medium- to long-term impact.
* Create alignment across senior engineers, Product, Architecture, Security, and business stakeholders.
* Improve delivery predictability, platform adoption, engineering quality, and operational reliability.
* Scale the organization through clear ownership, repeatable engineering practices, and strong technical leadership.
* Ensure the team can deliver effectively without depending excessively on any single individual.

**Must Have Qualifications**
============================

* 7+ years of experience in software engineering, with at least 2+ years in an engineering people-management or team-leadership role.
* Experience leading one or more engineering teams responsible for complex software products or platform services.
* Demonstrated experience hiring, managing performance, coaching engineers, and supporting career development.
* Track record of delivering enterprise SaaS, cloud, distributed systems, platform, ML, or AI products into production.
* Strong working knowledge of generative AI, agentic architectures, LLM-based applications, orchestration, and production deployment considerations.
* Understanding agent workflows involving tool use, retrieval, enterprise data, APIs, memory, guardrails, and human oversight.
* Experience managing technical roadmaps, delivery risks, dependencies, incidents, quality, and operational performance.
* Strong understanding of software architecture, APIs, cloud-native systems, automated testing, CI/CD, security, and observability.
* Ability to guide technical decisions and architecture discussions while empowering senior engineers to own implementation.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical and business trade-offs to senior stakeholders.
* Experience working effectively with distributed and cross-functional teams.
* Ability to operate with high autonomy and manage ambiguity in a product or high-scale technology environment.

**Strong Plus**
===============

* Experience establishing or scaling an AI platform, agentic engineering team, Center of Excellence, or developer platform function.
* Hands-on exposure to LangGraph, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or custom agent orchestration frameworks.
* Experience with AI evaluation platforms, model gateways, vector databases, prompt lifecycle management, or AI observability tools.
* Understanding of responsible AI, model governance, privacy, compliance, and enterprise security requirements.
* Experience in enterprise middleware, workflow orchestration, ERP, automation, or integration platforms.
* Experience balancing greenfield platform development with the modernization of existing enterprise products.
* Experience working in regulated, security-sensitive, or high-availability environments.

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

* Builds a healthy, appropriately staffed engineering team with clear responsibilities and strong technical ownership.
* Delivers AI platform and agentic capabilities predictably while maintaining security, reliability, quality, and cost discipline.
* Creates measurable adoption of shared AI capabilities across Redwood's product engineering teams.
* Establishes clear engineering standards for AI evaluation, observability, governance, and production readiness.
* Improves team effectiveness, delivery predictability, and operational performance.
* Develops capable engineers and reduces organizational dependency on individual contributors.
* Provides senior stakeholders with a clear, evidence-based view of progress, risks, dependencies, and investment requirements.

*If you like growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!*

  

**THE LEGAL BIT**

title: Sr Manager - Fund Raising
description:
**About Drip Capital**

Drip Capital is a trade finance and working capital lender to small and mid-sized businesses across the US, India and Mexico. We have financed $10 billion+ for thousands of businesses on our platform. We fund our lending and growth through established bank facilities and a growing base of non-bank private credit investors.

**Job Location :**
Andheri East, Mumbai (occasional travel to Asian capital hubs)

**Experience :**
5 - 10 years

**About the Role**

We are hiring a polished, client-facing professional with very high attention to detail to build and manage relationships with our non-bank investors. You'll focus on large family offices, wealth managers, private banks and investment managers in global capital and wealth hubs such as Singapore, Hong Kong, Japan and the US. That includes NRI family offices and wealth platforms, and selectively India.

You will be bringing in investors who want exposure to short-duration trade finance assets: high-quality paper from a lender with a 10+ year track record and a leadership position in the markets we operate in.

You will own the investor relationship from first contact to close. That means opening doors, pitching Drip, handling diligence and closing investors yourself. Drip's senior executives join for larger investors when needed, and you will work closely with our two most senior leaders. We already have a strong base of supportive investors. This role is about expanding it. We want a hunter.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Origination, Pitching & Closing**

* Build and actively work a target list of large family offices, multi-family offices, wealth managers, private banks, RIAs and investment managers, with a focus on offshore and NRI investors.
* Run proactive outreach through email, LinkedIn, calls, introductions and events, against clear weekly activity targets.
* Educate investors on trade finance as an asset class and why Drip's short-duration paper belongs in their portfolio.
* Pitch and close investors yourself, and bring in senior executives on larger relationships when they can make a difference.
* Represent Drip at investor conferences, roadshows and networking events.

**Presentations & Data**

* Own the investor deck, one-pagers and investor-facing materials.
* Work with our analytics team and loan-level data tape to present portfolio performance clearly: yields, duration, concentrations, delinquencies and vintage trends.
* Coordinate DDQs, RFPs and data rooms, and make sure every number shared with investors is accurate.

**Investor Relations & Reporting**

* Be the day-to-day point of contact for existing investors, and support repeat and larger allocations.
* Manage quarterly updates, distribution notices, renewals and reporting timelines.
* Track competing private credit offerings and investor appetite, and bring feedback on terms and positioning back to leadership.

**Execution & MIS**

* Guide investors through onboarding, KYC and documentation, coordinating with Legal, Compliance, Finance and Administration across jurisdictions.
* Own the CRM and produce a weekly pipeline report and monthly investor MIS for leadership.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Qualified investor meetings and pitches delivered each month
* Pipeline growth and conversion to closed investors
* New family office, wealth manager, private bank and investment manager relationships
* Retention and renewal of existing investors
* Accuracy and turnaround time on investor materials, DDQs and reporting

**Candidate Profile**

* 6 - 10 years combining analytical and client-facing experience across private wealth, family office coverage, investor relations, or capital raising for private credit, AIF/PMS or other alternatives.
* Track record of pitching and closing UHNI, family office and investors independently.
* Existing relationships with large family offices and wealth managers, ideally including NRI and offshore networks in Singapore, Hong Kong, Japan, US etc.
* Articulate, polished and confident in front of UHNIs and CIOs, with the presence to build trust quickly.
* Comfortable with data and credit concepts (yield, duration, default and loss rates, concentration). Strong Excel, PowerPoint.
* Uses Claude and other AI tools daily to be highly productive in research, outreach, materials and follow-up.
* Willing to travel regularly and overlap with US hours a few evenings a week. CFA (any level) or MBA a plus.

**Ideal Background**

Our best fit has an analytical foundation and moved into client-facing roles. For example:

* An undergraduate degree in engineering, economics, mathematics or finance, often followed by an MBA (ISB, IIM or equivalent).
* Early career in an analytical seat such as equity or credit research, investment banking, consulting or a credit team.
* A move into private wealth, family office coverage, institutional sales or investor relations, with a track record of building and growing a book of relationships.
* A strong plus: international exposure, either through working, studying or living in the US, Europe, the Middle East or elsewhere in Asia, or by working at a global bank or financial firm in India (e.g., Goldman Sachs, Nomura, HSBC, JP Morgan). We value people used to high expectations on speed, quality of deliverables and getting things done across cultures. You understand the numbers well enough to defend them in front of a CIO, and you would rather be in the meeting than behind the spreadsheet.

description:
At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com.
  
  
As guided by Our Credo, Johnson & Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.
  
  
**Job Function**
Pharmaceutical Sales
  
  
**Job Sub Function**
Sales – Immunology (Commission)
  
  
**Job Category**
Professional
  
  
**All Job Posting Locations:**
Mumbai, India
  
  
**Job Description**
**Position Summary**
The Key Account Manager – Immunology is a target-carrying account owner responsible for launching and scaling the Tremfya franchise (PSO, PsA / psoriatic disease and the emerging IBD opportunity) across government / institutional reimbursed accounts. The role follows a focused launch-and-scale model: establish IL-23 leadership in high-readiness accounts, convert accessible patient pools into treated and continued patients.
  
  
Central access creation (Rate Contracts, registrations, listings, GTE and tenders) is owned by the Central Account Team; the incumbent facilitates that access at account level and converts it into procurement and reimbursed sales. Launch priority accounts are Army, CGHS and Railways,expanding to ESI, States, Autonomous institutes and PSU as the business scales. The unifying discipline is: Map deeply → Facilitate access → Shape protocol & biologic sequencing → Identify opportunity pool.
  
  
**Major Duties & Responsibilities**
In order of importance, briefly describe, in sentence form, the major responsibilities of this position as it exists today. Describe the job, not the person in the job. Each item should be a major responsibility, not a day-to-day activity. Typically no more than seven or eight major responsibilities ranked in order of highest percentage time to least.
  
  
**Approximate**
**Major Duties / Responsibilities**
Reimbursed Business Delivery & Tremfya Commercial Ownership
  
  

* Accountable for achieving Tremfya reimbursed sales targets (PSO, PsA and IBD SKUs) in assigned accounts, in line with the RB incentive plan
* Own the account outcome: grow account budget share and drive quarter-on-quarter reimbursed growth.
* Ensure accurate demand forecasting, order fulfilment coordination and timely account receivables in partnership with the Value and Supply teams.
* Map each account end-to-end — PsD / IBD patient pool, treating specialists, formulary and access status — and build a prioritized 360° launch account plan.
* Apply account-archetype logic: Army (early adoption / biologic leadership), CGHS (referral roadmap + formulary), Railways (scalable platform), ESI (future pathway), Autonomous / State (setting pathway and discussions for Franchise (Product promotion) & Medical Team for advocacy & protocol inclusion)

Facilitate Access & Navigate Reimbursement Pathways
  
  

* Facilitate the Value Team’s central access (Army RC, CGHS listing, Railway AMI/registration, GTE inclusion) at account level via account intelligence, documentation and ground follow-up — the KAM facilitates and utilises access .
* Navigate account-specific approval and procurement processes (e.g., Army MMF / PVMS, CGHS STC / non-STC, local-purchase routes) to minimise access-to-treatment timelines.

Value, Influence, Stakeholder Orchestration & Compliance
  
  

* Deliver the differential IL-23 value proposition vs IL-17 / anti-TNF competition, engage KOLs and government decision networks, and build advocacy for formulary and protocol inclusion .
* Act as cross-functional ‘quarterback’ across Medical, Franchise and Value; ensure ethical, compliant engagement and adherence to SOPs on tender interactions and HCC.

**Quality, Regulatory & Compliance (QRC) Responsibilities**
Describe important QRC responsibilities applicable for this job.
  
  

* Ensure all account and commercial activities comply with the J&J Credo, Health Care Compliance (HCC) policies, anti-bribery / anti-corruption standards and applicable local regulations.
* Adhere to SOPs on tender management, sales-achievement documentation, interactions with government officials and pharmacovigilance / adverse-event reporting requirements.

**Key Performance Indicators**
Primary measures of success for this position.
  
  

* Tremfya reimbursed business growth % and target achievement (PSO, PsA, IBD SKUs) vs. plan and vs. the incentive threshold.
* PsD / IBD accessible-pool conversion: eligible → treated patients, and account budget-share growth.
* New patient starts and patient continuation / persistence rates on Tremfya.
* Biologic-adoption progress: protocol inclusion, IL-23 share vs IL-17 / anti-TNF, and Stelara-to-Tremfya IBD upgradation.
* Access utilisation of Value-Team-secured RCs, listings and formulary inclusions (facilitation, not ownership).
* Quality of launch account plans, forecasting accuracy and KOL / stakeholder engagement.

**Functional Competencies**
Competencies (skills, knowledge and attributes) required to perform the job.
  
  

* Commercial / Target Delivery & Selling
* Biologic Adoption & Scientific Selling
* Strategic Account Management
* Access & Reimbursement Pathway Navigation
* Market & Policy Knowledge and Compliance
* Financial Acumen & Forecasting

**Behavioural Competencies**
Behavioural and leadership competencies required to perform the job (Leadership Imperatives).
  
  

* Collaboration and Partnering
* Influence and Impact
* Decision Making
* Customer & Patient Insights
* Change Management
* Ethical Conduct

**Key Working Relationships**
The most important working relationships inside and outside the company.
  
  
Internal
  
  
Value Team, Immunology Franchise, Medical Affairs (MAF), Market Access, Supply Chain, HCC and Finance teams.
  
  
External
  
  
Dermatologists, rheumatologists, gastroenterologists, KOLs, institutional decision-makers, government / scheme authorities, empanelled hospitals, distributors and service providers.
  
  
**Required Skills**
**Preferred Skills:**
Account Management, AI Judgement Integration, Business Behavior, Clinical Experience, Competitive Landscape, Cross-Functional Collaboration, Cultural Competence, Customer Centricity, Data Savvy, Developing Partnerships, Immunology, Market Knowledge, Pharmaceutical Industry, Pharmaceutical Sales Marketing, Problem Solving, Product Knowledge, Sales, Sales Enablement, Sales Trends, Strategic Sales Planning

title: Key Account Manager — Battery IoT
description:
**Key Account Manager — Battery IoT**

**B2B Enterprise Sales**  **Mumbai / Travel Required**  **₹14–18L Fixed + Variable (Total ₹28–36L)**

**About Ajjas**

Ajjas (HPS Lab Designs Pvt. Ltd.) is a connected-asset IoT company based in Navi Mumbai. We build the hardware, write the firmware, and run the data platform — so nothing gets lost in translation between the device in the field and the dashboard on your desk.

In our battery IoT vertical, we track battery packs for OEMs and energy storage players, enabling warranty odometry, health monitoring, and theft prevention on distributed battery assets. It's a commercially active vertical with paying clients that needs focused expansion. That's where you come in.

We are a small, focused team working with mid-market and enterprise clients. You will work directly with the founding team.

**The Role**

We are hiring a Key Account Manager (KAM) to drive commercial expansion of our battery IoT vertical. You will be scaling existing deployments and landing new logos with battery OEMs, pack manufacturers, and energy storage providers.

This is a field-intensive, founder-coached role. You will prospect, qualify, run product demonstrations, anchor pilots, and convert pilots into commercial contracts. The founding team will co-sell with you on key accounts and provide full technical support — your job is to move deals forward consistently and close.

**What You Will DoProspecting & Pipeline**

● Build and manage a named-account pipeline across battery OEMs, pack manufacturers, and energy storage providers.

● Generate qualified meetings through referrals, warm introductions, industry networks, and LinkedIn — not spray-and-pray cold outreach.

● Attend relevant battery and energy storage trade events, industry associations, and OEM factory visits to build relationships and generate leads.

**Discovery & Qualification**

● Run structured discovery calls to identify the real operational problem — warranty fraud, theft, compliance — before pitching.

● Qualify rigorously against budget, decision authority, timeline, and technical feasibility before investing in a pilot.

**Demonstrations & Pilots**

● Deliver live platform demonstrations to operations, supply chain, and technology stakeholders.

● Anchor every pilot to a Mutual Success Matrix — agreed success metrics, review timelines, and escalation contacts — so the proof of concept has a defined path to a commercial decision.

● Coordinate hardware deployment, field visits, and dashboard access with the internal team during pilots.

**Closing & Expansion**

● Own the commercial proposal and close the first contract on pilot accounts.

● Identify and pursue expansion opportunities on live accounts — additional SKUs, product lines, or geographies.

● Hand off to Customer Success post-onboarding while retaining the senior commercial relationship.

**Market Intelligence**

● Feed back insights on competitor products, OEM roadmaps, and client requirements to the product and strategy teams.

**What We Are Looking ForMust-Have**

● Experience in B2B enterprise sales, account management, or business development — battery or energy storage industry background strongly preferred.

● Outcomes-driven: you measure yourself by pipeline converted and revenue closed, not by calls made or emails sent.

● Consultative, problem-first sales style — you ask before you pitch, and you qualify hard before you invest time.

● Willingness to travel for client visits, OEM factory calls, and field deployments across India.

● Strong written and verbal communication — crisp follow-up emails, comfortable in a boardroom with a VP.

● Self-starter who manages a pipeline without daily supervision.

**Strong Plus**

● Existing relationships with procurement, supply chain, or engineering contacts at battery OEMs or energy storage providers.

● Familiarity with proof-of-concept / pilot-driven enterprise sales cycles.

● Experience using a CRM (any) for pipeline and activity tracking.

**Mindset**

● You do thorough pre-meeting research — on the company, the business problem, and the person sitting across from you — before every client interaction.

● You are cognitively agile: you can draw on past experience and new learning to answer questions on the fly, even when the ask was not anticipated.

● You believe in building lasting relationships, not just closing commercial transactions — you want the client to call you first when something goes wrong.

● You do not disappear after a proposal goes out. You own the follow-through.

● You are comfortable selling a product that asks the client to change how they think about their asset — not just bolt on a tracker.

● Market intelligence from the field goes back to the team. You treat what you hear in client meetings as product input, not just sales noise.

**What We Offer**

● Fixed compensation of ₹14–18L per annum based on experience, plus a performance variable that can match the fixed component — total potential of ₹28–36L.  
● Direct mentorship and co-selling from the founder (Shailendra Singh, IIM Kozhikode, 10+ years building Ajjas).

● Real ownership of a rapidly growing vertical with paying clients from day one.

● Fast career growth: as Ajjas scales, this role scales with it.

● Live deployments and real revenue — you are not selling vapourware.

**Location & Travel**

Base: Navi Mumbai (Ajjas HQ). Travel required across India for client visits, OEM factory calls, and pilot deployments. Remote flexibility is available once you have achieved your Key Result Areas (KRAs) — until then, base location is expected.

**How to Apply**

Send your CV and a short note (3–5 sentences) on the most complex B2B deal you have worked on — what made it hard, and how it closed (or did not). Email: hr@ajjas.com

Warm referrals are welcome and given priority. If someone in your network knows Ajjas, mention their name.

Pay: ₹1,400,000.00 - ₹1,800,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Security Officer
description:
**Role highlights:**
--------------------

* **Security Officer**
* Location: New Delhi, India
* Department: ICEYE, India
* Reports to: CEO, ICEYE India
* Employment type: Permanent
* Workplace model: Office
* Employment is subject to applicable security screening. Appointment as CCSO under SMLDI 2025 is subject to Indian citizenship, police verification, DDP vetting (repeated every three years) and an Official Secrets Act undertaking. Start date depends on government vetting.

**Why this role matters:**
--------------------------

*As the Security Officer, you’ll build ICEYE India’s security function from the ground up and serve as our appointed Company Chief Security Officer under India’s Security Manual for Licensed Defence Industries (SMLDI 2025). Your work allows ICEYE India to operate as a licensed defence company, pass government inspections and take part in classified programmes. You’ll also be the CEO’s trusted advisor on all security matters.*

**Who We Are**
--------------

ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.

ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

**Your day-to-day responsibilities**
------------------------------------

* Own the roadmap that makes ICEYE India an audit-ready, licensed defence company, including the industrial licence and Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) security clearance
* Act as ICEYE India’s appointed Company Chief Security Officer, representing us with the Department of Defence Production (DDP), the MHA and other authorities, and leading every inspection and audit
* Build the security framework with the group security team: policies, SOPs, secure areas, classified document registry and the audit trail inspectors expect
* Set up and run personnel security: police verification, government vetting, Official Secrets Act undertakings and re-verification cycles
* Lead cyber security accreditation as Cyber Information Security Officer under SMLDI Chapter 7, including CERT-In reporting and protection of ICEYE group information held in India
* Manage export-control compliance, data exchange with the ICEYE group and foreign-national visits
* Translate security requirements into practice for the business, from classified RFPs and contract clauses to customer and IN-SPACe requirements
* Prepare and rehearse incident-response and crisis playbooks with Legal and group security

**What we’re looking for**
--------------------------

**Must haves:**

* Indian citizen, eligible for appointment and positive vetting as Company Chief Security Officer (before appointment and every three years)
* Former officer of the Armed Forces, a Central Armed Police Force or the Police, with no adverse remarks in your release certificate
* Hands-on knowledge of the Official Secrets Act 1923, the MHA security instructions and SMLDI 2025
* Track record as a security officer in a defence, intelligence, aerospace or critical-infrastructure organisation in India, including taking an organisation from uncleared to cleared at least once
* Established working relationships with the DDP, the MHA and other national security authorities
* Working knowledge of IT security accreditation for classified systems (SMLDI Chapter 7, CERT-In, NCIIPC)
* Fluent Hindi and English

**Nice to haves:**

* Familiarity with NATO, EU or US classified-information frameworks
* Working knowledge of India’s export-control regime (SCOMET, DGFT) and IN-SPACe authorisation conditions
* Experience in a foreign-owned Indian entity

**Application Process**
-----------------------

* Intro conversation with Talent Acquisition (30 min)
* Hiring manager interview with the CEO, ICEYE India (60 min)
* Technical case: a take-home roadmap exercise showing how you would get from the current state to the highest target classification level, covering facility, personnel and IT approval. You will present and defend it to ICEYE’s Chief Security Officer (3 x 45 min)
* Cross-functional discussion with colleagues from Operations and Legal/Compliance if required.

**Working at ICEYE**
--------------------

At ICEYE, you’ll join a diverse and highly engaged team united by the ambition to make the impossible possible. As a global scale-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one. Your growth, wellbeing, and success are a priority, with continuous professional development, training opportunities, and a culture where collaboration is how we win.

**How We Work (Our Values)**
----------------------------

**Make the impossible possible**: We set ambitious goals and stay calm under pressure. We bring grit, optimism, and ownership when things get hard, and we keep moving until we find a way.

* **Be curious**: Go deep, ask questions, listen carefully, and think critically. Understand the “why” behind decisions.
* **See the big picture:** Stay close to what’s happening across the company so you can make better decisions. Consider how your work affects others.
* **Drive effective teamwork:** Create psychological safety, invite different perspectives, and build inclusive teams. There are no bad questions.
* **Act as one team:** We win together. We match tasks to the right owner and stay agile as priorities shift.
* **Have fun**: What we do matters—and it should be enjoyable. Celebrate progress, take pride in results, and share the wins.

**Benefits**
------------

Our benefits are designed to support your health and wellbeing, at work and beyond. We keep improving them based on employee feedback, and offerings vary by location. Talent Acquisition will confirm what applies for this role and location during the process.

**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion**
------------------------------------------------------

We want ICEYE to be a place where people can be themselves and do great work. Different backgrounds and perspectives make us stronger, which is why we work to create an environment where people feel included, respected, and able to speak up. Whatever your background, we want you to bring your authentic self to the table.

We’re committed to fair, inclusive hiring and equal opportunity. Everyone is welcome to apply. If you need any adjustments or support during the recruitment process, tell us—we’ll do our best to help.

Apply now to start your ICEYE journey, and help us continue to make the impossible possible together. Read more about ICEYE and working with us at iceye.com.

description:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.

Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebratingour wins – big and small.

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you'll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let's build what's next - together!

Anaplan. As the engine behind back-office system connectivity, you might not recognize our name, but our customers rank among the who's who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, and Bayer are just a few of the 2,000+ companies that rely on our best-in-class platform and its native AI capabilities to see, plan, and lead their businesses. By dynamically connecting financial, strategic, and operational plans in real-time, companies trust Anaplan to give them the power to anticipate change, address complexity, deliver operational insights, increase profits, and stay ahead of their competition.  
  
What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our commitment to our customers' success and our collective motivation to achieve ambitious goals. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, and we behave like leaders irrespective of title. When you work for us, you'll be part of a winning culture that's dedicated to creating opportunities for our customers, partners, and employees. We hope you'll join us. Let's create something incredible together!  
  
We're looking for a Senior Platform Infrastructure Engineer to join our Platform Infrastructure Operations Team in Gurugram. In this role, you will be responsible for the operational health, maintenance, and reliability of the Kubernetes infrastructure and in-cluster services that underpin Anaplan's SaaS product offering.  
  
You will focus on maintaining the stability and performance of our large-scale production environments. This includes participating in on-call rotations, responding to incidents, performing essential maintenance, and supporting our developer teams with Kubernetes related queries and asks. This is a hands-on role where you will work with a broad range of modern infrastructure technologies to ensure our platform is secure, resilient, and efficient. This role will report directly to the Engineering Manager.  
  
**Your Impact**

* Lead platform maintenance task, upgrades, and patching across our Kubernetes clusters and in cluster services to ensure stability and security.
* Design and implement automation efforts to reduce manual tasks and improve system reliability.
* Troubleshoot and resolve production issues, acting as a point of escalation for complex issues. Perform root cause analysis and participate in incident/problem management processes.
* Act as a technical lead, providing mentorship, guidance, and code reviews for junior engineers.
* Partner with engineering leads across Platform infrastructure to define the technical roadmap for the Kubernetes platform and cloud infrastructure.
* Collaborate with development teams, addressing queries and requests related to Kubernetes and infrastructure.
* Develop and improve observability by developing dashboards and alerting within Grafana to drive improvements in MTTD and MTTR.

**Your Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, mathematics, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Hands-on experience managing and supporting infrastructure in a Public Cloud environment (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
* In depth knowledge and operational experience with large-scale and multi-tenant Kubernetes environments.
* A solid understanding of Linux system administration.
* Proficiency with Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) tooling such as Terraform.
* Experience with Observability tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, or OpenTelemetry.
* Software development or scripting skills for automation (e.g., Python, Go, or Bash).
* Proven track record of designing, deploying, and maintaining highly available cloud architectures.
* Experience working in an operational context, including an understanding of incident management and on-call responsibilities.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with Kubernetes in-cluster services like Ingress Controllers (e.g., Traefik, Ingress NGINX), Cert Manager, and a Service Mesh (eg. Istio).
* Experience with configuration management tools like Ansible.
* Understanding of Agile/Kanban methodologies.

title: Veterinary & Breeder Business Manager, Purina India
description:
**Position Summary**

As the Head of Veterinary & Breeder Channels for Purina India, you will lead the development and growth of Purina's professional channels through veterinarians, breeders, veterinary institutions, and key petcare influencers.

The role is responsible for delivering business in these channels through advocacy, strengthening customer relationships, commercial plans, driving channel activation, and increasing recommendation and brand preference within the petcare ecosystem. You will own the strategy and execution of engagement programs, events, partnerships, and channel development initiatives that enhance Purina's visibility and be responsible for the commercial performance.

Working closely with Sales, Marketing and external stakeholders, you will establish Purina as the preferred partner across the veterinary and breeder communities while delivering business growth through these strategic channels.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Veterinary & Breeder Channel Strategy**

* Responsible for delivering the business targets for this channel
* Develop and execute the commercial & growth strategy for veterinary and breeder channels across India.
* Drive brand recommendation, advocacy, and customer acquisition through professional petcare networks.
* Identify and prioritize key veterinary clinics, hospitals, breeders, institutions, and influencers that can accelerate channel growth.
* Build sustainable engagement models to increase Purina's relevance and presence within the professional petcare ecosystem.
* Establish channel-specific goals, engagement plans, and commercial growth initiatives.

**Advocacy & Relationship Management**

* Develop strong relationships with veterinarians, breeders, academicians, institutions, associations, and industry influencers.
* Build and manage a robust network of Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and channel advocates.
* Create partnership programs that strengthen Purina's visibility and reputation among professional stakeholders.
* Drive initiatives that increase recommendation, trial, and adoption of Purina products within veterinary and breeder communities.

**Events & Customer Engagement**

* Own Purina India's veterinary and breeder engagement calendar.
* Plan and execute participation in:
* + Veterinary congresses
  + Industry conferences
  + Petcare exhibitions
  + Breeder forums
  + Association events
  + Regional customer engagement programs
* Lead Purina-hosted conferences, KOL forums, advisory boards, customer meets, and networking events.
* Ensure high-quality execution and measurable commercial outcomes from all channel events and activations.
* Develop innovative engagement platforms that strengthen relationships and improve advocacy.

**Commercial Activation & Business Development**

* Partner with Sales and Marketing teams to design and execute channel-specific growth initiatives.
* Develop programs that improve conversion, retention, and recommendation within veterinary and breeder channels.
* Support commercial planning and expansion opportunities within the professional petcare ecosystem.
* Track channel performance and identify opportunities to increase penetration and business impact.
* Translate stakeholder insights into actionable business opportunities and market development initiatives.

**Strategic Partnerships**

* Build partnerships with veterinary colleges, universities, professional associations, breeder networks, and industry bodies.
* Identify collaboration opportunities that enhance Purina's reach, visibility, and credibility.
* Strengthen Purina's presence across key professional and industry platforms.
* Represent Purina at external events, industry forums, and stakeholder engagements.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Corporate Communications, Regulatory Affairs, and Consumer Engagement teams.
* Support product launches, category development initiatives, and business growth plans through channel advocacy programs.
* Provide insights on customer needs, market trends, competitive activity, and channel dynamics.
* Contribute to annual business planning and channel growth strategy.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Veterinary Science, Animal Sciences, Life Sciences, or a related field.
* MBA or postgraduate qualification preferred.

**Experience**

* 8-12 years of relevant experience in sales, channel development, customer marketing, trade marketing, business development, advocacy, or stakeholder management.
* Experience in pet food, animal health, pharmaceuticals, healthcare, FMCG, consumer products, or related industries preferred.
* Demonstrated success in managing professional customer networks, partnerships, or influencer ecosystems.
* Proven experience in planning and executing events, conferences, customer engagement programs, and partnership initiatives.
* Experience working in highly cross-functional commercial environments.

title: Business Growth And Operations Associate
description:
WE'RE HIRING!Business Growth & Operations AssociateBecome a Part of the Founding Team at UPLYFT

**Location:**
Kolkata, West Bengal

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
2–5 years preferred

**Industry:**
Corporate Training | Learning & Development | Business Consulting

About UPLYFT

UPLYFT is an Organizational Learning & Development initiative of
**Altheos Wellness Global**
, focused on helping organisations build stronger, more capable and future-ready workforces.

We design and deliver practical corporate learning and capability-building programmes across leadership, communication, productivity, digital skills, AI, workplace technology and industry-specific training.

Through a network of expert trainers and facilitators, we partner with organisations to deliver customised learning solutions that create measurable workplace impact.

As we embark on our growth journey, we are looking for an entrepreneurial, proactive and execution-oriented professional to join our founding team.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a
**Business Growth & Operations Associate**
who will work closely with the Founder and take ownership of business development, client relationships, programme coordination and day-to-day business operations.

This is a comprehensive, multidimensional role that brings together business development, relationship management, operational execution and strategic support.

You will be instrumental in building our client base, developing our partner network, establishing operational systems and driving business growth.

**This is not a conventional sales or operations role. We are looking for someone who thinks like a business builder, takes initiative and is comfortable wearing multiple hats.**

Key Responsibilities

**1. Business Development & Revenue Growth**

* Identify and research potential corporate clients, SMEs, healthcare organisations and institutions across Eastern India.
* Build and actively manage a pipeline of prospective clients and business opportunities.
* Initiate business outreach through LinkedIn, email, telephone, professional networks and direct interactions.
* Generate leads, establish connections and schedule business meetings.
* Understand client requirements and identify relevant training and development opportunities.
* Participate in client discussions, presentations and business meetings.
* Coordinate preparation and submission of proposals, quotations and commercial offers.
* Drive follow-ups, negotiations and business opportunities towards successful conversion.
* Work towards defined business development and revenue targets.

**2. Client Relationship Management**

* Build and nurture long-term relationships with prospective and existing clients.
* Understand client expectations and ensure effective communication throughout the engagement.
* Coordinate client onboarding and programme requirements.
* Identify opportunities for repeat business, cross-selling and long-term partnerships.
* Ensure a positive client experience at every stage of engagement.

**3. Programme & Operations Management**

* Coordinate the end-to-end execution of corporate training programmes.
* Liaise with clients and faculty partners to finalise programme requirements, schedules and delivery plans.
* Coordinate trainer onboarding, availability, assignments and scheduling.
* Manage programme logistics, documentation and communication.
* Monitor programme execution and ensure timely completion of deliverables.
* Coordinate post-training feedback, reports and client follow-ups.
* Identify operational gaps and develop processes to improve efficiency.

**4. Faculty & Partner Network Management**

* Identify, engage and onboard trainers, consultants and subject matter experts.
* Maintain a database of faculty partners and their areas of expertise.
* Coordinate assignments, availability, schedules and engagement-related communication.
* Build and nurture a professional network of training and development partners.

**5. Business Operations & Growth Support**

* Maintain the business development pipeline, client database and CRM records.
* Prepare periodic business development and operational reports.
* Support budgeting, quotations, invoicing coordination and commercial documentation.
* Assist in developing standard operating procedures, templates and operational workflows.
* Support the Founder in strategic initiatives, business planning and execution.
* Explore partnership opportunities, new markets and avenues for business expansion.

Who Are We Looking For?

We are looking for someone who:

* Has an entrepreneurial mindset and a strong sense of ownership.
* Is proactive, self-driven and comfortable taking initiative.
* Possesses excellent communication, networking and interpersonal skills.
* Is confident in business development, client engagement and relationship building.
* Is organised and capable of managing multiple responsibilities simultaneously.
* Can interact confidently with senior professionals, business owners and corporate decision-makers.
* Is resourceful, solution-oriented and adaptable in a growing business environment.
* Can work independently while collaborating closely with the Founder and partner network.
* Thinks beyond assigned responsibilities and is motivated by building something from the ground up.



**We value initiative, accountability, execution capability and attitude as much as formal qualifications.**

Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline. An MBA or postgraduate qualification in Business Administration, Sales, Marketing, HR or related fields will be an advantage.
* Preferably 2–5 years of experience in business development, B2B sales, client relationship management, business operations, corporate training or consulting.
* Experience in the corporate training, HR, Learning & Development, consulting or professional services sector will be an added advantage.
* Good working knowledge of MS Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint, and Google Workspace.
* Familiarity with CRM tools, digital communication platforms and AI-enabled productivity tools will be an advantage.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. Knowledge of Hindi and Bengali will be useful.

Compensation, Incentives & Growth Opportunities

We believe that people who contribute directly to business growth should have the opportunity to participate meaningfully in its success.

The compensation structure will include:

* **Fixed monthly compensation**
  providing financial stability.
* **Attractive, potentially uncapped performance-linked commissions**
  on business successfully generated and converted.
* Direct earning potential linked to business development contributions and revenue generation.

Your ability to identify opportunities, acquire clients and generate business will directly influence your additional earning potential.

We are particularly interested in individuals with an entrepreneurial mindset who enjoy taking ownership, building relationships, identifying opportunities and translating ideas into tangible business results.

**Your growth and earning potential will be closely linked to the value you create and the contribution you make towards building UPLYFT.**

Why Join UPLYFT?

* Be part of the founding team of a growing business.
* Work directly with the Founder and gain exposure to strategic business decisions.
* Take ownership of business development, operations and organisational growth.
* Build business systems, processes, networks and client relationships from the ground up.
* Enjoy performance-linked financial rewards with potentially uncapped commissions.
* Develop entrepreneurial, leadership and business management capabilities.
* Grow alongside the organisation as it expands into new markets.

Who Should Apply?

This opportunity is ideal for someone who has outgrown a narrowly defined job role and is looking for greater responsibility, professional independence and the opportunity to build something meaningful.

You could be a business development professional, an operations executive, a client relationship manager or someone working in the corporate training and consulting ecosystem.

You might not have experience in every aspect of this role. That is perfectly fine. What matters most is your willingness to learn, ability to take ownership, confidence in building relationships and determination to get things done.

**We are looking for a business builder, not merely an employee.**

How to Apply

Interested candidates can share their updated CV at:

**altheoswellnessglobal@gmail.com**

**Email Subject:**
Application – Business Growth & Operations Associate | UPLYFT

Please include a brief note explaining why you believe you are suited for this opportunity.

**UPLYFT – Build. Learn. Lead.**

*A Unit of Altheos Wellness Global*

title: Business Coach, Amazon, VAS-Category
description:
**Description**
Equal parts advisor and operating partner, Amazon’s team of Business Coaches assist and guide our Delivery Service Partner (DSP) business owners as they build and grow successful last mile package delivery businesses during a transformational time.
  
  
The Business Coach finds and executes value-creation opportunities and manages the DSP relationship across the entire lifecycle of the business. As trusted advisors, Business Coaches work alongside DSPs to help solve their biggest challenges at a programmatic level; influence their business planning and strategy; and look around corners to identify obstacles and recommend solutions, ensuring DSP owners make effective business decisions and are setup for success.
  
  
Our Business Coaches are leaders and collaborators. They are analytical and creative; deadline-driven, organized and able to multi-task; and have strong interpersonal skills including a demonstrated ability to earn trust, inspire others, and be empathetic. You’ll be at the center of cross-functional teams, all working together to deliver the highest quality experience to Amazon customers.
  
  
If you're a dynamic, organized self-starter who’s ready to partner with our DSP owners as they launch and scale their business in one of the fastest growing industries in the world, we’d like to talk with you. Curious? Good, that’s one of our Leadership Principles! Discover more about the opportunity below.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
**On a Daily Basis, Business Coaches Are Responsible For**
Supporting owners as they onboard to the program and prepare to launch.
  
  
Guiding owners as they scale their business and manage operational issues, ensuring they have resources in place to effectively ramp-up operations and prepare for peak periods.
  
  
Coordinating Business and Financial Health Reviews to discuss business performance and new opportunities, as well as to provide benchmarking data and insights.
  
  
Identifying workflow inefficiencies and working to formulate and implement operational improvements at the network level and to improve the individual DSP owner experience.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
As a Business Coach, you will partner with 20-40 DSP owners assigned to delivery stations across IN. You’ll work closely with a portfolio of owners at different stages as they set strategy, help drive accountability and engagement, and motivate and track key performance metrics. You’ll collaborate with an integrated internal team of Station Operations Managers, Program Managers, and Compliance and Finance personnel to ensure owners launch and scale their business in compliance with program requirements. Together, you’ll provide best-in-class support for owners by removing obstacles and improving financial, operational, and safety practices at the network level. You’ll accomplish this by analyzing problems, discovering insights, delivering recommendations, and driving change both internally and externally.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 2+ years of employee and performance management experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience
