title: Trainee Engineer, NOC
description:
**Description**
**Who We Are**
Scale Computing is a global leader in edge computing, hyperconverged infrastructure, and managed networking solutions. We deliver innovative, secure, andscalable technology that powers critical operations worldwide.
  
  
**About The Role**
Trainee/Associate Engineer will oversee daily operation of support desk functions that includes taking calls as first level support, entering the reported problems in the ticketing system, solving user problems, proper escalation of open problems and dealing with the customers. Will also participate in preventative maintenance, troubleshooting, configuring and providing technical
  
  
support for end-users.
  
  
**Great Candidates Will Look Like This**
A team player who can work well within the team and collaborate cross-functionally, especially in a remote environment.
  
  
An excellent communicator who is efficient and effective with customers and colleagues via instant messages, email, video conferencing and in-person interactions.Enjoy troubleshooting and problem-solving analytically.
  
  
**Essential duties and responsibilities include the following: (Other duties may be assigned.)**
Provide helpful and professional assistance to customers via phone, email and tickets.
  
  
Create or update support tickets as required for phone calls.
  
  
Document all calls, actions, and any relevant information in ticket notes.
  
  
Handle tickets created by customers via email.
  
  
Follow up on existing tickets proactively and within specified time frames.
  
  
Resolve or escalate tickets in a timely manner, within SLA guidelines.
  
  
Interact with other departments and teams, collaborating on tickets or solutions.
  
  
Evaluate customers’ needs and determine the appropriate action.
  
  
Troubleshoot complex technical issues with customers via phone.
  
  
Understand and follow security and other guidelines for customers’ accounts.
  
  
Process voicemails, creating or updating support tickets as necessary.
  
  
Write and send customized email responses to customers for specific situations.
  
  
Understand and adhere to Scale Computing policies and procedures.
  
  
Place outbound calls to resolve internally-detected issues.
  
  
Be professional and courteous at all times, especially when speaking or conversing with customers.
  
  
**Requirements**
**Technical requirements:**
**Knowledge Of At Least Some Of The Following**
General computer systems .
  
  
PCs, laptops, mobile devices.
  
  
Current and recent Operating Systems .
  
  
Windows, Mac OS, Linux.
  
  
Routing Protocols and concepts .
  
  
Static and Dynamic routing, Distance, Priority, routing table, Default Gateway .
  
  
Switching Protocols and concepts .
  
  
VLAN, Trunks and link bonding, Spanning Tree and RSTP, MAC Address table,ARP.
  
  
Networking Protocols and concepts .
  
  
TCP, UDP, DHCP, DNS, VPN, ICMP, TELNET, SSH FTP, HTTP(s), IPSEC, SSL,etc.
  
  
Network troubleshooting tools such as PING, TRACEROUTE, NSLOOKUP, IPCONFIG, etc.
  
  
OSI Model – Advanced understanding of layers 1-4 .
  
  
Subnetting and Supernetting .
  
  
Firewall rules and policies, Access Lists .
  
  
Deep understanding of technical concepts within networking environments as well as security, risk and compliance.
  
  
Entry Level knowledge of Switches, Routers, Firewalls, and Networking in general is required. Must be detail-oriented and must be able to work well in a team environment.
  
  
**Reporting Structure**
Reports to Tier 1 Manager - NOC.
  
  
**Education And Experience**
Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech/BCA) in a technical domain such as Computer Science, Telecommunication, Electronics & Communication, Information Technology, or a related field.
  
  
Minimum experience in the networking domain is preferred. (0-2 years)
  
  
**Experience Working In Helpdesk Or Technical Support Is Preferred.**
Industry certifications like CompTIA Network+, CCNA, CCNP, JNCIA, Wireshark, etc. are preferred.
  
  
**Shift Timings**
9.30PM-6.30 AM(Night Shift)
  
  
**Perks of Acumera**
Group medical insurance.
  
  
Paid company holidays.
  
  
Casual dress code Cab facilities for employees working in shifts.
  
  
Fully stocked snacks at office.
  
  
Vibrant and Inclusive Workplace Atmosphere.
  
  
Flexible work environment and an opportunity to grow as we grow.
  
  
Scale Computing is an equal-opportunity employer.
  
  
All final candidates will be subject to a pre-employment background check.

title: Physical Security Technical Helpdesk Specialist
description:
**About the role**

The role represents an opportunity for global experience providing engineering support to our client’s enterprise-level electronic security systems and architecture in QCIC RUN’s technical support helpdesk environment.

The engineer will be required to participate in an out-of-hours rota as directed.

The successful candidate will also be required to work a rota of early and late shifts on alternative weeks, all shifts is required to be performed in our India office. This role forms part of our global RUN team so the successful candidate will be liaising with colleagues and clients in the rest of EMEA, APAC, and the US.

This role would suit an individual who has experience in CCURE, Lenel, Genetec or has equivalent certifications with Prowatch and feels confident they can transition their skills. We will provide relevant training to the successful candidate.

**What you will do**

* Provide technical support and troubleshooting assistance for electronic security systems, including diagnosing and resolving hardware and software issues via our RUN Helpdesk Support environment. Helpdesk Support/ Telephonic Customer Service experience is required.
* Conduct system testing and commissioning to ensure the functionality, reliability, and performance of electronic security systems and applications are in order.
* Perform planned periodic maintenance and software updates for electronic security systems to ensure optimal performance and security of associated Access Control & CCTV applications as directed.
* Respond to application related issues (impacting a single site or individual assets on a single site, with impact to core business activities)
* Day to day operations - maintenance and support - including but not limited to reactive support activities, ticket triage, escalations, etc. as directed
* Day to day operations - testing and validation of changes, repairs and additions to security systems in conjunction with hardware vendor or installation teams as directed
* Day to day monitoring of activities, planned system audits or health checks within a specific site or region including access control, CCTV, and intrusion detection related activities as directed
* Work with and provide security application support to the client’s infrastructure teams related to the servers, networks infrastructure required to run the security applications
* Provide governance and control in maintaining and applying the agreed system standards with all programming and system configuration.
* Provide coordination and site attendance support to Q-Net partners required for onsite reactive maintenance related to a service request, providing updates to the customer whilst ensuring partner adheres to the SLA requirements. Upon completion of the attendance by the partner, all required documents is to be collected and ticket system and reports are updated, while detail received from partner is reviewed for accuracy.
* Escalation and liaison internally to product champions as well as with the manufacturer for Level 3 support items as required
* Provide administration support on all license renewals including proposal creation, license renewals tracking and executing, license roll-out, delivery confirmation and supply of detaill for invoicing completion.
* Ensure all relevant information is uploaded to internal project folders on both QCIC SharePoint and client SharePoint/Microsoft Teams sites.
* Assist with monitoring service cost, reviewing partner job cards and expenses and presenting to service managers.
* Assist with monthly performance reporting for both clients and leadership.
* Effectively communicate new or existing service developments to the service manager/Account Directors. Conduct training sessions for clients and end-users on the operation and maintenance of security systems.

* Ad-hoc assignments, duties and responsibilities as requested by the service manager/Account Directors.

* **C-Cure, Genetec, Lenel**
  & Prowatch certification
* Experience with Enterprise Level Electronic Security Systems
* Experience with deploying and/or supporting

* Experience with ticketing systems
* Able to assess reported issues and rectify
* Able to work with remote connectivity tools
* Excellent communication skills to peers and clients

**Job Description**

We are seeking a Web Access Management Support professional to provide operational support for enterprise Identity and Access Management (IAM) services using PingFederate, PingAccess, and Ping MFA, with Ping DaVinci as an added advantage.

The role focuses on production support, monitoring, troubleshooting, incident resolution, configuration changes, and coordination with engineering, infrastructure, and security teams to maintain reliable authentication and access services in an AWS-based environment.

**Required Skills**

* Hands-on support experience with PingFederate, PingAccess, and Ping MFA.

* Knowledge of AWS cloud environments and support exposure to Kubernetes/Amazon EKS.
* Strong understanding of web access concepts such as sessions, cookies, reverse proxies, SSL certificates, and authentication flows.
* Experience analyzing application logs, browser traces, and access issues in production environments.
* Familiarity with LDAP, Active Directory, REST APIs, and identity integrations.
* Working knowledge of incident, change, and problem management processes.
* Basic scripting or automation knowledge.
* Strong communication and documentation skills.

title: Support Engineer IV , Amazon Pharmacy Operations
description:
**Description**
Amazon Pharmacy delivers prescriptions safely, accurately, and fast. The business is defined by four things: cost, speed, scale, and patient safety. Our fulfillment network spans central and regional fill, small-format sites, kiosks, and growing automation, and every order is a patient’s prescription.
  
  
The team is the first line of technical support for that network, 24x7 across multiple shifts. We triage fulfillment issues, work with vendors on robotics and automation hardware problems, and route genuine defects to the right engineering team. The goal goes beyond fixing tickets. By finding the patterns behind recurring issues and the friction on the floor, you will turn manual work into automation and help move the operational metrics: faster order flow, higher throughput, lower cost per unit, and fewer escalations, with no compromise on patient safety.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Triage and resolve fulfillment issues from SIM and Trouble Ticket queues within defined SLAs, as part of a 24x7 multi-shift rotation.
* Diagnose problems across Pharmacy fulfillment systems using logs, metrics, dashboards, and data queries, and restore service quickly.
* Work with third-party vendors on robotics and automation hardware incidents: open and track escalations, share diagnostic data, and confirm fixes on site.
* Resolve network issues that affect fulfillment, mainly orders routed to the wrong fulfillment center and inventory out-of-stock scenarios.
* Route genuine defects to the right engineering team with clear reproduction steps, impact, and root-cause data, and follow them through to resolution.
* Analyze ticket trends to find recurring issues, then write scripts, automated remediation, and self-healing workflows that eliminate them.
* Help automate site launch readiness and configuration checks for new pharmacy sites and formats.
* Build and tune monitoring, dashboards, and alarms that catch issues before sites or patients feel them.
* Write and maintain runbooks, and contribute to Correction of Error (COE) reviews for high-severity incidents.

**About The Team**
Join as one of the first engineers on Amazon Pharmacy’s new Support Engineering team in Bengaluru. You will help shape how the team works from day one: the runbooks we write, the tools we build, and the issues we automate away first. Early members of a new team have an outsized say in its direction, and the work you do here will show up directly in how Pharmacy fulfillment runs worldwide.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 4+ years of software development, or 4+ years of technical support experience
* Experience scripting in modern program languages
* Experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems
* Experience in agile/scrum or related collaborative workflow
* Experience troubleshooting and documenting findings

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of UNIX/Linux operating system
* Experience analyzing and troubleshooting RESTful web API calls
* Knowledge of distributed applications/enterprise applications

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. Key duties encompass real-time alert triage, foundational diagnostic troubleshooting, comprehensive incident logging, and swift escalation of complex issues to upper-tier engineering groups to sustain system reliability and uphold rigorous SLA commitments.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Continuous Monitoring: Supervise enterprise network infrastructure, servers, applications, and links via monitoring tools (e.g., Nagios, Zabbix, SolarWinds, Datadog, PRTG).
* Incident Triage & Management: Acknowledge alerts, perform initial analysis, create detailed incident tickets in platforms like ServiceNow or Jira, and assign proper priority levels.
* Advanced Troubleshooting: Apply established operational procedures to remediate complex L2/L3 infrastructure incidents, including hardware power cycles, port resets, WAN circuit instabilities, storage reclamation, and system service restorations.
* Incident Escalation & Outreach: Route complex operational issues to subject matter experts, third-party providers (such as telecom carriers and equipment vendors), and key internal partners in accordance with established SLA response windows.
* Documentation & Reporting: Maintain accurate shift handover logs, document recurring issues, and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Networking Fundamentals: Strong grasp of OSI layers, TCP/IP suite, DNS, DHCP, VPN, VLANs, routing protocols (OSPF, BGP basics), and subnetting.
* Operating Systems: Basic command-line troubleshooting skills in Linux/Unix and Windows Server environments.
* Tool Proficiency: Familiarity with network diagnostic utilities (ping, traceroute, mtr, nslookup, tcpdump, netstat) and ticketing systems.
* Communication: Clear verbal and written English communication for cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder notifications during outages.
* Shift Flexibility: Participate in 24/7 support with other teams across the globe. Some weekend work may be required.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics & Telecommunications, or equivalent diploma.
* Experience: 5+ years of experience in a Network Operations Center, technical support, or IT helpdesk environment.
* Certifications (Preferred): Cisco CCNA, CompTIA Network+, CompTIA Security+, or ITIL v4 Foundation.

Physical Demand & Work Environment
  
  

* Must have the ability to perform office-related tasks, which may include prolonged sitting or standing.
* Must have the ability to move from place to place within an office environment.
* Must be able to use a computer.
* Must have the ability to communicate effectively.
* Some positions may require occasional repetitive motion or movements of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.

title: Specialist IT- Integration Architect
description:
**What you’ll do:**
-------------------

This position defines and communicates a shared architectural vision for a complex product (highly integrated, multiple applications) that supports current and future business needs. The architect collaborates with Agile teams to consider solutions, validate technology assumptions, evaluate alternatives, and converge on a solution, and works closely with Enterprise and Solution Architects to deliver solutions aligned to the broader architecture guardrails.  
This role owns the integration architecture for Eaton's external, API-first layer. This includes designing how External Customer platform and the back-end engines (Salesforce Commerce Cloud, External facing Commerce platform, ERP platforms, MuleSoft, Apigee, Azure Services, Redis Cache, Data Platforms, and third-party applications) connect to external customers and partner-hosted APIs, and defining the standards, patterns, and framework for External APIs push + pull modernization.

* Own the integration strategy and define the future-state architecture aligned with business and digital transformation goals.
* Design and govern scalable, secure, and reusable integration solutions across the developing platform.
* Establish API-led connectivity standards, API governance, and reusable integration patterns to enable seamless data exchange across systems.
* Provide architectural oversight, review solution designs, enforce standards, and ensure compliance with enterprise architecture principles.
* Ensure integration solutions meet security, compliance, data privacy, and operational risk requirements across all connected systems.
* Define standards for integration performance, availability, monitoring, and operational support to ensure stable and reliable services.
* Support the successful delivery of integration initiatives through standardized design approaches, CI/CD adoption, automation, and release governance.
* Own end-to-end integration designs (REST API and MuleSoft) and unblock the build team through timely design reviews
* Define integration standards, reusable patterns, and a framework for consuming partner-hosted APIs
* Design for throughput, reliability, and observability (monitoring, end-to-end tracing, SLAs), addressing External APIs timeout and throughput issues
* Architect event-driven / push integration (webhooks, pub/sub, messaging) alongside existing pull APIs
* Partner with Identity (Okta / Saviynt) to design external-customer authentication and coarse/fine-grained entitlements at the integration layer

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

* Education: bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution.
* Experience: 15+ years in the software industry with a proven track record of shipping high-quality products, including significant experience designing API and system-to-system integrations, ideally for external / B2B customers.

**Skills:**
-----------

* Strong expertise in Application-to-Application (A2A), real-time, batch, and event-driven integrations
* Minimum 5 years of work experience in Mulesoft and Kafka
* Expert-level understanding of integration / middleware and API platforms, programming languages, and their associated development platforms
* Deep understanding of Enterprise Integration Patterns (EIP) and API-led architecture
* Expert-level skills in integration and API technologies — MuleSoft, REST/SOAP, JSON/XML, and API gateways; general-purpose language proficiency (e.g., Java) a plus  
  Strong knowledge of Kafka, event streaming, messaging, and publish-subscribe architectures
* API management & gateway: MuleSoft / Anypoint, gateway policies, rate limiting / throttling, versioning, and API security (OAuth2 / OIDC, mTLS, keys)
* Event-driven architecture: webhooks, publish/subscribe, message queues / streaming
* Identity & entitlements: Okta, Saviynt; coarse- vs fine-grained access for external users
* Integration monitoring / observability and B2B / partner-API onboarding
* Experience with data transformation, canonical data models, ETL/ELT processes, and Snowflake integrations
* Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and automated deployments
* Experience integrating Salesforce, SAP/ERP, eCommerce, Order Management, and customer-facing platforms
* Good to have knowledge in Azure cloud integration services, cloud-native integration patterns, and hybrid architecture
* Comfortable working directly with both technical and non-technical audiences
* Good judgment, time-management, and decision-making skills
* Ability to work collaboratively on a technical team
* Patience and empathy when working with and coaching developers and testers
* Extensive experience working with diverse, global cultures, organizations, and teams
* Able to align distributor / partner integration requirements with Eaton architecture guardrails
* Advanced verbal and written communication skills, including explaining and presenting technical concepts to all levels of the organization

**Senior Network Engineer | Pune, India| Full-time**
**Your Role:**
We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Network Engineer to join our global IT Operations Center (ITOC). The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing, monitoring, troubleshooting, and optimizing enterprise network infrastructure across global data centers and business locations. This role requires strong expertise in routing, switching, firewalls, VPN technologies, wireless networking, network security, and operational support within a 24x7 environment.
  
  
The successful candidate will play a critical role in ensuring network availability, performance, security, and continuous improvement through automation and proactive infrastructure management.

**Network Operations & Support**

* Monitor and maintain the health, performance, and availability of global network infrastructure and data center environments.
* Provide advanced L2 and L3 support for network incidents, service requests, and problem management activities.
* Troubleshoot complex network connectivity, performance, and security issues across LAN, WAN, WLAN, and VPN environments.
* Take ownership of critical incidents and ensure timely resolution within defined SLAs.
* Collaborate with global IT teams, business units, and external vendors for issue resolution and service improvements.

**Network Administration & Engineering**

* Configure, deploy, and support:

+ Layer 2 & Layer 3 Switches
+ Enterprise Routers
+ Cisco ASA / Firepower Firewalls
+ Wireless LAN Controllers and Access Points
+ VPN Gateways and Remote Access Solutions
+ Load Balancers and QoS Implementations

* Design, implement, and support secure site-to-site and remote-access VPN solutions.
* Perform network infrastructure upgrades, firmware updates, security patching, and lifecycle management activities.
* Execute approved changes following established change management and configuration management processes

**Network Monitoring & Performance Management**

* Utilize enterprise monitoring and diagnostic tools such as:

+ Nagios
+ Wireshark
+ PRTG
+ SNMP-based monitoring solutions

* Proactively identify performance bottlenecks and implement corrective actions.
* Analyze network traffic patterns and capacity requirements to improve infrastructure efficiency and reliability.
* Develop and maintain network documentation, topology diagrams, asset inventories, and operational procedures

**Network Security & Compliance**

* Implement and maintain network security controls, firewall rules, VPN configurations, and access policies.
* Monitor network security events and collaborate with cybersecurity teams to mitigate risks.
* Ensure compliance with corporate security standards, best practices, and regulatory requirements.
* Participate in vulnerability remediation and security improvement initiatives.

**Automation & Continuous Improvement**

* Drive automation initiatives to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual effort.
* Develop scripts and automated workflows for network monitoring, reporting, configuration backup, and routine maintenance tasks.
* Identify opportunities for process optimization and service enhancements.
* Contribute to network architecture reviews and infrastructure modernization projects.

**Required Qualifications:**
**Education:**
Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  
  
**Certifications:**

* CCNA and CCNP Certification (Mandatory)
* Additional certifications such as Cisco Security, Fortinet, Palo Alto, or ITIL are highly preferred.

**Technical Skills:**

* Strong understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, STP, OSPF, BGP, NAT, ACLs, QoS, and VPN technologies.
* Deep understanding of OSI and TCP/IP networking models.
* Hands-on experience with Cisco routing and switching technologies.
* Expertise in Cisco ASA/Firepower firewall administration and troubleshooting.
* Experience supporting WAN, SD-WAN, MPLS, VPN, and wireless network environments.
* Proficiency with network monitoring, packet analysis, and troubleshooting tools.
* Knowledge of network security frameworks and best practices.
* Experience in automation and scripting using PowerShell, Python, or similar technologies is preferred.

**Required Competencies:**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a global, multicultural team environment.
* Strong customer service orientation and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Excellent time management, prioritization, and incident management skills.
* Ability to perform under pressure in a 24x7 operational environment.

* Experience working in a Network Operations Center (NOC) or IT Operations Center environment.

* Exposure to network automation and infrastructure-as-code methodologies.

A Service Operations Analyst is an information technology (IT) professional who assists BSL customers resolve issues and facilitate service requests. They will also work closely with other teams within BSL to help on tasks that are outside the scope of their knowledge or expertise.

This is a hands-on technical role involving tenant administration, client deployment, connectors, MCP servers, plugins, skills, policies and managed client settings.

The successful candidate will be technically curious, methodical and comfortable configuring enterprise applications, troubleshooting issues and documenting solutions.

Job Purpose

Configure, administer, operate, troubleshoot and continuously improve enterprise AI productivity tools to ensure employees have secure, reliable and well-integrated technology to support their work.

This is an execution-focused technical role, with approximately 90% dedicated to hands-on administration, configuration, deployment, integration and support, and 10% dedicated to governance, documentation and coordination.

Key Responsibilities

1. Microsoft 365 Administration & Management – 30%

* Administer the Microsoft 365 environment, including tenant settings, Microsoft 365 Admin Center, user and group management, roles, permissions and license assignment.
* Configure and manage Microsoft 365 Copilot, including administrative settings, access policies, licensing and security configurations.
* Manage Microsoft Entra ID, including SSO, role-based access control (RBAC), Conditional Access, identity and access policies.
* Administer Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive and Exchange settings relevant to enterprise AI productivity tools.
* Support Microsoft Purview policies, data protection, DLP and data-boundary controls.
* Ensure Microsoft 365 configurations align with enterprise security, identity and data classification standards.

2. Claude Enterprise Administration & Configuration – 20%

* Administer and configure Claude Enterprise workspaces, including user onboarding, groups, roles, permissions and access controls.
* Manage Claude Enterprise workspace settings, SSO, SCIM provisioning and identity integrations.
* Configure and maintain enterprise-level security, privacy and data access settings.
* Support the deployment, configuration and administration of Claude Desktop and Claude Code.
* Manage user access, workspace policies, approved capabilities and enterprise configurations.
* Troubleshoot Claude Enterprise access, authentication, configuration and usage-related issues.

3. AI Client Deployment & Endpoint Management – 15%

* Configure, deploy and maintain enterprise AI productivity clients across managed endpoints.
* Use Microsoft Intune to manage installation, configuration, updates, version control and security settings for AI clients such as Claude Desktop, Claude Code and other approved tools.
* Maintain consistent client configurations across different operating environments and user groups.
* Troubleshoot installation, compatibility, endpoint, authentication and client-side issues.
* Coordinate with endpoint and infrastructure teams to ensure reliable deployment and maintenance.
* Support controlled rollout of new AI tools and client updates.

4. AI Integrations, Connectors, MCP & Automation – 15%

* Set up, configure, test and maintain MCP servers, connectors, plugins and skills for approved enterprise use cases.
* Configure authentication, API scopes, permissions and connectivity for approved integrations.
* Build and maintain simple agents and workflows in Copilot Studio.
* Support integrations with enterprise applications and services using REST APIs, JSON and relevant authentication mechanisms.
* Validate integrations before release, manage versioning and rollback, and retire connectors and plugins that are no longer used.
* Maintain a catalog of approved connectors and plugins, including configuration and access details.
* Troubleshoot connector, integration and MCP-related issues.

5. Technical Support, Troubleshooting & Monitoring – 10%

* Diagnose and resolve access, authentication, permission, integration and client-side issues across Microsoft 365, Claude Enterprise and other approved AI tools.
* Troubleshoot SSO, Entra ID, endpoint, SDK, sandbox and connector-related issues.
* Monitor tool availability, usage telemetry and cost drivers; identify anomalies, capacity issues and capability gaps.
* Manage technical support tickets and coordinate with vendors and internal teams through resolution.
* Identify recurring issues and recommend configuration improvements to enhance reliability and user experience.

6. Governance, Documentation & Coordination – 10%

* Execute the technical steps of intake and security reviews for new connectors, plugins and AI tool configurations, working with Architecture, Security and Identity teams.
* Maintain technical runbooks, configuration records, access documentation and change logs.
* Apply approved configuration changes through established change control processes.
* Provide technical input to release notes, how-to guides and training materials.
* Track license assignment and rollout status for new user cohorts, and support adoption reporting.
* Surface recurring user issues, enhancement requests and configuration gaps to the relevant leads.
* Ensure configurations align with company policies and responsible AI requirements.

Measures of Success

* Time taken from approved request to deployment of a live connector, plugin, client or configuration change.
* Reliability and availability of enterprise AI productivity tools.
* Ticket resolution time and reduction in repeat technical issues.
* Accuracy of user access, licensing, identity and policy configurations.
* Successful deployment and maintenance of AI clients across managed endpoints.
* Reliability of MCP servers, connectors, plugins and integrations.
* Completeness and currency of configuration documentation and the approved connector catalog.
* Availability of accurate usage and cost telemetry.

**Job Qualifications & Experience**

Education

**Experience**

* 2–5 years of hands-on experience in Microsoft 365 administration, SaaS application administration, IT operations, endpoint management or systems support.
* Strong practical experience in Microsoft 365 administration, including tenant management, user and group administration, licensing, access controls and security configurations.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Intune and Microsoft 365 administration.
* Hands-on exposure to Microsoft 365 Copilot, Claude Enterprise, ChatGPT Enterprise or similar enterprise AI productivity tools in an administrative or configuration capacity.
* Experience configuring and maintaining enterprise applications or AI clients across managed endpoints.
* Exposure to MCP, plugins, connectors or LLM tool integrations, with the ability to read configurations, troubleshoot integrations and work from the command line.
* Scripting ability using PowerShell or Python, with practical knowledge of REST APIs and JSON.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Understanding of enterprise identity, authentication, access management and security controls.

* Familiarity with Microsoft Intune and managed endpoint deployments.

title: Notion Implementation Architect
company: UDIT - University of Design, Innovation and Technology
description:
**Notion Implementation Architect**

*Experience: 3–5 years | Reports to: Founder & Pro Chancellor |Location: Gurugram, NCR*

**The Mission**

UDIT is rolling out Notion as its core operating system — starting with how academic departments run (course templates, assessment rubrics, timetables, teaching plans, and course feedback, all in one place instead of scattered across spreadsheets, inboxes, and SurveyMonkey), then extending the same approach across the rest of the institution: HR, IT, Marketing, Admissions, and beyond. The academic rollout spans roughly six departments and 50+ staff, most of whom have never used Notion before — and it's the proving ground, not the finish line.

We need someone who has already done this — designed and rolled out a Notion workspace across a real organisation, not just used Notion well personally. You'll own the architecture, the rollout, and the adoption, starting from two pilot academic departments (Visual Communication and Fashion Management), scaling across the rest of academics, and then carrying the same playbook into HR, IT, Marketing, Admissions, and every other function that's currently running on spreadsheets, email, and disconnected tools.

**What You'll Actually Do**

**Design the workspace**

* Architect UDIT's Notion workspace: relational databases, templates, rollups, and permissions for course templates, formative and summative assessment rubrics, timetables, and teaching plans (a separate database, tracked week by week across courses).
* Design how course feedback is captured and stored directly in Notion and linked to courses, replacing SurveyMonkey — every raw response retained, not just summaries.
* Map UDIT's academic approval chain (course coordinator → programme leader → HoD → Dean/PVC) into clean, usable Notion workflows.
* Build in provision for non-project teaching alongside UDIT's project-based courses, and a lightweight way to track faculty work on institutional projects not tied to any course, for visibility only.

**Own the rollout — academics first, then the rest of UDIT**

* Lead the rollout across the two pilot academic departments first — Department of Visual Communication and Department of Fashion Management — then scale to the remaining academic departments.
* Train 50+ academic staff, most with no prior Notion experience, department by department. If HoDs and Programme Leads can't run their own workspace without you, the rollout isn't done.
* Set HoDs and Programme Leads up as the actual workspace owners, with clear governance for who can edit what.
* Once the academic rollout is stable, run the same audit-design-train-handover playbook across HR, IT, Marketing, Admissions, and other functions — each with its own workflows, owners, and adoption challenges.
* Administer UDIT's Notion Enterprise workspace institution-wide — permissions, guest access policy for external jurors and reviewers (who get no direct Notion access), cross-functional structure, and workspace-wide standards that hold up as more teams join.

**Make it stick**

* Produce the implementation document capturing agreed decisions and the full Notion structure — the first deliverable expected from this role.
* Document every database, template, and workflow: what it's for, who owns it, how to maintain it.
* Keep the workspace coherent as it scales across both academic departments and non-academic functions — naming conventions, template discipline, and governance that doesn't collapse as more teams join.

**Must Have**

* 3–5 years implementing Notion workspaces across an organisation — not personal use, a track record of designing and rolling out Notion for real teams with real adoption, not just a tidy personal setup.
* Experience rolling out Notion across more than one function or department — comfortable with the reality that HR, IT, Marketing, and Admissions each think about their work differently, and none of them run like an academic department.
* Strong, hands-on skill with Notion's relational databases — linked and related databases, rollups, formulas, views, and templates built for people who've never used Notion before.
* Experience designing permission structures and governance for a multi-team or multi-department workspace, ideally on a Notion Enterprise or Team plan.
* Proven ability to train non-technical staff and drive real adoption — not just build the system and hand over a manual.
* Comfortable translating complex, real-world workflows (academic approval chains, HR processes, marketing campaigns, admissions funnels, IT ticketing) into clean, usable Notion structures.
* Strong written documentation skills — able to produce a clear implementation document that others can follow without you in the room.
* A track record you can show, not just describe: specific workspaces you've built, for whom, at what scale, and what changed as a result.
* Comfortable working directly with a founder and with department heads senior to you — this role gets a mandate, not a task list.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in education or another institution with complex, multi-stakeholder academic or operational workflows.
* Familiarity with the Notion API, and with automation tools (n8n, Zapier, Make, or similar) to connect Notion with other systems.
* Experience migrating an organisation off another tool (spreadsheets, SurveyMonkey, a legacy LMS or intranet) into Notion.
* Basic comfort with HTML/CSS/JavaScript or Python, for lightweight customisation beyond what Notion natively supports.

**Why Join UDIT?**

* Real ownership — you're designing and shipping the system UDIT will run on, not maintaining someone else's workspace.
* Direct access to leadership — flat structure, fast decisions, no bureaucracy standing between a good idea and shipping it.
* A live, well-scoped rollout already in motion — pilot departments identified, decisions already made on structure — plus a clear, institution-wide mandate beyond it: HR, IT, Marketing, Admissions, and more.
* Join an institution with a decade-plus track record in Indian design education — UDIT grew out of IIAD, and now spans Design, Technology, and Management.

**How to Apply**

Send us:

1. Your CV at afrin.fatima@udit.edu.in
2. A short portfolio of 2–3 Notion workspaces you've designed and rolled out across an organisation — what the problem was, what you built, and what changed as a result.

**Applications without item 2 will not be reviewed.**

title: IT Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Job title: IT Infrastructure Engineer**

**Location: Kochi (Onsite)**

**Contract: Permanent, full-time**

**About us:**

Cyncly is a global technology powerhouse with 2,800+ employees and 70,000+ customers across 100+ countries and 46+ offices. Cyncly transforms the way customizable products and spaces are imagined, designed, sold, managed and made. Our end-to-end software solutions connect professional designers, retailers and manufacturers to the world's largest repository of product content. Today, our business spans across the Kitchen & Bath, Furniture, Window, Glass & Door, and Flooring industries with operations in North & South America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Africa.

Cyncly offers over 30 years of experience to deliver more value for our customers through an expanded portfolio of end-to-end solutions. Our global presence allows us to provide world-class support and sales with a local touch, providing the best possible customer experience.

Cyncly is now embarking on an exciting journey as we continue to expand through strong organic growth and complementary acquisitions, backed by leading growth private equity firms specializing in technology.

**About the Role**

The IT Infrastructure Engineer is a hands-on role responsible for implementing, managing, securing, and supporting IT infrastructure and Cloud Operations across Cyncly’s global environment.

The role combines CloudOps with ongoing operations, with a strong focus on Azure virtual machines, storage, networking, secure connectivity, monitoring, backup, and disaster recovery. The Engineer will translate approved designs into reliable production environments and provide advanced troubleshooting for cloud and network issues.

Experience with Cisco Meraki, Check Point firewalls, and Microsoft Hyper-V will be an added advantage.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Azure Infrastructure Deployment and Operations**

* Deploy, configure, and administer Azure virtual machines, managed disks, availability configurations, and supporting Windows and Linux workloads.
* Manage Azure Storage accounts, including Blob Storage and Azure Files, covering access controls, redundancy, lifecycle management, and data protection.
* Deploy and support infrastructure-related Azure services, including Azure App Service, Key Vault, Azure Backup, and Azure Site Recovery.
* Manage subscriptions, resource groups, resource naming, tagging, and resource lifecycle activities according to organizational standards.
* Configure Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, alerts, and diagnostic settings to support availability, troubleshooting, and operational visibility.
* Support capacity planning, resource sizing, performance tuning, and cost optimization.

**Azure Networking and Secure Connectivity**

* Deploy and manage Azure Virtual Networks, subnets, network interfaces, IP addressing, and Network Security Groups.
* Configure and troubleshoot virtual network peering, route tables, user-defined routes, and traffic flows between Azure, on-premises environments, and remote locations.
* Implement and support Azure VPN Gateway, site-to-site and point-to-site VPNs, and hybrid connectivity.
* Configure and administer Azure Bastion for secure administrative access to virtual machines.
* Manage Azure DNS, Private DNS zones, Private Endpoints, and connectivity to Azure services.
* Deploy and support Azure Load Balancer, Application Gateway, Web Application Firewall, Azure Firewall, and NAT Gateway, as required.
* Troubleshoot routing, DNS resolution, VPN connectivity, latency, packet loss, and firewall-related issues.
* Collaborate with security teams to implement network segmentation, access restrictions, and secure connectivity standards.

**Automation, Security, and Operational Improvement**

* Develop and maintain automation using PowerShell, Azure CLI, Terraform, Bicep, or similar tools.
* Apply Infrastructure as Code practices to improve deployment consistency and configuration management.
* Implement role-based access control, managed identities, Azure Policy, and secure secret management in line with approved standards.
* Support patching, vulnerability remediation, infrastructure hardening, and backup and recovery validation.
* Use approved AI tools to assist with scripting, troubleshooting, documentation, and operational improvement, while protecting company information and validating outputs.

**Project Delivery, Support, and Documentation**

* Deliver Azure and network infrastructure projects according to approved designs, schedules, budgets, and change management procedures.
* Plan and execute infrastructure migrations, upgrades, and connectivity changes, including testing, rollback planning, and post-change validation.
* Provide L3/L4 troubleshooting for escalated Azure and network incidents, perform root cause analysis, and implement corrective actions.
* Maintain infrastructure diagrams, configuration records, deployment procedures, runbooks, and troubleshooting guides.
* Coordinate operational handovers and knowledge transfer to support teams.
* Participate in on-call support and planned maintenance outside standard working hours, as required.

**Required Qualifications and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Minimum of 6 years of hands-on infrastructure engineering experience, preferably 6–8+ years, with substantial experience in Azure administration and networking.
* Strong practical experience deploying and supporting Azure virtual machines, storage accounts, Blob Storage, managed disks, monitoring, and backup services.
* Hands-on experience with Azure networking, including VNets, subnets, NSGs, peering, routing, VPN Gateway, Bastion, DNS, and Private Endpoints.
* Strong understanding of TCP/IP, subnetting, routing, switching, NAT, VPNs, firewalls, and network troubleshooting.

title: Control Tower Manager
description:
**Role Summary**
The Control Tower Manager leads the Control Tower team and owns network health across all BlitzNow hubs. You will run the shift roster, set the daily rhythm of monitoring and escalation, and turn Control Tower data into fixes on the ground. You move the team from firefighting to preventing repeat failures.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Team and shift management
* Lead a team of Control Tower Executives across rotational morning and evening shifts, including weekends and peak days
* Plan the shift roster, run shift handovers and make sure no hub goes unmonitored
* Coach, review and rate executives on their KPIs; hire and onboard new team members
* Hub opening and rider reporting
* Own on-time hub opening and on-time rider reporting across the network
* Set escalation rules with City and Hub Managers for late openings and rider no-shows
* Track rider attendance trends and flag hubs with chronic shortfalls to Ops leadership
* Shipment ageing
* Own the ageing bucket for every hub and drive closure within SLA
* Run daily ageing reviews with hub teams and push RTO, re-attempt and lost-shipment cases to closure
* Cash on Delivery
* Own daily CoD monitoring for all hubs: collection, deposit and reconciliation
* Escalate pending deposits and short cash the same day; work with Finance on recovery
* Hub discipline and rating
* Define the hub discipline checklist and the hub rating method, and publish ratings weekly
* Drive bottom-rated hubs through improvement plans with the ground team
* Reporting and analytics
* Build and maintain daily, weekly and monthly reports and dashboards on network KPIs
* Find the root cause of under-performance and agree corrective actions with owners
* Present network performance and hot spots to leadership and key clients
* Process and SOPs
* Write and update Control Tower SOPs and escalation matrices
* Find automation opportunities in monitoring and reporting, and work with Product and Tech to build them

**What We Are Looking For**

* Graduate in any discipline. Supply Chain is a plus.
* ~3 in operations, with at least 1 years in a Control Tower, central ops or war room role
* Experience leading a team of 5 or more people in a shift-based setup
* Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills; working knowledge of SQL and a BI tool such as Metabase
* Clear communicator & Owner who can push City and Hub Managers to act and close issues

**Good to have**

* Past experience in quick commerce, hyperlocal delivery or last-mile logistics
* Experience setting up a Control Tower from scratch or scaling one across cities
* Exposure to Lean or root cause methods such as 5 Whys or DMAIC

description:
**Job Description: Supply Chain Manager for Children’s Personal Care Brand (Inventory and Distribution Planning)**

 
**Location:**

Bangalore, India

 

 
**Employment Type:**

Full-time

 

 
**Target Start:**

End of this year

 

**About Nest**

Nest creates gentle, natural personal care for Gen Alpha, starting with deodorants and expanding into everyday essentials. Our refillable, dermatologist-tested products are designed for young skin and made in India for families everywhere.

 

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a self-starting Supply Chain Manager with at least five years of experience to own inventory and distribution planning for Nest from day one. You will run everyday supply chain operations end to end, with support from an external strategy consultant who helps set long-term direction. This is a hands-on role for someone who takes initiative, makes sound decisions without waiting for direction, and grows into an integral team member as the business scales.

 

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own day-to-day inventory planning, including stock levels, reorder points, and SKU-level forecasting for deodorants and upcoming personal care categories.
* Manage distribution planning across D2C, marketplaces, eco-retail partners, and export channels.
* Coordinate inbound supplier and manufacturing schedules, with attention to batch timelines, quality checks, and refill formats.
* Oversee warehousing, stock accuracy, cycle counts, and dispatch operations.
* Negotiate and manage courier, 3PL, and freight partners to balance cost, speed, and reliability.
* Build and maintain SOPs for inventory, packaging, dispatch, and returns, including reverse logistics for refillable containers.
* Track KPIs such as fill rate, stockout rate, inventory turns, cost per order, and on-time delivery.
* Work with the founders, the strategy consultant, marketing, and finance to plan launches and forecast demand.
* Ensure compliance with FSSAI, BIS, and other regulatory requirements relevant to personal care products.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum five years of experience in supply chain, inventory, or distribution planning, ideally in beauty, personal care, FMCG, or D2C.
* Hands-on experience with demand forecasting, inventory management, and distribution planning.
* Experience with ERP, WMS, or inventory tools, plus strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.
* Working knowledge of Indian logistics networks, courier partners, and import or export documentation is a plus.
* Proven self-starter with a strong ownership mindset.
* Comfortable working in an early-stage, fast-moving environment and collaborating with external consultants.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to build relationships with vendors and internal teams.

**What We Offer**

* Full ownership of supply chain operations in a mission-driven brand.
* Direct access to founders and a strategy consultant.
* Clear growth path into a senior operations or leadership role as Nest scales.
* Opportunity to shape the operating model for a new category with a sustainability focus.

**Compensation**

Compensation will be competitive and based on experience.

description:
**Sr. Business Operations Manager – Rider Experience & Consumer Insights**
**Uber | India & South Asia**
**About The Role**
At Uber, millions of riders trust us to get them where they need to go, every day. But what makes a great ride experience? What frustrates riders, what builds their trust, and what makes them choose Uber again and again?
  
  
We are looking for someone who is
**obsessed with understanding consumers**
— someone who is endlessly curious about what riders think, feel and experience, and passionate about turning those insights into meaningful change.
  
  
In this role, you will be the
**champion of the rider's voice within Uber**
, ensuring that consumer needs, expectations and pain points are at the heart of how we build products, design experiences and make business decisions.
  
  
You will shape Uber's Rider Experience strategy across India & South Asia, working closely with Product, Operations, Marketing and Marketplace teams to make Uber the most trusted and preferred mobility platform.
  
  
This is a unique opportunity to combine deep consumer understanding with strategic thinking and real business impact — moving beyond understanding what riders want to actually making it happen.
  
  

* Drive Consumer Insights & Problem Solving: Bring structure to ambiguous consumer problems, triangulating quantitative data, qualitative research and field insights to uncover root causes, size opportunities and drive actionable recommendations.
* Reimagine the Rider Experience: Identify and prioritize friction points across the end-to-end rider journey, with a focus on new rider experience, satisfaction and retention. Partner with cross-functional teams to drive measurable improvements.
* Build & Scale Rider Value Propositions: Identify opportunities for differentiated consumer propositions, validate them through research and experimentation, and partner with Product and Marketing to launch and scale impactful solutions.
* Own Critical Consumer Journeys: Drive improvements across priority areas including payments, rider communications and engagement programs, balancing consumer experience, business impact and investment efficiency.
* Champion the Voice of the Rider: Build a deep understanding of rider needs, frustrations and unmet expectations by combining consumer research, VOC and behavioral data. Translate insights into clear priorities that influence business and product decisions.
* Embed Consumer Obsession Across Uber: Bring compelling consumer insights and data-backed recommendations into leadership discussions, challenge assumptions and mobilize teams to act on what matters most to riders.

**What You'll Need**

* 5+ years of experience in consumer insights, customer experience, consumer strategy, product, growth or related fields.
* Consumer obsession: Deep curiosity about human behavior, strong empathy and a natural instinct to uncover what consumers really need.
* Analytical rigor & structured problem solving: Ability to bring clarity to ambiguous problems, synthesize complex datasets and marry quantitative evidence with qualitative insights.
* Insight-to-action orientation: Proven ability to translate consumer understanding into sharp strategic recommendations, prioritized initiatives and measurable business outcomes.
* Strong ownership & execution: Comfortable navigating ambiguity, driving cross-functional initiatives and moving from problem identification to implementation.
* Storytelling & influence: Ability to simplify complex insights, build compelling narratives and influence senior stakeholders to champion the consumer perspective.

**Ready to Ride?**
This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.
  
  
Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.
  
  
Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.

You will make trade-offs that balance near-term performance with long-term scalability.
* You will build a strong leadership organization, developing senior leaders and people managers while strengthening succession and talent pipelines. You will create an environment of high standards, accountability, engagement, and continuous improvement.

title: Wind DT Supply Chain Leader
description:
**Job Description Summary**
The Digital Technology Supply Chain Leader is responsible to drive IT strategy and execution for the Supply Chain function across the Wind segment, covering nacelles, towers, and blades. This role is the critical bridge between business operations and technology, responsible for deploying, evolving, and maximizing value from digital solutions that support and transform global Supply Chain operations.
  
  
The Wind DT Supply Chain Leader will own the technology roadmap for Sourcing, Logistics, and broader Supply Chain systems, ensuring our digital capabilities keep pace with business growth and global expansion. A key element of this role is leveraging (gen)AI solutions to accelerate the transformation of the Supply Chain organization — driving efficiency, insight, and innovation across all Supply Chain functions.
  
  
**Job Description**
ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES
  
  

* Provide strategic and execution leadership across the Wind segment to deploy and evolve digital tools for Supply Chain, sustaining business operations and supporting the global expansion of the Wind business.
* Develop and implement Sourcing, Procurement, Logistics, and other Supply Chain systems to drive efficiency and operational excellence across the organization.
* Lead with a data-centric approach and deliver analytics solutions to accelerate time-to-insight for Supply Chain stakeholders, enabling faster and better decision-making.
* Identify, pilot, and implement (gen)AI solutions to transform Supply Chain processes — including tendering, supplier risk assessment, procurement, logistics optimization, and intelligent automation of manual workflows.
* Ensure excellent product management of existing IT solutions and drive continuous tool evolutions for the function to maximize business value.
* Partner with Business functional stakeholders, GEV DT, and Vendor Partners to drive the right priorities at agreed timelines, ensuring alignment between technology investments and business outcomes.
* Establish a culture of innovation, high-performance, collaboration, respect, and integrity. Positively and collaboratively lead the business and the team through change and digital transformation.

**Qualifications / Requirements**

* Significant experience in IT/Digital Technology leadership roles within Supply Chain in global industrial or manufacturing environments.
* Proven track record of developing and executing IT strategy for Supply Chain functions including Sourcing, Logistics, Procurement, and Planning.
* Hands-on experience with (gen)AI solutions — including identifying use cases, piloting, and scaling AI-driven capabilities within Supply Chain or related domains.
* Strong experience managing IT product portfolios and driving application delivery across multiple functions, business units, and geographies.
* Deep understanding of Supply Chain processes and how digital technology can be leveraged to drive transformation, efficiency, and competitive advantage.
* Experience with ERP systems (Oracle EBS preferred), supply chain planning tools, and analytics platforms in complex, multi-site industrial organizations.
* Demonstrated ability to partner with senior business stakeholders and translate business needs into effective technology solutions and roadmaps.
* Strong program and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent initiatives and deliver results on time and within budget.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence and engage stakeholders at all levels of the organization, from shop floor to executive leadership.

DESIRED CHARACTERISTICS
  
  

* High energy, self-motivated leader passionate about leveraging technology and (gen)AI to drive Supply Chain transformation and operational excellence.
* Strong quantitative, analytical, and problem-solving skills with a pragmatic, results-oriented mindset.
* Lean understanding and mindset with experience applying continuous improvement principles to technology delivery and Supply Chain operations.
* Curiosity and drive to explore emerging technologies — particularly generative AI, advanced analytics, and intelligent automation — and apply them to real-world Supply Chain challenges.
* Collaborative leader, able to build strong relationships across engineering, operations, and business functions in a global, diverse organization.
* Experience leading and developing high-performing teams with a focus on talent growth, accountability, and a culture of innovation.
* Comfortable navigating ambiguity and driving change in a fast-paced, matrixed, global industrial environment.

******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:**
Yes

title: Senior Manager — SAP Business Process and Performance Management Leader
description:
Xylem is a Fortune 500 global water solutions company dedicated to advancing sustainable impact and empowering the people who make water work every day. As a leading water technology company with 23,000 employees operating in over 150 countries, Xylem is at the forefront of addressing the world's most critical water challenges. We invite passionate individuals to join our team, dedicated to exceeding customer expectations through innovative and sustainable solutions.
  
  
This role establishes governance for enterprise business processes, process harmonization, KPI management, and continuous improvement across SAP functions. It ensures business processes are standardized globally, monitored effectively, and aligned with transformation objectives. By providing visibility into operational performance, the role enables proactive decision-making and benefits realization. The position protects the value of the ERP investment by preventing process fragmentation and ensuring sustainable adoption of global standards. Strong business process governance is critical to achieving operational excellence and maximizing transformation outcomes.
  
  
**End-to-end process performance**

* Own performance for critical business processes across OTC, RTR, STP, and PTM/SCM, measured as

business outcomes: order-to-confirmation time, MRP run duration, close cycle time, shipment throughput, and
  
  
period-end batch windows.
  
  

* Establish performance SLOs per process with business process owners, and report against them as a

standing operating metric rather than an incident-driven exercise.
  
  

* Lead root cause analysis where slow performance is actually a process design or master data problem, and

drive the fix upstream instead of optimizing around it.
  
  

* Own performance readiness as a formal go-live gate for every deployment wave, with volumetric modeling

based on real segment transaction profiles.
  
  
**ABAP performance engineering**

* Provide deep hands-on analysis and remediation of custom ABAP: expensive selects, nested loops,

sequential reads, buffering misuse, internal table handling, parallelization, and background job design.
  
  

* Drive code pushdown to HANA — CDS views, AMDP, and ABAP for Cloud patterns — replacing

application-layer processing where the database should be doing the work.
  
  

* Own performance standards inside the development lifecycle: ATC performance checks, SQL Monitor and

SQL Performance Tuning Worklist, code inspector rules, and mandatory performance review for high-volume
  
  
objects
  
  

* Partner with the ABAP and BTP Senior Manager so performance is designed in at build time, not diagnosed

after go-live.
  
  
**HANA database performance**

* Deep expertise in HANA internals: execution plan analysis, delta merge behavior, partitioning strategy, table

distribution, column store optimization, and memory and workload management.
  
  

* Own expensive statement analysis, plan cache review, index and view optimization, and data aging or

archiving strategy where data volume is the root cause.
  
  

* Manage sizing, capacity forecasting, and workload profiling with the RISE hyperscaler and SAP operations

teams.
  
  
**Batch, interface, and system performance**

* Own batch and job scheduling architecture, including critical path analysis for period-end and nightly windows.
* Analyze interface and integration performance across the landscape, including Integration Suite and

high-volume data flows.
  
  

* Lead formal performance and volume testing cycles: scenario design, execution, analysis, and sign-off.

Operations and stakeholder engagement
  
  

* Partner with SAP services engagements — MaxAttention, Enterprise Support, EarlyWatch, Cloud ALM, and

Focused Run — on health checks and safeguarding.
  
  

* Lead performance-related RCCA for production incidents and drive corrective actions to closure.
* Hold AMS and system integrator partners accountable for performance quality in delivered code.
* Translate technical findings into business impact for segment and program leadership.

**Qualifications**
**Required**

* 15+ years in SAP technical performance engineering, with demonstrated end-to-end ownership rather than a

component specialty.
  
  

* Expert-level ABAP performance tuning — you must be able to open a trace and diagnose it yourself. Deep

command of ST05, ST12, SAT, SQLM, SE30, and runtime analysis tooling.
  
  
Expert-level HANA performance and database internals: plan visualization, expensive statement analysis,
  
  
partitioning, delta merge, memory management, and sizing.
  
  

* Proven S/4HANA performance ownership through go-live and steady state at global scale, with high

transaction volumes.
  
  

* Strong command of Basis-adjacent performance domains: work process configuration, memory parameters,

RFC and background job tuning, and system monitoring.
  
  

* Functional literacy across core process areas — enough to reason about why a business process is shaped

the way it is, and to challenge it credibly.
  
  

* Experience defining and running formal performance test cycles as a go-live gate.

**Preferred**

* RISE with SAP private cloud operations experience and hyperscaler capacity management
* SAP Focused Run, Cloud ALM operations, and Signavio process mining used to correlate process design with

runtime behavior.
  
  

* Data volume management, archiving, and data aging strategy at scale.
* Manufacturing or industrial complexity: variant configuration, large BOM structures, and high-volume plant and

warehouse transactions.
  
  

* Fiori and UI5 frontend performance analysis.

**Success in the First 12 Months**
Published performance SLOs for critical business processes, with a baseline the business agrees with. A
  
  
measurable reduction in the top expensive statements and long-running custom programs. Period-end and MRP
  
  
windows brought inside committed times. Performance testing established as a non-negotiable go-live gate. And a
  
  
demonstrable shift from reactive incident tuning to designed-in performance, evidenced by fewer performance
  
  
defects surfacing in hypercare.
  
  
**Operating Principles You Will Work Under**

* Products, not projects. Persistent teams aligned to value streams, funded by capacity rather than project

cycles, each paired with a business process owner accountable for the outcome.
  
  

* Clean core is non-negotiable. Extensions live on BTP, the core stays standard, and custom code is

governed at the point of creation.
  
  

* Paved road, not toll booth. Golden paths, reference architectures, and reusable patterns, with guardrails

enforced in the pipeline rather than in a design authority meeting.
  
  

* Compliance by default. Controls are designed into the platform and evidenced automatically, so control

integrity holds at deployment scale.
  
  

* Accountable for value, not volume. Success is measured in business process KPIs, adoption, and realized

value, not tickets closed or hours delivered.
  
  

* Intelligent enterprise by design. AI and agent enablement, and the data readiness that makes both credible,

are owned capabilities.
  
  

* Global template authority, local execution. Template integrity is held centrally through the current

deployment horizon, with a defined path to greater product-team autonomy.
  
  
Join the global Xylem team to be a part of innovative technology solutions transforming water usage, conservation, and re-use. Our products impact public utilities, industrial sectors, residential areas, and commercial buildings, with a commitment to providing smart metering, network technologies, and advanced analytics for water, electric, and gas utilities. Partner with us in creating a world where water challenges are met with ingenuity and dedication; where we recognize the power of inclusion and belonging in driving innovation and allowing us to compete more effectively around the world.

title: Print & Merchandise Manager
description:

title: AVP/VP - Securing Lending
description: AVP / VP – Secured LendingLocation: Bengaluru HQ, with regular travel across operating statesLevel: VP / AVP – Secured Lending (calibrated at offer based on candidate calibre)Reporting Into: Co-founderGeographies: Karnataka, Uttar Pradesh, Rajasthan, Haryana,About the organisation - The business is a tech-led, data-driven RBI-registered NBFC building financial products for the prime layer of India's informal economy. The Business combines AI, automation, and proprietary systems with on-ground field assessments to improve underwriting decision quality and build a scalable lending platform for India's emerging middle class. The company's core unsecured products (Welcome Loan, Super Loan) have established a deep, trustled presence across its operating geographies, and is now extending that distribution and data muscle into secured lending and MSME finance as it scales AUM 4X.About the RoleSecured Lending is the organisations newest vertical and is currently in early pilot across a subset of operating states. This role is a from-scratch build: you will take the vertical from pilot to a scaled, multi-state secured lending business, with full ownership of strategy, product, policy, team, and goto-market. You will work as a single-threaded owner for Secured Lending business outcomes, partnering closely with a dedicated Credit (Secured) function that operates independently and reports separately — a deliberate structural choice to keep credit judgment unbiased by sales pressure, not a constraint on your authority over the business. This is a build role, not a maintain role. You will inherit a pilot product and a live, if early, view of what works; everything else — team, channels, policy calibration, geographic sequencing — is yours to design.What You'll Own1. Vertical Strategy & P&L• End-to-end ownership of the Secured Lending business case: AUM growth, portfolio quality, unit economics, and state-wise sequencing across Karnataka, UP, Rajasthan, Haryana, MP, and Uttarakhand• Define the build-out roadmap from current pilot-stage operations to full coverage across all six geographies• Own the secured lending budget and resourcing ask, working with co-founders on investment pace versus portfolio readiness2. Product & Policy• Take the existing pilot secured product (loan-against-property / collateral-backed offering) fromearly-stage to a market-ready product — ticket size bands, tenure, LTV, collateral and title verification workflow, pricing• Partner with Credit (Secured) to design and continuously refine underwriting policy purpose built for the informal-prime segment — borrowers with irregular, undocumented, or hard-to verify income– Bring sales-ground reality (income patterns, collateral types actually available, localtitle/registry quirks) into policy design without compromising Credit's independent sign-off• Define the LOS/LMS integration requirements for the secured journey end-to-end — application,legal/technical valuation, disbursement, and collections3. Team & Organisation Design• Design the Secured Lending org structure from the ground up — regional/cluster leadership,Area Manager and Relationship Officer layers, and how the vertical interfaces with organisationsexisting unsecured field network• Decide build-vs-borrow: where Secured Lending needs dedicated hires versus where it can runon a shared/seconded model with the unsecured AO network, especially in early states• Hire, structure, and stand up the first layer of state/cluster leadership; define hiring sequencingagainst the six-state rollout plan• Establish training and certification standards for secured-specific skills — collateral assessment,legal documentation, title verification — distinct from the unsecured RO playbook4. Go-to-Market & Channels• Design and execute two distinct GTM motions:– Graduation channel — identifying and converting existing unsecured borrowers withstrong repayment vintage into secured customers, using internal credit history as a sourcingand underwriting advantage– New-to- channel — building open-market sourcing through branch-led acquisitionand local partnership channels (legal, property, and community intermediaries) to acquiresecured customers with no prior relationship• Build the channel mix and incentive structures appropriate to each motion, recognising thatgraduation and acquisition customers differ in cost-to-source, risk profile, and sales cycle• Sequence channel and geographic rollout together — deciding which of the six states lead ongraduation versus open-market sourcing based on existing unsecured book depth andcompetitive intensity5. Cross-Functional Operating Rhythm• Establish a regular operating cadence with Credit (Secured), Collections, and MIS/Tech to trackportfolio quality (GNPA, SMA migration, OTRR, bounce rates) from the earliest disbursals• Represent Secured Lending in broader business review and OKR processesalongside the existing North and South unsecured reviews What We're Looking For• 8–12+ years in financial services, with at least 4–5 years in secured/mortgage lending (LAP,home loans, or gold/vehicle-backed lending) for the mass-market or informal-income segment• Demonstrated experience building a lending business or vertical from early/pilot stage to scale— not just running an established book• Strong field distribution background — has built or led a multi-state RO/AM-style sales network,ideally in NBFC or housing finance• Working fluency in secured lending policy and collateral mechanics — LTV, title due diligence,legal/technical valuation, registry processes across multiple state jurisdictions• Comfort operating with an independent Credit function — has built sales-credit collaborationmodels without owning credit sign-off• Hands-on org-builder: has hired, structured, and scaled field teams from a handful of people toa multi-state organisationGood to Have• Experience specifically in LAP or affordable housing finance targeted at self-employed,informal-income, or underserved borrower segments• Exposure to both graduation-style cross-sell (converting an existing unsecured base) and open market secured acquisition• Prior NBFC or HFC experience in Tier 2/3 markets across North or South India, ideallyoverlapping operating states• A track record as a strong #2 or regional business head ready to own a P&L independently forthe first time.What Success Looks Like — First 12 Months, by QuarterQ1 (Months 1–3)Secured Lending policy v1 (informal prime segment) signed off with Credit; pilot product gaps scoped and revision plan agreed; org structure and hiring plan approved; core sales layer hired for at least 2 of 4 states; Credit Manager (Secured) co-owner role activatedQ2 (Months 4–6)Revised pilot product (ticket size, LTV, collateral/title workflow, eligibility) live; graduation channel launched, converting existing unsecured borrowers with strong repayment vintage; open-market sourcing channel launched in at least 2 states for new-to-business customersQ3 (Months 7–9)Secured vertical operational across all 4 states, with AOlevel field structure mirrored from the unsecured playbook; RO/AM hiring and certification substantially complete; early portfolio quality benchmarks (X-bucket, OTRR) established and tracked; policy v2 calibration based on pilot learningsQ4 (Months 10– 12)Live across all operating geographies (KA, UP, RJ, Haryana); secured AUM run-rate target achieved (to be finalised as part of Yearly Budgeting process); graduation channel contributing a defined share of secured disbursals; monthly business review cadence, scorecards, and credit-sales collaboration forum institutionalised Designation & CompensationVP – Secured Lending: 10+ years, with a demonstrated track record of building and owning a secured lendingP&LAVP – Secured Lending: 8–10 years, strong regional/cluster leadership experience, ready to step up into avertical-owning roleCompensation: Competitive for a Series A/B NBFC in Bengaluru, plus ESOPs
