title: Head of Customer Experience
description: About Good MonkGood Monk is a Bengaluru-based clinical nutrition brand that fortifies everyday Indian food — protein for rotis, nutrition mixes for families and the 50+, fibre, and more. We sell across our own D2C store, Amazon, and quick commerce (Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart). Around 60% of our business is D2C, which means the experience a customer has after they click “buy” is ours to own — and it is a direct driver of repeat purchase, reviews, and brand trust.Why this role existsToday our customer experience runs on effort, not on a system. We need a leader who has already built customer support and order-operations infrastructure at a scaled D2C brand and can install it here — tools, processes, team, training, and measurement — starting from day one. The mandate is simple: every query gets answered fast and resolved properly, every COD order gets confirmed, every failed delivery gets rescued, and every customer interaction builds credibility for the brand rather than eroding it.This is a builder role, not a caretaker role. You will inherit a small team of CX executives and a lot of green-field.What you will own1. Customer query redressal systemDesign and implement an omnichannel support stack — WhatsApp, email, calls, Instagram/Facebook DMs, website chat, and marketplace buyer messages (Amazon, Q-com) — on a single helpdesk with unified customer history.Select and deploy the right tools: helpdesk/ticketing (e.g., Freshdesk, Zendesk, Gorgias, Richpanel, Zoho Desk), WhatsApp Business API platform, cloud telephony/dialer, and integrations with Shopify, Shopflo, and our logistics aggregator so agents see orders, payments, and shipment status in one view.Define the ticket taxonomy, priority matrix, SLAs (first response, resolution), escalation paths, and a refund/replacement/return policy with clear agent-level authority limits.Build the knowledge base, macros/canned responses, and product FAQs in partnership with R&D and marketing so answers on ingredients, dosage, safety, and claims are accurate and compliant.Own response rate and resolution quality across every channel; nothing goes unanswered.2. Order and delivery operations (outbound CX)Run the ABC calling desk: COD order confirmation, address verification, fake/duplicate order flagging, prepaid conversion, and abandoned-cart recovery — with scripts, call windows, and conversion tracking.Run the NDR desk: same-day action on every non-delivery report, customer contact, re-attempt coordination with courier partners, and root-cause tracking by courier, pin code, and reason.Drive RTO reduction and RTO closure: address quality, COD risk scoring, courier performance reviews, and clean reconciliation of returned inventory and refunds with finance and warehouse.Set up the workflows on our logistics aggregator (Shiprocket/ClickPost-type panel) and courier dashboards; hold courier partners to SLA.3. Voice of customer, NPS, and trustLaunch and run the NPS/CSAT programme — post-delivery and post-resolution surveys, segmented by product, channel, and cohort — and publish a monthly Voice-of-Customer report to the leadership team.Own ratings and reviews hygiene across Amazon, Q-com apps, Google, and our own store: respond to every negative review, convert resolved complaints into positive reviews, and flag product or listing issues to the owning team.Close the loop: a structured feedback pipeline from CX into product (formulation, taste, packaging), marketing (claims, expectations set by ads), and ops (packaging damage, delays).Protect the brand on compliance-sensitive conversations — health claims, adverse-event reports, allergen queries — with clear protocols and R&D sign-off.4. Team building and qualityHire, train, roster, and lead the CX executive team; define roles by queue (inbound, ABC, NDR/RTO) and scale headcount with order volume.Build the training curriculum — product knowledge, tone of voice, objection handling, tool usage — and a certification before agents go live.Run a QA programme: weekly call and chat audits, scorecards, coaching, and monthly calibration.Design incentive structures tied to confirmation rates, NDR conversion, CSAT, and QA — not just call counts.5. Tracking, reporting, and costBuild the CX dashboard (helpdesk + dialer + Shopify + logistics data): volumes, SLA adherence, CSAT/NPS, confirmation and NDR rates, RTO %, cost per contact, and agent productivity — reviewed weekly with the CEO.Own the CX budget: tooling, telephony, and headcount; manage the cost-per-order of CX as volume scales.Use automation and AI (WhatsApp flows, chatbots, auto-tagging, smart routing) where it improves speed without hurting the experience.First 90 daysDays 1–30 — Diagnose and stabilise. Audit every channel, tool, and process; baseline all KPIs (response time, backlog, CSAT, confirmation rate, NDR conversion, RTO %); clear the backlog; put interim SLAs and escalation rules in place; present the CX system blueprint and tool recommendations with costs.Days 31–60 — Install the system. Deploy the helpdesk and WhatsApp/telephony stack with Shopify and logistics integrations; launch the knowledge base and macros; set up ABC and NDR desks with scripts and trackers; roll out the QA scorecard; go live with post-delivery NPS.Days 61–90 — Run and prove it. Hit interim SLA targets; deliver the first monthly Voice-of-Customer report; show measurable movement on NDR conversion and RTO %; finalise the hiring plan and incentive structure for the team; lock year-one targets with the CEO.Who we are looking forMust-have6–10 years in customer experience / customer support / order operations, including at least 3 years leading the function at a D2C brand doing meaningful daily order volume (indicatively 500+ orders a day) — ideally in health, nutrition, beauty, or FMCG.Has personally built — not just run — a CX system: chose the tools, set the SLAs, wrote the processes, hired the team. Can describe the before-and-after in numbers.Hands-on with a modern helpdesk (Freshdesk, Zendesk, Gorgias, Richpanel, Zoho Desk or similar), a WhatsApp Business API platform (Interakt, WATI, Gupshup, Bitespeed or similar), and cloud telephony/dialers.Deep familiarity with Indian D2C order operations: Shopify, COD dynamics, NDR/RTO workflows, courier aggregators (Shiprocket, ClickPost, Delhivery, Bluedart panels), and reconciliation with finance.Has run an NPS/CSAT programme and used it to change something in product, marketing, or ops.Comfortable with data: builds own trackers and dashboards (Excel/Sheets at minimum; title: Sales Operations Manager
description:
At CDW, we make it happen, together. Trust, connection, and commitment are at the heart of how we work together to deliver for our customers. It’s why we’re coworkers, not just employees. Coworkers who genuinely believe in supporting our customers and one another. We collectively forge our path forward with a level of commitment that speaks to who we are and where we’re headed. **Job Summary**
We are looking for a Sales Operations Manager to lead and develop our India Sales Operations team, ensuring the seamless delivery of operational support across the customer lifecycle. Working closely with Sales, Finance, Procurement, distributors, vendors and logistics partners, you will drive operational excellence, customer satisfaction, compliance and continuous improvement while building a scalable function that supports the continued growth of the business.

Additionally, CDW is committed to fostering an equitable, transparent, and respectful hiring process for all applicants. We welcome thoughtful use of AI to expand your perspective and elevate how you share your story, while ensuring your application remains rooted in your own background, judgment, and voice.

CDW is a Fortune 500 technology solutions provider that helps businesses, government, education, and healthcare organizations achieve what’s possible through technology. What makes CDW different isn’t just what we do—it’s how we do it. At CDW we act as one—building trust, speaking candidly, and working together to achieve more. We play to win—focusing on what matters most and delivering for our customers. And we think forward—staying curious, moving fast, and continuously learning. Together, we deliver the full promise of what technology can do.
**Together, we Make Amazing Happen.**
CDW is an equal opportunity employer. title: Manager Operations
description:
**Overview**
**Role Overview:**
We are seeking an experienced and technically strong Operations Manager to lead the Subscription L3 team, responsible for managing enterprise-level Client Delivery, platform reliability, technical delivery, and continuous improvement across multiple client accounts.
  
  
The role requires a strong blend of technical expertise, operational leadership, stakeholder management, and people development. The individual will own end-to-end service delivery, drive operational excellence, establish scalable delivery practices, and ensure high availability and stability of the Subscription platform.
  
  
The candidate will work closely with Product, Engineering, QA, BSA, Client Experience, and Global Operations teams to ensure seamless service delivery and continuous platform improvement.
  
  
Click here to view how Epsilon transforms marketing with 1 View, 1 Vision and 1 Voice.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Technical Operations & Service Delivery

+ Own end-to-end L3 service delivery across multiple Subscription client accounts.
+ Ensure platform stability, availability, reliability, and adherence to defined SLAs and operational KPIs.
+ Oversee incident, problem, change, release, and escalation management.
+ Drive effective resolution of critical production incidents, ensuring timely communication and stakeholder alignment.
+ Establish strong operational governance, including daily reviews, service reviews, and periodic business reviews.
+ Ensure adherence to ITIL-aligned service management processes and organizational standards.

* Technical Leadership & Platform Ownership

+ Provide technical oversight across Subscription platform operations, integrations, workflows, databases, and infrastructure.
+ Guide teams in troubleshooting complex production issues, identifying root causes, and implementing permanent corrective actions.
+ Partner with Engineering and Product teams to drive platform enhancements, defect resolution, and technical debt reduction.
+ Drive platform upgrades, patching, migrations, infrastructure modernization, and technology transitions.
+ Establish technical documentation, knowledge management, runbooks, and operational best practices.
+ Promote engineering-led operations and reduce dependency on manual Client delivery activities.

* Client & Stakeholder Management

+ Act as a key escalation point for client-facing technical and operational matters.
+ Build effective working relationships with internal stakeholders, client teams, and global delivery partners.
+ Ensure transparent communication on service performance, risks, dependencies, and critical incidents.
+ Drive service improvement initiatives based on client feedback and operational performance.
+ Participate in client governance meetings and provide leadership-level updates on delivery performance.

* People, Resource & Capacity Management

+ Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of L3 engineers, technical leads, and client delivery specialists.
+ Own resource planning, capacity management, utilization, and workforce optimization.
+ Identify skill gaps and drive structured technical training, cross-skilling, and succession planning.
+ Establish clear accountability, ownership, and performance expectations across the team.
+ Build a culture of collaboration, technical excellence, and continuous learning.
+ Drive effective onboarding and knowledge transitions for new client accounts.

* Automation, AI & Continuous Improvement

+ Identify opportunities to automate repetitive operational activities and eliminate manual interventions.
+ Champion AI-driven operations, intelligent monitoring, proactive incident detection, and automated remediation.
+ Drive adoption of approved AI tools and engineering productivity solutions.
+ Establish measurable automation goals and track productivity improvements and resource efficiencies.
+ Encourage innovation through reusable frameworks, standardized solutions, and scalable automation practices.

* Global Operations & Transition Management


+ Lead transition of Subscription client accounts into the Global Operations model.
+ Ensure structured knowledge transfer, operational readiness, documentation, and stakeholder sign-offs.
+ Define transition milestones, resource requirements, governance, and stabilization plans.
+ Ensure seamless handover from implementation and engineering teams into steady-state operations.
+ Drive standardization across accounts while accommodating client-specific requirements.

* Governance, Risk & Compliance

+ Ensure adherence to security policies, compliance requirements, access controls, and audit standards.
+ Proactively identify operational risks, recurring issues, and service delivery dependencies.
+ Establish effective risk mitigation and escalation mechanisms.
+ Maintain operational dashboards, performance reports, and management-level updates.
+ Drive accountability for audit findings and process improvement actions.

**Qualifications**
**Technical Skills:**

* 10–13 years of experience in enterprise application client delivery, technical operations, or software delivery. Strong understanding of enterprise application architecture and Client Delivery.
* Experience managing complex L3 client delivery, application integrations, databases.
* Working knowledge of SQL, APIs, scripting, workflow orchestration, and troubleshooting methodologies.
* Experience with incident management, monitoring, release management, and ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow, VSTS, JIRA.
* Exposure to cloud infrastructure, DevOps practices, CI/CD, and automation frameworks is preferred.

**Leadership & Management Skills**

* Proven experience leading distributed technical teams and managing multiple enterprise client accounts.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and escalation-handling capabilities.
* Demonstrated ability to manage resources, budgets, capacity, and delivery commitments.
* Experience driving delivery transformation and process standardization.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
* Ability to engage with senior leadership and communicate technical matters in business terms.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline. ITIL certification is preferred.
* Relevant cloud, DevOps, automation, or project management certifications are an added advantage.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**
The ideal candidate is a technically strong leader who can balance day-to-day delivery execution with long-term transformation initiatives.
  
  
They should be capable of moving beyond traditional ticket-based Delivery management and building a proactive, engineering-driven delivery organization.
  
  
**The Individual Should Demonstrate**

* Strong ownership and accountability for service delivery.
* Ability to lead through technical complexity and delivery challenges.
* A continuous improvement mindset with a focus on automation and AI adoption.
* Ability to scale delivery across multiple clients without compromising service quality.
* Strong collaboration across Delivery, Engineering, QA, BSA, DEV and Global Operational teams.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) -**
The role will be measured against the following performance dimensions:
  
  

* Service Delivery: SLA compliance, incident resolution, service availability
* Platform Reliability: Production stability, recurring incidents, defect reduction
* Incident Management: MTTR, P1/P2 resolution effectiveness, RCA quality and timeliness
* Client Satisfaction: Stakeholder feedback, escalation management, service reviews
* Operational Efficiency: Automation adoption, productivity, manual effort reduction
* Resource Management: Utilization, capacity planning, skill coverage
* Technical Excellence: Upgrade execution, patching, technical debt reduction
* Transition Management: Transition timelines, operational readiness, stabilization
* People Development: Training, cross-skilling, retention and succession planning

**Additional Information**
Epsilon is a global data, technology and services company that powers the marketing and advertising ecosystem. For decades, we’ve provided marketers from the world’s leading brands the data, technology and services they need to engage consumers with 1 View, 1 Vision and 1 Voice. 1 View of their universe of potential buyers. 1 Vision for engaging each individual. And 1 Voice to harmonize engagement across paid, owned and earned channels.
  
  
Epsilon’s comprehensive portfolio of capabilities across our suite of digital media, messaging and loyalty solutions bridge the divide between marketing and advertising technology. We process 400+ billion consumer actions each day using advanced AI and hold many patents of proprietary technology, including real-time modeling languages and consumer privacy advancements. Thanks to the work of every employee, Epsilon has been consistently recognized as industry-leading by Forrester, Adweek and the MRC. Epsilon is a global company with more than 9,000 employees around the world.
  
  
Our pillars aren't just words. They're how we show up every day.
  
  

* People centricity: We focus on employee well-being in an environment where colleagues truly care about each other.
* Collaboration: We work together, support one another, and collectively achieve goals.
* Growth: There are endless opportunities for growth through learning, development and career advancement.
* Innovation: We drive progress through cutting-edge solutions and forward-thinking approaches.
* Flexibility: We’ve created a balance between work and personal life, and we encourage adaptability to solve problems creatively.

Our values guide us to create value for our clients, our people and consumers.
  
  

* Act with integrity
* Work together to win together
* Innovate with purpose
* Respect all voices
* Empower with accountability

These pillars and values are our foundation—shaping our culture, guiding our decisions, and uniting us in common purpose.
  
  
**Epsilon is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**
Epsilon is committed to promoting diversity, inclusion, and equal employment opportunities by using reasonable efforts to attract, recruit, engage and retain qualified individuals of all ethnicities and backgrounds, including, but not limited to, women, people of color, LGBTQ individuals, people with disabilities and any other underrepresented groups, traits or characteristics.

title: Manager III, Support Engineer, Amazon Pharmacy Operations
description: DescriptionWe are looking for a founding leader to build Amazon Pharmacy’s Support Engineering team in Bengaluru from scratch. You will hire the first engineers, design how the team operates, and decide what gets automated first. There is no inherited playbook and no legacy to work around, so the choices you make will set how Pharmacy fulfillment is supported worldwide.Amazon Pharmacy delivers prescriptions safely, accurately, and fast. The business is defined by four things: cost, speed, scale, and patient safety. Our fulfillment network spans central and regional fill, small-format sites, kiosks, and growing automation, and every order is a patient’s prescription.Your team will be the first line of technical support for that network, 24x7 across multiple shifts. It triages fulfillment issues, manages robotics and automation hardware problems with vendors, and routes genuine defects to the right engineering team. The mandate goes beyond keeping the lights on. By studying recurring issues and floor-level friction, your team finds the opportunities that move operational metrics: faster order flow, higher throughput and lower cost per unit on the floor, and fewer escalations, with no compromise on patient safety. Every repeat issue you automate away returns capacity to the network. You will partner with Operations and engineering leaders across Pharmacy, and the results will show up in the numbers the business cares about most.Key job responsibilities Build, hire, and lead a team of Support Engineers in Bengaluru, owning 24x7 multi-shift coverage for global Pharmacy fulfillment, including rosters, shift handoffs, and on-call rotations. Own triage and resolution of fulfillment issues across SIM and Trouble Ticket queues. Set severity criteria, escalation paths, and SLAs, and report on SLA adherence, MTTR, backlog, and repeat-ticket rate. Manage robotics and automation hardware incidents with third-party vendors: run escalations, track vendor SLAs and action items, and hold vendors accountable for fixes and preventive maintenance. Resolve network issues that affect fulfillment, mainly routing orders to the right fulfillment center and handling inventory out-of-stock scenarios, in partnership with network and inventory teams. Route genuine defects to the right engineering team with reproduction steps, impact, and root-cause data, and follow through until the fix lands. Drive high-severity incident response and Correction of Error (COE) reviews with clear, owned action items. Move the operational metrics. Analyze ticket and floor data to find opportunities that improve site efficiency, throughput, and speed, and deliver them with Operations and engineering partners. Own the automation roadmap. Turn recurring issues and manual runbooks into scripts, automated remediation, and self-healing workflows, and automate site launch readiness and configuration checks. Build monitoring, dashboards, and alarms that detect issues before sites or patients feel them. Uphold patient safety and regulatory requirements, including HIPAA, in daily operations. No workaround may compromise dispensing accuracy. Coach and grow engineers, and raise the hiring bar.About The TeamOur team is dedicated to ensuring Amazon Pharmacy's operations is scaled and efficient for customers worldwide. We value collaboration, clear communication, and a genuine commitment to each other's growth. This is an opportunity to shape the direction of a team that directly impacts healthcare for millions of customers at Amazon.Basic Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a related technical discipline 3+ years of experience managing technical support, support engineering, or operations engineering teams 5+ years of experience in technical support, production support, or operations engineering roles Experience running 24x7 or multi-shift operations, including rosters, on-call rotations, and escalation processes Experience using operational metrics (SLA adherence, MTTR, ticket volume and aging) to drive team performance Experience leading incident management and root cause analysis for high-severity issues Experience working with engineering teams and external vendors to resolve technical issues Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent experiencePreferred Qualifications Experience managing engineering teams in an operations environment Experience with scripting and automation in Python, SQL, or Bash, and leading teams that automate manual operational work Experience with AWS services for monitoring, alarming, and automation Experience with IT service management tooling and ticketing workflows, such as SIM, Trouble Ticketing, ServiceNow, or JiraOur inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Manager, Business Operations
description:
**The Company**
PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.
  
  
We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
  
  
We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.
  
  
Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.
  
  
**Job Summary:**
**What Do You Need To Know About The Role**
The Core Platforms Technology team is looking for a talented, self-driven, and analytically minded Business Operations professional. Reporting to the Chief of Staff, the Business Operations Analyst will partner with engineering leaders and cross-functional teams to improve operating discipline, generate actionable insights, and enable data-driven decision-making across the organization.
  
  
This role combines business operations, data analysis, workforce and capacity planning, portfolio governance, communications, and program execution.
  
  
Meet Our Team
  
  
The Business Operations team supports the Core Platforms Technology leadership team and helps the organization operate effectively at scale. We partner closely with Engineering, Product, Finance, People, Strategy, and other Business Operations teams to translate business priorities into measurable plans and coordinated execution.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**Essential Responsibilities:**

* Lead functional projects and programs to optimize operational processes.
* Identify issues and recommend best practices for process improvements.

description:
**Who We Are**
VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking an experienced Major Incident Management Lead to join our VNO ECS team in Bangalore or Pune. This role is responsible for leading the response to high-impact service incidents across live operational environments, ensuring rapid service restoration whilst minimising customer and business disruption. Working within a 24/7 operational environment, you will coordinate technical teams, suppliers, operational functions and senior stakeholders to drive incident resolution, provide clear communication, and continuously improve incident management practices. The role is ideal for professionals with experience in telecom, ISP or service provider environments who are passionate about operational excellence, stakeholder engagement and service resilience.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Take charge of the NOC floor during assigned shifts within a 24/7 operational model

* Lead incident bridges and coordinate incident response teams, ensuring clear understanding of impact, priorities, actions, ownership and next steps
* Engage technical teams, operational support functions, suppliers and senior stakeholders to accelerate service recovery
* Maintain momentum during incidents by monitoring progress, challenging assumptions and removing obstacles to restoration
* Deliver timely, accurate and audience-appropriate communications to customers, leadership teams and key stakeholders
* Manage technical and management escalations in accordance with agreed service and operational standards
* Support planning and operational management of special events, including monitoring, communications and escalation processes
* Coordinate live operational responses during special events and ensure emerging risks are identified and addressed promptly
* Lead or support business continuity, disaster recovery and crisis management activities when required
* Maintain detailed and accurate records of incidents, key decisions, actions and outcomes
* Participate in post-incident reviews and contribute to improvements in service resilience, operational processes and stakeholder experience
* Support the enhancement of major incident management tools, reporting and ways of working
* Prepare and communicate daily, weekly and monthly operational reports
* Participate in customer reviews, service discussions and incident management forums
* Build customer confidence through proactive communication, ownership and effective incident leadership
* Ensure adherence to ITIL-aligned Major Incident, Problem and Change Management processes

**Who You Are**

* Experience in telecom, ISP or service provider environments with a strong understanding of operational service management

* Understanding of CCNA fundamentals and networking concepts
* Strong ownership mindset with accountability for service outcomes
* Ability to remain calm, focused and decisive during high-severity incidents
* Excellent stakeholder management and customer engagement skills
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with experience working across global teams
* Ability to communicate technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
* Skilled at coordinating cross-functional teams in time-critical environments
* Familiarity with ITIL practices and service management frameworks
* ITIL Foundation or ITIL Practitioner certification is preferred

**Not a perfect fit?**

If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
  
  
**What's In It For You**

* Opportunity to lead critical, customer-impacting incidents across a global telecommunications environment
* Exposure to senior leadership, cross-functional operational teams and international stakeholders
* Experience in business continuity, crisis management and service resilience activities
* Opportunity to contribute to service improvement initiatives and operational transformation programmes
* A collaborative environment focused on continuous learning, innovation and operational excellence

title: Commercial Sourcing Manager
description:
Tata Electronics Private Limited (TEPL) is a greenfield venture of the Tata Group with expertise in manufacturing precision components.
  
  
Tata Electronics (a wholly owned subsidiary of Tata Sons Pvt. Ltd.) is building India’s first AI-enabled state-of-the-art Semiconductor Foundry. This facility will produce chips for applications such as power management IC, display drivers, microcontrollers (MCU) and high-performance computing logic, addressing the growing demand in markets such as automotive, computing and data storage, wireless communications and artificial intelligence.
  
  
Tata Electronics is a subsidiary of the Tata group. The Tata Group operates in more than 100 countries across six continents, with the mission 'To improve the quality of life of the communities we serve globally, through long term stakeholder value creation based on leadership with Trust.’
  
  
**Role in a nutshell**
Lead the end‑to‑end equipment and material sourcing for a greenfield semiconductor assembly and testing facility, ensuring uninterrupted availability, quality, compliance, and cost effectiveness of direct and indirect materials required for process qualification, ramp‑up, and steady‑state production.
  
  
The role is accountable for building a world‑class, resilient, and compliant equipment and materials supply ecosystem from zero—covering dicing saws, die bonders, wire bonders, molding presses, trim & form systems, AOI/X‑ray/SAM inspection tools, burn‑in chambers, and automated test equipment (ATE) along with handlers, SMT Process eqpt, die attach materials like epoxy adhesives, sinter paste, solder, bonding wires (Au, Cu), lead frames or substrates, epoxy molding compound (EMC), gels, plating metals, marking supplies, solder balls, flux, underfill, tape & reel, moisture barrier bags, cleaning solvents, ESD items, machine consumables, chemicals, gases, consumables, spare parts, and cleanroom materials—while managing risks related to single sourcing, geopolitics, logistics, purity, and contamination control
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Strategic Leadership:**

* Build and manage strategic supplier relationships, ensuring quality, cost competitiveness, and sustainability.
* Negotiate long-term contracts and secure critical equipment and material supply
* Ensure slot reservation, factory installs, spares/consumables readiness, and service level agreements are in place to achieve tool move‑in, qualification, and ramp milestones on‑time and on‑budget, in compliance with local and global trade/tax regimes.
* Build a Phase‑wise equipment procurement master plan aligned to process of record (POR), construction schedule, cleanroom readiness, AMHS track readiness, and tool hook‑up sequences.
* Develop category strategies per toolset: new vs refurbished, OEM vs third‑party, frame agreements and slot reservations considerations.
* Establish total cost of ownership (TCO) models (capex, install, consumables, service, uptime impact) and should‑cost for high‑value sections.
* Work with logistics and customs team to set export control pathways and India trade architecture.
* Define and execute global supply chain for OSAT materials sourcing strategy aligned to:
* Process of Record (POR),
* Ramp curve and capacity plans
* Yield, variability, and quality control requirements
* Align supply chain operations with organizational goals, technology roadmaps, and market demands.
* Establish single vs multi sourcing philosophy for each equipment and material category
* Develop local vs global sourcing roadmap with risk‑based segmentation

**Supplier selection and qualification**

* Lead supplier identification, qualification, and onboarding for all OSAT equipment and materials
* Coordinate with Process Engineering, Quality, and EHS for:
* Material specifications
* Change control
* Contamination and defect risk assessment
* Establish Approved Vendor Lists (AVL) and Approved Material Lists (AML)

**Contracting & Commercial Management**

* Negotiate contracts to secure critical equipment, spare parts, and service agreements.
* Secure critical material supply.
* Negotiate: Long‑term supply agreements, Volume commitments and price protection, Consignment and Vendor‑Managed Inventory (VMI), Yield‑linked and performance‑based pricing
* Structure contracts covering: Quality guarantees, Supply continuity, Change notification, Confidentiality and IP protection

**Start‑Up & Ramp‑Up Readiness**

* Ensure Day‑1 readiness for all line qualification materials
* Build ramp‑synchronized equipment and material plans aligned to: Tool installation schedules, Process releases
* Develop material buffers and safety stocks for ramp volatility

**Spares, Consumables & Service Continuity**

* Build startup and sustaining spares strategies; deploy consignment and min‑max policies integrated with MES.
* Negotiate multi‑year service contracts with uptime SLAs (e.g., ≥95–98%), response times, escalation ladders, and OPEX caps; structure outcome‑based models (uptime/throughput).
* Establish local service capability (OEM/third‑party) and critical spares localization (where feasible) to reduce MTTR and import dependency.

**Operations, Inventory & Logistics Management**

* Oversee equipment planning, sourcing, installation, and maintenance support.
* Oversee planning, sourcing, inventory management, and distribution across multiple geographies.
* Establish material planning models integrated with: MES / ERP / MRP, Consumption and yield data
* Implement risk management frameworks to mitigate supply disruptions.
* Optimize: Inventory turns, Shelf‑life management, Cold storage and hazardous storage
* Implement cleanroom‑compatible equipment and material handling

**Risk Management & Supply Resilience**

* Identify and mitigate risks related to: Single‑source materials, Long lead times, Geopolitical and logistics disruptions
* Develop: Alternate suppliers, Substitution strategies (qualified and pre‑approved), Emergency supply and expediting playbooks

**Cost, Risk & Governance**

* Own the equipment capex and OPEX models; deliver savings vs baseline via value analysis and value engineering (VAVE), shared spares pools, and energy/consumables optimization.
* Maintain risk registers (single‑source OEMs, export license lead times, shipping lanes, customs clearances, site readiness); implement dual sourcing/alternate modules where possible.
* Run tender boards, change order/claims management, ethics & compliance audits, and management reporting (schedule, cost, risk, quality, EHS).

**EHS & Regulatory Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with: Hazardous chemical and gas regulations, Storage, transport, and disposal norms, Import/export and customs requirements
* Coordinate approvals with: EHS, Facilities, Government and statutory bodies
* Build safe and compliant chemical and gas supply chains

**Innovation & Transformation**

* Champion automation and analytics to optimize equipment utilization and reduce downtime and overall equipment efficiency (OOE)
* Drive digitalization, predictive analytics, and automation in supply chain processes.
* Champion sustainability initiatives and compliance with global regulations.
* Implement and govern:
* ERP / MRP integration
* Supplier portals
* Material traceability and lot genealogy
* Ensure end‑to‑end visibility from supplier lot to manufacturing lot to customer lot

**Leadership & Collaboration**

* Lead cross-functional teams across procurement, logistics, and manufacturing.
* Collaborate with R&D, manufacturing, and finance to ensure seamless integration of supply chain strategies.

**Building Developing a world class material supply chain team**

* Build a high-performance commercial sourcing team with an ability to execute greenfield and brownfield fab projects.
* Develop a hiring, training, coaching/mentoring and retaining strategy to build organization capacity and capability
* Develop a continuously learning and developing culture to build talent pipeline for near, mid- and long-term requirements
* Ensure succession and career planning for each team members.
* Ensure learning and development opportunities for teams.
* Encourage diversity and inclusion as per corporate values and guidelines.
* Build and lead a high‑caliber equipment and materials sourcing team with a category management approach
* Define capability development in: Semiconductor materials science basics, Risk management, Supplier negotiations

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Materials Science, Supply Chain, or related field.
* Master’s degree (MBA or equivalent) preferred.
* Strong knowledge of semiconductor assembly test equipment and materials, global trade regulations, and compliance standards.
* Exceptional leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to drive transformation initiatives and deliver measurable business impact.

**Essential Experience**

* 15+ years of progressive experience in supply chain management, with at least 7 years in leadership roles.
* Proven track record in semiconductor or high-tech manufacturing industries.
* Expertise in global procurement, supplier negotiations, and risk management.
* Experience in implementing advanced supply chain technologies (ERP, predictive analytics, AI-driven planning).
* Demonstrated success in managing multi-entity, cross-border supply chain operations.

title: Manufacturing Excellence - Senior Associate
description:
The Opportunity
  
  
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
  
  
As a Manufacturing Excellence - Senior Associate, you will specialize in enhancing product development and manufacturing processes. You will collaborate closely with clients to analyze product lifecycles, identify bottlenecks, and develop strategies to enhance speed to market, reduce costs, and improve quality. Within our Management Consulting practice, you will focus on optimizing operational efficiency and effectiveness, providing guidance on implementing lean manufacturing principles, optimizing supply chain integration, and leveraging digital technologies.
  
  
As a Senior Associate, you will utilize your skills to analyze complex problems and manage assigned workstreams, developing deliverables within client service engagements. You will build meaningful client connections, anticipate needs, and embrace increased ambiguity. Your role involves mentoring others, maintaining professional and technical standards, and navigating complexity to deliver quality work and grow your personal brand.
  
  
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will be part of a team that partners with clients across diverse industries to address critical business challenges and drive transformation in how products are designed, engineered, and manufactured. You will contribute to strategic advisory and implementation services in areas such as Strategy & Operations, Digital Manufacturing, and Connected Products & Solutions.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
PwC’s Operations and Supply Chain Solutions (OSCS) – Physical Product Development & Manufacturing (PPDM) partners with global clients to transform how products are designed, engineered, manufactured, and serviced. As a Manager within the Manufacturing Excellence capability, you will lead engagement teams and deliver strategic and operational transformation programs across industries.
  
  
You will collaborate with senior client stakeholders to shape solutions, drive execution, and ensure measurable business impact across Manufacturing Excellence, Product Development Excellence, Digital Manufacturing, Digital Engineering, and Connected Physical Products & IoT.
  
  
**Position Requirements**
**Knowledge Preferred:**

* Manufacturing Strategy & Operations: Expertise in end-to-end manufacturing process and shop floor operations, with the ability to diagnose operational challenges and recommend strategic initiatives to enhance throughput, productivity, plant network efficiency and cost-to-serve.
* Operations Excellence: Proven experience in leading Lean, Six Sigma, TPM, or Kaizen initiatives, with the ability to design operational improvement roadmaps and drive multi-site implementation.
* Maintenance & Reliability: Knowledge of preventive/predictive maintenance, asset reliability programs, and uptime optimization strategies.
* Manufacturing Quality: Exposure to manufacturing quality systems, root cause analysis (RCA), CAPA implementation, and cost of poor quality (COPQ) tracking.
* Contract Manufacturing Strategy: Experience supporting make-vs-buy decisions, managing external manufacturing partners, and evaluating outsourcing opportunities.
* M&A Integration & Separation: Ability to lead manufacturing-focused due diligence, synergy assessment, and post-merger integration initiatives.
* Network Optimization: Experience in footprint rationalization, multi-site manufacturing optimization, or supply chain network redesign projects. Experience with network design tools such as Riverlogic, Lamasoft would be preferred
* Project Management: Demonstrated ability to scope, plan, and lead complex multi-workstream transformation initiatives, with strong stakeholder management.

**Skills Preferred**

* Strong problem-solving capabilities with the ability to structure ambiguous problems.
* Analytical skills to interpret operational data and convert it into business insights.
* Executive-level communication and presentation skills for CXO / VP-level interactions
* Ability to lead and mentor teams, providing guidance, feedback, and skill development.
* Demonstrated experience delivering high-quality work and managing cross-functional project teams.
* Strong collaboration skills with the ability to build trusted relationships with clients, internal teams, and leadership.

What You Must Have
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, or related fields from Tier-1 institutes.
* MBA in Operations (Preferred)
* 5+ years of relevant experience in manufacturing strategy, operational excellence, digital manufacturing, or related consulting/industry roles.
* Prior experience managing teams, owning client relationships, and delivering large-scale transformation projects.

What Sets You Apart
  
  

* Demonstrating proficiency in Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma methodologies
* Utilizing advanced skills in Manufacturing Strategy and Operations Management
* Excelling in project management for end-to-end implementations
* Engaging in network optimization and supply chain management projects
* Applying analytical thinking to manufacturing cost analysis and feasibility studies
* Embracing emerging technologies and digital manufacturing solutions
* Developing go-to-market strategies and product roadmaps for manufacturing clients

title: Senior Manager - Design Assurance & Product Management
description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
  
  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.
  
  
**Domain focus: Design Assurance practice delivery across all Cyber Architecture and Solutions security domains.**
**Job Purpose:**
The delivery management layer in the Design Assurance practice, between the Principals and the analysts. You own review scheduling and reviewer allocation against demand, track findings to closure across the practice, and manage the assurance throughput and turnaround metrics the function is judged on. You carry a review caseload alongside the management load.
  
  
**About the team:**
Design Assurance and Product Management makes sure security is designed in before anything is built, and that GSK's security capabilities are run as products rather than projects. Design Assurance independently verifies that solutions meet the architecture standards set elsewhere in Cyber Architecture and Solutions; it writes none of those standards, and that separation is what makes the review worth anything. Product Management owns the security portfolio, vendor governance and investment analytics, and is how GSK manages its managed service vendor as a whole. Platform support engineering moves into this function, with a small internal team retaining oversight while the vendor operates more than 30 platforms and the data fabric under an OTO model. Seventeen roles.
  
  
**What makes this role different. The delivery management layer between the Principals and the analysts in a practice judged on throughput and turnaround, not just rigour. You own review scheduling and reviewer allocation against incoming demand, drive findings to closure across every domain, and run the governance reporting and audit evidence packs. Workflow automation in ServiceNow is how the practice scales, and improving it is part of the role. You carry a review caseload alongside the management load, so this is not a pure coordination job.**
**Key responsibilities:**
This role will provide you the opportunity to lead key activities to progress your career. These responsibilities include some of the following:
  
  

* Manage the demand pipeline across two Principals and the domain analysts, and decide what gets expedited — including telling a programme director that their review will not be.
* Manage assurance throughput, turnaround and SLA metrics the function is judged on, and escalate capacity pressure before turnaround slips quietly.
* Drive findings and time-bound conditions to closure across all domains, chasing the ones that stall and escalating aged items by name.
* Develop the analyst team's domain depth and progression, in a practice where most reviewers arrive strong in one domain and need two.
* Own the quality of what the practice produces — review rigour, finding clarity and closure discipline — and correct it at the individual level when it drops.
* Carry a review caseload alongside the management load, so technical credibility with the Principals is maintained.
* Manage the analyst team's day-to-day workload, quality and development across their domain specialisms.
* Carry roughly a third of a reviewer caseload yourself on Tier 2 designs, so allocation decisions are informed by current technical judgement rather than administration.
* Verify against standards the practice does not write, and protect that separation in how work is allocated.
* Spot capacity pressure in the pipeline two sprints out and escalate it, rather than letting turnaround slip quietly and explaining it afterwards.
* Use approved AI tools in your day-to-day work to improve your own productivity and your team's ways of working, sharing what works and applying sound judgement, including validating outputs and following GSK's Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* 10+ years in cyber security or technology assurance, including team management — domain focus: Design Assurance practice delivery across all Cyber Architecture and Solutions security domains
* Managing delivery across Principals and analysts — review scheduling and reviewer allocation against demand, using workflow automation
* Tracking findings to closure with throughput and turnaround metrics, and running practice governance reporting and audit evidence packs
* Carrying a review caseload alongside people management, coordinating with architecture, engineering and vendor delivery teams
* Managing AI and agentic tool reviews within the practice, and using AI to improve review throughput and evidence qualityManaging AI and agentic tool reviews within the practice, and setting the evidence standard those reviews must meet.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Managing and developing a team of senior reviewers and analysts
* ServiceNow or equivalent GRC and workflow tooling, including automation and dashboards
* Enough architecture depth to personally carry a Tier 2 review of a SIEM integration or a cloud landing-zone design, so reviewer allocation is informed rather than administrative.
* Regulated industry experience, including GxP and audit evidence standards
* Protecting senior review capacity by absorbing day-to-day allocation and demand management into the delivery layer.
* Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Typical tools and technologies: Review scheduling and reviewer allocation, workflow automation in ServiceNow, SLA, throughput and turnaround metrics, findings tracking to closure, governance reporting and audit evidence packs, Power BI.

**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. title: Manager Logistics
description:
****Career Area:****
Supply Chain and Logistics
  
  
****Job Description:****
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
  
  
****Job Summary****
Develops, oversees, and strives to maximize the efficiency of the targeted logistics, distribution and production replenishment networks necessary to provide end-to-end supply chains, typically for 1 location.
  
  
****What You Will Do:****

* Designing and optimizing logistics plans and targeted processes to meet production demands and ensure customer satisfaction.
* Managing a team of staff to evaluate and implement logistics programs and activities in compliance with related regulations for an organization.
* Developing mechanisms and metrics to monitor and forecast costs, savings and performance for targeted transportation modes.

****Additional Information****

* Bachelors Degree in Engineering / Science / commerce or equivalent
* Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in logistics functions with atleast 3 years in leadership roles.

****What You Have:****
Continuous Transformation: Knowledge of evolving the business to remain competitive; ability to understand, adapt oneself to, respond to and proactively seek changes and innovation in the business environment to improve the competitive advantage of an organization.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Implements new systems, procedures and tools efficiently when changes occur in the work environment.
* Adjusts current working processes or adopts new approaches in response to changes in the business environment.
* Seeks challenging opportunities or assignments to grow and develop one's own knowledge, skills and abilities.
* Explains lessons or experiences learned from mistakes and failures as well as successes.
* Communicates and analyzes assumptions about a particular issue with colleagues to gain new perspectives or more effective solutions.

Data Gathering & Analysis: Knowledge of data gathering and analysis tools, techniques, and processes; ability to collect and synthesize data from a variety of stakeholders and sources in an objective manner to reach a conclusion, goal, or judgment.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Participates in gathering and analyzing an organization's data based on requirements.
* Follows proper data gathering and analysis processes and policies.
* Utilizes basic data collection and evaluation tools and techniques.
* Reports problems that arise in the data collection process.
* Documents data from various sources and in various formats.

Decision Making and Critical Thinking: Knowledge of the decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Applies an assigned technique for critical thinking in a decision-making process.
* Identifies, obtains, and organizes relevant data and ideas.
* Participates in documenting data, ideas, players, stakeholders, and processes.
* Recognizes, clarifies, and prioritizes concerns.
* Assists in assessing risks, benefits and consideration of alternatives.

Logistics Operations Management: Knowledge of logistics node management; ability to operate a warehouse or distribution center that handles the flow of goods from supplier to production to customer.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Helps minimize bottlenecks and delays and the resulting impact on operating costs.
* Uses real-time inventory software, with guidance, to move supplies where needed, when needed.
* Maintains item and inventory management records.
* Assists in resolving issues related to physical space management.
* Works with Distribution Requirements Planning (DRP) processes and operations.

Logistics Management: Knowledge of logistics and management; ability to follow proper processes and run operations for effective and efficient movement of materials and finished products.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Assists in the development of process flows to track lead time by activity.
* Uses tools, with guidance, to forecast delivery times, determine costs and assess performance.
* Maintains records of all shipments and invoices using an established system.
* Participates in integrating logistics processes and developing effective networks.
* Works with logistics in a domestic environment.

Planning and Organizing: Knowledge of the process of planning and arranging tasks and resources; ability to plan and organize both time and resources to get things completed while structuring and maintaining work in a systematic and highly methodical way.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Raises awareness of potential bottlenecks and disruptions to the schedule.
* Breaks tasks into manageable steps that can be incorporated into a personal work plan.
* Escalates concerns over competing or conflicting priorities.
* Monitors progress continuously and adjusts tactics for handling situations on a case by case basis.
* Creates action plans that ensure the accomplishment of responsibilities.

Project Management: Knowledge of effective project management strategies and tactics; ability to plan, organize, monitor, and control projects, ensuring efficient utilization of technical and administrative resources to achieve project objectives.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Provides input for Gantt or PERT charts or their equivalent to track project progress and status.
* Under guidance, plans and estimates simple projects.
* Assists in detailed project plans including cost, schedule, and resource requirements.
* Obtains information from stakeholders during the planning stage of a project.
* Produces standard project status reports.

Supply Chain Management - MFG: Knowledge of functions, principles and techniques used in supply chain management; ability to develop and use, strategies, practices and tools for controlling the logistical processes.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Discusses considerations for integrating partner and supplier transactions.
* Recognizes software systems or components used to manage supply chain.
* Summarizes supply chain considerations for different types of products or components.
* Participates in supply chain analysis and uses it to spot trends and improvement opportunities.
* Works with a specific part of supply chain management process.

title: VP - IAM Operations & User Experience
description:
**Role Title:**
**VP - IAM Operations & User Experience**
**(L12)**
**Company Overview**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
  
  
**Organizational Overview**
The Identity and Access Management (IAM) team at Synchrony, led by the Head of IAM reporting to the CISO, oversees key security functions. Direct reports specialize in authentication, authorization, privileged access management, special programs, and federated controls governance. This structure ensures comprehensive management of identity and access processes to maintain robust security and compliance across the organization.
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
This is a people manager role responsible for leading enterprise IAM Security Administration, End User Operations, across people, technology, controls, and transformation. The VP will combine IAM expertise with practical AI and automation engineering capability to drive reliable identity lifecycle and privileged access operations, simplify access requests and fulfilment, and reduce repetitive manual work. The role will define automation strategy and requirements, partner with Automation and Engineering teams to deliver scalable solutions and safely operationalize Agentic AI and Generative AI with appropriate human oversight and security controls
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Lead the enterprise IAM Security Administration and Automation functions, including people, operations, technology, controls, and transformation.
  
  

* Drive automation and access-experience transformation: Own the strategy to automate the majority of repetitive Security Administration activities using Agentic AI, Generative AI, RPA, Python, PowerShell, APIs, and self-service. Prioritize opportunities, modernize IAM access requests and fulfilment, and define requirements, business outcomes, and control objectives with Automation and Engineering teams. Drive automation of ServiceNow request, incident, change, and problem-management activities.
* Improve operations through data, AI, and user insight: Analyse IAM operational data, incidents, logs, knowledge articles, historical resolutions, and recurring issues to identify sustainable improvements. Use Generative AI, Splunk, and IAM telemetry to accelerate troubleshooting and root-cause analysis and establish AI-assisted monitoring and predictive capabilities. Gather end-user feedback to reduce friction, manual effort, and unnecessary process complexity.
* Establish governance and measurable outcomes: Maintain human-in-the-loop oversight, approvals, auditability, security, and segregation-of-duties controls for AI-driven operations. Set and track targets for automation coverage, manual effort reduction, provisioning success, recurring failure reduction, SLA adherence, incident resolution, first-time-right execution, operational reliability, and security-control effectiveness, with no compromise to governance or compliance.
* Identify and prioritize automation opportunities that enhance the user experience and collaborate with the automation team to implement them.
* Build talent and lead cross-functional transformation: Lead, coach, and develop Security Administration and Operations teams, strengthening IAM, AI, Python, PowerShell, and RPA capabilities. Identify high-potential talent, establish succession plans and technical SME ownership, and promote automation-first thinking, engineering discipline, continuous improvement, and accountability. Partner with technology, Automation, control, business, and end-user communities to deliver measurable improvements in cost, quality, speed, and risk reduction.

**Required Skills/Knowledge**

* Strong experience in IAM/IGA, identity lifecycle management, and Security Administration across SailPoint, NHID, Okta, Beyond Identity, Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, and Delinea/PAM, including provisioning, reconciliation, access governance, and privileged access operations.
* Ability to identify, assess, and prioritize IAM automation opportunities based on business value, operational efficiency, risk reduction, and end-user experience. Working knowledge of Python, PowerShell, REST APIs, Automation Anywhere/RPA, Agentic AI, Generative AI, and LLM-based capabilities to evaluate potential use cases and collaborate effectively with automation teams.
* Experience translating IAM operational needs into clear business requirements, process flows, control requirements, and acceptance criteria for automation teams, including integration needs across IAM platforms, ServiceNow, and Splunk. Strong understanding of approval workflows, audit requirements, segregation-of-duties controls, and the safe use of AI.
* Demonstrated people leadership and IAM transformation capability, including team development, succession planning, operational ownership, and cross-functional collaboration. Ability to partner with automation teams through feasibility assessment, prioritization, user acceptance testing, adoption, and benefits realization.

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**

* Experience developing and prioritizing an IAM automation roadmap, identifying opportunities for reusable solutions across processes, and partnering with automation teams to assess feasibility, dependencies, and expected benefits.
* Ability to identify use cases for AI-assisted monitoring, predictive insights, knowledge assistance, and intelligent troubleshooting to address recurring IAM failures and operational risks.
* Experience driving the adoption of automation and self-service across IAM, Active Directory, PAM, ServiceNow, and routine administrative processes, with measurable improvements in cost, quality, speed, risk reduction, and end-user experience.

**Eligibility Criteria**
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field; Master’s degree preferred with 9+years of IT experience with a minimum of 6 years focused on IAM operations and end-user services management.
  
  
**Work Timings: 2:00 PM - 11:00 PM IST**
(This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility and Choice offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs. Please discuss this with the hiring manager for more details.)

title: Sr Operations & Logistics Manager
description:
**Sr. Business Operations Manager – Rider Experience & Consumer Insights**  
  
**Uber | India & South Asia**  
  
**About the Role**  
  
At Uber, millions of riders trust us to get them where they need to go, every day. But what makes a great ride experience? What frustrates riders, what builds their trust, and what makes them choose Uber again and again?  
  
We are looking for someone who is **obsessed with understanding consumers** — someone who is endlessly curious about what riders think, feel and experience, and passionate about turning those insights into meaningful change.  
  
In this role, you will be the **champion of the rider's voice within Uber**, ensuring that consumer needs, expectations and pain points are at the heart of how we build products, design experiences and make business decisions.  
  
You will shape Uber's Rider Experience strategy across India & South Asia, working closely with Product, Operations, Marketing and Marketplace teams to make Uber the most trusted and preferred mobility platform.  
  
This is a unique opportunity to combine deep consumer understanding with strategic thinking and real business impact — moving beyond understanding what riders want to actually making it happen.  

* **Drive Consumer Insights & Problem Solving:** Bring structure to ambiguous consumer problems, triangulating quantitative data, qualitative research and field insights to uncover root causes, size opportunities and drive actionable recommendations.
* **Reimagine the Rider Experience:** Identify and prioritize friction points across the end-to-end rider journey, with a focus on new rider experience, satisfaction and retention. Partner with cross-functional teams to drive measurable improvements.
* **Build & Scale Rider Value Propositions:** Identify opportunities for differentiated consumer propositions, validate them through research and experimentation, and partner with Product and Marketing to launch and scale impactful solutions.
* **Own Critical Consumer Journeys:** Drive improvements across priority areas including payments, rider communications and engagement programs, balancing consumer experience, business impact and investment efficiency.
* **Champion the Voice of the Rider:** Build a deep understanding of rider needs, frustrations and unmet expectations by combining consumer research, VOC and behavioral data. Translate insights into clear priorities that influence business and product decisions.
* **Embed Consumer Obsession Across Uber:** Bring compelling consumer insights and data-backed recommendations into leadership discussions, challenge assumptions and mobilize teams to act on what matters most to riders.

  
**What You'll Need**  

* **5+ years of experience** in consumer insights, customer experience, consumer strategy, product, growth or related fields.
* **Consumer obsession:** Deep curiosity about human behavior, strong empathy and a natural instinct to uncover what consumers really need.
* **Analytical rigor & structured problem solving:** Ability to bring clarity to ambiguous problems, synthesize complex datasets and marry quantitative evidence with qualitative insights.
* **Insight-to-action orientation:** Proven ability to translate consumer understanding into sharp strategic recommendations, prioritized initiatives and measurable business outcomes.
* **Strong ownership & execution:** Comfortable navigating ambiguity, driving cross-functional initiatives and moving from problem identification to implementation.
* **Storytelling & influence:** Ability to simplify complex insights, build compelling narratives and influence senior stakeholders to champion the consumer perspective.

  
**Ready to Ride?**  
  
This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.  
  
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.  
  
Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.  
  
Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.

title: Head of Operations (Lounges)
description:
**About Revolut**

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 15,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

**About the role**

At Revolut, Operations means problem-solving at scale. Our team tackles the company’s toughest challenges with speed, precision, and creativity. They design systems that unlock efficiency and power global growth.

We're looking for a Head of Operations to build and scale Revolut's global airport lounge network, from launching our first locations to managing a portfolio of lounges.

You'll own end-to-end lounge operations, ensuring each location delivers an exceptional customer experience while maximising commercial performance and operational efficiency.

We're looking for an entrepreneurial leader with expertise in airport lounges and building scalable operations across markets.

Up to shape what’s next in finance? Let’s get in touch.

**What you'll be doing**

* Leading end-to-end operational readiness and launch of new airport lounges globally, coordinating with airport partners, operators, construction, design, and internal teams
* Owning day-to-day operational performance across the lounge network, ensuring consistently high standards of service quality, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency
* Maximising lounge profitability by driving revenue growth, optimising capacity utilisation, developing ancillary revenue opportunities, and managing operating costs
* Selecting, onboarding, and managing third-party lounge operators, establishing strict SLAs, performance targets, and governance mechanisms
* Defining and continuously improving premium hospitality standards across F&B, staffing, facilities, and customer experience
* Building scalable operating models, processes, reporting, and governance to support rapid expansion across multiple countries
* Ensuring compliance with relevant airport, safety, security, and local regulatory requirements
* Hiring, developing, and leading a high-performing operations team to support the growth of our global lounge network

**What you'll need**

* Extensive experience in airport lounge operations, including successfully opening and operating lounges, ideally across multiple countries
* Experience managing multi-site airport lounge or premium hospitality operations, with direct accountability for operational performance and customer experience
* Commercial and financial acumen, paired with experience managing P&Ls, improving profitability, optimising capacity utilisation, and driving revenue growth
* An in-depth understanding of airport lounge operating models, including third-party operators, SLAs, airport requirements, hospitality standards, and F&B operations
* A track record of building operational processes, infrastructure, and teams from scratch and scaling them across multiple locations
* Solid stakeholder management skills, with experience working with airport authorities, operators, suppliers, and cross-functional teams
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, and the ability to use data to drive operational improvements and ROI-based prioritisation
* An entrepreneurial mindset, capable of operating independently, and a willingness to be hands-on in a fast-paced, high-growth environment

*Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.*

***Important notice for candidates:***

*Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.*

* ***Only apply through official Revolut channels.*** *We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.*
* ***Always double-check the emails you receive.*** *Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.*

***We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process.*** *If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.*
