title: Manager III, Support Engineer, Amazon Pharmacy Operations
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

We are looking for a founding leader to build Amazon Pharmacy’s Support Engineering team in Bengaluru from scratch. You will hire the first engineers, design how the team operates, and decide what gets automated first. There is no inherited playbook and no legacy to work around, so the choices you make will set how Pharmacy fulfillment is supported worldwide.  
Amazon Pharmacy delivers prescriptions safely, accurately, and fast. The business is defined by four things: cost, speed, scale, and patient safety. Our fulfillment network spans central and regional fill, small-format sites, kiosks, and growing automation, and every order is a patient’s prescription.  
Your team will be the first line of technical support for that network, 24x7 across multiple shifts. It triages fulfillment issues, manages robotics and automation hardware problems with vendors, and routes genuine defects to the right engineering team. The mandate goes beyond keeping the lights on. By studying recurring issues and floor-level friction, your team finds the opportunities that move operational metrics: faster order flow, higher throughput and lower cost per unit on the floor, and fewer escalations, with no compromise on patient safety. Every repeat issue you automate away returns capacity to the network. You will partner with Operations and engineering leaders across Pharmacy, and the results will show up in the numbers the business cares about most.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Build, hire, and lead a team of Support Engineers in Bengaluru, owning 24x7 multi-shift coverage for global Pharmacy fulfillment, including rosters, shift handoffs, and on-call rotations.
* Own triage and resolution of fulfillment issues across SIM and Trouble Ticket queues. Set severity criteria, escalation paths, and SLAs, and report on SLA adherence, MTTR, backlog, and repeat-ticket rate.
* Manage robotics and automation hardware incidents with third-party vendors: run escalations, track vendor SLAs and action items, and hold vendors accountable for fixes and preventive maintenance.
* Resolve network issues that affect fulfillment, mainly routing orders to the right fulfillment center and handling inventory out-of-stock scenarios, in partnership with network and inventory teams.
* Route genuine defects to the right engineering team with reproduction steps, impact, and root-cause data, and follow through until the fix lands.
* Drive high-severity incident response and Correction of Error (COE) reviews with clear, owned action items.
* Move the operational metrics. Analyze ticket and floor data to find opportunities that improve site efficiency, throughput, and speed, and deliver them with Operations and engineering partners.
* Own the automation roadmap. Turn recurring issues and manual runbooks into scripts, automated remediation, and self-healing workflows, and automate site launch readiness and configuration checks.
* Build monitoring, dashboards, and alarms that detect issues before sites or patients feel them.
* Uphold patient safety and regulatory requirements, including HIPAA, in daily operations. No workaround may compromise dispensing accuracy.
* Coach and grow engineers, and raise the hiring bar.

  
About the team  
Our team is dedicated to ensuring Amazon Pharmacy's operations is scaled and efficient for customers worldwide. We operate at the intersection of engineering and operations, building scalable support mechanisms and driving continuous improvement. We value collaboration, clear communication, and a genuine commitment to each other's growth. As we look ahead, we are investing in automation, smarter tooling, and new approaches to incident management. This is an opportunity to shape the direction of a team that directly impacts healthcare for millions of customers at Amazon.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a related technical discipline
* · 3+ years of experience managing technical support, support engineering, or operations engineering teams
* · 5+ years of experience in technical support, production support, or operations engineering roles
* · Experience running 24x7 or multi-shift operations, including rosters, on-call rotations, and escalation processes
* · Experience using operational metrics (SLA adherence, MTTR, ticket volume and aging) to drive team performance
* · Experience leading incident management and root cause analysis for high-severity issues
* · Experience working with engineering teams and external vendors to resolve technical issues
* · Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience managing engineering teams in an operations environment
* · Experience with scripting and automation in Python, SQL, or Bash, and leading teams that automate manual operational work
* · Experience with AWS services for monitoring, alarming, and automation
* · Experience with IT service management tooling and ticketing workflows, such as SIM, Trouble Ticketing, ServiceNow, or Jira

title: Sales Operations Manager
description:
**Description**

At CDW, we make it happen, together. Trust, connection, and commitment are at the heart of how we work together to deliver for our customers. It’s why we’re coworkers, not just employees. Coworkers who genuinely believe in supporting our customers and one another. We collectively forge our path forward with a level of commitment that speaks to who we are and where we’re headed. title: Lead Analyst - Design Assurance & Product Management - Operations
description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Domain focus: Design Assurance Operations (intake, scheduling, tooling and committee).**

**Job Purpose:**

Run Design Assurance programme coordination and governance: the operational backbone that keeps the practice running. You manage all incoming review requests, check scope, confirm the right architecture specification is available, and allocate to the correct domain analyst. You maintain the review calendar and the governance reporting.

**About the team**:

Design Assurance and Product Management makes sure security is designed in before anything is built, and that GSK's security capabilities are run as products rather than projects. Design Assurance independently verifies that solutions meet the architecture standards set elsewhere in Cyber Architecture and Solutions; it writes none of those standards, and that separation is what makes the review worth anything. Product Management owns the security portfolio, vendor governance and investment analytics, and is how GSK manages its managed service vendor as a whole. Platform support engineering moves into this function, with a small internal team retaining oversight while the vendor operates more than 30 platforms and the data fabric under an OTO model. Seventeen roles.

**What makes this role different. The operational backbone of the Design Assurance practice rather than a reviewer role. You own the ServiceNow intake workflow, the review calendar and the DA tooling and templates, and you will be the person who notices that a review request arrived without the architecture specification attached and stops it before it wastes a reviewer's week. Expect to produce audit evidence packs and committee material under GxP record-keeping standards, where a missing date or an unsigned approval is itself the finding.**

**Key responsibilities:**

This role will provide you the opportunity to lead key activities to progress your career. These responsibilities include some of the following:

  

* Run Design Assurance intake in ServiceNow: log every review request, scope-check it, and route it to the right domain reviewer across Network and Zero Trust, Platform Security and MDR, Application Security, Data Security and Cloud, OT Security and Vulnerability and Configuration Management, and Cryptography, PQC and AI Security.
* Confirm the architecture specification exists and is current before a review starts, and reject requests that arrive without one rather than letting a reviewer discover it mid-week.
* Maintain the review calendar and reviewer allocation against capacity, and publish turnaround commitments to requesting programmes.
* Administer and version-control the Design Assurance template and tooling set, publishing approved updates and withdrawing superseded versions so no reviewer works from a stale template.
* Produce practice reporting in Power BI: throughput, first-time-pass rate, turnaround against SLA, coverage by domain and bypass rate.
* Prepare governance forum packs and the supporting evidence trail, to GxP record-keeping standards where a missing approval or date is itself the finding.
* Track findings and time-bound conditions to closure across the practice, chase the ones that stall, and escalate aged items by name.
* Own the assurance register as the single record of what has been reviewed, by whom and with what outcome, so coverage can be evidenced on demand for internal audit and regulatory inspection without reconstruction.
* Assemble audit and regulatory evidence requests, including the decision trail showing a review actually operated rather than merely existed.
* Improve the intake and coordination process and automate the manual steps, rather than only operating them.
* Use approved AI tools in your day-to-day work to improve your own productivity and your team's ways of working, sharing what works and applying sound judgement, including validating outputs and following GSK's Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements.

**Basic Qualifications:**

  

* 10+ years in cyber security, technology governance or programme coordination — domain focus: Design Assurance Operations (intake, scheduling, tooling and committee)
* Running DA intake and triage — scope check, specification check and allocation to the right domain analyst — and managing the review calendar so no request is lost or delayed
* Owning DA tooling and templates — GRC system, SharePoint and review packs — with automated intake, reminders and reporting
* Administering the Design Assurance Committee — agenda, minutes and actions — and maintaining the DA knowledge base and requestor onboarding
* Using AI and automation to streamline DA intake, triage and reporting, and routing AI tool reviews to the right specialistRunning DA intake, triage and reporting, including the automation that supports it, and routing AI tool reviews to the right specialist

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* GRC tooling such as ServiceNow, and SharePoint or equivalent repository management
* Power BI or equivalent for DA performance and governance reporting
* Workflow automation or low-code tooling for intake and reminders
* Exposure to security architecture and GxP-compliant documentation practice

* Operating a controlled records environment where retention, version history and approval trails survive an inspection without reconstruction.
* Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Typical tools and technologies: Intake and triage workflow in ServiceNow, review calendar and reviewer allocation, design assurance templates and tooling administration, committee and governance pack preparation, Power BI for throughput and SLA reporting, GxP-compliant records management.

**Skills**

AI for Cybersecurity, Application Security, Cloud Security, Computer Programming, Data Security, Design Assurance, Identity Access Management (IAM), Information Systems, Infrastructure Security, IT Governance, Microsoft Power BI, ML Security, Operating Systems Security, Product Management, Scripting, Security Engineering, Security Technologies, Security Testing, Vulnerability Management, Zero Trust

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

title: Mgr, Quality/Training Strategy, GO-AI Operations Integration
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

The Manager, Quality & Training Strategy owns how GO-AI defines, measures, and improves the quality of annotations delivered to Amazon Robotics and Worldwide Operations science teams. You will own the quality model for an AI and ML annotation workforce: how accuracy is measured, how measurement scales across use cases and demand, and how quality standards reflect the customer's perception of the output they receive. You operate as the independent measurement function for the annotation business, providing defect insights to Operations while representing the customer's view of quality.  
  
As GO-AI evolves, this role ensures that quality measurement keeps pace with how annotations are consumed by data scientists inside an ML product development lifecycle, and increasingly alongside model-generated output. You lead a team of program managers and quality managers across India and Costa Rica, and you apply an up-to-date understanding of AI capabilities to identify and drive use cases that improve operational metrics.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Own the GO-AI quality model. Define how annotation accuracy is measured for each use case so that published metrics reflect the customer's perceived quality of the output.

  

* Own quality KPI definition and governance across 70+ use cases, including target baselining, process capability assessment, and the standards applied to new and ramping workforces.

  

* Define the quality measurement strategy, including how coverage and depth of measurement scale with demand, risk, and cost of quality.

  

* Lead deep dives on any degradation of customer-consumed quality metrics, drive to root cause through standardized mechanisms, and publish findings and corrective actions to senior leadership through weekly and monthly business reviews.

  

* Operate as the independent measurement function for the annotation business. Partner with Customer Tech Programs on customer quality and speed expectations, and with Operations business unit leaders on defect insights and remediation.

  

* Translate ML customer needs into quality standards. Understand how annotations feed model training and evaluation so that quality definitions match how data scientists consume the output.

  

* Maintain a current understanding of AI capabilities and how they function. Identify and drive use cases where AI tooling improves quality, speed, and experience.

  

* Lead and develop a geographically distributed team of 6 to 8 program managers and quality managers across India and Costa Rica. Own hiring, onboarding, performance management, career growth, and team structure.

  
About the team  
GO-AI is a technology enablement organization that accelerates the development and enhances the performance of AI-based robotic and automation solutions for Amazon Robotics (AR) and key Worldwide Operations programs. We combine human expertise with machine learning to produce high-quality training data, validate model outputs, and continuously improve AI system performance across many annotation programs and a large global workforce.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of team management experience
* 5+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
* Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
* Experience managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership
* Experience with tools/systems to analyze data including Excel, Access, SQL or other data management systems
* Experience managing programs across multiple geographies and cultures

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in AI/ML operations, data annotation, or ML data quality.
* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or equivalent process improvement certification
* Experience designing measurement or audit frameworks at scale
* Experience applying GenAI or LLM-based tools to improve operational metrics
* Experience operating as an independent quality assurance function alongside an operations organization

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Production Manager
description:
**Production Manager:**

Company: Zlaata India

Department: Production

Industry: Fashion

Job Location: Chennai, India

Reports To: Head of Brand / Brand Manager

Employment Type: Full-Time

**About the Role:**

We are looking for an experienced Production Manager to oversee the end-to-end garment production process and ensure that products are manufactured according to approved quality standards, production plans, specifications, cost targets, and delivery timelines. The role will be responsible for planning and monitoring production activities, coordinating with internal teams and external vendors, managing production capacity and manpower, resolving production challenges, and ensuring the timely availability of finished garments for the retail business. The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of garment manufacturing, production planning, apparel construction, quality control, vendor management, and team management.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Production Planning & Management**

● Plan and manage daily, weekly, and monthly garment production requirements based on business and delivery requirements.

● Prepare production schedules and ensure timely execution of production plans.

● Monitor production progress against planned quantities and timelines.

● Allocate production activities based on capacity, manpower, machinery, and vendor availability.

● Ensure production targets are achieved without compromising quality.

● Identify production bottlenecks and take timely corrective action.

● Ensure smooth flow of garments from sampling to bulk production and final dispatch.

**2. Garment Production & Process Monitoring**

● Oversee the complete garment manufacturing process, including:

○ Fabric receipt and inspection

○ Cutting

○ Stitching

○ Embroidery/printing, where applicable

○ Finishing

○ Pressing

○ Quality inspection

○ Packing

○ Dispatch

● Monitor production at each stage to ensure adherence to approved specifications.

● Ensure production is carried out according to approved samples, size charts, tech packs, and production requirements.

● Monitor production efficiency and identify opportunities to improve processes.

● Ensure proper coordination between different production stages to avoid delays.

**3. Production Target & Delivery Management**

● Take ownership of production targets and delivery commitments.

● Track daily production output against planned quantities.

● Identify delays at an early stage and develop recovery plans.

● Coordinate with relevant teams to ensure production deadlines are met.

● Maintain production timelines for new collections, repeat orders, seasonal products, and retail requirements.

● Escalate critical production delays to management with a clear action plan.

**4. Manpower & Team Management**

● Manage and supervise production teams, supervisors, operators, workers, and support staff.

● Allocate manpower according to production requirements and workload.

● Monitor employee productivity and production efficiency.

● Identify manpower shortages and coordinate for timely deployment of additional resources.

● Conduct regular reviews with production supervisors and team members.

● Train and guide team members on production processes, productivity, safety, and quality expectations.

● Build a performance-driven and accountable production team.

**5. Production Quality Coordination**

● Work closely with the QA/QC team to ensure production meets approved quality standards.

● Ensure quality issues identified during production are addressed immediately.

● Coordinate with QA/QC teams on inline, midline, and final inspections.

● Monitor recurring production defects and take preventive measures.

● Ensure rework and rejection levels are minimized.

● Implement corrective actions related to production processes.

● Ensure production teams follow approved quality standards and specifications.

**6. Fabric, Trims & Material Coordination**

● Coordinate with Stores, Sourcing, Merchandising, and Procurement teams regarding the availability of fabrics, trims, labels, accessories, and other production materials.

● Ensure required materials are available before production starts.

● Monitor material consumption and minimize wastage.

● Identify material shortages or quality issues that may affect production timelines.

● Coordinate with relevant teams to resolve material-related production delays.

● Ensure proper handling and storage of production materials.

**7. Vendor & Supplier Management**

● Manage and coordinate with external garment manufacturers and production vendors.

● Allocate production orders based on vendor capacity, capability, quality, and delivery performance.

● Communicate production specifications, quantities, quality expectations, and delivery timelines to vendors.

● Monitor vendor production progress regularly.

● Conduct vendor performance reviews based on quality, delivery, capacity, productivity, and responsiveness.

● Identify underperforming vendors and implement improvement plans.

● Develop and maintain strong working relationships with key production partners.

**8. Production Cost & Efficiency**

● Monitor production costs and ensure manufacturing activities remain within approved budgets.

● Identify opportunities to reduce production costs without compromising product quality.

● Monitor fabric and material wastage.

● Improve manpower utilization and production efficiency.

● Analyse production productivity and identify areas for cost and time optimization.

● Support management in evaluating production capacity, vendor costing, and manufacturing feasibility.

**9. Production Reporting & Documentation**

● Maintain accurate production records and documentation.

**● Prepare and monitor:**

○ Daily production reports

○ Production planning sheets

○ Production achievement reports

○ Pending production reports

○ Vendor production reports

○ Manpower productivity reports

○ Rework and rejection reports

○ Material consumption reports

○ Production delay reports

● Provide regular production updates to management.

● Highlight production risks, delays, capacity constraints, and quality concerns.

● Maintain production MIS and performance dashboards where required.

**10. Cross-Functional Coordination**

● Coordinate closely with Design, Merchandising, Sourcing, QA/QC, Warehouse, Procurement, Finance, and Management.

● Work with Merchandising teams to understand order requirements and delivery timelines.

● Coordinate with Design and Technical teams regarding construction and production feasibility.

● Work with QA/QC teams to resolve quality concerns.

● Coordinate with Warehouse and Logistics teams to ensure timely movement and dispatch of finished goods.

● Ensure clear communication between all teams involved in the production cycle.

**11. Production Process Improvement**

● Identify production inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and recurring operational issues.

● Develop and implement process improvement initiatives.

● Improve production planning, workflow, manpower utilization, and productivity.

● Introduce systems and processes to improve production tracking and visibility.

● Reduce production lead time, rework, wastage, and delays.

● Continuously improve production processes in line with business growth and retail requirements.

**12. Compliance, Safety & Workplace Standards**

● Ensure production activities are carried out in accordance with company policies and workplace safety standards.

● Ensure production teams follow appropriate safety procedures.

● Monitor housekeeping and workplace discipline within production areas.

● Ensure machinery and equipment are used appropriately and safely.

● Escalate any major safety, compliance, or operational risks to management immediately.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

The performance of the Production Manager will be measured through:

● Achievement of planned production targets

● On-time production and delivery percentage

● Production efficiency and productivity

● Reduction in production delays and bottlenecks

● Reduction in rework and rejection percentage

● Reduction in material and fabric wastage

● Production cost adherence

● Manpower productivity and utilization

● Vendor production performance

● Quality compliance across production stages

● Effective resolution of production issues

● Accuracy and timeliness of production reports

● Reduction in production lead time

● Successful implementation of process improvement initiatives

**Required Qualifications**

● Bachelor's degree / Diploma in Apparel, Garment Technology, Textile Technology, Fashion Technology, Production Management, or a related field.

● 6–10 years of experience in garment production, apparel manufacturing, fashion, or retail production.

● Strong hands-on experience in garment manufacturing and production management.

● Good knowledge of garment construction and production processes.

● Experience managing production teams and external manufacturing vendors.

● Strong knowledge of production planning and capacity management.

● Experience in handling bulk garment production from sampling to final dispatch.

● Strong understanding of garment quality requirements.

● Good knowledge of production costing, material utilization, and wastage control.

● Strong reporting and analytical skills.

● Good knowledge of MS Excel and production tracking systems.

**Preferred Skills**

● Garment production planning

● Apparel manufacturing

● Production scheduling

● Capacity planning

● Vendor management

● Manpower management

● Garment construction

● Fabric and trims knowledge

● Production quality management

● Cost and wastage control

● Production MIS and reporting

● Root Cause Analysis

● Process improvement

● Team leadership

● Cross-functional coordination

● Strong negotiation and communication skills Ideal Candidate Profile.

title: Operations Supervisor
description:
**Company Description**
Nizhal PG for Men provides premium, comfortable, and hassle-free accommodation for working professionals and students in Pallikaranai and Guindy, Chennai. The property offers homely meals, modern amenities, and a safe, well-maintained living environment. Residents benefit from a welcoming community atmosphere and support for day-to-day needs. Nizhal PG focuses on creating a “home away from home” experience through reliable service and attentive management.
  
**Role Description**
The Operations Supervisor is responsible for overseeing daily PG operations, including room allocations, housekeeping standards, maintenance coordination, and meal service quality. This full-time, on-site role in Chennai involves supervising staff, monitoring occupancy, handling resident queries, and ensuring smooth check-in and check-out procedures. The Operations Supervisor will track inventory, manage vendor relationships, and support budgeting for supplies and services. The role also includes implementing safety and cleanliness protocols, maintaining records, and resolving operational issues promptly to ensure a positive resident experience.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Supervisory Skills to lead staff, manage schedules, and ensure adherence to service standards.
* Candidates should possess Operations and Operations Management skills to coordinate daily activities, optimize processes, and maintain efficient PG operations.
* Candidates should possess Analytical Skills to monitor occupancy, assess costs, interpret operational data, and support decision-making.
* Candidates should possess excellent Communication skills to interact with residents, staff, and vendors, and to address concerns professionally.
* Prior experience in hospitality, facility management, or residential operations supervision is highly beneficial.
* Ability to work on-site, handle multiple priorities, and respond quickly to operational issues.
* Basic proficiency with spreadsheets or property management tools for record-keeping and reporting.
* A diploma or degree in hospitality, business, or a related field is preferred but not mandatory; relevant experience will be considered.

title: SalesOps - Manager, Functional- Customer
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Customer**
The Customer Team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, GenAI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We enable Deloitte client service teams to enhance customer experience and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital product and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects, balancing business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to help solve the biggest problems that impact customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce. We also offer Business Process as a Service, enabling organizations to streamline operations and achieve greater efficiency through scalable, technology-enabled managed insights that guide ongoing transformation and operational excellence.
  
  
**Position Summary**
Level: Manager or equivalent
  
  
We are seeking a Sales Operations Technologist Manager to lead the design and implementation of scalable Sales Operations solutions across CRM, CPQ, ERP, data, analytics, and AI platforms. This role combines deep Sales Operations domain expertise with solution architecture, systems integration, automation, delivery leadership, and practical application of Agentic AI.
  
  
The successful candidate will help life sciences organizations improve commercial effectiveness across pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, diagnostics, and healthcare businesses. The Manager will lead client engagements, shape solution strategies, develop high-performing teams, and contribute to the growth of our Sales Operations and commercial technology capabilities.
  
  
**Work you’ll do:**
As a Manager, you will lead multidisciplinary teams and work directly with client executives, commercial leaders, business stakeholders, IT organizations, data teams, and technology partners to deliver measurable business outcomes. You will be responsible for shaping solutions from strategy and discovery through design, implementation, adoption, and value realization.
  
  
You will lead and oversee work across the following areas:
  
  

* Translate Sales Operations requirements into scalable solutions supporting territory and account alignment, segmentation and targeting, quota and incentive planning, sales forecasting, pipeline and opportunity management, account planning, field productivity, pricing and quoting, approvals, and commercial performance reporting.
* Define enterprise solution architectures and delivery approaches integrating CRM, CPQ, ERP, data, analytics, workflow, and AI platforms.
* Lead implementations and solution delivery across platforms such as Salesforce, Veeva, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle, SAP, and other enterprise applications.
* Establish reusable integration patterns, APIs, data models, workflows, accelerators, and delivery standards that can be deployed across client environments.
* Identify, prioritize, and oversee practical Agentic AI use cases, including sales planning assistants, forecasting and pipeline analysis agents, next-best-action recommendations, account and territory intelligence, automated opportunity and CRM hygiene, quoting and approval support, and sales performance insights.
* Define and oversee human-in-the-loop controls, access controls, auditability, evaluation criteria, monitoring, and escalation paths for AI-enabled solutions.
* Lead discovery workshops, process assessments, design sessions, demonstrations, executive discussions, testing, deployment planning, and adoption activities.
* Build trusted relationships with client executives and key stakeholders, facilitate difficult decisions, manage expectations, and communicate risks, dependencies, and trade-offs clearly.
* Manage delivery quality, scope, schedule, resources, risks, issues, dependencies, and financial performance across workstreams or engagements.
* Coach and develop consultants and senior consultants through structured feedback, hands-on leadership, and opportunities to expand their domain and technology expertise.
* Establish solution roadmaps, implementation plans, operating models, adoption strategies, governance approaches, and measurable value cases.
* Support and lead pre-sales activities, including account planning, proposals, statements of work, solution demonstrations, estimates, client presentations, and pursuit strategy.
* Contribute to market eminence, intellectual capital, reusable assets, accelerators, and offerings that strengthen our Sales Operations and commercial technology portfolio.
* Ensure solutions reflect life sciences-specific requirements related to HCP/HCO data, field force structures, regulatory expectations, data privacy, commercial compliance, and data governance.

**The team:**
Step into our
**Sales & Service**
team, where technology powers business impact and innovation drives everything we do. As a global, dynamic group, we deliver seamless, end-to-end solutions—advising on strategy, implementing advanced CRM or back-office platforms, and enabling continuous business improvement. Here, you’ll collaborate with passionate, creative minds to transform sales models, elevate service excellence, and optimize customer operations. If you’re ready to grow your expertise, make bold ideas real, and help redefine the customer experience for leading organizations, this is your next big move. Join us and shape the future of sales and service!
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* 10+ years of consulting or industry experience, including significant experience leading Sales Operations, Commercial Operations, CRM, CPQ, business transformation, or technology implementation initiatives.
* Experience leading end-to-end client engagements or major workstreams, including delivery planning, team leadership, quality management, risk management, and executive communication.
* Strong understanding of Sales Operations processes and performance drivers, including territory and account alignment, segmentation, targeting, quota and incentive planning, forecasting, pipeline management, account planning, pricing, quoting, approvals, and performance reporting.
* Experience implementing or integrating two or more CRM, CPQ, ERP, data, or analytics platforms.
* Experience with APIs, middleware, data integration, workflow automation, enterprise solution architecture, and delivery governance.
* Practical knowledge of Agentic AI, generative AI, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, tool calling, AI orchestration, or related enterprise AI patterns.
* Ability to convert business requirements into solution strategies, functional designs, technical specifications, implementation plans, roadmaps, and value cases.
* Demonstrated ability to lead workshops, influence senior stakeholders, manage ambiguity, resolve issues, and make sound delivery decisions.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, presentation, relationship management, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience leading, coaching, and developing consulting or technology delivery teams
* Experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, diagnostics, or healthcare commercial operations.
* Knowledge of HCP/HCO master data, customer consent, field force effectiveness, promotional compliance, and commercial data governance.

**Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* Experience with Salesforce, Veeva CRM, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle CPQ, Salesforce Revenue Cloud, SAP CPQ, or similar platforms.
* Experience with cloud platforms, data warehouses, business intelligence tools, and low-code/no-code automation platforms.
* Familiarity with AI governance, model evaluation, prompt engineering, agent monitoring, responsible AI practices, and enterprise controls.
* Consulting, systems integration, product management, enterprise architecture, or operating model design experience.
* Experience developing proposals, estimates, solution demonstrations, reusable assets, or market-facing points of view.
* Relevant Salesforce, Veeva, CPQ, cloud, data, architecture, or AI certifications.

**Success Measures**
Success in this role will be measured by:
  
  

* Delivery of high-quality Sales Operations solutions that achieve agreed client outcomes, timelines, and quality expectations.
* Adoption, usability, and sustained business value of implemented solutions.
* Reduction in manual processes, disconnected workflows, and operational friction.
* Improved CRM, Sales Operations, and commercial data quality.
* Faster planning, forecasting, quoting, approval, and decision-making cycles.
* Reusability and scalability of solution components across platforms, business units, and clients.
* Demonstrated business value from AI-enabled capabilities with appropriate controls and monitoring.
* Effective management of data privacy, compliance, security, delivery, and operational risks.
* Strong client relationships, team engagement, talent development, and contribution to pursuit and practice growth.

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field, or equivalent from accredited university

**Location:**

* Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. title: Project Head
description:
**Key Responsibilities**
Project Planning & Execution
  
  

* Provide overall leadership for the end-to-end execution and delivery of real estate projects.
* Lead project planning, execution strategy, scheduling and resource deployment across multiple developments.
* Establish clear project milestones, deliverables, timelines and accountability mechanisms.
* Ensure projects are executed in accordance with approved plans, budgets, quality standards and business objectives.
* Drive execution of villas, plotted developments and apartment projects from project initiation through completion and handover. Multi-Project Management
* Oversee and manage 3–4 large projects simultaneously, with approximately 3–4 million sq. ft. under active development.
* Establish effective systems for monitoring project progress, identifying deviations and ensuring timely corrective action.
* Balance resources, priorities and execution requirements across multiple project locations. Cost & Commercial Control
* Take ownership of project budgets and ensure execution remains within approved cost parameters.
* Monitor project expenditure, resource utilisation and cost deviations.
* Identify potential cost overruns early and implement corrective measures.
* Work closely with internal teams, contractors, consultants and vendors to ensure commercial discipline.

Site Operations & Resource Management
  
  

* Provide leadership to large site teams and ensure effective deployment of manpower and resources.
* Build and manage strong project execution teams with clear roles, responsibilities and accountability.
* Ensure adequate site infrastructure, manpower, equipment and resources are available.

Contractor, Consultant & Vendor Management
  
  

* Lead sourcing, selection, onboarding and performance management of contractors, consultants and vendors.
* Establish expectations around scope, timelines, quality, safety and deliverables.
* Monitor performance and address execution issues promptly.

Quality, Safety & Compliance
  
  

* Ensure adherence to quality standards, safety requirements and statutory regulations.
* Establish robust systems for quality monitoring and safety compliance.
* Identify compliance and execution risks and ensure timely mitigation.

Project Governance, Risk & Stakeholder Management
  
  

* Establish project governance, MIS, dashboards and progress monitoring systems.
* Track timelines, physical progress, cost, resources, quality, safety, compliance, risks and bottlenecks.
* Develop mitigation and recovery plans and drive timely corrective action.
* Act as key interface with senior leadership, consultants, contractors, vendors and internal stakeholders.

Leadership & Team Development
  
  

* Build and lead high-performing project teams.
* Establish clear performance expectations and accountability.
* Develop project leaders and site teams through coaching, direction and performance management.

IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE
  
  

* 20+ years of experience in real estate project execution, preferably with reputed large developers or large infrastructure companies.
* Proven experience in end-to-end delivery of villas, plotted developments and apartment projects.
* Demonstrated experience managing multiple large-scale projects simultaneously.
* Experience handling 3–4 large projects with approximately 3–4 million sq. ft. under active development.
* Strong expertise in project planning and scheduling, execution, cost control, site operations, progress monitoring, contractor/consultant/vendor management, quality, safety and statutory compliance.
* Strong ability to identify execution risks, remove bottlenecks and drive corrective actions.
* Demonstrated ability to build and lead large, high-performing project teams.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Strong understanding of project governance, MIS, progress reporting and escalation management.
* Relevant technical / professional qualifications in construction, civil engineering, project management or related disciplines advantageous; postgraduate qualification preferred.

title: SOC L3 _ Chennai (WFO)
description:

Lead SIEM use case development, correlation rule optimization, and continuous reduction of false positives to enhance detection effectiveness.

Manage log source onboarding, data quality, retention, and compliance with contractual and regulatory requirements.

Direct and manage the full incident response lifecycle, including root cause analysis, lessons learned, and post incident reporting.

Monitor and ensure compliance with SLAs, KPIs, internal controls, and customer contractual obligations.

Prepare and deliver operational, technical, and executive level reports on SOC performance, incidents, and risk trends.

Act as a trusted security advisor to customers and internal stakeholders, providing guidance on threat landscape and risk posture.

Bachelor s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.

5-8+ years of experience in Security Operations or SOC environments.

Minimum of 3+ years of hands-on experience with LogRhythm SIEM (preferred).

Experience in Managed Security Services (MSS) or multi-tenant SOC environments is highly preferred.

Technical Skills:

Strong hands-on experience with LogRhythm SIEM (preferred), including administration and operations.

Solid understanding of security monitoring, incident handling, and threat detection.

Experience with log management, network security, endpoint security, and cloud environments.

Knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK framework and threat intelligence concepts.

Understanding on SOAR automation for reducing manual efforts.

The opportunity is for a seasoned supplier quality professional with a robust track record of
  
  
success and a strong technical foundation in developing & managing regional supply base
  
  
to cater to the facilities & customers that are based globally.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Regional Supplier Quality Manager (SQM) – Mechanicals & Electro mechanicals is responsible for establishing, leading, and continuous execution of the supplier quality management strategy across regional supply chains for transformer manufacturing. This role ensures that all mechanical components (e.g., tanks, radiators, insulation materials, structural steel) and electromechanical assemblies (e.g., tap changers, bushings, control cabinets, sensors, cooling systems etc.) meet rigorous reliability, safety, and regulatory standards.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Supplier Qualification & Auditing
* Supplier Quality Management System Audit: Lead comprehensive supplier quality audits (VDA 6.3, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001 as applicable) for prospective and active suppliers across the region.
* Component Qualification: Manage the approval process for new mechanical and electromechanical components using APQP and PPAP methodologies (or equivalent industry frameworks).
* Technical Capability Assessment: Evaluate supplier manufacturing processes, welding quality (e.g., ISO 3834 / AWS D1.1), non-destructive testing (NDT), surface treatment/coatings (C5-I/M ISO 12944 environments), and electromechanical integration.
* Supplier Quality Performance & Continuous Improvement
* KPI Tracking: Monitor, report, and drive improvement on key supplier metrics: Supplier Parts per Million (PPM), On-Time In-Spec (OTIS), First Pass Yield (FPY), and Non-Conformance Report (NCR) closure rates.
* Root Cause Analysis & Corrective Actions: Lead formal non-conformance investigations using 8D, 5-Why, and Fishbone methodologies. Ensure root causes are identified and permanent corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) are verified.
* Supplier Development: Drive continuous improvement initiatives (Lean, Six Sigma) with strategic suppliers to improve yield, reduce lead times, and mitigate quality risks.
* Engineering & Technical Alignment
* Design for Manufacturability (DFM): Interface between Global Sourcing, Site Procurement, Engineering, and Suppliers to review engineering drawings, GD&T, material specifications, and tolerance stack-ups.
* Special Process Validation: Oversee validation of critical mechanical and electromechanical processes, including structural welding, hermetic seal integrity, galvanizing/painting, transformer tank pressure testing etc.
* Inspection & Test Plans (ITP): Define and approve critical-to-quality (CTQ) parameters, factory acceptance tests (FAT), and source inspection plans at supplier facilities.
* Regional Sourcing Strategy & Quality Governance
* Risk Management: Maintain regional supplier quality risk matrices, identifying critical component failure modes (FMEA) and establishing risk mitigation strategies.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Global Sourcing Managers, Plant Manufacturing Engineering, and Plant Quality teams to align supplier strategies with overall production schedules and cost targets.
* Standardization: Harmonize supplier quality standards, audit tools, and incoming quality control (IQC) procedures across regional manufacturing plants.

**Qualifications & Skills**
Educational & Technical Requirements
  
  

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, or related engineering field.
* Experience: 15+ years of Quality Assurance experience in heavy manufacturing, power transmission & distribution, transformers, or industrial equipment sectors.
* Subject Matter Expertise:
* Deep technical understanding of transformer mechanical components (tank fabrication, conservator systems, radiator/cooling assemblies) and electromechanical units (on-load/off-circuit tap changers, high-voltage bushings, control panels, monitoring instruments).
* Strong knowledge of international standards: IEC 60076, IEEE C57, NACE, ISO 9001, ISO 3834, AWS D1.1, ISO 12944.

**Certifications (Preferred)**

* Certified Quality Auditor / Manager (ASQ CQA, CQE, or CQM)
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt
* VDA 6.3 Process Auditor certification
* NDT Level II (VT/PT/MT/UT) or International Welding Engineer (IWE) / CWI is a strong plus
* Coating Inspection NACE Level 2 or Higher

Core Competencies & Soft Skills
  
  

* Problem Solving: Advanced analytical skills with proficiency in 8D, FMEA, SPC, and Root Cause Analysis.
* Auditing & Compliance: Proven ability to audit complex industrial supply chains and enforce rigorous quality standards.
* Stakeholder Management: Exceptional communication and negotiation skills to manage regional cross-cultural supplier relationships and internal executive communication.
* Travel Willingness: Ability to travel up to 40%–50% regionally for supplier visits, audits, and source inspections.

title: Head of Sourcing
description:
Job Description: General Manager – Sourcing (Leather & Accessories)

Location: Chennai/South India (Export Manufacturing Hub)

Reporting To: Chief Operating Officer / Director – Operations

**Role Overview**

The General Manager – Sourcing will lead end-to-end strategic procurement and raw material sourcing for leather goods, footwear, and accessory manufacturing. This leader will oversee vendor development, cost benchmarking, capacity planning, and supply resilience, with a core technical focus on cow and sheep/lamb leather, tanneries, trims, and hardware to support export buyers and private-label programs.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Strategic Sourcing & Material Procurement

● Direct end-to-end sourcing of wet-blue, crust, and finished leather (specializing in cow, calf, sheep, and lamb hides/skins), along with textiles, hardware, and trims.

● Lead supplier negotiations on pricing, payment terms, minimum order quantities (MOQs), and delivery schedules to ensure target gross margins.

● Formulate seasonal raw material roadmaps aligned with buyer technical packs, styling guidelines, and Bill of Materials (BOM).

2. Tannery & Vendor Management

● Identify, audit, and onboard tanneries and material vendors domestically and internationally.

● Monitor tannery production schedules to secure on-time delivery of crust and finished hides while minimizing lead times.

● Drive vendor performance evaluation based on OTIF (On-Time In-Full), defect rates, yield consistency, and compliance standards (such as LWG certification).

3. Technical Quality & Yield Optimization

● Work closely with Product Development, Pattern Making, and Production teams to establish cutting yields, grade selection, and substance/thickness specifications for cow and sheep leathers.

● Ensure all raw materials comply with international restricted substances lists (RSL/REACH), color fastness, tensile strength, and environmental standards.

● Address quality defects, grain variations, and finishing discrepancies directly with tanneries prior to factory dispatch.

4. Cost Engineering & Budget Control

● Implement standard costing sheets, benchmarking mechanisms, and cost-reduction initiatives to offset raw material price fluctuations.

● Optimize inventory carrying costs by aligning material procurement cycles with master production schedules (MPS).

● Monitor market price trends of hides and skins across key global trading regions to inform forward-purchasing strategies.

**Qualifications & Candidate Profile**

● Education: Degree in Leather Technology, Footwear/Apparel Production, or Sourcing from institutions such as CLRI, FDDI, NIFT, or equivalent.

● Experience: 15–20 years of progressive experience in material sourcing, procurement, or product-level technical sourcing within leather goods, footwear, or leather garment export manufacturing.

● Technical Expertise:

○ Deep domain mastery of sheep and cow leather tanning processes, grading, yield economics, and finishing techniques.

○ Working knowledge of LWG (Leather Working Group) compliance, REACH, and global brand sustainability audits.

● Leadership & Commercial Acumen: Proven track record in high-value contract negotiations, vendor development, and cross-functional leadership across Merchandising, Production, and Finance.

title: Deputy General Manager Process and Proposal
description:

The position requires a strategic techno-commercial leader who can drive business growth through successful proposal submissions, accurate cost estimation, optimized process designs, and effective client engagement. The role will work closely with Business Development, Commercial, Procurement, Project Execution, and Operations teams to ensure successful conversion of opportunities into profitable projects.

**Process Engineering Leadership**

* Lead process engineering activities for water and wastewater treatment projects, including WTP, STP, ETP, RO, UF/MF, MBR, MBBR, and ZLD systems.

* Process Flow Diagrams (PFDs)
* Piping & Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs)
* Hydraulic calculations
* Process calculations and mass balances
* Equipment specifications
* Process design reports

**Estimation and cost Engineering**

* Lead project estimation activities for EPC, Design-Build, and technology-based water treatment projects.
* Develop accurate CAPEX and OPEX estimates based on project requirements and design concepts.
* Review equipment sizing, material take-offs, and engineering quantities to support cost estimation activities.

* Detailed cost estimates
* Techno-commercial evaluations
* Life-cycle cost analyses

* Identify project risks, assumptions, exclusions, and contingencies during bid development.

* Build strong relationships with clients, consultants, technology partners, EPC contractors, and industry stakeholders.

* Drive a culture of technical excellence, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.

**Requirements**

title: Head - IQAC - GO/JC/4831/2026
description:
**Job Details**
**Job Title:**
Head – Internal Quality Assurance Cell (IQAC)
  
  
**Job Location:**
Chennai, Tamil Nadu
  
  
**Work Model:**
Work from Office
  
  
**Job Level:**
Head / Senior Leadership
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-time
  
  
**Candidate Expectations**
**Total Experience:**
15+ years preferred.
  
  
**Relevant Experience:**
Significant experience in institutional quality assurance, accreditation, academic administration, quality frameworks, and institutional ranking processes within higher education.
  
  
**Candidate Location:**
Chennai preferred; candidates willing to relocate may be considered.
  
  
**Mandatory Skills**
Leadership of IQAC or institutional quality assurance functions.
  
  
NAAC accreditation processes, assessment, and documentation.
  
  
Institutional ranking frameworks and data management.
  
  
Academic and administrative quality audits.
  
  
Outcome-based education, academic quality metrics, and continuous improvement.
  
  
Preparation of institutional reports, evidence repositories, and performance dashboards.
  
  
Stakeholder coordination and team leadership.
  
  
**Preferred Industry:**
Universities, higher education institutions, medical colleges, engineering institutions, and multidisciplinary educational institutions.
  
  
**Leadership Expectations:**
Ability to lead institution-wide quality initiatives, coordinate accreditation and ranking activities, and establish robust quality assurance and governance mechanisms.
  
  
**Education & Certification**
**Mandatory:**
Ph.D. or postgraduate qualification in a relevant discipline, as appropriate to the institution's requirements.
  
  
**Preferred:**
Ph.D. with substantial experience in higher education administration, academic quality assurance, or institutional governance.
  
  
**Good to Have:**
Training or certifications related to NAAC accreditation, NBA accreditation, quality management systems, academic auditing, outcome-based education, or institutional assessment frameworks.
  
  
**Additional Preference:**
Experience in multidisciplinary institutions covering Medical/Healthcare and Engineering education.
  
  
**Detailed Job Description**
**Role Overview**
The Head of IQAC will be responsible for establishing, leading, and strengthening the institution's internal quality assurance framework. The role will oversee institutional quality processes, accreditation readiness, NAAC-related data and documentation, institutional ranking submissions, academic and administrative audits, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  
  
The position will work closely with senior management, academic leaders, department heads, faculty, and administrative teams to ensure institutional performance is measured, documented, evaluated, and improved in line with applicable regulatory and accreditation requirements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Institutional Quality Assurance & Governance**
Develop and implement institution-wide quality assurance policies, frameworks, procedures, and annual quality plans.
  
  
Lead the functioning of the Internal Quality Assurance Cell and establish mechanisms for continuous academic and administrative improvement.
  
  
Define quality indicators, monitoring systems, review mechanisms, and accountability structures across departments.
  
  
Ensure quality initiatives are aligned with institutional objectives and applicable regulatory and accreditation requirements.
  
  
**NAAC Accreditation & Assessment**
Lead institutional preparedness for NAAC accreditation, assessment, and applicable quality assurance processes.
  
  
Coordinate the collection, verification, consolidation, and presentation of data and supporting evidence required for accreditation.
  
  
Oversee preparation and review of relevant institutional submissions, including the Annual Quality Assurance Report (AQAR), Self-Study Report (SSR), and other applicable documentation.
  
  
Track accreditation criteria, performance indicators, evidence gaps, and improvement requirements.
  
  
Coordinate with academic and administrative departments to ensure accurate, consistent, and timely submissions in accordance with applicable guidelines.
  
  
**Institutional Rankings & Performance Data**
Lead institutional ranking-related data collection, validation, analysis, and submission activities for relevant national and other applicable ranking frameworks.
  
  
Coordinate with departments to compile verified information relating to academics, research, faculty, student outcomes, infrastructure, outreach, and institutional performance.
  
  
Establish centralised data repositories and evidence-tracking mechanisms to improve data accuracy, consistency, and auditability.
  
  
Analyse ranking performance, identify gaps, and recommend initiatives to strengthen institutional outcomes.
  
  
Monitor ranking criteria, submission timelines, and applicable framework updates.
  
  
**Academic Quality & Continuous Improvement**
Monitor academic quality indicators, teaching-learning processes, curriculum delivery, assessment practices, and student outcomes.
  
  
Promote outcome-based education, programme outcome mapping, feedback mechanisms, and academic quality enhancement initiatives, where applicable.
  
  
Facilitate internal academic audits, administrative audits, and periodic departmental reviews.
  
  
Identify performance gaps and coordinate corrective and preventive action plans.
  
  
Encourage evidence-based decision-making and a culture of continuous quality improvement.
  
  
**Data Management, Documentation & Reporting**
Establish standardised processes for data collection, validation, documentation, and record maintenance.
  
  
Develop dashboards and institutional reports to track quality indicators, accreditation readiness, ranking performance, and improvement initiatives.
  
  
Ensure the availability of reliable supporting evidence for audits, assessments, accreditation reviews, and ranking submissions.
  
  
Implement document control, version management, and evidence verification practices.
  
  
Present periodic quality performance reports and improvement recommendations to institutional leadership.
  
  
**Stakeholder Coordination & Capacity Building**
Work closely with senior management, academic leadership, faculty, department coordinators, and administrative teams on quality-related initiatives.
  
  
Establish departmental quality coordinators and define clear responsibilities for data submission, verification, and compliance.
  
  
Conduct awareness sessions and capacity-building programmes on accreditation criteria, documentation standards, quality metrics, and institutional ranking requirements.
  
  
Facilitate internal quality review meetings and monitor the closure of agreed action items.
  
  
Build institution-wide ownership of quality assurance and accreditation readiness.
  
  
**Regulatory Compliance & Quality Audits**
Monitor applicable quality assurance and accreditation requirements relevant to the institution and its academic programmes.
  
  
Coordinate internal reviews to assess compliance with prescribed academic, administrative, and documentation standards.
  
  
Ensure timely identification, escalation, and closure of quality-related gaps.
  
  
Maintain readiness for external assessments, inspections, audits, and accreditation visits.
  
  
Coordinate with relevant institutional departments to ensure consistency between submitted data, supporting evidence, and official records.
  
  
**Strategic Planning & Institutional Improvement**
Translate accreditation and ranking findings into measurable institutional improvement plans.
  
  
Benchmark institutional performance against relevant peer institutions and applicable quality frameworks.
  
  
Recommend process improvements, governance mechanisms, and digital tools to strengthen quality management.
  
  
Track implementation of improvement initiatives and report progress to institutional leadership.
  
  
Contribute to long-term institutional planning through quality analytics and performance insights.
  
  
**Key Skills**
**Mandatory Skills**
IQAC leadership and institutional quality assurance.
  
  
NAAC accreditation and related documentation.
  
  
Institutional rankings and performance data management.
  
  
Academic and administrative quality audits.
  
  
Data validation, evidence management, and institutional reporting.
  
  
Quality indicators, performance monitoring, and continuous improvement.
  
  
Stakeholder coordination and institutional governance.
  
  
Team leadership and cross-functional collaboration.
  
  
**Good-to-Have Skills**
Exposure to NBA accreditation and other applicable programme-level accreditation frameworks.
  
  
Experience in multidisciplinary universities offering Medical/Healthcare and Engineering programmes.
  
  
Knowledge of outcome-based education, programme outcome assessment, and academic quality frameworks.
  
  
Experience with institutional dashboards, data analytics, and digital documentation systems.
  
  
Exposure to national ranking frameworks, benchmarking, and institutional performance improvement.
  
  
Research, academic administration, and university-level governance experience.
  
  
**Other Specific Remarks**
Candidates should have substantial experience in institutional quality assurance, accreditation, and ranking-related activities, rather than general academic administration alone.
  
  
Demonstrated ownership of NAAC-related data, documentation, assessment readiness, and institutional quality processes is preferred.
  
  
Strong expertise in data accuracy, evidence validation, reporting, and coordination across academic and administrative departments is essential.
  
  
Candidates should be capable of leading institution-wide quality initiatives and presenting performance insights to senior leadership.
  
  
Experience in a university or large multidisciplinary higher education institution will be an advantage.
  
  
Candidates with exposure to both Medical/Healthcare and Engineering education are preferred.
  
  
The role requires a detail-oriented, process-driven leader with strong analytical, documentation, governance, and stakeholder management capabilities.

title: Manager - Management Consulting
description:

The candidate should possess sufficient technical understanding to assess emerging energy-sector solutions, while ensuring high-quality deliverables, regulatory compliance and timely, responsive support to client requirements.

**Detailed expectations from the role:**

* Discom Power Planning and Optimization Advise State Discoms on power procurement planning, resource adequacy, power shortage/surplus assessment and optimization of power purchase costs, including evaluation of short-, medium- and long-term procurement options.
* Data Analytics, Energy Modelling and Decision Support Undertake power-sector data analysis, energy modelling and scenario assessment to support procurement strategy, project evaluation, market assessment and management decision-making, including development of analytical dashboards and management presentations.
* Renewable Energy Strategy and Energy Transition Advisory Support clients in developing renewable energy strategies and transition roadmaps, including assessment of procurement options, renewable power sourcing, open access/captive solutions, storage and emerging RE procurement mechanisms.

* Experience in power-sector consulting, advisory or project management, preferably with exposure to Discoms, power markets, renewable energy or energy transition.
* Understanding of power-sector business, market and commercial aspects, including power procurement, power markets, resource planning and related decision-making processes.
* Strong analytical, communication and presentation skills, with the ability to develop reports, presentations, analytical assessments and client-facing deliverables.
* Understanding of policy, regulatory and market developments across the power sector, including their implications for utilities, market participants and energy-sector businesses.
* Understanding of energy transition themes, including renewable energy integration, decarbonization, energy efficiency, energy storage and evolving power-sector business models.

* Experience in supporting power procurement, tendering and commercial processes, including preparation/review of RFPs, bid documents, evaluation frameworks and related documentation.
* Ability to undertake market assessment, techno-commercial analysis and evaluation of strategic options, and support clients in developing recommendations and implementation roadmaps.
* Ability to track and interpret regulations, policies and guidelines issued by CERC, SERCs, MoP, MNRE and other relevant sector institutions, and assess their implications for clients.
* Good understanding of emerging power-market and energy-transition developments, including renewable energy procurement, FDRE/RTC, BESS, pumped storage and other flexibility solutions.

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, preferred streams are Electrical, Mechanical or any related field. Master's degree preferred (MBA/M. Tech).
* At least 7 years of relevant experience.

**Location**

* Base location shall be Chennai. However, the role would require the applicant to undertake travel or relocation for pursuing various opportunities.

**Remuneration Structure**

* We offer a motivation based and competitive reward package.
