title: Technical Head – Sampling & Development
description:
**About Evolv**

Evolv Clothing is a Chennai-based apparel manufacturing powerhouse with over 50 years of deep expertise in precision garment manufacturing for leading European and American brands. Recognized for quality, consistency, and product excellence, Evolv specializes in value-added apparel manufacturing, blending craftsmanship with innovation and technology.

With advanced manufacturing capabilities, strong global partnerships, and a commitment to sustainable and compliant production, Evolv is strengthening its position as a preferred apparel manufacturing partner for UK, European, and global fashion brands.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a senior Technical Head to lead the Sampling and Development function. The role requires strong technical expertise and a thorough understanding of the products we manufacture, along with the leadership to deliver sampling and development programs that meet customer expectations, quality standards, and delivery timelines.

The Technical Head will own technical evaluation, product feasibility, and sampling execution end to end. Working closely with customers and internal teams, the role resolves technical challenges, makes sure product requirements are clearly understood before sampling begins, and builds the technical capability of the garment technician team.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Technical Review & Product Feasibility**

·  Analyse customer tech packs, sketches, specifications, measurement charts, construction details, and workmanship requirements to fully understand each product.

·  Assess product feasibility against garment construction, fabric and trim behaviour, wash-finish requirements, and technical risks.

·  Identify technical gaps early and recommend practical construction or process solutions before sampling begins.

·  Provide technical inputs for costing, including construction methods, SMV, and fabric consumption.

·  Translate customer requests into technical garment development solutions, ensuring design feasibility and product functionality.

·  Coordinate closely with design teams on fabric selection, trim compatibility, garment detailing, and construction techniques.

·  Understand the characteristics of different fabric categories and determine suitable trims, construction techniques, and finishing methods for each garment.

·  Evaluate fabric suitability and identify appropriate garment construction approaches based on design requirements and end-use.

·  Explore and develop new avenues in garment development across design, technical, and construction aspects, considering fabric characteristics, trim selection, and garment feasibility.

**Sampling & Development Delivery**

·  Lead the sample room and development team so that all samples are completed and submitted within agreed timelines.

·  Plan sample room capacity, workload, and priorities across customers and seasons.

·  Conduct fit sessions, review fit comments, and drive pattern and construction corrections.

·  Review and sign off every sample against customer specifications and quality standards before submission.

·  Track sample status, approvals, comments, and revisions, and reduce the number of sample rounds per style.

·  Drive seasonal garment development in collaboration with design teams, aligning product concepts with collection requirements.

·  Lead sampling and technical development activities to translate garment concepts into production-ready samples.

·  Prepare and develop garment lines for seasonal collections in coordination with the Technical Head, Sampling, and Development teams.

**Customer Liaison & Technical Ownership**

·  Act as the senior technical point of contact for customers on construction, specifications, feasibility, and development concerns.

·  Translate customer feedback into clear, actionable instructions for internal teams.

·  Take full ownership of technical issues and coordinate merchandising, pattern, sampling, production, and quality teams to resolve them within customer timelines.

·  Escalate risks to sample quality or delivery proactively and ensure closure with all stakeholders

**Sampling-to-Production Handover**

·  Lead pre-production (PP) meetings and ensure complete technical handover from sampling to bulk production.

·  Be present on the production floor to support the line on technical issues during bulk, so that issues solved in sampling do not recur in production.

**Team Leadership & Capability Development**

·  Guide, coach, and train garment technicians to upgrade their technical skills and problem-solving capability.

·  Identify skill gaps across the technical and sampling teams and run structured, hands-on training.

·  Set technical standards and SOPs for sampling, tech pack interpretation, and measurement checks.

·  Set KRAs for the team, review performance, and build accountability for quality and timelines.

**Key Performance Indicators**

·  On-time sample submission rate

·  Right-first-time sample approval rate and average sample rounds per style

·  Technical issues carried from sampling into bulk production

·  Measurable skill improvement across the garment technician team

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

**Experience**

·  10-15 years in garment technical, sampling, or product development roles within export apparel manufacturing for UK, European, or US brands.

·  Must have led a technical or sampling team including garment technicians

·  Hands-on experience with product categories Women’s, Kid’s and Men’s Woven Wears, including tech packs, fit sessions, and sample development.

·  Proven experience handling customer technical discussions and feasibility issues directly.

**Technical & Functional Skills**

·  Expert knowledge of garment construction, specifications, measurements, workmanship, and fabric and trim behaviour.

·  Strong understanding of patterns, fit, sewing operations, washes/finishes, and testing requirements.

·  Ability to evaluate SMV, construction methods, and consumption for costing inputs.

·  Strong troubleshooting and decision-making skills, with the ability to manage multiple development programs at once.

·  Confident customer communication and stakeholder management at a senior level.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

·  A hands-on technical leader capable of leading and developing the technical team while confidently handling customer discussions and resolving technical challenges.

·  Takes ownership of technical issues and drives them to resolution.

·  Develops people and raises the technical standard of the whole team.

**Education**

A degree in Garment Technology, Fashion Technology, Textile Technology, or Apparel Manufacturing from NIFT or an equivalent recognized institution is required. A postgraduate (PG) qualification in a relevant field will be an added advantage.

**What Evolv Offers**

·  Leadership of a key function at an established manufacturer with over 50+ years of expertise.

·  Direct exposure to leading UK, European, and global fashion brands.

·  The opportunity to shape and strengthen sampling standards, processes, and team capabilities while driving technical development, improving garment construction, fit, quality, and product execution.

**Apply Now**

Interested candidates can share their profiles at: careers@evolvclothing.com

description:
When you join Verizon
  
  
You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. The Associate Director of AI Science is a highly strategic, business-facing leadership role dedicated to driving commercial value across our Home and Mobility verticals. Sitting at the intersection of advanced machine learning and business strategy, this role focuses on leveraging propensity modeling and dynamic microsegmentation to unlock new revenue streams, optimize the customer lifecycle, and elevate customer lifetime value.
  
  
You will act as the crucial bridge between our technical AI Science teams and the Home and Mobility business units, ensuring that complex AI and data science capabilities are translated into adopted, scalable solutions that deliver measurable ROI and continuous business growth.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Business Strategy & Commercial Value Creation**

* Monetize AI Capabilities: Lead the strategic application of advanced propensity models (e.g., likelihood-to-buy, churn prediction, next-best-action, cross-sell/up-sell) to drive tangible growth and retention in the Home and Mobility sectors.
* Define Microsegmentation Strategy: Guide the development of highly granular, behavioral microsegments to personalize marketing efforts, optimize pricing strategies, and tailor product offerings in real-time.
* ROI Accountability: Establish frameworks to measure the commercial impact of deployed AI models. Define, track, and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) that demonstrate direct value creation, revenue lift, and cost optimization.
* Lifecycle Optimization: Embed AI-driven insights into critical touchpoints along the customer lifecycle, ensuring predictive interventions are timed perfectly with high-impact trigger events.

**Stakeholder Management & AI Adoption**

* Executive Liaison: Serve as the primary strategic advisor and translator between the AI Science function and Home/Mobility business leaders (Marketing, Product, Sales, and Customer Experience).
* Drive Business Adoption: Champion the operationalization of AI models. Overcome organizational silos and resistance by demonstrating clear business value, securing buy-in, and embedding AI tools directly into end-user workflows.
* Storytelling with Data: Translate highly technical machine learning concepts, model performance metrics, and statistical outputs into clear, compelling narratives and strategic recommendations for senior executive leadership.
* Needs Translation: Proactively identify business pain points within Home and Mobility and translate these into actionable data science projects, defining clear modeling requirements for the technical teams.

**Technical Oversight & Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Model Lifecycle Strategy: Oversee the business strategy for models deployed in high-impact areas, ensuring continuous optimization, accuracy, and relevance to shifting market dynamics.
* Pipeline Integration: Partner closely with Data Engineering, MLOps, and IT teams to ensure models are seamlessly deployed into production environments and marketing automation platforms.
* Team Mentorship: Provide strategic direction and business-context mentorship to data scientists and AI engineers, ensuring their technical execution remains tightly aligned with corporate objectives.

**Core Competencies & Qualifications**
**Experience & Education**

* Education: Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Business Analytics, or a related field (an MBA with a strong quantitative focus is highly preferred).
* Industry Experience: 8+ years of experience in data science, advanced analytics, or AI strategy, with a minimum of 3 years in a leadership, product management, or business-facing role.
* Domain Knowledge: Deep understanding of the telecommunications, broadband, or consumer technology industries, specifically within Home (e.g., fiber, smart home, IoT) and Mobility (e.g., 5G, wireless services) verticals.

**Technical & Business Skills**

* AI/ML Fluency: Strong foundational understanding of machine learning algorithms, deep learning, NLP, and LLM architecture. Must be highly conversant in how techniques utilizing frameworks like PyTorch and scikit-learn are applied to business problems, even if not writing production code daily.
* Advanced Propensity & Segmentation: Proven track record of designing, evaluating, and strategically deploying end-to-end propensity models and clustering techniques for large-scale customer bases.
* Data Stack Familiarity: Experience working with cloud platforms (e.g., GCP, AWS, Azure), production MLOps tools, and large-scale data extraction processes.
* Exceptional Communication: Elite presentation skills with the ability to distill complex analytical findings into actionable business strategies for non-technical stakeholders.

What Success Looks Like in Year One
  
  

* Successfully integrated at least three major propensity or microsegmentation models into the Home and Mobility go-to-market workflows.
* Established a regular cadence of AI performance reporting that clearly demonstrates incremental revenue lift or churn reduction to the executive team.
* Achieved a high adoption rate of AI-driven recommendations among business stakeholders, shifting the organizational culture toward proactive, model-driven decision-making.

Where you’ll be working
  
  
In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.
  
  
Scheduled Weekly Hours
  
  
40

You will be the primary point of contact for clients, ensuring their needs are met and their business objectives are achieved. This role requires a deep understanding of market trends, strong project management skills, and the ability to develop and implement effective strategies.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Client Servicing/Relationships:**

* Manage external stakeholder relationships and build strong, lasting connections with clients.
* Act as the primary point of contact for clients, addressing their needs and managing expectations.
* Align services with clients' business objectives and regularly communicate updates and feedback.
* Ensure client satisfaction (CSat), revenue growth, and client retention.

**Project/Account Management:**

* Oversee the execution of projects from initiation to completion.
* Develop project timelines, allocate resources effectively, and monitor progress to ensure timely delivery.
* Review presentations, reports, and creative assets for accuracy and quality.
* Provide feedback and guidance to team members to improve deliverables.
* Implement standards and processes to maintain consistent quality.
* Track revenue and goals, ensuring alignment with client and company objectives.
* Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities to maximize client value and deepend share of wallet
* Explore ways to leverage technology to enhance client experiences and streamline operations.

**Strategy and Ideation/Brainstorming:**

* Develop strategic plans to meet clients' objectives.
* Analyze market trends and competitor activities to inform strategic decisions.
* Collaborate with the strategy team to develop tailored strategies and evaluate their effectiveness.
* Generate creative ideas and solutions to address client needs.
* Ensure ideations align with client objectives and brand identity.

**Overall Knowledge of Digital & Social Beat Offerings:**

* Possess a strong understanding of the company's products and services.
* Acquire expertise in various tools and platforms such as Meta, Google Analytics, Content, SEO, Marketplace, Influencer Marketing, and Marketing Automation.

**Industry Trends, Market Analysis:**

* Conduct research to identify industry trends and market opportunities.
* Analyze data and market reports to assess competitive landscapes.
* Provide insights and recommendations based on market analysis.
* Adapt strategies to capitalize on emerging trends and opportunities.

**What qualities are we looking for in you?**

* Exhibit adaptability, inclusivity, sincerity, curiosity, entrepreneurial spirit, and teamwork.
* Blend creative and data-driven mindsets, with a passion for quantifiable marketing outcomes.
* Maintain a positive attitude and curiosity towards digital marketing, grasping concepts quickly and making sound judgments.
* Lead and mentor a team, inspiring all levels of staff and developing talent.
* Create a collaborative and outcomes-driven environment, managing multiple projects and clients.
* Display insightful business sense and interest in adtech & martech for value creation, adapting to dynamic environments.
* Be a proactive and organized go-getter, taking initiative and thinking ahead.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field.
* 2-4+ years of experience in account management, client servicing, or a related role.
* Proficiency in digital platforms and mediums (Google, Meta, YouTube, Affiliates and other platforms) and how they impact growth of brands
* Proven experience in managing and growing client relationships.
* Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strategic thinker with the ability to analyze market trends and make data-driven decisions.
* Experience in leading and mentoring a team.

title: Delivery Manager I
description:
**Role Description**
The Project Manager II will oversee day-to-day technology operations and production support for a mid-sized Health Plan, ensuring seamless delivery of services across core healthcare administration systems, including enrolment, claims, adjudication, and payments.
  
  
This role requires strong leadership, project management, service delivery, and stakeholder management capabilities. The individual will work closely with health plan clients, third-party vendors, and onshore/offshore teams to ensure operational stability, timely issue resolution, continuous improvement, and high customer satisfaction.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Project & Service Delivery Management
* Manage end-to-end technology delivery and production support operations, ensuring adherence to defined SLAs and operational commitments.
* Oversee day-to-day production support activities for healthcare administration platforms and associated applications.
* Plan, prioritize, and coordinate operational activities, enhancements, maintenance, and release schedules.
* Ensure timely delivery of project milestones, tasks, and customer commitments.
* Drive service delivery excellence through continuous process improvements and operational efficiencies.
* Production Support & Incident Management
* Ensure production stability and application performance across the Health Plan ecosystem.
* Lead incident management, problem management, root cause analysis (RCA), and resolution activities.
* Manage incidents, service requests, and change activities using service management tools such as ServiceNow and JIRA.
* Coordinate with network, middleware, infrastructure, hardware, operating system, database, and application support teams to resolve technical issues.
* Manage customer escalations and ensure timely communication and resolution.
* Provide on-call support and coordinate critical production activities during after-hours and weekends, as required.
* Client & Stakeholder Management
* Act as a primary point of contact for customer interactions, operational reviews, and service delivery discussions.
* Lead customer calls, prioritize business requirements, and drive issue resolution.
* Collaborate with onshore teams, offshore delivery teams, business stakeholders, and third-party vendors.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with client executives, business leaders, and technology partners.
* Drive stakeholder alignment and ensure transparent communication on project progress, risks, dependencies, and escalations.
* Governance, Reporting & Compliance
* Prepare and deliver SLA reports, operational dashboards, and management status reports within defined timelines.
* Establish and maintain governance frameworks, including RACI matrices, RAID logs, and Steering Committee reviews.
* Monitor service performance, identify operational risks, and implement mitigation plans.
* Ensure compliance with organizational policies, contractual obligations, regulatory requirements, and internal controls.
* Manage vendor performance, SOWs, SLAs, and Change Requests.
* Resource & Team Management
* Manage project staffing, resource allocation, and delivery capacity.
* Mentor, coach, and develop team members to strengthen technical capabilities and operational accountability.
* Drive team collaboration, performance management, and effective coordination across distributed teams.
* Foster a culture of ownership, continuous learning, and customer-centric service delivery.
* Process Improvement & Transformation
* Identify opportunities for automation, operational efficiency, and service improvement.
* Establish standardized processes to improve consistency, quality, and service delivery.
* Drive change management, release management, and successful client rollouts.
* Apply ITIL best practices, SDLC, and Agile methodologies to enhance operational effectiveness.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 12+ years of relevant experience in IT, Healthcare IT, technology operations, or service delivery management.
* Strong experience in project management, production support, and service delivery operations.
* Proven experience managing customer-facing technology support teams in complex IT environments.
* Experience managing healthcare payer systems, preferably HealthEdge HealthRules suite.
* Strong understanding of core healthcare administration processes, including enrolment, claims processing, adjudication, and payments.
* Hands-on experience with service management tools such as ServiceNow and JIRA.
* Strong knowledge of ITIL practices, incident management, problem management, change management, and release management.
* Experience managing SLAs, operational metrics, service reports, SOWs, and Change Requests.
* Proven experience in vendor management and stakeholder engagement.
* Strong understanding of SDLC and Agile methodologies.
* Excellent planning, coordination, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Strong proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and management presentations.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively with customers, senior management, and cross-functional teams.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, drive accountability, and deliver results in a dynamic environment.

Educational Qualification
  
  

* Bachelor's degree or higher in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* 12+ years of relevant professional experience in IT or Healthcare Management.

What We Look For
  
  

* Strong customer focus and commitment to service excellence.
* Ability to lead teams and manage complex operational challenges.
* Proactive approach to risk identification, issue resolution, and continuous improvement.
* Strong leadership, decision-making, and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Ability to build collaborative partnerships across technology, business, and operations teams.
* Ownership mindset with a focus on delivering high-quality outcomes, operational stability, and customer satisfaction.

**Skills**
Agile, Change Management, Claims Management, Healthcare Systems, ITIL, Incident Management, Issue Analysis, Jira, Payment Processing, Production Support, Project Management

title: Manager, Business Operations
description:
**The Company**
PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.
  
  
We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
  
  
We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.
  
  
Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.
  
  
**Job Summary:**
**What Do You Need To Know About The Role**
The Core Platforms Technology team is looking for a talented, self-driven, and analytically minded Business Operations professional. Reporting to the Chief of Staff, the Business Operations Analyst will partner with engineering leaders and cross-functional teams to improve operating discipline, generate actionable insights, and enable data-driven decision-making across the organization.
  
  
This role combines business operations, data analysis, workforce and capacity planning, portfolio governance, communications, and program execution.
  
  
Meet Our Team
  
  
The Business Operations team supports the Core Platforms Technology leadership team and helps the organization operate effectively at scale. We partner closely with Engineering, Product, Finance, People, Strategy, and other Business Operations teams to translate business priorities into measurable plans and coordinated execution.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**Essential Responsibilities:**

* Lead functional projects and programs to optimize operational processes.
* Identify issues and recommend best practices for process improvements.
* Partner with various departments to understand business trends.
* Drive business or process improvements within the function.
* Provide oversight and support for planning and management of financial, budget, and headcount targets.
* Act as a point of contact or liaison between business leadership, staff, and other key partners.
* Promote transparent reporting and foster a culture of data-driven decision-making by defining key metrics and evaluating progress.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* 5+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:**
**Your Day-to-Day Responsibilities**
In this role, you will:
  
  

* Prepare, analyze, and interpret organizational and operational data, including workforce census, OKRs, KPIs, capacity, investment plans, roadmaps, delivery health, and other leadership reporting.
* Translate data into actionable insights, clearly identifying trends, risks, dependencies, and opportunities for leadership consideration.
* Create dashboards, executive presentations, and decision-support materials that communicate complex information clearly and concisely.
* Partner with engineering and product teams to maintain data quality, reporting accuracy, and consistent operating metrics.
* Support annual and quarterly planning processes, including workforce planning, capacity planning, resource allocation, and scenario modelling for employees and contingent workers.
* Support portfolio and operating reviews by tracking priorities, milestones, risks, dependencies, decisions, and follow-through.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and improve recurring operational processes and reporting.
* Use company-approved AI and automation tools to accelerate analysis, generate initial insights, synthesize information, and improve the efficiency of reporting and communications.
* Evaluate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, relevance, bias, and business context, while adhering to applicable data privacy, security, and responsible-AI requirements.
* Help develop and maintain operating playbooks, training materials, communications, templates, and best practices for the organization.
* Develop leadership messaging for internal communications, organizational updates, operating reviews, and executive presentations.
* Support employee engagement and organizational effectiveness initiatives in partnership with People Business Partners and business leaders.
* Lead or contribute to cross-functional initiatives and special projects, from problem definition and analysis through implementation and measurement of outcomes.

**What You Need To Bring**

* 5+ years of experience in business operations, strategic planning, analytics, program management, technical project management, or a related discipline, preferably within a technology or engineering organization.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to convert data into insights, recommendations, and executive-level narratives.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
* Working knowledge of data-analysis and visualization tools such as SQL, Power BI, Tableau, Looker or equivalent platforms.
* Practical experience using generative AI or AI-enabled productivity tools for research, data synthesis, reporting, communications, workflow improvement, or decision support.
* Understanding of responsible AI use, including data confidentiality, output validation, bias awareness, and appropriate human oversight.
* Ability to identify repeatable processes that can be simplified or automated using AI, workflow tools, or low-code solutions.
* Strong execution orientation, with demonstrated ownership from problem definition through delivery and follow-through.
* Excellent written, verbal, and visual communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with senior executives and technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities, meet deadlines, and adapt quickly in an environment characterized by change and ambiguity.
* Proven ability to work independently while collaborating effectively in a cross-functional, matrixed organization.
* Ability to establish credibility, build trusted relationships, and influence stakeholders without direct authority.
* Sound judgment and the ability to balance business partnership with constructive challenge and timely escalation of risks.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting platform engineering, infrastructure, cloud, developer productivity, enterprise technology, or another complex technical organization.
* Experience with portfolio management, technology investment planning, engineering capacity planning, or organizational health metrics.
* Familiarity with automation or low-code tools such as Power Automate, Copilot, or similar platforms.
* Experience designing executive dashboards, conducting scenario analysis, or developing business cases.
* Demonstrated curiosity about emerging AI capabilities and their application to business and engineering operations.

**Subsidiary:**
PayPal
  
  
**Travel Percent:**
0
  
  
PayPal does not charge candidates any fees for courses, applications, resume reviews, interviews, background checks, or onboarding. When making an application directly, we will never ask you to share passwords, one-time passcodes (OTP), or verification codes. Any such request is a red flag and likely part of a scam. All communication regarding your application will come from official PayPal email domains. If you suspect fraudulent activity, please report it immediately. To learn more about how to identify and avoid recruitment fraud please visit https://careers.pypl.com/contact-us.
  
  
For the majority of employees, PayPal's balanced hybrid work model offers 3 days in the office for effective in-person collaboration and 2 days at your choice of either the PayPal office or your home workspace, ensuring that you equally have the benefits and conveniences of both locations.
  
  
**Our Benefits:**
At PayPal, we’re committed to building an equitable and inclusive global economy. And we can’t do this without our most important asset-you. That’s why we offer comprehensive, choice-based programs, to support all aspects of personal wellbeing—physical, emotional, and financial—delivering meaningful value where it matters most. We strive to create a flexible, balanced work culture with a holistic approach to benefits, including generous paid time off, healthcare coverage for you and your family, and resources to create financial security and support your mental health.
  
  
**Who We Are:**
Click Here to learn more about our culture and community.
  
  
**Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
PayPal provides equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. In addition, PayPal will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you are unable to submit an application because of incompatible assistive technology or a disability, please contact us at paypalglobaltalentacquisition@paypal.com.
  
  
**Belonging at PayPal:**
Our employees are central to advancing our mission, and we strive to create an environment where everyone can do their best work with a sense of purpose and belonging. Belonging at PayPal means creating a workplace with a sense of acceptance and security where all employees feel included and valued. We are proud to have a diverse workforce reflective of the merchants, consumers, and communities that we serve, and we continue to take tangible actions to cultivate inclusivity and belonging at PayPal.
  
  
Any general requests for consideration of your skills, please Join our Talent Community.
  
  
We know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates. Please don’t hesitate to apply.

title: Release Train Manager, VP
description:
Join us as a Release Train Manager
  
  

* This is a unique opportunity to join a fast paced and Agile team, responsible for aligning the vision, planning, and interdependencies of many teams by providing cross-team or domain synchronisation of the portfolio delivery and domain pipeline
* With no two days the same, you'll have the chance to be a true servant leader and help ensure consistent Agile delivery at scale
* In this exciting role, you'll enjoy regular engagements with key stakeholders as well as the opportunity to build your network across the bank
* We're offering this role at vice president level

What you'll do
  
  
In this key role, you’ll be developing and maintaining the release train. This will include the preparation and review of the release and environment strategy, involving plans and estimation, and management of interdependencies. With your vital leadership, you’ll provide cross-team synchronisation, making sure everyone has a clear understanding of how their work helps our customers.
  
  
You’ll drive continuous improvement across delivery via various channels, including improving or removing manual steps, and we’ll look to you to demonstrably improve release train agility and value to end state customers.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities Will Include**

* Enhancing deployment and management phases of the development lifecycle, including through Agile coaching and active contribution to release and environment best practice
* Facilitating and fostering the preparation of release and sprint vision, goals and work pipelines and facilitating pre and post planning meetings
* Building and communicating release calendars and iterative planning cycles and synchronising with other release train managers across domains
* Aggregating the programme release objectives into value streams release objectives where they exist and publishing them for visibility and transparency
* Assisting with the economic decision-making by facilitating estimation by teams and the roll up to programme and portfolio levels

The skills you'll need
  
  
We’re looking for someone with an expert understanding of running complex projects spanning multiple scrum and non-scrum teams.
  
  
**You’ll Also Need**

* Expert level knowledge and proficiency with scaled Agile and P3M tools and methodologies spanning value stream, portfolio, programme and team levels
* The ability to prioritise and sequence tasks that are to be delivered by the feature teams
* Strong servant leadership capabilities along with the ability to create and share a vision in-line with the bank’s
* Strong stakeholder skills with the ability to influence both business and technical partners
* Experience of running multiple matrix managed teams

title: Frontier Transformation leader
description:

**Frontier Transformation Lead**

You will work collaboratively with senior business, delivery, solutioning, operations, talent, and capability leaders to translate AI offerings and accelerators into new ways of working, strengthen workforce capability, and enable outcome-based delivery.

* Drive the adoption and diffusion of AI offerings, assets, toolkits, and accelerators into live client engagements, working closely with sales, solutioning, and account management teams.

.

* Demonstrated experience leading enterprise-scale workforce transformation, including career pathing, reskilling, certification, and transition toward AI or emerging-technology capabilities.
* Strong delivery and transformation leadership, with the credibility to drive changes in ways of working across live client accounts in partnership with sales, solutioning, and delivery organizations.

* Strong understanding of Generative AI, Agentic AI, AI-native engineering roles, and emerging AI-enabled delivery models.

**These will help you stand out**

* Experience owning a large-scale workforce strategy or capability community of 2000-3000 professionals.
* Demonstrated ability to lead large, distributed talent populations through senior leadership layers and drive measurable capability transformation.
* Experience taking new intellectual property, accelerators, or technology capabilities into live client environments and embedding them into delivery.
* Strong executive stakeholder management experience across business, sales, delivery, operations, HR, and technology organizations.
* Experience building enterprise reskilling, certification, talent mobility, or AI capability programs that connect workforce transformation with business demand.

We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

title: Digital Acceleration Lead, Director
description:
Join us as a Digital Acceleration Lead
  
  

* Drive the acceleration and scaling of digital, data and AI-enabled solutions across Risk, turning strategic priorities and proven ideas into reusable capabilities that deliver sustainable business value and improved risk outcomes
* Partner with senior stakeholders and delivery teams across a complex operating environment that enables the successful transition from experimentation to enterprise-wide adoption
* You'll lead a team to deliver priority interventions, build colleagues skills, confidence and embed lasting ownership across the Risk function
* We're offering this role at director level

What you’ll do
  
  
As a Digital Acceleration Lead, you'll be responsible for driving the delivery of digital, data and AI-powered solutions that support Risk's strategic objectives, enhance business outcomes and set the direction for data-driven oversight, analytics and knowledge management capabilities.
  
  
In addition, you’ll also lead the identification, industrialisation and expansion of high-impact digital, AI-enabled capabilities and a team that combines solution delivery with capability development, fostering digital and AI skills across Risk, strengthening colleague ownership
  
  
**You’ll Also Be Responsible For**

* Supporting the delivery of digital solutions across Risk and deliver business outcomes
* Accelerating the adoption of digital and AI-enabled ways of working by delivering priority interventions that build lasting capability, confidence and self-sufficiency within Risk
* Translating senior stakeholder priorities and Risk function roadmaps into a balanced portfolio of targeted interventions, proof of concept, capability-building activities and scalable solutions
* Leading a team to provide a deliver-and-develop model, combining outcome delivery with capability transfer and skills development
* Designing and delivering joint engagements that embed specialist expertise alongside Risk colleagues to build ownership and sustainable capability
* Scaling prioritised solutions into governed, maintainable and reusable products supported by appropriate guidance, training and adoption approaches

**Responsibilities**
The role will be responsible for tender preparation for turnkey High-Voltage AC Substations for Utility and Industry projects from the early pursuit phase until final negotiation, contract signature and handover to the execution team. The position of Tendering Manager will have a variety of responsibilities including, but not limited to:
  
  

* Together with the International front-end sales organization, you will identify projects in the early stage, understand customer requirements and follow-up regularly and promptly with customers during the acquisition phase
* Together with the sales organization, you follow the sales strategy for the individual tenders by selecting the winning solution, both commercially and technically
* Assume the lead for assigned tenders, incorporating the help of interdisciplinary supporting teams consisting of engineering, project management, legal, commercial and supply chain management
* Prepare and ensure on-time and complete technical and commercial tender submittal to the customer and lead the technical and commercial negotiations with customers
* Responsible for the integration of supplier offers, risk evaluation and completeness of tender in multi-national setups
* Oversee the validation of terms and conditions in each offer
* Hand over successful sales projects to the project execution and engineering departments
* Collaborate with supply chain management to coordinate subcontractor and supplier offers. Support SCM in negotiations with vendors to get the best technical and commercial offers
* Provide in a timely manner all necessary information to support the Linjemontage risk and approval process in accordance with company policy.

**Qualifications And Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in relevant engineering discipline
* Strong communication, interpersonal, and leadership skills.
* Minimum 10 years of experience in sales and tendering of power systems, with a focus on substations.
* Proven track record of working with utility and industrial customers, as well as international EPC contractors and project developers.
* Solid technical knowledge of AIS and GIS high-voltage (HV) and medium-voltage (MV) equipment and systems.
* Experience collaborating with Nordic utilities or EPC companies will be considered a strong advantage.

**Personal attributes**

* Leadership on Integrity
* Proactive and self-motivated with the ability to work with cross-functional and cross-border teams as well as to cope with a flexible-load environment
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Willingness to travel for site assessments and project meetings.
* Structured and solution oriented.
* International travel is required.

**What We Offer**

* A key role in exciting, future-oriented projects within the energy sector
* Autonomy in your work and decision-making responsibilities
* Opportunities for continuous professional growth and development
* A strong, collaborative, and supportive team culture
* Long-term career prospects within a growing and forward-thinking organization

**Recruitment process**
We do not accept applications by email. We will review all applications and make an initial selection. Selected candidates will be invited to a first interview by phone. Final candidates will then be invited to an in-person interview at our office in Chennai.
  
  
**Office location**
COWRKS Rmz Millenia Business Park, 600096 Chennai Tamil Nadu, India
  
  
**About Linjemontage**
***Linjemontage is a Swedish pure-play EPC provider within power infrastructure, enabling the modernisation and expansion of the Nordic electricity grid. title: Senior Manager / Manager - Finance
description:
***Did you know KONE moves over one billion people every day? In 2025, we had annual net sales of EUR 11.2 billion. **Chennai HO**
team, as

The Financial Controller manages the day-to-day financial controlling activities to meet the Units short and long-term business objectives and comply with the KONE Financial Control Models (FCM) and external regulations, accounting principles and standards. The Financial Controller supports the definition of local financial policies and ensures that both local and global policies are adhered to. This role applies to Financial Controllers in all frontline and supply line units for all business units and will report to a Financial Director/Manager.
  
  
***What will you be doing?***

* Ensure that the legal entity financial reporting is prepared on a timely manner in accordance with both KONE Accounting Standards and statutory requirements.
* Ensure that all defined tasks in the month-end closing process executed by finance operations partner(s), KONE Business Services and the finance Global Process Owners (GPOs) are performed for a unit

* Review and approve key reconciliations journal entries and the bridge between KONE Reporting (IFRS) and statutory reporting
* Ensure that proper balance sheet reconciliation is prepared for the legal entity in accordance with the KONE balance sheet reconciliation policy
* Ensure timeliness, completeness and accuracy of both legal entity and business line/unit results and forecasts in KONE consolidation system (CPM Beacon) in collaboration with business controllers
* Organize and run periodic financial performance and balance sheet reviews with Finance Director, Business Controllers, KONE Business Services and finance operations partner(s)
* Ensure forecasting of statutory income statement and balance sheet items, bridging between business forecasting and legal entity view
* Ensure execution of unit specific internal control activities (execution of local internal control activities, relevant documentation and appropriate monitoring activities as defined by global KONE internal controls framework)
* Ensure that statutory and tax reporting are filed in accordance with both, the local legislation and globally agreed timelines
* Ensure that annual dividends are distributed in accordance with the KONE dividend policy
* Manage audit process ensuring that both group as well as statutory audit is conducted in accordance with globally defined scheduled and scope
* Continuous follow-up of local legislation and understanding of potential impacts to our business and financial reporting. There should be proactive communication of these on to both, local and global stakeholders
* Act as the first point of contact for local authorities
* Approve payment proposals and authorize manual payments in accordance with KONE policy
* Collaborate actively with finance GPOs, KONE Business Services and finance operations partner(s) to resolve process issues or exceptions. Ensure that KONE global finance processes and improvement initiatives are implemented in unit in line with global policies and process blueprints
* Identify and forecast FX exposure and agree on hedge plan with KCO treasury
* Actively participate in relevant mergers & acquisitions related activities in cooperation with the global KONE M&A team
* May lead a team of financial professionals
* Providing actionable insights on financial performance of unit to the Finance Director, Business Controllers as well as business leaders on a day-to-day basis
* Participate to selected business meetings to build detailed understanding of unit business performance and related topics. Provide accounting expertise as needed.
* Advise business on bank guarantees, provide approvals, and collect back bank guarantees

* 10+years of experience with relevant education.

***What do we offer?***

* Career progression opportunities within a global organization.
* Total reward elements that engage and motivate our employees and help us make KONE a great place to work.

*At KONE, we are focused on creating an innovative and collaborative working culture where we value the contribution of each individual. * Manage and develop a team of revenue accountants; provide mentorship, coaching, and performance feedback
* Partner with global stakeholders across the US and India, ensuring seamless revenue operations and governance
* Partner cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Legal, and Finance partners to review contracts, process changes, and new product launches
* Evaluate and document accounting implications for new revenue streams, partnerships, and go-to-market initiatives
* Maintain and enhance revenue accounting procedures, and internal controls
* Act as a primary point of contact for external auditors on revenue-related matters
* Drive process improvements and automation across revenue accounting systems and tools
* Support the design, implementation, and execution of key revenue controls and system enhancements within NetSuite and Zuora.
* Participate in system migration, automation, and integration initiatives in partnership with the business systems team.
* Identify and execute opportunities for continuous process improvement to enhance accuracy and efficiency across revenue workflows.

**What You'll Need To Thrive (Requirements)**
**Must-Haves:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance; CPA or CA preferred
* 12+ years of progressive accounting experience, including deep revenue accounting expertise
* Strong knowledge of ASC 606 and SaaS / fintech revenue models
* Experience managing and developing high-performing teams
* Background in public accounting and/or high-growth technology companies strongly preferred
* Comfort operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment with incomplete information
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain technical accounting concepts to non-accounting partners
* Experience with large-scale transaction volumes and complex billing structures

**Revenue Operations Experience - Good-to-have**

* Familiarity with the end-to-end order-to-cash process, including order management, billing, collections, payment processing, and cash application.
* Experience partnering with Billing, Collections, Cash Applications, or Payments teams to resolve invoice, payment, and reconciliation issues.
* Exposure to platforms such as NetSuite, Zuora, Salesforce, or Stripe, including integrations and process automation.Understanding of order-to-cash controls and metrics such as billing accuracy, DSO, AR aging, and unapplied cash.

**In 6–12 months, you will:**

* Reduce revenue close timelines
* Improve revenue procedures
* Scale systems to support growth
* Enable faster product launches with revenue-ready frameworks

**Special Sauce (Preferred Qualifications)**

* Experience with SQL.
* Experience in system implementation, process automation, or ERP migration projects

The role will be responsible for ensuring accurate financial records, timely closure of accounts, compliance with applicable regulatory requirements and effective coordination with the holding company, group entities and external professional advisors.

The ideal candidate should have sound knowledge of accounting principles, taxation, statutory compliance and financial reporting, along with the ability to independently manage routine finance and accounting functions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Accounting & Financial Operations**

* Manage day-to-day accounting activities and ensure accurate and complete maintenance of books of accounts in the company's accounting system.
* Oversee accounts payable, accounts receivable, banking transactions, payroll accounting, employee reimbursements and other financial transactions.
* Ensure proper documentation, verification and accounting of all financial transactions.

**2. Financial Reporting & Month-End Closure**

* Manage monthly, quarterly and year-end closure of accounts.
* Perform ledger scrutiny, account reconciliations, accruals, provisions and preparation of financial statements and supporting schedules.
* Prepare periodic MIS reports and financial statements for management review.
* Ensure timely and accurate financial reporting in accordance with applicable accounting standards.

**3. Taxation & Statutory Compliance**

* Handle applicable GST, TDS, income tax, PF and other statutory compliances.
* Prepare tax workings, coordinate with consultants and ensure timely filing of returns and payment of statutory dues.
* Maintain statutory records and monitor compliance deadlines to ensure adherence to applicable regulations.

**4. Banking & Reconciliation**

* Manage day-to-day banking and payment activities.
* Ensure timely reconciliation of bank accounts, vendor accounts, customer balances, statutory accounts and other balance sheet items.
* Monitor outstanding balances and follow up on discrepancies and pending settlements.

**5. Intercompany Accounting & Group Coordination**

* Maintain and reconcile intercompany transactions and balances.
* Coordinate with the holding company and other group entities on accounting, financial reporting and related finance requirements.
* Ensure accuracy and consistency of intercompany accounting records and timely resolution of reconciliation differences.

**6. Costing & Transfer Pricing**

* Prepare cost workings for intercompany cost-plus billing.
* Support transfer-pricing documentation, intercompany reconciliations and related compliance requirements.
* Coordinate with tax and transfer-pricing consultants for necessary documentation and filings.

**7. Audit & Professional Coordination**

* Coordinate with the Company Secretary, statutory and internal auditors, tax consultants and other professional advisors.
* Provide necessary financial records, schedules, supporting documents and clarifications for audits and statutory filings.
* Maintain and monitor the compliance calendar to ensure timely completion of statutory and regulatory requirements.

**8. Budgeting & Financial Planning**

* Support preparation of budgets, cash-flow forecasts and periodic financial plans.
* Assist in financial analysis, expense monitoring and variance analysis.
* Provide relevant financial information and reports to support management decision-making.

**9. Other Responsibilities**

* Undertake additional finance, accounting, reporting and compliance-related responsibilities as assigned from time to time.

**Desired Skills & Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of accounting principles, financial reporting and taxation.
* Hands-on experience in GST, TDS, income tax and other statutory compliances.
* Experience in managing month-end and year-end financial closures.
* Knowledge of intercompany accounting, cost-plus billing and transfer-pricing requirements.
* Proficiency in accounting software and MS Excel.
* Strong analytical, reconciliation and problem-solving skills.
* Good coordination and communication skills to work with internal stakeholders, group entities and external consultants.
* High attention to detail, ownership and ability to meet deadlines.
* Ability to independently manage routine finance and accounting operations.

title: Manager - Management Consulting
description:
**About the Role:**

We are seeking a motivated and talented professional with a strong understanding of Discoms, power markets, procurement, policy and regulatory developments, energy transition and strategic advisory. The candidate should possess sufficient technical understanding to assess emerging energy-sector solutions, while ensuring high-quality deliverables, regulatory compliance and timely, responsive support to client requirements.

**Detailed expectations from the role:**

* Discom Power Planning and Optimization Advise State Discoms on power procurement planning, resource adequacy, power shortage/surplus assessment and optimization of power purchase costs, including evaluation of short-, medium- and long-term procurement options.
* Data Analytics, Energy Modelling and Decision Support Undertake power-sector data analysis, energy modelling and scenario assessment to support procurement strategy, project evaluation, market assessment and management decision-making, including development of analytical dashboards and management presentations.
* Renewable Energy Strategy and Energy Transition Advisory Support clients in developing renewable energy strategies and transition roadmaps, including assessment of procurement options, renewable power sourcing, open access/captive solutions, storage and emerging RE procurement mechanisms.
* Policy, Regulatory and Market Analysis Analyze policy, regulatory and market developments affecting renewable energy, power procurement and electricity markets, and assess their implications for clients’ projects, business strategies and investment decisions.
* Capacity Building and Stakeholder Engagement Design and support delivery of training, workshops and capacity-building programmes on renewable energy, power markets, procurement, clean-energy transition and related sector developments; engage with utilities, government agencies, developers and other stakeholders.
* Project Implementation and PMC Support Support implementation and monitoring of renewable energy projects, including coordination with project stakeholders, review of key deliverables, tracking of project progress, and identification and escalation of technical, commercial and regulatory issues.

**Required skill set**

* Experience in power-sector consulting, advisory or project management, preferably with exposure to Discoms, power markets, renewable energy or energy transition.
* Understanding of power-sector business, market and commercial aspects, including power procurement, power markets, resource planning and related decision-making processes.
* Strong analytical, communication and presentation skills, with the ability to develop reports, presentations, analytical assessments and client-facing deliverables.
* Understanding of policy, regulatory and market developments across the power sector, including their implications for utilities, market participants and energy-sector businesses.
* Understanding of energy transition themes, including renewable energy integration, decarbonization, energy efficiency, energy storage and evolving power-sector business models.
* Working knowledge of key power-sector regulatory and commercial frameworks, including open access, captive/group captive, power procurement, transmission and distribution-related regulations and applicable charges.
* Experience in supporting power procurement, tendering and commercial processes, including preparation/review of RFPs, bid documents, evaluation frameworks and related documentation.
* Ability to undertake market assessment, techno-commercial analysis and evaluation of strategic options, and support clients in developing recommendations and implementation roadmaps.
* Ability to track and interpret regulations, policies and guidelines issued by CERC, SERCs, MoP, MNRE and other relevant sector institutions, and assess their implications for clients.
* Good understanding of emerging power-market and energy-transition developments, including renewable energy procurement, FDRE/RTC, BESS, pumped storage and other flexibility solutions.

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, preferred streams are Electrical, Mechanical or any related field. Master's degree preferred (MBA/M. Tech).
* At least 7 years of relevant experience.

**Location**

* Base location shall be Chennai. However, the role would require the applicant to undertake travel or relocation for pursuing various opportunities.

**Remuneration Structure**

* We offer a motivation based and competitive reward package.

title: Chief Financial Officer (CFO) – Chartered Accountant
description:
Chief Financial Officer (CFO) – Chartered Accountant

Function: Finance, Strategy & Governance

Location: Chennai

Experience: 4-6 years

Employment: Full-time

About JustAct

Founded in 2019, JustAct is one of the world's leading AI-powered Online Dispute Resolution (ODR) platforms. We enable organizations, institutions, businesses, and individuals to resolve disputes through technology-enabled Negotiation, Mediation, Arbitration, and allied legal services.

Trusted by leading banks, NBFCs, enterprises, and arbitral institutions globally, JustAct combines legal expertise with cutting-edge technology to make dispute resolution faster, more efficient, and more accessible.

About the Role

We are seeking a commercially astute Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to lead JustAct’s

financial strategy, planning, governance, and performance management.

The CFO will partner with the CEO and Board on business strategy, profitability, capital

allocation, fundraising, and expansion. This is a hands-on leadership role requiring the

ability to combine strategic financial planning with strong execution across cash flow,

financial controls, and operational finance.

Key Responsibilities

1. Financial Strategy & Business Planning

● Develop and execute financial strategies aligned with business goals and

long-term growth.

● Lead budgeting, forecasting, financial modelling, and scenario planning.

● Establish robust MIS, dashboards, and business-unit profitability reporting.

● Analyse financial performance, identify risks and opportunities, and recommend

corrective actions.

● Evaluate new products, partnerships, investments, pricing, and international

expansion opportunities.

2. Cash Flow & Working Capital Management

● Own cash flow forecasting, treasury, liquidity planning, and capital allocation.

● Improve receivables, collections, payables, and working capital efficiency in

collaboration with business teams.

● Monitor operating costs, margins, and profitability to support sustainable growth.

● Evaluate financing options and optimise capital utilisation.

3. Fundraising & Investor Relations

● Prepare investor-ready financial models, business plans, projections, and

valuation analyses.

● Support fundraising, financial due diligence, investor reporting, and data-room

preparation.

● Build relationships with investors, lenders, and financial institutions.

● Partner with the CEO and Board on funding strategies, capital structure, and

investment decisions.

4. Accounting, Compliance & Governance

● Oversee accounting, financial reporting, audits, taxation, and statutory

compliance.

● Strengthen internal financial controls, approval frameworks, SOPs, and risk

management.

● Ensure accurate and timely financial statements and regulatory filings.

● Manage relationships with auditors, tax advisors, bankers, and other external

stakeholders.

● Establish appropriate financial oversight for international operations and

cross-border transactions, as applicable.

5. Commercial Finance & Business Performance

● Partner with sales, product, technology, and operations teams on commercial and

financial decisions.

● Develop pricing models, margin analyses, and product-level profitability

assessments.

● Evaluate customer economics, revenue concentration, and opportunities for cost

optimisation.

● Support strategic partnerships, enterprise contracts, and market expansion

decisions.

6. Finance Team & Systems

● Build and lead a high-performing finance function with clear responsibilities and

accountability.

● Implement scalable financial systems, ERP tools, reporting automation, and

efficient workflows.

● Develop strong financial discipline and a culture of ownership across the

organisation.

Qualifications & Experience

● Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) – mandatory.

● 4-6 years of relevant professional experience, including significant experience in

senior finance leadership.

● Experience in technology, SaaS, FinTech, financial services, Legal-Tech, or other

high-growth businesses is an advantage.

● Exposure to fundraising, investor management, and international operations is

highly desirable.

Why Join JustAct?

● Work directly with the CEO and Board to shape financial strategy and business

growth.

● Influence profitability, capital allocation, fundraising, and long-term enterprise

value.

● Build a scalable, technology-enabled finance function in a growing Legal-Tech

company.

● Play a key leadership role in strengthening governance and supporting domestic

and international expansion.

● Make a direct impact on the company's next phase of growth.

title: Venture Development Fellow
description:

**BuildWithMe.Studio | Venture Studio**

3 Months

Fellowship

Remote

₹5,000 per month

About BuildWithMe.Studio

BuildWithMe.Studio is a founder-first venture studio focused on discovering promising business opportunities, validating real-world problems and building meaningful ventures.

We work at the intersection of market research, customer discovery, business strategy and venture development.

We are looking for a curious, analytical and research-oriented individual who wants to understand how startups are built from the ground up.

As a Venture Development Fellow, you will work closely with the Founder and participate in identifying opportunities, researching markets, understanding customer problems and evaluating potential startup ideas.

This fellowship offers practical exposure to the venture-building process and an opportunity to learn by working on real-world business opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Opportunity Discovery**

* Research emerging markets, industries and business opportunities.
* Identify real customer problems and potential startup opportunities.
* Analyse market trends and emerging business models.
* Identify gaps in existing products and services.
* Evaluate opportunities worth exploring further.

**2. Market & Customer Research**

* Conduct primary and secondary market research.
* Support customer discovery and conduct customer interviews.
* Analyse target customers, behaviours and pain points.
* Research market size, demand and commercial potential.
* Study competitors and existing market solutions.

**3. Venture Development**

* Develop Business Model Canvases and initial business models.
* Evaluate startup ideas and their feasibility.
* Support venture validation experiments.
* Document assumptions, hypotheses, evidence and findings.
* Prepare recommendations on whether an opportunity deserves further validation.

**4. Research & Documentation**

* Prepare structured market and opportunity research reports.
* Maintain the BuildWithMe opportunity pipeline.
* Document research findings, learning and decisions.
* Work directly with the Founder to evaluate promising opportunities.

What You Will Learn

During this fellowship, you will gain practical exposure to:

* Opportunity Discovery
* Customer Discovery
* Problem Validation
* Primary & Secondary Market Research
* Competitor Analysis
* Customer Interviews
* Market Sizing
* Business Model Development
* Venture Validation
* Startup Strategy
* Build-or-Kill Decisions

Expected Outcomes After 3 Months

By the end of the fellowship, you will have contributed to:

* Multiple market and opportunity research projects.
* Customer discovery conversations and insights.
* Startup opportunity assessments.
* Business Model Canvas development exercises.
* Venture validation experiments.
* At least one detailed venture opportunity report.
* A documented portfolio of your research, work and learning.

Who Should Apply?

We welcome applications from:

* College students and recent graduates.
* Aspiring entrepreneurs and future founders.
* Business, Engineering, Management and Economics students.
* Research-oriented individuals.
* Startup enthusiasts interested in venture building.

We value curiosity, ownership, analytical thinking and willingness to learn more than academic credentials alone.

Preferred Skills

* Research and analytical thinking.
* Critical thinking and problem-solving.
* Strong written and verbal communication.
* Structured approach to solving problems.
* Basic understanding of business and startups.
* Familiarity with Excel / Google Sheets.
* Presentation and report preparation skills.

Why Join BuildWithMe.Studio?

This is not just an opportunity to study startups. It is an opportunity to understand how ventures are discovered, evaluated and developed.

You will:

* Work directly with the Founder.
* Explore real-world business problems.
* Contribute to actual venture research.
* Learn practical startup evaluation frameworks.
* Gain hands-on experience in venture development.
* Build a portfolio of research and venture development work.

Fellowship Details

* **Duration:**
  3 Months
* **Mode:**
  Remote
* **Monthly Stipend:**
  ₹5,000
* **Total Stipend:**

How to Apply

Interested candidates can apply through LinkedIn.

We encourage applicants to share their resume along with a brief note explaining why they are interested in venture development and what they hope to learn from this fellowship.

**If you are curious about how ideas become businesses and want to learn by doing, we would love to hear from you.**

title: Senior Commercial Engineer

Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.
  
  
We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!
  
  
**Job Description**
The Sr. Commercial Engineer owns the commercial side of the AMAT Panels business, from enquiry to order. The role turns customer requests into accurate,, and profitable quotations, builds strong relationships with customer buying and engineering teams, and helps the sales team win and close orders.
  
  
You will work closely with sales, the Strategic Business Unit (SBU), engineering, operations, quality, and finance to prepare cost estimates and financial proposals, position products on price and value against competitors, manage contract terms and order entry, and maintain the local order forecast. The role is the main commercial contact for customers on pricing, terms, order status, and warranty claims.
  
  
You will report to the Global Business Manager and will work in an Hybrid work mode based at Chennai Oragadam, India.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**
**Commercial Quotations & Cost Estimation**

* Respond to customer RFQs and enquiries by reviewing specifications, drawings and commercial terms, and by clarifying scope, exceptions and deviations with customers and sales.
* Prepare cost estimates, quotations and financial proposals for control panel and LV panel solutions, working with engineering on BOMs and with suppliers on material and component pricing.
* Work with the SBU on pricing strategy and competitive positioning; evaluate competitor product features, pricing and positioning, and recommend pricing to win profitable business.

**Senior Manager – Corporate Real Estate Governance**
**About The Role**
As a
**Senior Manager – Corporate Real Estate Governance**
, you will provide governance leadership across Corporate Real Estate projects, contracts, commercial models, and third-party engagements. You will be a key member of the Corporate Real Estate team, collaborating with Legal, Finance, Procurement, Compliance, Business Leadership, and external partners to ensure all initiatives are commercially sound, compliant, and aligned with enterprise governance standards.

**In This Role, You Will**

* Lead governance oversight across major Corporate Real Estate projects, including site acquisitions, expansions, consolidations, exits, capital expenditure programs, fit-outs, and workplace technology implementations.

* Govern commercial contracts and vendor agreements across Integrated Facilities Management, Facilities Management Services, construction, and strategic outsourcing engagements.
* Provide governance advisory and risk-based recommendations to leadership teams during negotiations, RFPs, contract renewals, and key commercial decisions.
* Drive third-party risk oversight, financial governance, policy compliance, audit readiness, and continuous improvement while fostering collaboration across functional stakeholders.

* Extensive experience in Corporate Real Estate Governance, Contract Management, Commercial Governance, Enterprise Risk Management, Compliance, or related disciplines.
* Strong expertise in contract management and governance, including contract review, interpretation, change management, amendments, and enforcement of contractual obligations.
* Deep commercial acumen with experience evaluating commercial models, pricing structures, cost management approaches, financial controls, and business cases.

* Exceptional stakeholder management, influencing, communication, and collaboration skills across Legal, Finance, Procurement, Corporate Real Estate, and Business Leadership teams.
* Strong analytical thinking, decision-making, problem-solving, negotiation, and advisory capabilities.
* Bachelor's Degree in Law, Business Administration, Commerce, Finance, Engineering, Real Estate, Facilities Management, or a related discipline.
* A strong sense of ownership, desire to create meaningful outcomes, and passion for work that serves a greater purpose.
* The embodiment of Cognizant’s Values of: Work as One, Dare to Innovate, Raise the Bar, Do The Right Thing, and Own It.

**These will help you succeed**

* MBA (Finance, Operations, Strategy), Master's in Real Estate, or an equivalent postgraduate qualification.
* Experience with Corporate Real Estate technologies such as IWMS, CAFM, Planon, Archibus, ServiceNow Workplace, or similar platforms.
* Knowledge of AI, automation, analytics, and governance reporting solutions.
* Familiarity with ESG, sustainability, and green building frameworks including LEED, WELL, GRI, and ISO 14001.

* Experience supporting global RFPs, outsourcing programs, and vendor transitions.

* Experience working within highly matrixed multinational organizations across India and APAC.
* Advanced capabilities in Power BI, Excel analytics, dashboarding, and executive reporting.
* Experience supporting transformation programs, change management initiatives, and stakeholder engagement activities.
* Professional certifications such as:

+ Certified Commercial Contracts Manager (CCCM) / WorldCC
+ PMP or PRINCE2
+ ISO 37301 Compliance Management
+ Enterprise Risk Management (ERM)
+ Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt
