title: Manager, Business Operations
description:
**The Company**
PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.
  
  
We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
  
  
We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.
  
  
Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.
  
  
**Job Summary:**
**What Do You Need To Know About The Role**
The Core Platforms Technology team is looking for a talented, self-driven, and analytically minded Business Operations professional. Reporting to the Chief of Staff, the Business Operations Analyst will partner with engineering leaders and cross-functional teams to improve operating discipline, generate actionable insights, and enable data-driven decision-making across the organization.
  
  
This role combines business operations, data analysis, workforce and capacity planning, portfolio governance, communications, and program execution.
  
  
Meet Our Team
  
  
The Business Operations team supports the Core Platforms Technology leadership team and helps the organization operate effectively at scale. We partner closely with Engineering, Product, Finance, People, Strategy, and other Business Operations teams to translate business priorities into measurable plans and coordinated execution.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**Essential Responsibilities:**

* Lead functional projects and programs to optimize operational processes.
* Identify issues and recommend best practices for process improvements.
* Partner with various departments to understand business trends.
* Drive business or process improvements within the function.
* Provide oversight and support for planning and management of financial, budget, and headcount targets.
* Act as a point of contact or liaison between business leadership, staff, and other key partners.
* Promote transparent reporting and foster a culture of data-driven decision-making by defining key metrics and evaluating progress.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* 5+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:**
**Your Day-to-Day Responsibilities**
In this role, you will:
  
  

* Prepare, analyze, and interpret organizational and operational data, including workforce census, OKRs, KPIs, capacity, investment plans, roadmaps, delivery health, and other leadership reporting.
* Translate data into actionable insights, clearly identifying trends, risks, dependencies, and opportunities for leadership consideration.
* Create dashboards, executive presentations, and decision-support materials that communicate complex information clearly and concisely.
* Partner with engineering and product teams to maintain data quality, reporting accuracy, and consistent operating metrics.
* Support annual and quarterly planning processes, including workforce planning, capacity planning, resource allocation, and scenario modelling for employees and contingent workers.
* Support portfolio and operating reviews by tracking priorities, milestones, risks, dependencies, decisions, and follow-through.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and improve recurring operational processes and reporting.
* Use company-approved AI and automation tools to accelerate analysis, generate initial insights, synthesize information, and improve the efficiency of reporting and communications.
* Evaluate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, relevance, bias, and business context, while adhering to applicable data privacy, security, and responsible-AI requirements.
* Help develop and maintain operating playbooks, training materials, communications, templates, and best practices for the organization.
* Develop leadership messaging for internal communications, organizational updates, operating reviews, and executive presentations.
* Support employee engagement and organizational effectiveness initiatives in partnership with People Business Partners and business leaders.
* Lead or contribute to cross-functional initiatives and special projects, from problem definition and analysis through implementation and measurement of outcomes.

**What You Need To Bring**

* 5+ years of experience in business operations, strategic planning, analytics, program management, technical project management, or a related discipline, preferably within a technology or engineering organization.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to convert data into insights, recommendations, and executive-level narratives.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
* Working knowledge of data-analysis and visualization tools such as SQL, Power BI, Tableau, Looker or equivalent platforms.
* Practical experience using generative AI or AI-enabled productivity tools for research, data synthesis, reporting, communications, workflow improvement, or decision support.
* Understanding of responsible AI use, including data confidentiality, output validation, bias awareness, and appropriate human oversight.
* Ability to identify repeatable processes that can be simplified or automated using AI, workflow tools, or low-code solutions.
* Strong execution orientation, with demonstrated ownership from problem definition through delivery and follow-through.
* Excellent written, verbal, and visual communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with senior executives and technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities, meet deadlines, and adapt quickly in an environment characterized by change and ambiguity.
* Proven ability to work independently while collaborating effectively in a cross-functional, matrixed organization.
* Ability to establish credibility, build trusted relationships, and influence stakeholders without direct authority.
* Sound judgment and the ability to balance business partnership with constructive challenge and timely escalation of risks.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting platform engineering, infrastructure, cloud, developer productivity, enterprise technology, or another complex technical organization.
* Experience with portfolio management, technology investment planning, engineering capacity planning, or organizational health metrics.
* Familiarity with automation or low-code tools such as Power Automate, Copilot, or similar platforms.
* Experience designing executive dashboards, conducting scenario analysis, or developing business cases.
* Demonstrated curiosity about emerging AI capabilities and their application to business and engineering operations.

**Subsidiary:**
PayPal
  
  
**Travel Percent:**
0
  
  
PayPal does not charge candidates any fees for courses, applications, resume reviews, interviews, background checks, or onboarding. When making an application directly, we will never ask you to share passwords, one-time passcodes (OTP), or verification codes. Any such request is a red flag and likely part of a scam. All communication regarding your application will come from official PayPal email domains. If you suspect fraudulent activity, please report it immediately. To learn more about how to identify and avoid recruitment fraud please visit https://careers.pypl.com/contact-us.
  
  
For the majority of employees, PayPal's balanced hybrid work model offers 3 days in the office for effective in-person collaboration and 2 days at your choice of either the PayPal office or your home workspace, ensuring that you equally have the benefits and conveniences of both locations.
  
  
**Our Benefits:**
At PayPal, we’re committed to building an equitable and inclusive global economy. And we can’t do this without our most important asset-you. That’s why we offer comprehensive, choice-based programs, to support all aspects of personal wellbeing—physical, emotional, and financial—delivering meaningful value where it matters most. We strive to create a flexible, balanced work culture with a holistic approach to benefits, including generous paid time off, healthcare coverage for you and your family, and resources to create financial security and support your mental health.
  
  
**Who We Are:**
Click Here to learn more about our culture and community.
  
  
**Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
PayPal provides equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. In addition, PayPal will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you are unable to submit an application because of incompatible assistive technology or a disability, please contact us at paypalglobaltalentacquisition@paypal.com.
  
  
**Belonging at PayPal:**
Our employees are central to advancing our mission, and we strive to create an environment where everyone can do their best work with a sense of purpose and belonging. Belonging at PayPal means creating a workplace with a sense of acceptance and security where all employees feel included and valued. We are proud to have a diverse workforce reflective of the merchants, consumers, and communities that we serve, and we continue to take tangible actions to cultivate inclusivity and belonging at PayPal.

* Ensure technical staff follow client requirements, safety procedures and operational SOPs.
* Monitor maintenance activities, breakdowns and preventive maintenance schedules.
* Identify operational gaps and take corrective action.

* Monitor discipline, performance and retention of technical staff.

* Monitor manpower requirements, deployment status and vacancies.
* Track pending recruitment requirements and ensure timely closure.
* Report operational challenges, client feedback and corrective actions to management.
* Monitor site performance and ensure agreed service standards are maintained.

* Excellent communication and client-handling skills.

* Timely closure of technical manpower requirements.
* Minimum manpower shortages across assigned sites.
* Smooth and efficient site operations.
* High client satisfaction and effective complaint resolution.
* Better employee retention and engagement.
* Consistent operational performance and reporting.

**The ideal candidate must be equally strong in technical manpower sourcing, site operations and client relationship management.**

title: Manager, Business Operations
description:
**The Company**

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

**Job Summary:**

What do you need to know about the role
  
  
The Core Platforms Technology team is looking for a talented, self-driven, and analytically minded Business Operations professional. Reporting to the Chief of Staff, the Business Operations Analyst will partner with engineering leaders and cross-functional teams to improve operating discipline, generate actionable insights, and enable data-driven decision-making across the organization.
  
This role combines business operations, data analysis, workforce and capacity planning, portfolio governance, communications, and program execution.
  
  
Meet Our Team
  
  
The Business Operations team supports the Core Platforms Technology leadership team and helps the organization operate effectively at scale. We partner closely with Engineering, Product, Finance, People, Strategy, and other Business Operations teams to translate business priorities into measurable plans and coordinated execution.

**Job Description:**

**Essential Responsibilities:**

* Lead functional projects and programs to optimize operational processes.
* Identify issues and recommend best practices for process improvements.
* Partner with various departments to understand business trends.
* Drive business or process improvements within the function.
* Provide oversight and support for planning and management of financial, budget, and headcount targets.
* Act as a point of contact or liaison between business leadership, staff, and other key partners.
* Promote transparent reporting and foster a culture of data-driven decision-making by defining key metrics and evaluating progress.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* 5+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications****:**

### **Your Day-to-Day Responsibilities**

  
  

In this role, you will:

  
  

* Prepare, analyze, and interpret organizational and operational data, including workforce census, OKRs, KPIs, capacity, investment plans, roadmaps, delivery health, and other leadership reporting.
* Translate data into actionable insights, clearly identifying trends, risks, dependencies, and opportunities for leadership consideration.
* Create dashboards, executive presentations, and decision-support materials that communicate complex information clearly and concisely.
* Partner with engineering and product teams to maintain data quality, reporting accuracy, and consistent operating metrics.
* Support annual and quarterly planning processes, including workforce planning, capacity planning, resource allocation, and scenario modelling for employees and contingent workers.
* Support portfolio and operating reviews by tracking priorities, milestones, risks, dependencies, decisions, and follow-through.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and improve recurring operational processes and reporting.
* Use company-approved AI and automation tools to accelerate analysis, generate initial insights, synthesize information, and improve the efficiency of reporting and communications.
* Evaluate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, relevance, bias, and business context, while adhering to applicable data privacy, security, and responsible-AI requirements.
* Help develop and maintain operating playbooks, training materials, communications, templates, and best practices for the organization.
* Develop leadership messaging for internal communications, organizational updates, operating reviews, and executive presentations.
* Support employee engagement and organizational effectiveness initiatives in partnership with People Business Partners and business leaders.
* Lead or contribute to cross-functional initiatives and special projects, from problem definition and analysis through implementation and measurement of outcomes.

### **What You Need to Bring**

  
  

* 5+ years of experience in business operations, strategic planning, analytics, program management, technical project management, or a related discipline, preferably within a technology or engineering organization.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to convert data into insights, recommendations, and executive-level narratives.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
* Working knowledge of data-analysis and visualization tools such as SQL, Power BI, Tableau, Looker or equivalent platforms.
* Practical experience using generative AI or AI-enabled productivity tools for research, data synthesis, reporting, communications, workflow improvement, or decision support.
* Understanding of responsible AI use, including data confidentiality, output validation, bias awareness, and appropriate human oversight.
* Ability to identify repeatable processes that can be simplified or automated using AI, workflow tools, or low-code solutions.
* Strong execution orientation, with demonstrated ownership from problem definition through delivery and follow-through.
* Excellent written, verbal, and visual communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with senior executives and technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities, meet deadlines, and adapt quickly in an environment characterized by change and ambiguity.
* Proven ability to work independently while collaborating effectively in a cross-functional, matrixed organization.
* Ability to establish credibility, build trusted relationships, and influence stakeholders without direct authority.
* Sound judgment and the ability to balance business partnership with constructive challenge and timely escalation of risks.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  

  

### **Preferred Qualifications**

  
  

* Experience supporting platform engineering, infrastructure, cloud, developer productivity, enterprise technology, or another complex technical organization.
* Experience with portfolio management, technology investment planning, engineering capacity planning, or organizational health metrics.
* Familiarity with automation or low-code tools such as Power Automate, Copilot, or similar platforms.
* Experience designing executive dashboards, conducting scenario analysis, or developing business cases.

PayPal

title: Guest Relation Manager
description:
**About The Opportunity**

* This role serves as the property Manager on Duty, overseeing all front office operations at a Marriott property with a focus on delivering exceptional hospitality and service excellence.
* The Guest Relation Manager acts as the primary representative of property management in resolving guest-related issues and ensures seamless lobby operations and service recovery.

Role & Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead and supervise the guest services team, demonstrating strong interpersonal and communication skills to influence, coach, and build mutual trust among associates.
* Serve as a role model for appropriate behaviors and ensure associates uphold hospitality standards and operational excellence.
* Manage day-to-day front office operations, including understanding associate roles well enough to perform duties during absences.
* Celebrate team successes and publicly recognize contributions to foster motivation and morale.
* Maintain open, collaborative relationships with associates and ensure team cohesion.
* Conduct daily operational checks including occupancy, arrivals, departures, and briefing attendance.
* Read and act on GR Log Book and DIR; print and action trace report A136 and pre-arrival screening reports.
* Maintain consistent lobby presence to welcome guests, assist with requests, and resolve issues promptly.
* Review Daily Incident Reports and coordinate with Department Manager for service recovery actions.
* Prepare and maintain welcome drink stations, guest preference sheets, and amenity vouchers for upcoming arrivals.
* Collect and track minimum 3 guest feedbacks daily, update profiles with guest preferences, and report to Guest Voice.
* Print and review guest birthday report (C102) to arrange personalized amenities for celebrating guests.
* Conduct courtesy calls to unwell guests and deliver 'get well soon' cards with amenities.
* Perform random checks on in-house preference sheets and resolve discrepancies with Housekeeping.
* Prepare departure gifts with thank-you notes for elite and long-stay guests departing the next day.
* Interact with elite guests at the Marriott Club to collect feedback and enhance loyalty.
* Conduct courtesy calls and feedback collection for elite and long-stay guests prior to departure.
* Arrange tea/coffee with wake-up calls for Platinum and Gold members and inform AYS accordingly.
* Prepare focus letters for next day arrivals and update the Total Amenity sheet.
* Complete and file daily checklists, trace reports, VIP departure reports, and shift handovers.
* Respond to guest complaints and problems promptly, empowering associates to deliver excellent service.
* Monitor associate service behaviors and provide feedback to improve performance.
* Participate in developing corrective action plans to enhance guest satisfaction.
* Provide immediate assistance to guests and ensure all associates understand customer service expectations.
* Identify developmental needs of team members and provide coaching, mentoring, and on-the-job training.
* Participate in performance appraisals, progressive discipline procedures, and associate satisfaction reviews.
* Communicate effectively via phone, email, or in person with supervisors, peers, and subordinates.
* Analyze information to solve problems and make decisions; maintain high visibility in public areas during peak times.
* Implement all emergency plans including fire, theft, bomb threats, elevator incidents, and medical emergencies.
* Perform Front Desk duties during high-demand periods to ensure service continuity.

**Skills & Qualifications**
Must-Have
  
  

* Proven leadership and interpersonal skills to manage and motivate a guest services team.
* Ability to handle guest complaints, resolve service issues, and implement corrective actions.
* Strong organizational skills to manage daily checklists, reports, and shift handovers.
* Experience with property software systems (e.g., Guestware, FOSSE) for tracking and resolving guest issues.
* Proficiency in basic computer skills including word processing and internet browsers.
* Strong oral and written communication skills to interact with guests and team members.
* Ability to perform basic mathematical calculations for operational tasks.
* Understanding of Marriott’s Spirit to Serve and commitment to delivering exceptional guest experiences.
* Availability to work flexible hours including peak times and emergencies.

**Preferred**

* Prior experience in luxury hotel front office or guest relations roles.
* Familiarity with Marriott’s guest rewards programs and property-specific amenities.
* Experience in managing elite guest interactions and personalized service delivery.
* Knowledge of local attractions and ability to provide guest recommendations.

Benefits & Culture Highlights
  
  

* Opportunity to lead a dynamic guest services team within a globally recognized hospitality brand.
* Professional development through coaching, mentoring, and training initiatives.
* Exposure to diverse guest interactions and high-impact service recovery scenarios.
* Collaborative work environment that values inclusion, teamwork, and associate recognition.

**Position Summary**

**Position Summary**
Level: Manager or equivalent
  
  
We are seeking a Sales Operations Technologist Manager to lead the design and implementation of scalable Sales Operations solutions across CRM, CPQ, ERP, data, analytics, and AI platforms. This role combines deep Sales Operations domain expertise with solution architecture, systems integration, automation, delivery leadership, and practical application of Agentic AI.

The Manager will lead client engagements, shape solution strategies, develop high-performing teams, and contribute to the growth of our Sales Operations and commercial technology capabilities.
  
  
**Work you’ll do:**
As a Manager, you will lead multidisciplinary teams and work directly with client executives, commercial leaders, business stakeholders, IT organizations, data teams, and technology partners to deliver measurable business outcomes. You will be responsible for shaping solutions from strategy and discovery through design, implementation, adoption, and value realization.
  
  
You will lead and oversee work across the following areas:
  
  

* Translate Sales Operations requirements into scalable solutions supporting territory and account alignment, segmentation and targeting, quota and incentive planning, sales forecasting, pipeline and opportunity management, account planning, field productivity, pricing and quoting, approvals, and commercial performance reporting.
* Define enterprise solution architectures and delivery approaches integrating CRM, CPQ, ERP, data, analytics, workflow, and AI platforms.
* Lead implementations and solution delivery across platforms such as Salesforce, Veeva, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle, SAP, and other enterprise applications.

title: Senior Manager, Applied AI
description:
**Position Summary**
The Manager, Applied AI leads TTEC’s AI Delivery Team, a focused enterprise capability for delivering, operating, and scaling responsible AI. The team converts prioritized business needs into secure, reliable, and measurable AI solutions, owning reusable platforms, technical patterns, integrations, targeted Forward Engineering support, and production operations while enabling teams across the enterprise to build within approved guardrails. This role is accountable for team leadership and execution, including capacity, prioritization, talent, and delivery management. At launch, the role also carries AI product leadership responsibilities, shaping opportunities, defining the delivery backlog, and driving adoption, until a dedicated AI Product Leader is added as the team matures. The successful candidate combines strong people leadership with enough technical depth to guide architecture, integration, and AI operations work, builds trusted partnerships with business leaders, the development-focused organization, Data Engineering, Security, Legal, Privacy, and RAIC, and keeps the team focused on measurable business outcomes over technology experimentation alone.
  
  

* AI Delivery Team leadership (AI Architect, Integration Engineers, AI Operations Engineers, and future Forward Engineers and AI Product Leader)
* Intake, prioritization, and delivery management (Shape, Design, Build or Partner, Enable, Operate, and Scale lifecycle)
* AI platforms and reusable patterns (agents, copilots, connectors, and production-readiness criteria)
* Enterprise integration and AI action enablement (APIs, MCP servers, connectors, and workflow automation)
* AI production operations (monitoring, incident response, performance management, and usage analytics)
* AI economics and consumption (token utilization, API consumption, budget forecasting, and cost efficiency)
* Responsible AI governance alignment (Security, Legal, Privacy, and RAIC standards and oversight)
* AI adoption and enablement (federated delivery by business and technology teams within approved guardrails)

**Duties & Responsibilities**

* Lead, coach, and develop the AI Delivery Team, including the AI Architect, Integration Engineers, and AI Operations Engineers on Day 1, and Forward Engineers and an AI Product Leader as the team matures.
* Own team capacity planning, work prioritization, and delivery management so the team’s work reflects enterprise priorities and measurable business value.
* Lead the Shape stage of the delivery lifecycle, confirming the problem, value, scope, delivery path, sponsorship, and ownership for each opportunity before work begins.
* Match each opportunity to the appropriate delivery path based on scale, complexity, and organizational impact, and transition broader enterprise and cross-functional work to the development-focused organization.
* Establish and run the team’s operating rhythm across the full lifecycle (Shape, Design, Build or Partner, Enable, Operate, and Scale), with clear handoffs and accountability at each stage.
* Stand up the Day 1 foundation: establish the technical foundation, integrate priority systems, stabilize AI operations, create initial support processes, and define the delivery backlog.
* Ensure production reliability, telemetry, cost, and support are treated as part of every solution rather than post-launch work, and oversee monitoring, incident response, and performance management for production AI services.
* Manage AI consumption and cost, including token and API utilization, budget forecasting, and cost efficiency, and report on tokenomic outcomes.
* Embed architectural, security, privacy, legal, and responsible AI requirements throughout delivery, partnering with Security, Legal, Privacy, and RAIC on standards, reviews, risk classification, and exceptions.
* Partner with Data Engineering as a shared service, defining AI data and retrieval requirements while the data organization provides pipelines, quality, access, indexing, and governance capabilities.
* Drive AI adoption and enablement by helping business and technology teams innovate safely within approved standards and guardrails, and by reusing successful patterns across the enterprise.
* Track and report team performance to leadership across delivery, business value, quality and trust, operations, economics, and federation measures.
* Lead the team’s evolution from its Day 1 structure to the long-term model, including onboarding Forward Engineers, right-sizing AI Operations, and separating people leadership from product and innovation leadership.
* Recruit, onboard, and retain talent, and build clear career paths and skill development in agent design, context engineering, integration, and AI observability.
* Keep the team and TTEC informed on the latest AI innovations, product updates, and guardrails, and translate them into roadmap and backlog priorities.
* Communicate delivery status, risks, value realized, and investment needs to executive stakeholders in clear business terms.
* Foster a team culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and responsible AI use.

**Basic Qualifications**

* BA/BS in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent work experience.
* 8+ years of experience in software engineering, systems engineering, cloud, or enterprise technology delivery, including 3+ years of people leadership managing technical teams.
* Hands-on experience delivering or operating AI, machine learning, or intelligent automation solutions in an enterprise environment.
* Working knowledge of generative AI concepts, including LLMs, agents, copilots, prompt and context engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and evaluation.
* Demonstrated experience managing delivery across a portfolio of work, including intake, prioritization, capacity planning, and backlog management.
* Experience with enterprise integration patterns, including REST APIs, connectors, identity and authentication, and workflow automation.
* Understanding of production operations practices, including monitoring, observability, incident management, performance tuning, and service reliability.
* Experience managing technology consumption and cost, including budgeting, forecasting, and platform or vendor cost optimization.
* Working knowledge of security, privacy, and compliance requirements as they apply to AI and data, including data access controls and responsible AI principles.
* Experience partnering with application development, data engineering, security, legal, and business stakeholders to deliver cross-functional outcomes.
* Experience working within enterprise incident, problem, and change management processes in an ITIL-based environment.
* Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, and change leadership skills, with the ability to translate technical work into business value.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Microsoft AI and automation platforms such as Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Power Automate, and Azure Logic Apps.
* Familiarity with agent frameworks and protocols such as Semantic Kernel, LangGraph, AutoGen, and Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Experience with AI observability and evaluation tools such as PromptFlow, LangSmith, or similar platforms.
* Experience integrating with enterprise platforms such as Microsoft 365, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Workday, SAP, or Jira.
* Familiarity with data platforms that support AI retrieval, such as Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Azure Data Factory, vector databases, and knowledge indexing.
* Experience with Agile, product management, or portfolio management practices and tools such as Asana or Jira.
* Relevant certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or equivalent AI or cloud certifications.

**What Sets You Apart**

* Experience building a new team from the ground up, establishing structure, operating rhythm, and trust in a newly formed function.
* A business-outcomes mindset that prioritizes measurable value, adoption, and process improvement over technology experimentation alone.
* Ability to set and hold clear delivery boundaries, taking on the right work and routing broader work to the right partners.
* Curiosity and fluency with the fast-moving AI landscape, balanced by sound judgment on risk, governance, and cost.
* Relationship builder who creates alignment, trust, and shared accountability with peers, cross-functional partners, and leadership.

**Primary Location**
India-Telangana-Hyderabad

* Anticipate attrition, backfill, renewal and transition requirements to protect delivery and billing continuity.

title: Head of Production & Game Design Mentor
description:
About Us

Backstage Pass Institute of Gaming is a specialised institution that trains the next generation of game developers, designers, and artists. Kyodai Gameworks is a game studio building original IP for mobile, PC and console. Its team includes industry experts, mentors, students, and Backstage Pass alumni.

We're looking for an experienced game designer and production leader to take on a dual role. You'll mentor student teams at Backstage Pass to international standards, and you'll lead projects and production at Kyodai Gameworks.

The Role

You'll report directly to the Founder on all Kyodai Gameworks projects and Backstage Pass student projects. The role combines creative leadership, production ownership and hands-on mentoring. You'll take games from concept to launch, and you'll help students build work that competes on a global stage.

What You'll DoAt Kyodai Gameworks

•     Head projects and production across the studio's slate of original IP for mobile, PC and console

•     Lead cross-functional teams through the full development cycle: concept, pre-production, production, launch and live operations

•     Own the publishing of Kyodai titles, including release planning, platform submissions, store presence and launch execution

•     Plan and deliver external game development projects for clients and partners, managing scope, timelines, budgets and quality

•     Set up and manage game analytics and attribution pipelines, and turn player data into design, retention and monetisation decisions

•     Track project progress, milestones and deadlines through project management tools, and report status to the Founder

•     Review revenue and KPI reports, and drive monetisation, LiveOps and optimisation initiatives to grow revenue from the studio's games

•     Build strong production processes, pipelines and team culture

•     Manage tasks and deadlines of reportees.

At Backstage Pass

•     Mentor student teams in building polished, playable games to international quality standards

•     Guide student projects from game idea and concept through prototyping to a finished game

•     Prepare and submit student games to international festivals, competitions and award events

•     Share industry best practices in game design, production and analytics with students

What We're Looking ForMust Have

•     8+ years of experience in game design, including shipped titles on mobile, PC and console

•     Strong hands-on experience with Unity and Unreal Engine

•     Proven production experience leading teams and delivering games on schedule

•     Strong track record of developing original game ideas and concepts from scratch

•     Hands-on experience setting up and using Game Analytics, Firebase, Google AdMob, and Unity Analytics

•     Experience with attribution tools such as Singular

•     Hands-on experience with project management tools such as Jira, Trello, Asana or ClickUp for tracking progress, deadlines and reporting

•     Experience reviewing revenue reports and taking action to increase game
revenue through monetisation, LiveOps and player data

•     Experience publishing games on app stores, Steam and/or console platforms

•     Ability to deliver external or client development projects

•     Passion for mentoring and developing young talent

•     Excellent communication, leadership and stakeholder management skills

Nice to Have

•     Games that have been recognised at international festivals or award events

•     Experience with other attribution and analytics tools such as AppsFlyer or Adjust

•     Familiarity with console certification processes

Why Join Us

•     Lead original IP across all major platforms

•     Shape the careers of the next generation of game developers

•     Work directly with the Founder and have real influence on studio and academic direction

•     Build games that compete and win on the international stage

How to Apply

Apply through LinkedIn or send your resume and portfolio (with links to shipped titles) to hemanjali@backstagepass.co.in

title: Founder's Office
description:
**About Roligt Foods**

Roligt Foods is building a next gen clean label beverage brand out of Hyderabad. We make drinks with short, honest ingredient lists and nothing we cannot defend. We are pre-launch, running live activations across the city and rolling out smart vending kiosks. As we scale, we are building a small team that owns outcomes, not tasks.

**The role**

This role in the Founder's Office works directly with the founder and sees the whole business. Based in Hyderabad, you track every vertical (kiosks, events, brand, sales, production and finance), spot what is slipping and push it to closure. You run the operating rhythm of the company and take on the problems that do not have an owner yet. This role suits someone who wants to learn how a consumer business is run end to end, and is comfortable being held to outcomes early.

**What you will do**

* Track the weekly numbers of every vertical: kiosk sales and uptime, events and leads, brand, production and cash.
* Run the weekly leadership review. Prepare the dashboard, capture decisions and chase every action to closure.
* Own special projects for the founder: new channels, partnerships, pricing and launch plans.
* Do the first-pass analysis on business questions and come back with a recommendation, not just data.
* Work with the kiosk, events, brand and finance leads to unblock work that sits between teams.
* Prepare investor, board and partner material: decks, memos and updates.
* Lead the Generalist Interns in the Founder's Office and review their work.

**You will do well here if you have**

* An MBA (final year or recent graduate) or an undergraduate degree from a strong programme. Any stream. Up to 3 years of experience in consulting, startups, FMCG or operations is a plus.
* Strong Excel or Google Sheets and clear structured thinking. You can build a simple model and explain it.
* Clear, short writing. You can turn a messy discussion into a one-page note.
* Comfort moving between strategy and execution in the same day.
* High ownership and the discipline to follow up until things are done.

**What we offer**

* Fair, competitive pay in line with industry standards, based on your experience and track record.
* Fast-track growth. You work directly with the founder and see a consumer business built from zero.
* Broad exposure across product, brand, events, retail and operations.
* Real ownership. Small team, fast decisions. Your work shows up in the numbers.

**Please do not apply if**

* You are not based in, or not willing to relocate to, Hyderabad.
* You want a fixed job description that never changes.
* You are not comfortable working closely with the founder and being challenged on your work.

**How to apply**

Apply with your resume. At the top of your resume, add two lines on one problem you owned end to end and what the result was.

We are selective about who we hire. If you do not hear back within three weeks of applying, please assume your application has not been taken forward this time.

title: Lead Systems Operations Engineer(Technology Major Incident Management)
description:
**About This Role**
Wells Fargo is seeking a Lead Systems Operations Engineer
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Lead complex, broad impact initiatives including provision of high level systems consultation for the technology teams
* Work as key participant in large scale planning of computer systems and network infrastructure for Systems Operations functional area
* Review and analyze complex technical challenges, as well as escalated support issues related to core business solutions that require in depth evaluation of multiple factors, such as alternatives, enhancements, periodic systems reviews, or improvements to existing systems
* Make decisions on technical changes and enhancements
* Consult with engineering team on change design requiring solid understanding of technical process controls or standards that influence and drive new initiatives
* Collaborate and consult with technical peers, colleagues, and mid to more experienced level managers to resolve systems support issues and achieve goals

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of Systems Engineering, Technology Architecture experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

**Desired Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in Major Incident Management, Production Support, or IT Service Management.
* Strong experience with major incident triage, monitoring tools, escalation frameworks, and command center operations.
* Strong knowledge of ITIL Incident Management principles and service management frameworks.
* Proven experience leading customer-impacting and regulatory-sensitive incidents.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience leading complex incident bridge calls involving multiple technical towers, vendors, and stakeholders.
* Excellent verbal and written communication, executive communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience interacting with senior leadership and executive stakeholders during critical outages.
* Proven ability to make decisions under pressure and maintain control during high-impact situations.
* Ability to operate effectively in a 24x7, high-pressure environment.
* Experience in financial services or large regulated enterprises preferred.
* Experience as a Technical Writer or Technical Project Manager.
* Experience working in organizations with a large-scale IT footprint.
* Experience managing incidents across infrastructure, cloud, network, application, database, and end-user technology domains.
* Experience working with ServiceNow or equivalent ITSM platforms.
* Experience working with Microsoft Teams or equivalent collaboration tools.
* Experience in data analysis and reporting using Power BI, Excel, and similar tools.
* Experience building dashboards using Grafana, Splunk, or equivalent monitoring platforms.
* Working knowledge of Windows and Linux Server OS, networking, routing topology, and IT support fundamentals.
* Understanding of physical and virtual server technologies.
* Experience working with cloud technologies.
* Experience working in an Agile environment.
* Ability to analyze incident trends and drive service stability improvements.
* Experience mentoring or coaching junior team members is an advantage.

**Job Expectations**

* Serve as the primary Incident Commander for Major Incidents (P1/P2) from identification through restoration and closure.
* Lead and facilitate major incident bridge calls, ensuring effective engagement and coordination across technical teams, vendors, and business stakeholders.
* Assess and validate incident severity, impact, urgency, and major incident criteria throughout the incident lifecycle.
* Drive timely resolution by coordinating cross-functional teams and maintaining focus on restoration activities.
* Establish clear ownership, accountability, and action plans during ongoing incidents.
* Identify and assign Recovery Leaders and ensure accountability for restoration activities.
* Manage escalations across technical, operational, and leadership teams to remove blockers and accelerate resolution.
* Provide concise, accurate, and timely executive communications, including impact assessments, restoration updates, and recovery timelines.
* Maintain real-time incident documentation, timelines, business impact assessments, and recovery updates.
* Facilitate technical troubleshooting discussions while maintaining overall control of incident calls.
* Lead Post-Major Incident Reviews and root cause analysis, ensuring lessons learned and improvement opportunities are identified.
* Track and drive completion of corrective and preventive actions in collaboration with Problem Management.
* Partner closely with Technology Command Centre teams for monitoring, engagement, and escalation coordination.
* Develop and enhance Major Incident Management processes, governance, and operational excellence initiatives.
* Analyze incident trends and implement proactive measures to reduce recurring incidents and improve service stability.
* Ensure adherence to ITIL best practices and organizational operational standards.
* Mentor and coach junior Incident Managers and contribute to the growth of the Incident Management function.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.

title: Regional Security Advisor, Asia Pacific
description:
**Reports To:**
Director, Global Security & Investigations

**Position Summary**

Asia Pacific is one of the most dynamic and complex operating environments in the world, shaped by geopolitical tension, rapid economic change, natural hazards, and varied regulatory and cultural landscapes. As the senior security leader for the region, you will define and drive a security vision that protects our people, manufacturing footprint, assets, and reputation while enabling the company's growth ambitions.

You will be a strategic partner to regional and country leadership, shaping decisions on market entry, site selection, expansion, and risk appetite. You will translate global security strategy into a regional program that is mature, measurable, and adapted to each country. You will also build the organization, partnerships, and resilience that make the company a secure and credible presence across the region. This is a role for a leader who thinks at enterprise scale and can operate both at the boardroom table and on the plant floor.

**You Will Be Responsible For**

**Strategic Vision & Enterprise Risk Leadership**

* Defining and owning a multi-year Asia Pacific security strategy and roadmap, aligned to global priorities and integrated with regional business plans
* Anticipating geopolitical, economic, criminal, civil unrest, terrorism, and climate-related risks, and translating them into clear strategic guidance and scenario planning for senior leadership
* Leading regional risk assessments and turning the findings into prioritized, risk-based investment decisions for people, travelers, facilities, and assets
* Advising on the security implications of major business decisions, including market entry, acquisitions, divestitures, site selection, and supply chain footprint
* Contributing regional insight and thought leadership to the global security strategy, helping shape enterprise policy, standards, and investment priorities

**Resilience, Crisis & Incident Leadership**

* Owning regional crisis management, business continuity, and emergency preparedness, including governance, exercises, and a culture of continuous improvement
* Serving as the senior security lead during significant incidents, guiding executive decision-making, coordinating cross-functional response, and escalating to the Director, Global Security & Investigations
* Ensuring lessons from incidents and after-action reviews become lasting improvements to the program
* Overseeing sensitive investigations, the travel security risk program, and executive protection, with appropriate discretion and independence

**Program Ownership & Organizational Capability**

* Owning the regional implementation of global security policies and standards, defining metrics that demonstrate effectiveness, maturity,and value
* Partnering with the Global Security Operations Support Team to drive enterprise-wide standardization and technology-enabled solutions
* Building and leading the regional security organization as the program matures, including setting direction, developing talent, and providing oversight for those responsible for security at manufacturing plants and other facilities
* Managing regional security budgets, vendors, and service providers to deliver strong outcomes and value

**Executive Influence & Ecosystem Leadership**

* Serving as the principal security advisor to regional, country, and facility leadership, earning trust as a strategic partner rather than a cont rol function
* Partnering with HR, Legal, and Compliance & Ethics to deliver integrated, multidisciplinary guidance on complex, high-stakes matters
* Building and leading a network of relationships with host-country government agencies, law enforcement, industry bodies, and the multinational public/private security community
* Representing the company as a credible, well-connected voice on security across Asia Pacific

**What You Bring**

* 15+ years of progressive security management experience, preferably in Asia Pacific, including leadership of regional or multi-country programs
* Demonstrated responsibility for security in an environment outside your home country or country of primary residence (required)
* Experience in a large multinational company or an equivalent public/government sector (required)
* Proven ability to influence and advise senior executives, and to lead and inspire teams without relying on formal authority
* Strong strategic and geopolitical acumen, with the ability to turn complex risk into clear business decisions
* Experience building or maturing a security function, including talent, governance, and metrics
* Manufacturing sector experience (preferred)
* CPP, PSP, PSI, or equivalent certification (a plus)

title: Delivery Head, Business & IT Enablement
description:
**Role Overview**
The Delivery Head leads an enterprise managed-services portfolio covering procurement and asset management, order management, supplier and catalogue management, software asset and licence management, trade and compliance, financial reconciliation and continuous improvement, amongst other shared services functions. The role is accountable for delivery against agreed service levels and for the performance of the teams delivering these services.
  
  
The role is the senior point of accountability for the client, leading governance and working with service owners and stakeholders across procurement, finance, legal, security and compliance. The successful candidate will combine senior leadership with a strong understanding of operational processes, risks and exceptions.
  
  
The Delivery Head will also lead improvement and automation, develop the operating model, and contribute to new business through solution design, bids and client presentations. The role is based in Hyderabad and requires working from the office, client-site presence and escalation availability across a 24x5 operation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Service Delivery Leadership & Operational Excellence
* Own delivery across every service line in the portfolio, with accountability for service levels, quality, throughput and customer satisfaction.
* Run daily, weekly and monthly reviews, using trends and leading indicators to manage performance.
* Act as the senior escalation point for operational issues, ensuring issues are resolved at the appropriate level.
* Ensure each service line maintains current procedures, controls and audit evidence, with consistent quality assurance.
* Plan capacity and coverage across service lines and shifts to meet changing demand.
* Client Partnership & Governance
* Act as the single point of contact and accountability to the client for the portfolio, across service owners, procurement, finance, legal, security and compliance stakeholders.
* Chair operational, monthly service and quarterly business reviews, presenting performance, risks and corrective actions clearly.
* Translate client priorities into delivery commitments, and translate delivery constraints into language the client can act on.
* Build relationships with stakeholders responsible for the client’s budget and strategy.
* Gather client feedback, act on it and communicate progress.
* Commercial & Contractual Ownership
* Own the commercial performance of the portfolio — cost to serve, margin, and the committed productivity and efficiency targets across the contract term.
* Govern the service-level and service-credit regime: understand where exposure sits, prevent avoidable credits, and manage relief and remedy provisions correctly when performance slips.
* Own change control and scope discipline — recognise out-of-scope work, price it through the agreed mechanism, and prevent unbilled scope creep from accumulating.
* Maintain and apply the rate card for ad-hoc and project work, and keep the boundary between baseline service and chargeable work defensible.
* Support annual pricing, volume re-baselining and contract amendment discussions with evidence from the operation.
* Work within the organisation’s delegated authority and contractual obligations.
* Transition, Transformation & Partner Management
* Own the transition of scope into the portfolio — due diligence, knowledge transfer, shadow and reverse-shadow phases, gate criteria, cutover and the move into steady state.
* Ensure transition stages meet agreed acceptance criteria before progression.
* Manage subcontracted and partner-delivered service lines to the same standard as directly delivered ones, with a single accountable face to the client.
* Manage post-transition hypercare, including agreed specialist support, duration and exit criteria.
* Plan and execute structural change to the operating model, including consolidation of adjacent functions and the insourcing of scope where that is the agreed direction.
* Continuous Improvement, Automation & Innovation
* Maintain an improvement pipeline and measure benefits against an agreed baseline, including cost, effort, cycle time and quality.
* Set the automation agenda across the portfolio, prioritising on operational return, and sponsor the cases that need investment.
* Apply process automation, workflow tooling and applied AI to high-volume transactional work, with human control retained over anything carrying commercial or compliance consequence.
* Resolve the root causes of recurring exceptions, working with client and third-party teams where needed.
* Use relevant benchmarks and operational insight to recommend improvements to the client.
* Growth, Solutioning & Bid Leadership
* Identify and shape new opportunities in and around the account, converting operational insight into a credible commercial proposition.
* Contribute to formal bids — requests for information and proposal, solution design, delivery model, transition approach, assumptions and risk.
* Provide the operational and cost inputs that underpin pricing, and challenge commitments the operation cannot actually hold.
* Represent the delivery organisation in client presentations, site visits and orals.
* Carry agreed solutions into transition and ensure delivery commitments are understood and achievable.
* People & Capability
* Lead and develop a leadership team of function managers and team leads, and build the bench beneath them.
* Own succession for every critical role, so the portfolio does not depend on named individuals.
* Set the capability agenda — technical depth, certification, cross-training across service lines and shift patterns.
* Own hiring quality and onboarding at scale, including the ramp associated with new scope.
* Manage attrition actively, and build an operation people want to stay in.

PERFORMANCE & SERVICE LEVELS
  
  
Indicative performance targets for the role; final service levels are confirmed on engagement and measured per service line.
  
  

* Service delivery: meet agreed service levels and quality measures across the portfolio.
* Service credits: manage exposure, investigate any credit events and implement corrective actions.
* Client satisfaction: monitor feedback and deliver agreed improvements.
* Commercial Performance: deliver the portfolio to the agreed margin and cost-to-serve, and meet the committed annual efficiency target.
* Transition: meet agreed milestones and acceptance criteria.
* Improvement Pipeline: deliver the agreed annual benefit, evidenced against a pre-change baseline.
* Audit and compliance: maintain effective controls and address audit findings promptly.
* People: develop direct reports, maintain succession plans for critical roles and manage attrition against agreed targets.
* Growth: contribute to the agreed number of qualified opportunities or bid responses each year.

TOOLS & SYSTEMS
  
  

* ERP & Procurement: SAP and enterprise procurement and guided-buying platforms across the purchase-to-pay cycle.
* Service Management: enterprise IT service management platforms such as ServiceNow, covering request, incident, and hardware and software asset modules.

title: Service Delivery - Network Operations Lead
description:
At DuPont, our purpose is to empower the world with essential innovations to thrive. We work on things that matter. **SD-WAN and Data Center**

* Primary technical focal point and escalation point for AP-region incidents, changes, projects, suppliers and regional stakeholders.
* Support regional and global projects, including M&A, network refresh, site openings/exits, ISP orders and decommissions.
* Manage regional TCOM financials, POs, contracts and capital projects with procurement and vendors.
* Participate in P1/P2 follow-the-sun support and represent the region in RCA and change management processes.

**Operations, Incidents and Vendors**

* Lead technical discussions with vendors (manufacturer TAC support, carriers and the managed service provider) and internal stakeholders.
* Join and drive global P1/P2 and complex data center incident calls: gather evidence, ensure the right teams are engaged and support teams on firewall, SD-WAN and LAN issues.
* Analyze issues across LAN, WAN and security layers and coordinate troubleshooting with support vendors; support Root Cause Analysis.
* Maximize network performance by monitoring, troubleshooting outages, scheduling upgrades and working with other network leads on optimization.
* Manage the TCOM processes (incidents, problems, changes, requests) by review and approve change requests.
* Create and maintain SOPs, runbooks, KB articles and architecture documentation; support CMDB and asset alignment.
* Work with global vendors, solution architects and project managers to implement new global technology solutions, and support monitoring and automation initiatives.
* Coordinate with global infrastructure groups and ensure consistent adherence to IT standards and security policies.

**Required Skills And Experience**

* Minimum 8–10 years of experience in enterprise network operations and engineering.
* Technologies: Palo Alto Prisma SD-WAN (ION), Palo Alto Prisma Access, Palo Alto NGFW (Panorama), Fortinet (FortiManager / FortiAnalyzer), Cisco routing & switching, Cisco Wireless LAN.
* Strong experience implementing LAN and WAN services (LAN, WLAN, MPLS VPN, QoS, routing protocols, SD-WAN).
* Strong L2 and L3 troubleshooting across WAN and security layers.
* Good understanding of routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, RIP, static routing) and Layer-3 routing.
* Excellent understanding of LAN, Wireless LAN and WAN (IPsec, GRE), including site-to-site VPN and multi-vendor firewall interoperability.
* Good understanding of large data center network infrastructure and interconnect firewalls.
* Good understanding of NAT, DNS, TCP/IP addressing, security zones and policy design.
* Experience with ITSM tools, network monitoring and firewall policy management tools.
* Experience working with managed service providers and carriers in a multi-region environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Palo Alto certifications (PCNSE, Prisma SD-WAN) and/or Fortinet certifications (NSE 4 or higher / FCP / FCSS).
* Cisco certification (CCNP Enterprise or equivalent).
* Exposure to network automation and scripting (Python, PowerShell, APIs).

* Good communication skills, with the ability to lead technical calls and report to management.
* Ownership and accountability for regional service quality and vendor performance.
* Ability to work across time zones and support follow-the-sun operations.

**Benefits**
**Description:**
Pana Community Hospital is seeking a dedicated Director of Environmental Services to join our leadership team. In this role, you will oversee and direct the daily operations of the Environmental Services (EVS) Department, ensuring a clean, sanitary, safe, and organized environment throughout the hospital. You will provide leadership, supervision, and direction to departmental personnel while ensuring cleaning and sanitation standards are consistently maintained in accordance with hospital policies, infection prevention practices, and applicable regulatory requirements. Responsibilities include departmental staffing, scheduling, employee training, quality assurance, supply and equipment management, and budget oversight. Working collaboratively with hospital leadership, department managers, and clinical staff, you will play a vital role in supporting patient safety, operational efficiency, and a positive experience for patients, visitors, and employees.
  
  
**Qualifications And Requirements**

* Minimum of a high school diploma or equivalent required; associate degree or higher preferred.
* Two to five years of experience in healthcare environmental services required.
* Previous supervisory or management experience preferred.
* Knowledge of healthcare cleaning and sanitation practices, infection prevention principles, and environmental services operations.
* Demonstrated leadership, organizational, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
* Ability to communicate effectively and professionally with hospital personnel at all levels.
* Must demonstrate integrity, adaptability, attention to detail, initiative, and a strong commitment to teamwork.
* Ability to remain calm and respond effectively to changing priorities and unexpected situations in a healthcare environment.
* Must be willing to work beyond normal business hours when necessary and be available to respond to departmental needs after hours, on weekends, and as required.
* Strong reading, writing, analytical, and documentation skills.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Computer competency, including proficiency with Microsoft Windows and Microsoft Office 365 applications.

**Physical Requirements**

* Ability to lift up to 50 pounds.
* Ability to stand and walk for extended periods.
* Ability to reach, bend, kneel, and perform other physical activities associated with departmental operations.
* Ability to perform essential job functions with or without reasonable accommodation.

**Department Leadership and Operations**

* Oversees and directs the daily operations of the Environmental Services Department to ensure a clean, sanitary, orderly, and safe hospital environment.
* Provides leadership, supervision, guidance, and support to departmental personnel.
* Develops, implements, and maintains departmental policies, procedures, cleaning protocols, and standards of work in collaboration with appropriate hospital leadership.
* Ensures adequate staffing and scheduling to maintain appropriate coverage throughout the facility.
* Monitors departmental performance and identifies opportunities to improve operational efficiency, service quality, and workflow.
* Maintains proficiency in environmental services techniques, cleaning methods, and equipment utilized throughout the department.
* Ensures departmental equipment is properly maintained, inspected, and tested according to established requirements.

**Quality Assurance and Infection Prevention**

* Conducts routine inspections of patient care areas, common spaces, and other facility areas to ensure established cleanliness and sanitation standards are met.
* Monitors the quality and consistency of cleaning services and addresses deficiencies promptly.
* Collaborates with Infection Prevention and other departments to support infection control initiatives and ensure compliance with established cleaning and disinfection practices.
* Participates in performance improvement initiatives and develops corrective action plans when necessary.
* Investigates, documents, and reports unusual occurrences, safety concerns, and departmental issues.
* Assists in maintaining compliance with accreditation standards and applicable federal, state, and local regulations.

**Personnel Management and Development**

* Provides direction, coaching, and performance management to departmental employees.
* Participates in the recruitment and selection process, including screening applicants and making recommendations regarding hiring, promotions, transfers, and disciplinary actions.
* Conducts employee orientation, ongoing training, and regularly scheduled departmental in-services.
* Maintains documentation of employee training, including dates, topics, and attendance.
* Communicates administrative directives, departmental expectations, and operational updates to employees.
* Promotes open communication, teamwork, accountability, and employee engagement through regular departmental meetings and discussions.
* Addresses employee concerns at the departmental level and utilizes established grievance and employee relations processes when appropriate.
* Reviews timekeeping and payroll-related records and maintains accurate documentation of personnel actions and work assignments.

**Budget, Supplies, and Linen Management**

* Assists with the development and management of the annual departmental budget and monitors expenditures to remain within approved budgetary guidelines.
* Maintains appropriate inventory levels of cleaning supplies, equipment, and other departmental resources.
* Evaluates supplies, equipment, and operational procedures and recommends changes to improve safety, efficiency, quality, or cost-effectiveness.
* Oversees linen distribution and ensures patient care departments maintain adequate linen supplies.
* Monitors linen utilization, reviews usage statistics, and identifies opportunities to improve linen management and control costs.

**Organizational Collaboration and Compliance**

* Collaborates with hospital leadership, clinical departments, and support services to address environmental needs and support overall hospital operations.
* Participates in assigned committees, task forces, and organizational initiatives.
* Attends monthly department management meetings and communicates relevant information to departmental personnel.
* Attends monthly executive-management meetings and keeps the Administrative Representative informed of significant departmental concerns, unusual circumstances, and operational issues.
* Supports organizational compliance with accreditation requirements, regulatory standards, hospital policies, and applicable laws.
* Promotes the hospital's mission, vision, values, ethics, and organizational goals through departmental leadership and daily operations.

* Maintains positive, cooperative, and professional working relationships with physicians, hospital leadership, employees, patients, and visitors.
* Demonstrates professionalism, sincerity, tact, and sound judgment when addressing concerns or resolving conflicts.
* Responds to stressful situations in a calm, constructive, and solution-oriented manner.

* Demonstrates organization, accuracy, dependability, and attention to detail.
* Adapts effectively to changing departmental priorities and organizational needs.
* Accepts constructive criticism and responds positively to opportunities for improvement.
* Ensures compliance with organizational policies, procedures, and established standards of conduct.
* Maintains patient confidentiality and complies with HIPAA regulations at all times.
