title: VP - IAM Operations & User Experience
description:
**Role Title:**
**VP - IAM Operations & User Experience**
**(L12)**
**Company Overview**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
  
  
**Organizational Overview**
The Identity and Access Management (IAM) team at Synchrony, led by the Head of IAM reporting to the CISO, oversees key security functions. Direct reports specialize in authentication, authorization, privileged access management, special programs, and federated controls governance. This structure ensures comprehensive management of identity and access processes to maintain robust security and compliance across the organization.
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
This is a people manager role responsible for leading enterprise IAM Security Administration, End User Operations, across people, technology, controls, and transformation. The VP will combine IAM expertise with practical AI and automation engineering capability to drive reliable identity lifecycle and privileged access operations, simplify access requests and fulfilment, and reduce repetitive manual work. The role will define automation strategy and requirements, partner with Automation and Engineering teams to deliver scalable solutions and safely operationalize Agentic AI and Generative AI with appropriate human oversight and security controls
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Lead the enterprise IAM Security Administration and Automation functions, including people, operations, technology, controls, and transformation.
  
  

* Drive automation and access-experience transformation: Own the strategy to automate the majority of repetitive Security Administration activities using Agentic AI, Generative AI, RPA, Python, PowerShell, APIs, and self-service. Prioritize opportunities, modernize IAM access requests and fulfilment, and define requirements, business outcomes, and control objectives with Automation and Engineering teams. Drive automation of ServiceNow request, incident, change, and problem-management activities.
* Improve operations through data, AI, and user insight: Analyse IAM operational data, incidents, logs, knowledge articles, historical resolutions, and recurring issues to identify sustainable improvements. Use Generative AI, Splunk, and IAM telemetry to accelerate troubleshooting and root-cause analysis and establish AI-assisted monitoring and predictive capabilities. Gather end-user feedback to reduce friction, manual effort, and unnecessary process complexity.
* Establish governance and measurable outcomes: Maintain human-in-the-loop oversight, approvals, auditability, security, and segregation-of-duties controls for AI-driven operations. Set and track targets for automation coverage, manual effort reduction, provisioning success, recurring failure reduction, SLA adherence, incident resolution, first-time-right execution, operational reliability, and security-control effectiveness, with no compromise to governance or compliance.
* Identify and prioritize automation opportunities that enhance the user experience and collaborate with the automation team to implement them.
* Build talent and lead cross-functional transformation: Lead, coach, and develop Security Administration and Operations teams, strengthening IAM, AI, Python, PowerShell, and RPA capabilities. Identify high-potential talent, establish succession plans and technical SME ownership, and promote automation-first thinking, engineering discipline, continuous improvement, and accountability. Partner with technology, Automation, control, business, and end-user communities to deliver measurable improvements in cost, quality, speed, and risk reduction.

**Required Skills/Knowledge**

* Strong experience in IAM/IGA, identity lifecycle management, and Security Administration across SailPoint, NHID, Okta, Beyond Identity, Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, and Delinea/PAM, including provisioning, reconciliation, access governance, and privileged access operations.
* Ability to identify, assess, and prioritize IAM automation opportunities based on business value, operational efficiency, risk reduction, and end-user experience. Working knowledge of Python, PowerShell, REST APIs, Automation Anywhere/RPA, Agentic AI, Generative AI, and LLM-based capabilities to evaluate potential use cases and collaborate effectively with automation teams.
* Experience translating IAM operational needs into clear business requirements, process flows, control requirements, and acceptance criteria for automation teams, including integration needs across IAM platforms, ServiceNow, and Splunk. Strong understanding of approval workflows, audit requirements, segregation-of-duties controls, and the safe use of AI.
* Demonstrated people leadership and IAM transformation capability, including team development, succession planning, operational ownership, and cross-functional collaboration. Ability to partner with automation teams through feasibility assessment, prioritization, user acceptance testing, adoption, and benefits realization.

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**

* Experience developing and prioritizing an IAM automation roadmap, identifying opportunities for reusable solutions across processes, and partnering with automation teams to assess feasibility, dependencies, and expected benefits.
* Ability to identify use cases for AI-assisted monitoring, predictive insights, knowledge assistance, and intelligent troubleshooting to address recurring IAM failures and operational risks.
* Experience driving the adoption of automation and self-service across IAM, Active Directory, PAM, ServiceNow, and routine administrative processes, with measurable improvements in cost, quality, speed, risk reduction, and end-user experience.

**Eligibility Criteria**
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field; Master’s degree preferred with 9+years of IT experience with a minimum of 6 years focused on IAM operations and end-user services management.
  
  
**Work Timings: 2:00 PM - 11:00 PM IST**
(This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility and Choice offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs. Please discuss this with the hiring manager for more details.)

title: Associate Clinical Data Manager - Operations
description:
About Signant Health
  
At Signant Health, we help bring life-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.
  
  
Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.
  
  
If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.
  
  
About the Role
  
The Associate Clinical Data Manager is responsible for working with the Clinical Data Management team and other internal project team members to provide data management services for our customers, ensuring on-time and accurate deliverables. Responsibilities include providing data management guidance to internal project team members and customers; communicating with internal project team members and customers on all aspects of data management activities performed for a study; authoring data management documents; performing user acceptance testing on data management deliverables; and facilitating and verifying data clarifications and data changes.
  
  
**Shift:** This role requires working a night shift on a rotational basis.
  
  
KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES – Function
  
  

* Develop and maintain the Data Management Plan (DMP).
* Develop and maintain study-specific Data Cleaning / Reconciliation reports and validation plans.
* Provide weekly data management status updates to clients and internal Project Managers.
* Work with the internal Delivery team to define data management timelines, ensuring DM milestones are met.
* Develop other study-specific documentation manuals, including but not limited to the Maintenance Guide (MG), as necessary.
* Conduct study-specific trainings with internal Data Coordinators and Data Reviewers prior to release of the Data Management Plan initiatives.
* Adhere to Signant Health Standard Operating Procedures for all data management responsibilities.
* Identify areas of opportunity for improvement in the end-to-end Data Management process, driving out waste, increasing productivity, and delivering quality.
* Support delivery of improvements in the Data Management process by participating in small group activities, kaizen events, and Lean Six Sigma projects when necessary.
* Work a night shift on a rotational basis to support study and client needs across time zones.

Decision Making and Influence
  
  

* Collaborate with clients and internal Delivery teams to develop and maintain protocol-specific monitoring report specifications.
* Collaborate with clients and internal Data Coordinators and Data Reviewers to generate a study-specific tool for flagging discrepancies between the client IVR/EDC and TrialManager outputs.
* Collaborate with clients and the internal Technical Client Services team to conduct protocol reviews and identify protocol-specific device design and eligibility criteria.
* Collaborate with clients and the internal Technical Client Services team to define protocol-specific report(s) as necessary.
* Collaborate with the internal validation team to define detailed test cases for clinically significant reports.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ATTRIBUTES
  
  
**Essential:**  

* BA/BS degree in a relevant field (Medicine, Statistics, Computer Science) or equivalent work experience.
* Technical aptitude and ability to complete high-quality technical documentation; ability to understand and work with HTML as well as different types of clinical databases.
* Demonstrates extreme attention to detail and organization in all aspects of work; previous project management experience is an advantage.
* Ability to quickly learn and apply new skills, procedures, and approaches.
* Demonstrated ability to meet very short deadlines and multi-task in an extremely fast-paced work environment with little direct supervision.
* Proven ability to work both independently and in a team-oriented environment, providing back-up support to team members and establishing/maintaining effective working relationships with co-workers within and across functional areas.
* Previously demonstrated proactive and positive approach to tasks and projects overall, as well as to the types of scheduling and process changes that are inherent in a fast-paced business.
* Proficient in Access, Excel, and other office software technologies and applications.
* Proven ability to handle multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced work environment with minimal direct supervision.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Willingness and ability to work a night shift on a rotational basis.

**Desirable:**  

* Familiarity with 21 CFR Part 11 or experience in a regulated environment.
* 3+ years of professional experience in the clinical trials data management field.
* Familiarity with data management best practices (GCP, GDPR, MHRA).
* Familiarity with EDC systems.

Why Signant Health?
  
At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission.
  
We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo.
  
If you are looking for purpose-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it.
  
At Signant Health, accepting difference isn't enough — we celebrate it, we support it, and we nurture it for the benefit of our team members, our clients, and our community. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer, committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. Prior to their start date, all new hires are required to be verified through a thorough background check and identity verification to confirm eligibility for employment.
  
Unsolicited resumes submitted by agencies or third-party recruiters directly to hiring managers or any Signant Health employee will not be considered and will not obligate Signant Health to any fees or terms associated with the submission.

title: Mgr, Quality/Training Strategy, GO-AI Operations Integration
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

The Manager, Quality & Training Strategy owns how GO-AI defines, measures, and improves the quality of annotations delivered to Amazon Robotics and Worldwide Operations science teams. You will own the quality model for an AI and ML annotation workforce: how accuracy is measured, how measurement scales across use cases and demand, and how quality standards reflect the customer's perception of the output they receive. You operate as the independent measurement function for the annotation business, providing defect insights to Operations while representing the customer's view of quality.  
  
As GO-AI evolves, this role ensures that quality measurement keeps pace with how annotations are consumed by data scientists inside an ML product development lifecycle, and increasingly alongside model-generated output. You lead a team of program managers and quality managers across India and Costa Rica, and you apply an up-to-date understanding of AI capabilities to identify and drive use cases that improve operational metrics.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Own the GO-AI quality model. Define how annotation accuracy is measured for each use case so that published metrics reflect the customer's perceived quality of the output.

  

* Own quality KPI definition and governance across 70+ use cases, including target baselining, process capability assessment, and the standards applied to new and ramping workforces.

  

* Define the quality measurement strategy, including how coverage and depth of measurement scale with demand, risk, and cost of quality.

  

* Lead deep dives on any degradation of customer-consumed quality metrics, drive to root cause through standardized mechanisms, and publish findings and corrective actions to senior leadership through weekly and monthly business reviews.

  

* Operate as the independent measurement function for the annotation business. Partner with Customer Tech Programs on customer quality and speed expectations, and with Operations business unit leaders on defect insights and remediation.

  

* Translate ML customer needs into quality standards. Understand how annotations feed model training and evaluation so that quality definitions match how data scientists consume the output.

  

* Maintain a current understanding of AI capabilities and how they function. Identify and drive use cases where AI tooling improves quality, speed, and experience.

  

* Lead and develop a geographically distributed team of 6 to 8 program managers and quality managers across India and Costa Rica. Own hiring, onboarding, performance management, career growth, and team structure.

  
About the team  
GO-AI is a technology enablement organization that accelerates the development and enhances the performance of AI-based robotic and automation solutions for Amazon Robotics (AR) and key Worldwide Operations programs. We combine human expertise with machine learning to produce high-quality training data, validate model outputs, and continuously improve AI system performance across many annotation programs and a large global workforce.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of team management experience
* 5+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
* Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
* Experience managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership
* Experience with tools/systems to analyze data including Excel, Access, SQL or other data management systems
* Experience managing programs across multiple geographies and cultures

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in AI/ML operations, data annotation, or ML data quality.
* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or equivalent process improvement certification
* Experience designing measurement or audit frameworks at scale
* Experience applying GenAI or LLM-based tools to improve operational metrics
* Experience operating as an independent quality assurance function alongside an operations organization

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Data Center Services Manager
description:
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10 years of experience in program management.
* 7 years of experience in leadership role(s) with/without direct reports.
* Experience managing machine learning or artificial intelligence programs.
* Experience with AI, Generative AI, data processing technologies, performance, or scalability optimizations.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience managing multi-group, or multi-disciplinary projects.
* Experience in people management and leadership.
* Experience managing construction projects within an international working environment.
* Experience with commercial contract management and procurement.
* Experience working within the mission critical facilities.
* Experience managing vendor relationships and understanding standard practices in the design and construction industry.

**About The Job**
Google's projects, like our users, span the globe and require managers to keep the big picture in focus while being able to dive into the unique engineering challenges we face daily. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you lead complex, multi-disciplinary engineering projects using your engineering expertise. You plan requirements with internal customers and usher projects through the entire project lifecycle. This includes managing project schedules, identifying risks and clearly communicating them to project stakeholders. You're equally at home explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical trade-offs in product development with engineers.
  
  
Using your extensive technical and leadership expertise, you manage various Engineering-specific programs and teams.
  
  
As the Data Center Services Manager, you will be fully involved in nearly every aspect of the design development and localisation, procurement, schedule and cost management, delivery, commissioning, handover and close-out of the data center projects, including facility upgrades within operational data centres. You will partner with our local/regional facility managers, plant engineers, our design, project controls, delivery and commissioning teams, to develop scalable solutions at pace.
  
  
This role requires you to manage complex schedules, budgets and broad inter-dependencies, all while maintaining industry leading EHS and Quality standards.The role of the Data Center Services (DCS) manager requires strong communication, collaborative and organisational skills, with the ability to self-direct. You will manage a team and therefore strong leadership skills are required.
  
  
The Data Center team designs and operates some of the most sophisticated electrical and HVAC systems in the world. We are an upbeat, creative, team-oriented group of engineers committed to building and operating powerful data centers.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Manage a large, campus-wide data center construction and delivery organization with the DCS Manager as the single point of accountability and oversight for major projects utilizing internal and outsourced resources.
* Support the development of detailed, localized designs, leveraging the programmatic design plan of record, while driving procurement, construction, commissioning, close out, and hand-off to the Operations team to meet safety, cost, schedule, quality, and customer requirements.
* Lead problem-solving engagement with partners to overcome issues that affect the delivery of projects.
* Establish and maintain delivery models and global relationships with multiple vendors, measuring Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and metrics.
* Drive the proactive identification, selection, and onboarding of new regional contractors and vendors to increase the current bench.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

title: Fund Account Settlement - manager
description:
Job Description Position: Fund Account Settlement - manager
  
**Department:**
Custody Operations / Investment Operations
  
**Location:**
Mumbai
  
**Position Grade:**
Fund Account Settlement - manager
  
**Reporting Manager L1:**
Senior Manager
  
**Reporting Manager L2:**
AVP
  
**Job Purpose**
The role is responsible for ensuring
**accurate, timely and compliant investment operations and trade reporting**
, with a strong focus on trade settlement, reconciliations, corporate actions, cash management and regulatory compliance.
  
The candidate will be expected to proactively identify operational errors, process gaps and compliance risks, take corrective action and ensure an
**error-free and efficient trade reporting and settlement process**
across Indian and offshore capital markets.
  
Key Responsibilities 1. Trade Settlement & Reporting
  

* Manage and monitor trade settlement activities for Indian and offshore capital markets.
* Report trades across platforms including FTRAC, CBRICS, ICCL and other relevant systems.
* Ensure accurate and timely trade settlement and reporting.
* Monitor settlement status and proactively resolve trade discrepancies, exceptions and breaks.
* Handle Forex transactions through to preparation of trade settlement advice.
* Perform position checks, particularly on expiry days, and ensure timely resolution of exceptions.

2. Corporate Actions
  

* Monitor and process corporate actions including dividends, mergers, demergers, reorganizations and other events impacting mutual fund investments.
* Coordinate with custodians, fund administrators, brokers and other stakeholders for timely and accurate processing.
* Ensure appropriate accounting and reporting of corporate action events.

3. Cash Management
  

* Monitor cash flows related to investments and fund operations.
* Ensure adequate liquidity for redemptions, settlements and other fund obligations.
* Monitor cash balances and identify opportunities to optimize liquidity while adhering to regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate with relevant teams to resolve cash-related discrepancies.

4. Reconciliation
  

* Perform daily, weekly and monthly reconciliations of:

+ Trades and transactions
+ Securities and positions
+ Cash balances
+ Custodian statements
+ Trade confirmations

* Investigate breaks and discrepancies between internal records and external sources.
* Ensure timely resolution and proper documentation of reconciliation exceptions.

5. Compliance & Regulatory Reporting
  

* Ensure adherence to SEBI regulations, mutual fund guidelines, internal policies and fund prospectuses.
* Ensure compliance with applicable investment limits, risk management requirements and reporting standards.
* Prepare and submit regulatory reports, filings and required disclosures.
* Maintain appropriate audit trails and ensure readiness for internal and external audits.
* Identify potential compliance breaches and take timely corrective action.

6. Process Improvement & Controls
  

* Proactively identify gaps, inefficiencies and operational risks within existing processes.
* Recommend and implement process improvements to improve accuracy and efficiency.
* Strengthen maker-checker controls, audit controls and exception management processes.
* Develop and implement contingency measures for potential operational disruptions.
* Drive an error-free and control-oriented operating environment.

7. Investment Operations / Fund Accounting
  

* Support and oversee activities relating to FA-Custody and investment operations.
* Understand the relationship between custody operations, fund accounting and banking operations.
* Ensure accurate maintenance and processing of mutual fund investment records and transactions.
* Coordinate with internal teams and external service providers to ensure smooth operational functioning.

8. Risk Management
  

* Identify and assess operational risks associated with custody and mutual fund investment processes.
* Implement appropriate controls and mitigation measures.
* Monitor operational exceptions and ensure timely escalation of material risks.
* Maintain appropriate documentation for risk and control processes.

9. Client & Stakeholder Servicing
  

* Respond to operational queries from internal and external stakeholders.
* Coordinate effectively with custodians, fund administrators, brokers, banks and other service providers.
* Provide timely resolution to operational issues and ensure effective stakeholder communication.

**Required Knowledge & Skills**
  

* Strong knowledge of Indian and offshore capital markets.
* Understanding of various security segments, including:

+ Equity
+ Fixed Income
+ Mutual Funds
+ Other relevant investment products

* Strong understanding of Mutual Fund products, investment operations and processes.
* Knowledge of custody operations, trade settlement and fund accounting.
* Good understanding of banking and financial services operations.
* Knowledge of SEBI Mutual Fund Accounting Standards and Reporting Requirements.
* Knowledge of SEBI guidelines relating to mutual fund investment limits, risk management and regulatory compliance.
* Strong reconciliation and exception-management skills.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* High level of accuracy and attention to detail, particularly when handling large volumes of financial data.
* Strong MS Office skills and ability to work on relevant investment/custody operations systems.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and external stakeholders.

Personal Attributes
  

* High attention to detail and accuracy.
* Strong ownership and accountability.
* Proactive approach towards identifying and resolving issues.
* Control-oriented and compliance-focused mindset.
* Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple operational activities simultaneously.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Good interpersonal and relationship-management skills.
* Team player with the ability to work effectively across functions.

Educational Qualification & Experience
  

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce or a related field.
* Minimum 3 years of relevant experience specifically in Investment Operations / Custody Operations.
* Candidates with a Graduate/Postgraduate qualification and 4 5 years of relevant Investment Operations experience may also be considered.
* Prior experience in Mutual Fund Operations, Custody, Fund Accounting or Investment Operations is essential.
* Candidates should have up-to-date knowledge of applicable SEBI and mutual fund regulatory guidelines.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**
The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in
**trade settlement, custody operations, reconciliations, corporate actions, cash management and regulatory reporting**
, preferably within a
**mutual fund, asset management company, custodian, bank or financial services organization**
.
  
The candidate should be comfortable handling high-volume transactions, identifying operational breaks, managing regulatory controls and proactively improving processes.

title: GP Lead
description:

**About Godrej Industries Group (GIG)**
At the Godrej Industries Group, we are privileged to serve over 1.1 billion consumers globally through our businesses with market leadership positions in the consumer products, real estate, agriculture, financial services and chemicals industries.
  
  
https://www.godrejindustries.com/
  
  
**About Godrej Consumer Products Limited (GCPL)**
Godrej Consumer Products is a leading emerging markets company. As part of the over 125-year young Godrej Group, we are fortunate to have a proud legacy built on the strong values of trust, integrity and respect for others. At the same time, we are growing fast and have exciting, ambitious aspirations.
  
  
Today, our Group enjoys the patronage of 1.2 billion consumers globally, across different businesses. We rank among the largest Household Insecticide and Hair Care players in emerging markets. In Household Insecticides, we are the leader in India, the second largest player in Indonesia and are expanding our footprint in Africa. Innovation is a key driver of our strategy, and we are constantly looking to delight our consumers with exciting, superior quality products at affordable prices. We were the highest ranked Indian company on Forbes' list of The World's 100 Most Innovative Growth Companies 2015, for the second year in a row.
  
  
https://www.godrejcp.com/

6–8 years

description:

the art clinics have world class facilities including advanced operating theaters that are equipped
  
  
beyond international norms.

Practice that will help the Veterinarians in diagnosing and treating ophthalmic conditions.

areas)

equipment

protocols

Maintain asset registers and ensure proper utilization
  
  
Support procurement and cost control

Work closely with doctors, technicians, and front office teams
  
  
Ensure smooth functioning of clinic operations without disruption
  
  
Support clinic readiness for surgeries and procedures

Ensure quick resolution of breakdowns and operational issues
  
  
**Required Qualifications Skills**
Education
  
  
Graduate (any discipline)

**Experience**
56 years of experience in facility management (hospital / clinic / healthcare preferred)
  
  
Experience managing multi-functional facilities is a plus
  
  
Technical Skills
  
  
Knowledge of facility systems (electrical, plumbing, HVAC)
  
  
Vendor management and AMC handling
  
  
Basic computer skills (Excel, reports, inventory tracking)
  
  
Core Competencies
  
  
Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills
  
  
High attention to detail and ownership mindset
  
  
Should be able to travel to other branches of Mumbai
  
  
Ability to work in a fast-paced healthcare environment
  
  
Good coordination and communication skills
  
  
Should be able to join within a month.

title: Founding Operations
description:
**Founding Ops (Founder's Office) at Adzzat.**
Mumbai, in person, full time. Reports to the COO.

Adzzat is the delivery layer behind AI data companies. They bring the project. We bring vetted engineers, finance experts and annotators from across India, and run everything else: vetting, onboarding, quality, project management and payouts.

Our founders spend most of their time with clients in San Francisco. We're hiring someone to grow into running Mumbai.

**What you'll own (not all on day one, all of it within a year)**

* Delivery: every client project, from kickoff to final batch
* Scoping: turning rough client asks into people, cost and timelines
* The contributor network: recruiting, vetting, onboarding and keeping the best people
* Quality: guidelines, reviews and feedback loops that catch problems before the client does

**Who you are**

* Early in your career, but you've already run something real: a team, a fest, a founder's office stint, your own venture
* You learn fast, and new things don't scare you
* You never give up, and you don't burn relationships doing it
* Jugaad, not shortcuts: you find a way, but never cut corners on pay, client data or quality
* Hungry. Nobody needs to push you

* You want a tidy scope or a strict 9 to 6. Many of our clients are in the US

* A founding seat. You join before the playbook exists, and you write it

time at an early-stage startup or in a founder's office, strong spreadsheet skills, delivery experience in AI data, annotation or BPO.

  an engineering degree, an MBA or prior AI experience.

The Manager – MEP (MEP Supervisor) will supervise and coordinate all mechanical, electrical,

plumbing, fire and specialist building services for the interior fit-out of a multi-level luxury residence

and associated parking-level scope in a premium Mumbai high-rise tower. The role ensures services

are installed to the approved design, integrated seamlessly with architectural finishes, and tested

and commissioned through to handover. The incumbent reports to the Overall Coordinator (Senior

Manager – Projects) and works closely with the MEP consultant, specialist vendors and the tower's

base-building team.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Execution supervision: Supervise installation of electrical (LT distribution, lighting, distribution boards, earthing), HVAC (cooling, fresh air, filtration, exhaust), plumbing and drainage, fire detection and firefighting, and specialist systems (ELV, CCTV, security and access control, lighting control and home automation, AV and kitchen services) against approved issued-for-construction and coordination drawings.
* Design integration: Coordinate with the MEP consultant, lighting designer, automation, ELV, AV and security specialists, kitchen consultant, interior designers and finishing trades so that grilles, diffusers, light fittings, sensors, speakers, access panels and switches are positioned as per design intent; resolve clashes in ceilings, joinery and walls on site and sequence MEP and finishing trades.
* Base-building interface: Coordinate with the tower's base-building MEP and facilities teams for connections to risers and shared systems, load and capacity checks, shutdown and permit approvals, and DG and backup power interfaces.
* Drawing and submittal review: Review MEP and coordination drawings, shop drawings, material submittals and samples for constructability, maintainability and access; track RFIs to closure; support technical evaluation of MEP and specialist packages.
* Quality, testing and commissioning: Inspect concealed works before closure; witness pressure, insulation, leak, balancing and functional tests and commissioning (including lighting control, automation, fire alarm and security); ensure as-built drawings, O&M manuals, warranties and user training are completed.
* Planning and cost: Prepare MEP look-ahead schedules and track progress and long-lead items (fixtures, equipment, automation); verify measurements and contractor bills with the
* Contracts team; flag variations early; support value engineering only where approved and without compromising design intent.
* Snagging and handover: Close out MEP snags and support handover and the defects liability period.
* Reporting and risk flagging: Track MEP tasks daily; submit a weekly MEP site status report to the Overall Coordinator covering progress, testing and commissioning status, open RFIs and snags; and flag potential risks (clashes, long-lead items, base-building shutdowns, approvals, safety) early with proposed mitigation.
* Safety and compliance: Enforce safety, permit-to-work and electrical isolation procedures and statutory and building fit-out requirements; protect completed work and maintain site security and client confidentiality.

**Candidate Profile**

**Qualification:**
Bachelor's degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering from a reputed institution.

**Experience:**
8-10 years of experience in MEP execution and coordination, including at least 4 years on luxury residential, hospitality or premium interior fit-out projects.

**Skills:**

• Prior experience in luxury residential and hospitality projects will be given weightage.

• Strong technical knowledge of electrical, HVAC, plumbing, fire fighting and ELV systems,

from design coordination to commissioning.

• Hands-on experience integrating services with ceilings, joinery and architectural finishes in

high-specification interiors.

• Working knowledge of the National Building Code, fire safety norms and applicable electrical

regulations.

• Excellent coordination, communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability

to manage multiple vendors and consultants on a single complex project.

• Understanding of project budgeting, measurement and bill verification.

**Preferred Attributes**

• Experience with lighting control, home automation, AV and high-end kitchen systems.

• Prior experience in MEP design review and coordination.

• Proficiency in AutoCAD, MS Office and scheduling tools (MS Project or Primavera).

• Discretion and confidentiality when working on private residences.

• Strong problem-solving, negotiation and organizational abilities.

title: Assistant Manager Grievance Management
description:
**About Snapmint**

Snapmint is a leading fintech company redefining access to consumer credit in India. With over 10 million customers across 2,200+ cities, our zero-cost EMI platform enables responsible purchases without the need for a credit card across categories like fashion, electronics, and lifestyle. India has over 300 million credit-eligible consumers, yet fewer than 35 million actively use credit cards. Snapmint addresses this gap by offering a trusted, transparent alternative grounded in financial inclusion and ethical lending practices.

Founded in 2017, Snapmint is a profitable, high-growth company doubling year-on-year. Our founding team, alumni of IIT Bombay and ISB, brings deep experience from companies like Oyo, Ola, Maruti Suzuki, and has successfully built and exited ventures in ad-tech, patent analytics, and bank-tech.

We are building the future of responsible consumer finance, simple, transparent, and customer first.

**Role Summary**

We are seeking a highly motivated and customer-focused professional to manage grievance redressal activities within our NBFC operations. The incumbent will be responsible for handling escalated customer complaints, coordinating with internal and external stakeholders for timely resolution, ensuring adherence to regulatory requirements, driving process improvements, and maintaining grievance-related MIS and dashboards.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Grievance Resolution & Customer Management**

* Manage and resolve escalated customer grievances received through various channels including email, regulatory authorities, social media, and senior management escalations.
* Conduct customer interactions through calls and emails to understand concerns, gather relevant information, and provide satisfactory resolutions.
* Ensure complaints are addressed within defined Turnaround Time (TAT) and in compliance with regulatory guidelines.
* Draft professional responses for escalated complaints and regulatory submissions.

**Stakeholder Coordination**

* Liaise with cross-functional teams including Operations, Collections, Risk, Technology, Business, Legal, Compliance, and Merchant Partners for effective complaint resolution.
* Drive accountability among stakeholders to ensure timely closure of grievances.
* Escalate critical issues appropriately and provide regular updates to management.

**Reporting & Analytics**

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly grievance MIS reports.
* Develop and maintain dashboards to monitor complaint volumes, TAT adherence, root causes, customer satisfaction, and regulatory metrics.
* Analyze complaint trends and identify recurring issues impacting customer experience.

**Process Improvement & Governance**

* Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) of recurring complaints and recommend corrective and preventive actions.
* Identify opportunities for process enhancement, automation, and customer experience improvement.
* Track implementation of improvement initiatives and measure outcomes.
* Support audits, compliance reviews, and regulatory inspections related to grievance management.

**Operational Excellence**

* Ensure daily grievance queues, escalations, and assigned tasks are completed within agreed timelines.
* Monitor team productivity and service levels where applicable.
* Maintain accurate records and documentation of complaint handling activities.

**Key Skills & Competencies**

* Strong customer grievance handling and conflict resolution skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication.
* Ability to manage difficult customer conversations with empathy and professionalism.
* Strong stakeholder management and coordination skills.
* Analytical mindset with proficiency in data interpretation and reporting.
* Advanced knowledge of MS Excel, Word, Google Sheets, or similar reporting tools.
* Understanding of RBI guidelines, Integrated Ombudsman Scheme, and NBFC regulatory framework.
* Strong attention to detail and problem-solving ability.

**Qualifications and Preferred Experience**

* **Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Finance, Commerce, or related field.**
* Experience in
  **NBFC, FinTech, Banking, Consumer Lending, or E-commerce Financing.**
* Exposure to
  **RBI Ombudsman complaints, CMS complaints, regulatory escalations, and customer experience functions.**
* Experience in dashboard creation, RCA preparation, and process improvement initiatives.

**Location: Mumbai (Vidyavihar)**

**Working Days: 6 Days working**

title: Director of Celebrations
description:
**Company Description**
Fairmont Hotels & Resorts is where the intimate equally coexists with the infinite – an unrivaled portfolio of more than 90 extraordinary hotels where grand moments of life, heartfelt pleasures and personal milestones are celebrated and remembered long after any visit. Since 1907, Fairmont has created magnificent, meaningful and unforgettable hotels, rich with character and deeply connected to the history, culture and community of its destinations – places such as The Plaza in New York City, The Savoy in London, Fairmont San Francisco, Fairmont Banff Springs in Canada, Fairmont Peace Hotel in Shanghai, and Fairmont The Palm in Dubai. Famous for its engaging service, awe-inspiring public spaces, locally inspired cuisine, and iconic bars and lounges, Fairmont also takes great pride in its pioneering approach to hospitality and leadership in sustainability and responsible tourism practices. Fairmont is part of Accor, a world leading hospitality group counting over 5,400 properties throughout more than 110 countries, and a participating brand in ALL - Accor Live Limitless – a lifestyle loyalty program providing access to a wide variety of rewards, services and experiences.
  
  
**Job Description**

* Position Purpose

The Director of Celebrations is the creative and commercial leader responsible for curating extraordinary celebrations and distinctive social experiences across Fairmont Mumbai and Roswyn, A Morgans Originals Hotel.
  
  
The role brings together the elegance and refined service of Fairmont with Roswyn’s contemporary, expressive, and lifestyle-led character. The incumbent will transform client aspirations into personalised experiences that combine design, gastronomy, entertainment, culture, and exceptional hospitality.
  
  
From sophisticated weddings and intimate soirées to milestone celebrations, private gatherings, and high-profile social occasions, the Director of Celebrations will create meaningful moments that reflect each property’s identity while building lasting relationships with discerning clientele, event curators, wedding planners, and influential lifestyle partners.
  
  
The position combines creative vision, relationship-led business development, revenue generation, and operational leadership to establish both hotels as preferred destinations for exceptional celebrations.
  
  

* Key Responsibilities
* Celebration Vision & Experience Design
* Develop a distinctive celebration philosophy for both properties, aligned with their individual brand identities and guest expectations.
* Conceptualise bespoke experiences across weddings, engagement celebrations, milestone birthdays, anniversaries, private dinners, festive occasions, and exclusive social gatherings.
* Curate celebrations that bring together ambience, culinary experiences, décor, music, entertainment, personalisation, and thoughtful service.
* Introduce signature celebration concepts and innovative experiences that distinguish the hotels within the luxury and lifestyle hospitality market.
* Translate emerging luxury, design, fashion, food, and lifestyle trends into commercially viable celebration offerings.
* Ensure every celebration reflects creativity, authenticity, emotional connection, and meticulous attention to detail.
* Business Development & Relationship Curation
* Build a strong network of luxury wedding planners, event designers, lifestyle curators, social influencers, premium brands, and high-value clientele.
* Develop meaningful relationships with clients and partners to generate new business, referrals, and repeat celebrations.
* Represent both properties at relevant industry gatherings, luxury showcases, networking events, and curated client experiences.
* Lead client consultations, creative presentations, venue showcases, and bespoke proposal development.
* Collaborate with Sales and Marketing to create compelling celebration narratives and strengthen each property's market positioning.
* Build a pipeline of qualified celebration opportunities and maintain strong engagement throughout the client journey.
* Commercial Performance & Revenue Growth
* Own the celebration business plan, revenue objectives, conversion strategy, and profitability targets for both properties.
* Identify opportunities to maximise revenue through event experiences, food and beverage, accommodation, private dining, and other relevant hotel offerings.
* Develop distinctive celebration packages while retaining flexibility for bespoke client requirements.
* Monitor enquiry conversion, average event value, profitability, repeat business, and client acquisition.
* Work with Finance and Sales to establish pricing strategies, budgets, forecasts, and appropriate commercial controls.
* Ensure proposals, contracts, deposits, payment schedules, and commercial commitments comply with approved policies.
* Bespoke Client & Guest Experience
* Serve as the trusted advisor and principal relationship owner for key celebration clients.
* Understand each client's vision, preferences, cultural considerations, and expectations to deliver highly personalised experiences.
* Oversee the celebration journey from initial enquiry and concept development through execution and post-event engagement.
* Ensure exceptional attention to detail, thoughtful personalisation, seamless communication, and proactive service recovery.
* Develop post-celebration engagement strategies to nurture long-term relationships and encourage future bookings.
* Champion a culture in which every interaction feels personal, intuitive, and memorable.
* Creative Collaboration & Event Execution
* Partner with Culinary, Food & Beverage, Marketing, Rooms, Engineering, Housekeeping, Security, and external creative specialists to deliver seamless celebrations.
* Oversee creative briefs, event concepts, venue layouts, menu experiences, décor, entertainment, production, and event timelines.
* Lead creative reviews, client tastings, site inspections, and pre-event coordination meetings.
* Ensure concepts are operationally feasible, financially sound, and aligned with brand standards.
* Maintain oversight of event delivery, ensuring consistency between the agreed concept and the final guest experience.
* Conduct post-event reviews to capture client feedback, evaluate commercial performance, and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Brand Expression & Lifestyle Partnerships
* Protect the distinct identities of Fairmont Mumbai and Roswyn while developing celebration experiences appropriate to each property's positioning.
* Collaborate with Marketing to create compelling visual stories and celebration showcases, subject to brand guidelines and client consent.
* Explore relevant partnerships with luxury fashion, design, beauty, gastronomy, entertainment, and lifestyle brands.
* Develop distinctive experiences that encourage social engagement, referrals, and positive brand advocacy.
* Ensure all external collaborations enhance the guest experience and deliver measurable business value.
* Leadership & Culture
* Lead and inspire the celebrations team through creativity, accountability, commercial awareness, and service excellence.
* Establish clear performance expectations, development plans, and standards of execution.
* Foster collaboration across departments and encourage innovative thinking.
* Develop the team's capabilities in consultative selling, experience design, client relationship management, and luxury service.
* Champion the values of Accor and the relevant brand standards of both properties.
* Governance, Safety & Responsible Operations
* Ensure celebrations comply with applicable laws, licensing conditions, safety requirements, food hygiene standards, and hotel policies.
* Oversee approved vendor partnerships, contracts, event documentation, budgets, and operational risk assessments.
* Ensure responsible management of décor, entertainment, sound, production, and other event-related activities.
* Maintain appropriate financial discipline and ensure all commercial commitments follow the hotel's approval processes.
* Key Performance Indicators
* Celebration revenue and profitability against budget.
* Qualified enquiry generation and conversion rate.
* Average event value and ancillary revenue contribution.
* New client acquisition, repeat business, and referrals.
* Client satisfaction and post-event feedback.
* Strategic partnerships and contribution from referral channels.
* Effectiveness of signature experiences and creative initiatives.
* Brand positioning and quality of celebration execution.
* Budgetary control, compliance, and operational excellence.
* Team performance, engagement, and development.
* Qualifications & Experience
* Degree or diploma in Hospitality Management, Event Management, Business Management, or a related field.
* Typically 8–12 years of relevant experience in luxury hospitality, lifestyle hotels, luxury events, weddings, or bespoke social celebrations.
* Demonstrated experience in leading high-value events, cultivating premium clientele, and delivering personalised experiences.
* Strong commercial understanding of sales, revenue management, pricing, budgeting, and profitability.
* A well-developed network within the luxury celebrations, wedding, events, or lifestyle ecosystem would be advantageous.
* Experience working across multiple properties or distinct luxury and lifestyle brands would be preferred.
* Leadership Attributes
* Creative vision and an instinct for experiential luxury.
* Strong commercial and entrepreneurial mindset.
* Sophisticated communication and relationship-building skills.
* Aesthetic sensibility and attention to detail.
* Confidence in engaging discerning clients and senior stakeholders.
* Strong negotiation, presentation, and influencing capabilities.
* Collaborative leadership and cross-functional coordination.
* Adaptability, discretion, and sound judgement.
* A passion for creating memorable experiences and meaningful connections.
* Role Mandate

The Director of Celebrations will position Fairmont Mumbai and Roswyn, A Morgans Originals Hotel, as distinctive destinations for exceptional celebrations by bringing together creative excellence, contemporary lifestyle experiences, personalised luxury, and sustainable commercial growth.
  
  
Success in this role will be measured not only by revenue and profitability, but also by the strength of client relationships, the distinctiveness of experiences created, the reputation of both properties, and the lasting memories made possible through exceptional hospitality.
  
  
Additional Information
  
  
**Our commitment to Diversity & Inclusion:**
We are an inclusive company, and our ambition is to attract, recruit and promote diverse talent.

title: Unit Head
description:
Unit Head – Credit Line on UPI
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
The Unit Head will own the end-to-end business performance of the Credit Line on UPI (CLoU) portfolio. This includes growth strategy, acquisition funnels, partner ecosystem management, monetisation, unit economics, and lifecycle optimization.
  
  
The role is deeply P&L-oriented, requiring strong cross-functional collaboration with product, risk, operations, finance, and partner-bank teams to drive scalable and sustainable business outcomes.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Business Growth & Strategy
* Own overall business performance for Credit Line on UPI—including lines created, active users, activation %, throughput, and revenue generation.
* Craft the go-to-market (GTM) strategy across target customer segments (merchant & consumer), use cases, and distribution channels.
* Develop and execute strategies to grow P2M adoption, repeat usage, frequency, and wallet share.
* Evaluate market trends, competitive landscape, and regulatory context to shape business priorities.
* Ensure predictable, controllable growth aligned with portfolio health and partner expectations.
* Partner & Ecosystem Management
* Manage relationships with partner LSPs, PSPs, TPAPs, distribution partners, and ecosystem players.
* Drive partner onboarding, integration planning, scale-up, and ongoing performance management.
* Align incentives, revenue models, and commercial structures to optimise partner throughput and profitability.
* Lead governance forums with partners—reviewing business volumes, operational issues, funnel leakages, risk metrics, and revenue outcomes.
* Ensure stable and high-performing partnerships that enable predictable business scaling.
* Acquisition & Post-Acquisition Ownership
* Work with growth, marketing, product, and channel partners to optimise acquisition funnels end-to-end.
* Identify drop-off points across onboarding, activation, and early-usage stages; drive initiatives to improve activation and engagement.
* Own lifecycle interventions post-acquisition—nudges, journeys, campaigns, and partner-led programs to improve usage and repeat transactions.
* Drive funnel improvements that translate into higher active base, improved retention, and stronger unit economics.
* Revenue, Monetisation & Unit Economics
* Own all monetisation levers including interchange, MDR, interest income, late fees, and partner-linked revenue streams.
* Analyse and manage CAC, cost-to-serve, collection efficiency, risk-adjusted contribution margin, and overall P&L sustainability.

* Build revenue forecasts, P&L models, and commercial scenarios for planning and partner negotiations.
* Ensure strong visibility into revenue performance, profitability, and economic drivers across customer cohorts.

* Monitor dashboards tracking lines created, activations, active users, repeat usage, transaction value, risk metrics, and revenue.
* Identify performance patterns and proactively address early-warning signals related to risk, conversion, or partner issues.
* Lead business reviews with leadership, presenting insights, strategic decisions, and data-driven action plans.
* Drive controlled experiments, pilots, and A/B tests to unlock new segments, use cases, and monetisation opportunities.
* Use analytics to forecast performance, optimise growth levers, and improve portfolio profitability.

description:
**Head of Legal Operations**

**Function**
Legal Operations, Compliance and Contracts

12 to 18 years

**Education**
LLB (mandatory)

**Leadership scope**
Leads a team of lawyers

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced legal professional to lead our legal operations. The Head of Legal Operations will own the day-to-day legal function of the company across compliance, contracts and regulatory obligations, lead a team of lawyers, and build the technology infrastructure and processes that give management a complete, water-tight view of the company's compliance status and contractual obligations.

This role combines deep legal expertise with leadership, project management and a strong commercial understanding of the business. The ideal candidate is as comfortable negotiating a complex contract as designing a workflow that lets the business self-serve routine legal requests.

Preferred Background

Candidates from leading law firms, legal advisory firms, professional services organisations (audit, consulting, research), advertising or PR agencies, and media or publishing houses with established legal, compliance or corporate advisory functions are encouraged to apply.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Legal operations and team leadership

* Lead, mentor and develop a team of lawyers; set objectives, allocate work, plan capacity and build a culture of high performance.
* Run ongoing legal operations of the company, ensuring timely, consistent and high-quality legal support to business teams.
* Define the legal function's operating model, including intake and triage of legal requests, escalation paths, service levels and approval workflows.
* Act as a trusted advisor to senior management on legal risk and the business implications of legal matters.

2. Contracts and commercial negotiations

* Oversee drafting, review, negotiation and execution of client, vendor, partner and employment-related contracts.
* Lead negotiations on complex or high-value agreements, balancing legal protection with commercial outcomes.
* Develop and maintain standard templates, clause libraries and contracting playbooks to speed up turnaround while preserving risk guardrails.
* Maintain a centralised contract repository with clear metadata so that key dates, renewals and obligations are always visible.

3. Compliance and regulatory management

* Build and maintain a compliance framework covering applicable laws, regulations and contractual obligations.
* Track regulatory developments and assess their impact on the company; advise management on required actions.
* Create a consolidated compliance and obligations view for management, with clear ownership, deadlines and status reporting.
* Support audits, due diligence exercises and corporate advisory requirements, including corporate law matters.

4. Technology, process and automation

* Select, implement and administer legal technology, including contract lifecycle management (CLM) tools such as Spotdraft, and drive adoption across the business.
* Design and continuously improve workflows, templates and self-service tools to reduce manual effort and cycle times.
* Define and track KPIs such as contract turnaround time, volume of requests, compliance status and outside counsel spend; present dashboards to management.

5. Litigation, disputes and external counsel

* Oversee commercial litigation and dispute matters, working with external counsel on strategy, cost and outcomes.
* Manage the panel of external law firms, including scopes of work, fee arrangements and performance reviews.
* Maintain a clear record of all legal matters, risks and exposures, reported to management on a regular basis.

6. Budget and cross-functional partnership

* Plan and manage the legal function's budget and control legal spend.
* Partner with Finance, HR, IT, Procurement and business leaders to embed legal and compliance requirements into everyday processes.
* Run legal awareness and training sessions for business teams.

**Candidate Profile**

Experience

* 12 to 18 years of relevant experience heading the legal function and operations of a professional services firm, such as a law firm, audit firm, consulting firm, advertising agency, research firm, or media or publishing house.
* Proven track record of managing a team of lawyers and handling corporate law, commercial litigation, due diligence and regulatory compliance matters.
* Experience of operating or managing CLM tools such as Spotdraft, including rollout and adoption.

Skills and competencies

* **Negotiation, research and presentation:**
  excellent legal negotiation skills, with the ability to research complex issues and present clearly to senior management.
* **Commercial orientation:**
  ability to understand the business implications of legal matters and offer practical, risk-balanced advice.
* **Leadership:**
  capability to build, nurture and retain high-performing teams.
* **Project management:**
  ability to plan and deliver multiple initiatives, such as technology rollouts and process redesign, to deadline.
* **Process and data orientation:**
  comfort with workflows, dashboards and metrics to give management clear visibility.
* **Communication and integrity:**
  strong written and verbal communication, stakeholder management and absolute discretion with confidential information.

Educational Qualifications

* LLB is a must.
* An LLM or a specialization in corporate or commercial law is an advantage.
* Certifications in legal operations, compliance or project management are a plus.

Why Join Us

This is a senior leadership opportunity to shape a legal function from the ground up, with direct visibility to management and the freedom to build the people, processes and technology that will support the company's growth.

description:

StayVista is **India’s largest villa hospitality brand** and has redefined group getaways. Our handpicked luxury villas are present in every famous holiday destination across the country. We curate unique experiences paired with top-notch hospitality, creating unforgettable stays. **Here, you will be a part of our passionate team, dedicated to crafting exceptional getaways and curating one-of-a-kind homes.** We are a close-knit tribe, united by a shared love for travel and on a mission to become the most loved hospitality brand in India.

title: Supply Operations Quality Market Lead (Team Lead)
description:
The Supply Operations Quality (SOQ) Lead is accountable for end-to-end Quality leadership and oversight of supply operations in India, including product release, distribution, product quality management and vendor quality management. The role ensures regulatory compliance, inspection readiness and the supply of compliant products into India and relevant neighbouring markets.

As the **primary Quality point of contact for the India PCO**, the role provides direction on Quality matters, influences key business decisions, leads the escalation and resolution of significant Quality issues, and leads and **develops the India SOQ team**. It partners with Commercial, Regulatory Affairs, Medical, Global Supply Chain, External Supply Operations Quality and PGS sites to manage significant Quality risks and support continuity of supply.

The role **leads the delivery of India Marketing Authorisation Holder Quality responsibilities** and acts as the Responsible Person for the relevant India licences, ensuring product release, storage and distribution comply with regulatory requirements, Pfizer Quality Standards, Good Manufacturing Practice and Good Distribution Practice requirements.

**What You Will Achieve**

**Quality Leadership & Governance**

* Provide senior Quality leadership end-to-end quality oversight for the India market, with accountability for the effectiveness of market quality governance, compliance, risk management and quality decision-making.
* Lead quality management reviews and governance forums; ensuring significant Quality risks, trends and issues are assessed, escalated and addressed.
* Establish a consistent, risk-based approach to Quality decisions and issue management across the India market.
* Ensure implementation and maintenance of global and functional procedures, Pfizer Quality Standards and supporting Quality processes.
* Review Quality performance, including metrics, trends and emerging risks, and drive necessary improvement actions.
* Maintain oversight of Quality system effectiveness, training compliance and commitments arising from inspections, audits, deviations and corrective and preventive actions.

**2. Regulatory & Compliance Excellence**

* Act as the primary Quality representative for Pfizer India and the Good Distribution Practice Responsible Person for the relevant India licenses.
* Ensure compliance with local regulatory requirements, Pfizer Quality Standards and Good Manufacturing Practice and Good Distribution Practice requirements.
* Maintain inspection readiness and lead Quality support for health authority inspections and internal audits.
* Lead Quality-related interactions with local health authorities, in partnership with the relevant functions.
* Provide country-level direction and oversight for Quality compliance matters, ensuring effective coordination across the relevant Quality teams.
* Ensure timely and effective corrective and preventive actions following audits, inspections and significant Quality events, including verification of their effectiveness and sustainability.

**3. Suppliers, Partner & Distributor Oversight**

* Provide market-level oversight of Quality activities relating to suppliers, distributors, third-party logistics providers and commercial partners.
* Work with the relevant Quality teams to ensure supplier risks and performance issues are identified, escalated, and addressed.
* Drive supplier performance improvement through effective governance, Quality agreements, performance metrics and risk-based oversight.
* Ensure supplier qualification and audit activities are completed in line with regulatory requirements, Pfizer Quality Standards and established procedures

**4. Product Quality Management**

* Overseeing GMP/GDP and Quality Operations in the market and accountable for the Release for Distribution of imported products in India and export markets
* Lead investigation and resolution of market quality issues, root cause analysis, and sustainable CAPAs for product quality issues.
* Lead cross-functional Quality decisions and actions to manage product risks and support continuity of supply.
* Ensure product complaints are managed in compliance with Pfizer procedures and global Quality systems.
* Provide Quality leadership and oversight for market actions, recalls, quarantine alerts and product returns.

**5. People Leadership & Talent Development**

* Lead and develop a high-performing India SOQ team with clear accountabilities and objectives.
* Provide regular coaching, feedback, and performance management.
* Build team capability through development planning, knowledge sharing, and succession planning.
* Foster an inclusive and collaborative working environment that supports accountability and effective decision-making

**6. Business Partnership and strategic support**

* Represent Quality within the PCO leadership discussions and business forums.
* Serve as the primary Quality point of contact for India PCO
* Enable market launches, product lifecycle management activities, and supply continuity initiatives.
* Partner with global and regional teams to ensure compliance and operational excellence.
* Provide quality expertise in business transformation and process improvement initiatives

**Here Is What You Need** (minimum requirements)

* **Bachelors degree or MBA / MS Degree in Pharmacy**
* **10-15 years of relevant experience in the pharmaceutical industry in a Quality role is a must**
* **People Management experience is required. Strong leadership skills in managing a team and ability to engage and develop direct reports; a minimum of 5 years leading and demonstrated success in developing a team of colleagues is a must**
* **Extensive GMP/GDP Knowledge.** Trained and experienced in the total application of GMP/GDP licensing and Marketing Authorization compliance requirements
* Extensive experience with quality systems, investigations, CAPA management, audits, and inspections
* Extensive experience in managing cross-functional stakeholders, strong negotiation and influencing skills with internal senior stakeholders and external parties
* Demonstrated insight and understanding of stakeholders need and business requirements
* Strong analytical skills and decision-making skills, extensive experience in leading complex projects
* Extensive experience with demonstrated ability to communicate effectively
* Experience interacting with health authorities, regulatory agencies and external stakeholders
* High level of self-integrity and ethical conduct
* Strong planning and organisation skills
* A track record of continuous improvement and balancing efficiencies and effectiveness in processes

**Bonus Points If You Have** (Preferred Requirements)

* MBA degree or PhD degree

title: Assistant Manager – OFR Import Operations
description:
**ABOUT OCEAN FREIGHT OPERATIONS**

The Ocean Freight Operations team plays a pivotal role in managing all ocean-bound imports and exports, utilizing a diverse range of equipment and services. The team collaborates closely with a network of ocean carriers, Procurement & capacity management (PCM), and participating in major carrier alliances to secure planned space protection from key container ports globally. This meticulous coordination is essential for ensuring a reliable and efficient transportation process for ocean-bound cargo.

  

**JOB SUMMARY**

As an integral part of Ocean Freight Import Operations, the incumbent role in ensuring the efficiency of import processes within the specified region. The role involves supporting the ocean-bound cargo movements. It involves coordinating with various processes, including vessel scheduling, cargo documentation, interaction with ocean carriers to constantly strive for optimizing efficiency, regulations, and maintaining high standards of service.

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Operational Excellence:**

* Ensure cost-effective, high-quality Import Ocean freight operations at satellite locations.
* Handle a high volume of files and meet tight deadlines without sacrificing quality.
* Co-ordinate with Consignee, destination office for green light approval.
* Ensure operational compliance and error-free documentation on a timely basis.
* Responsible for the smooth execution of Imports Operation functions.
* Increase customer satisfaction (both internal/external) with best-in-class services.
* Co-ordinate with gateway/CFS/ICD team for timely de-stuffing of containers.
* Proactively report and manage Ops. Irregularity within 24 hours for irregularities such as excess landing, short landing, damages, etc.
* Eliminate revenue leakage by plugging all possible gaps.
* Co-ordinate with CBC team for timely clearance of DAP/DDU & DDP shipments and delivery of shipments to the consignee.
* Coordinate with the team in closing transshipment bonds if any executed with the shipping line and customs.
* Release documents to customers according to agreed SOP/COP (Cash/Credit).
* Manage the vendor payment process and ensure shipment tracking.
* Avoid claims and penalties due to service failures.
* Handle customer complaints and overseas queries.
* Implement CW1 Best Practices, including auto rating, auto costing, timely and accurate estimation of costs, milestone updation, and file hygiene checks.
* Taking complete responsibility for independently managing customer accounts, guided by both supervisor and manager, following the 'one file, one operator' approach.

  

**Stakeholder Management:**

* Increase customer satisfaction with best-in-class services.
* Manage carrier, supplier, and network relationships.
* Interface with sales teams and customer service teams.
* Keep the customer service team informed about shipment-related updates.

  

**Customer & Network Support:**

* Record complaints concerning all import shipments.
* Undertake and assist in daily export operations tasks.
* Address and resolve network-related issues.
* Maintain regular communication with sales and support teams.

  

**COMPETENCIES**

**Functional Competencies**

* Product Knowledge: Thorough knowledge of products, services, and logistics industry.
* Customer Service: Strong customer service skills to address inquiries, provide updates, and resolve issues related to shipments.
* Technology Proficiency: Implementing CW1 and other tools for optimizing operations.
* Customs Regulations Acumen: Understanding of customs procedures, tariff and international trade laws for industry regulations and standards.3

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Agility: Ability to adapt quickly to changing operational needs and environments.
* Continuous Learning: Willingness to learn and improve skills to enhance performance.
* Attention to Detail: Consistently maintaining accuracy and precision in tasks and documentation.
* Quality Orientation: Commitment to delivering high-quality results and services.
* Initiative: Taking proactive steps to improve processes or address issues without waiting for direction.
* Team Collaboration: Collaborating across teams for smooth operations.

**WHO CAN APPLY?**

**Must Have**

* Bachelor’s degree in any field required.
* Proven experience in running smooth operations processes.
* 2-3 years of experience in the shipping or logistics for Executive/ Sr. Executive.
* 4-5 years of experience in the shipping/logistics industry for AM/DM.
* Basic problem-solving skills to address common challenges.
* Proficient in Email writing and verbal communication with internal and external coordination.

  

**Preferred**

* Courses and certifications in business administration, operations management.
* Completed Cargo Basic and Dangerous Goods courses.
