title: Lenskart - Business Strategy & Operations
description:
Senior Manager - Business Strategy & Operations

**About the Company**

Lenskart is Asia's largest eyewear company, serving over 40 million people across 175+ cities in India, Singapore, Dubai, and beyond. What started as an online eyewear store in 2010 has grown into an omnichannel powerhouse with 3,000+ stores, the world's most automated eyewear manufacturing facility, and a mission to serve one billion eyes. "Good is not good enough" is something you'll hear often at Lenskart - we're constantly pushing ourselves to redefine how people see and experience the world.

**About the Role**

This is an opportunity to solve some of the most important business problems at one of India's fastest-scaling consumer companies. As a Senior Manager – Business Strategy & Operations, you'll work directly on high-impact strategic initiatives that shape the future of Lenskart. You'll own critical workstreams, partner with senior leaders, and drive execution across multiple business functions. This role is designed for people who thrive in ambiguity, love solving complex problems, and want significantly more ownership than a traditional strategy role offers. Please note: After submitting your application, you will receive an AI assessment via email. Completing this assessment is mandatory for progressing to the next stage of the hiring process.

**Responsibilities**

* Own high-impact strategic initiatives from problem definition to execution, ensuring measurable business outcomes.
* Partner closely with business leaders to identify growth opportunities, solve operational challenges, and improve business performance.
* Drive cross-functional projects involving Sales, Retail, Supply Chain, Marketing, Finance, Product, and Customer Experience teams.
* Build business cases, perform deep analytical problem-solving, and convert insights into actionable recommendations.
* Leverage AI extensively for research, analysis, reporting, automation, and decision-making. Develop AI-powered workflows that improve productivity and eliminate manual processes wherever possible.
* Build dashboards, operating mechanisms, and review frameworks to track business performance and ensure execution excellence.
* Get hands-on with execution by working directly with business teams, stores, vendors, and stakeholders to understand problems firsthand and implement practical solutions.
* Present structured recommendations and updates to senior leadership through crisp communication and data-backed insights.

**Qualifications**

* Undergraduate degree from an IIT (or another top-tier engineering institute) and/or an MBA from an IIM or another leading global business school.
* 2–5 years of experience in management consulting (McKinsey, BCG, Bain, Kearney, Strategy&, Oliver Wyman, etc.), investment banking, founder's office, CEO's office, business strategy, business operations, or high-growth startups.
* Strong analytical and structured problem-solving capabilities with experience handling complex, ambiguous business problems.
* Demonstrated ownership of high-impact projects with measurable business outcomes.
* Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct reporting authority.
* Strong proficiency in Excel/Sheets, SQL (preferred), data analysis, and business storytelling.
* Daily user of AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Cursor, or similar) with the ability to build AI-assisted workflows, automations, or lightweight agents that improve business productivity.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to simplify complex ideas into clear recommendations.
* Founder, startup, or entrepreneurial experience will be considered a strong advantage.

**What You Can Expect**

* Ownership of business-critical initiatives with visible impact on the company's growth.
* Direct exposure to senior leadership and opportunities to influence key strategic decisions.
* A fast-paced, founder-led environment where exceptional performance is recognized with accelerated growth and responsibility.
* The opportunity to work across multiple business functions and gain a holistic understanding of scaling a global consumer brand.
* A culture that values first-principles thinking, speed, ownership, and continuous learning.
* The chance to build meaningful solutions using AI and modern technology while solving real business problems.
* A role that can become a defining milestone in your career—not because of the title, but because of the scale of problems you'll solve and the impact you'll create.

title: Sr Operations & Logistics Manager
description:
**Sr. Business Operations Manager – Rider Experience & Consumer Insights**
**Uber | India & South Asia**
**About The Role**
At Uber, millions of riders trust us to get them where they need to go, every day. But what makes a great ride experience? What frustrates riders, what builds their trust, and what makes them choose Uber again and again?
  
  
We are looking for someone who is
**obsessed with understanding consumers**
— someone who is endlessly curious about what riders think, feel and experience, and passionate about turning those insights into meaningful change.
  
  
In this role, you will be the
**champion of the rider's voice within Uber**
, ensuring that consumer needs, expectations and pain points are at the heart of how we build products, design experiences and make business decisions.
  
  
You will shape Uber's Rider Experience strategy across India & South Asia, working closely with Product, Operations, Marketing and Marketplace teams to make Uber the most trusted and preferred mobility platform.
  
  
This is a unique opportunity to combine deep consumer understanding with strategic thinking and real business impact — moving beyond understanding what riders want to actually making it happen.
  
  

* Drive Consumer Insights & Problem Solving: Bring structure to ambiguous consumer problems, triangulating quantitative data, qualitative research and field insights to uncover root causes, size opportunities and drive actionable recommendations.
* Reimagine the Rider Experience: Identify and prioritize friction points across the end-to-end rider journey, with a focus on new rider experience, satisfaction and retention. Partner with cross-functional teams to drive measurable improvements.
* Build & Scale Rider Value Propositions: Identify opportunities for differentiated consumer propositions, validate them through research and experimentation, and partner with Product and Marketing to launch and scale impactful solutions.
* Own Critical Consumer Journeys: Drive improvements across priority areas including payments, rider communications and engagement programs, balancing consumer experience, business impact and investment efficiency.
* Champion the Voice of the Rider: Build a deep understanding of rider needs, frustrations and unmet expectations by combining consumer research, VOC and behavioral data. Translate insights into clear priorities that influence business and product decisions.
* Embed Consumer Obsession Across Uber: Bring compelling consumer insights and data-backed recommendations into leadership discussions, challenge assumptions and mobilize teams to act on what matters most to riders.

**What You'll Need**

* 5+ years of experience in consumer insights, customer experience, consumer strategy, product, growth or related fields.
* Consumer obsession: Deep curiosity about human behavior, strong empathy and a natural instinct to uncover what consumers really need.
* Analytical rigor & structured problem solving: Ability to bring clarity to ambiguous problems, synthesize complex datasets and marry quantitative evidence with qualitative insights.
* Insight-to-action orientation: Proven ability to translate consumer understanding into sharp strategic recommendations, prioritized initiatives and measurable business outcomes.
* Strong ownership & execution: Comfortable navigating ambiguity, driving cross-functional initiatives and moving from problem identification to implementation.
* Storytelling & influence: Ability to simplify complex insights, build compelling narratives and influence senior stakeholders to champion the consumer perspective.

**Ready to Ride?**
This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

title: Merchandising Manager – High-Fashion Garment Exports
description:
Merchandising Manager – High-Fashion Garment Exports

**Company:**
PREWAL STUDIO PRIVATE LIMITED

**Location:**
Udyog Vihar Phase 1, Gurugram

**Employment:**
Full-time | On-site

**Experience:**
Preferably 8–12 years in garment export merchandising

**Reporting to:**
COO, working closely with the Founders

**Joining:**
Immediate or short-notice candidates preferred

About PREWAL

PREWAL is a high-fashion garment manufacturing and export company serving international buyers across the USA, Europe and Australia. Our work involves detailed product development, embroidery, embellishment and close coordination between sampling and production.

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Merchandising Manager to lead merchandising and take overall responsibility for order coordination, buyer communication, costing, material readiness and delivery planning.

Role ownership

You will own the merchandising process from development through shipment readiness, ensuring that buyer requirements translate into clear internal priorities, realistic timelines and timely execution.

You will lead merchandising support staff and coordinate with Product Development, Sourcing, Production, QA and EXIM. You will be expected to identify risks early, drive corrective action and keep management informed of decisions requiring intervention.

Key responsibilities

**1. Buyer communication and account ownership**

* Independently manage daily communication with international buyers and buying houses.
* Clarify specifications, quantities, prices, approvals and delivery requirements.
* Maintain clear records of buyer comments, decisions and commitments.
* Confirm internal feasibility before making commercial or delivery commitments.

**2. Development and approval coordination**

* Translate buyer requirements into clear development briefs and priorities.
* Coordinate sample submissions, corrections and approvals with Product Development and QA/Technical teams.
* Track fit samples, size sets, PP samples and other required approvals.
* Ensure buyer comments reach the relevant teams and are correctly incorporated.

**3. Costing and commercial control**

* Prepare or validate cost sheets covering fabric, trims, embroidery, processing, stitching, finishing and packing.
* Check consumption, supplier quotations and costing assumptions.
* Track changes against approved costings and highlight their commercial impact.
* Obtain management approval for significant pricing or commercial deviations.

**4. Material and supplier coordination**

* Coordinate fabric, trims, accessories and outsourced processes against order requirements.
* Track purchase requirements, supplier commitments, material approvals and delivery dates.
* Identify shortages, quality concerns and delays early, with clear corrective actions.

**5. TNA and order planning**

* Own and maintain the order Time and Action calendar from development through shipment.
* Agree milestones with the relevant departments and track planned versus actual progress.
* Maintain accurate, current WIP reports showing pending actions, owners, deadlines and risks.
* Resolve conflicting priorities and escalate issues with practical recovery plans.

**6. Pre-production readiness**

* Verify that required approvals, materials and production information are ready before bulk production.
* Ensure mandatory size-set and PP approvals are completed.
* Ensure Production receives the approved final sample and complete handover from Product Development.
* Coordinate pre-production meetings and closure of pending points.

**7. Production and shipment coordination**

* Align order priorities and delivery requirements with the Production Head’s capacity and execution plan.
* Monitor progress through production, finishing, inspection and packing.
* Coordinate shipment readiness with Production, QA and EXIM.
* Escalate delivery risks early and obtain approval before communicating major changes to buyers.

**8. Team leadership and management reporting**

* Allocate responsibilities to assistant/junior merchandising staff and verify follow-through.
* Lead regular order reviews with clear actions and deadlines.
* Maintain organised order files, approvals, cost sheets and correspondence.
* Present management with accurate status, key risks and decisions required.

Candidate requirements

* Preferably 8–12 years of relevant experience in garment export merchandising.
* Demonstrated ability to independently manage international buyer accounts and orders.
* Strong experience working with garment manufacturers/export houses.
* Experience with high-fashion, embroidered or embellished garments is strongly preferred.
* Practical knowledge of fabrics, trims, consumption, costing, sampling and garment production.
* Strong command of TNA planning, Excel and WIP reporting.
* Clear written and spoken English.
* Ability to lead a small merchandising team and coordinate effectively across departments.
* Sound judgement, attention to detail and consistent follow-through.
* Relevant apparel, textile or fashion qualification, or equivalent industry experience.

Strong Senior Merchandisers already performing this level of responsibility are also encouraged to apply.

How success will be measured

* Timely development submissions and approvals.
* Material readiness against agreed production requirements.
* Delivery performance against committed shipment dates.
* Cost control against approved costings.
* Accurate WIP reporting and early identification of risks.
* Effective buyer communication and closure of team actions.

**Compensation:**
Based on relevant experience and demonstrated capability.

Please apply through LinkedIn with an updated CV highlighting the products, export markets, buyer accounts and team responsibilities you have independently handled.

title: Assistant Vice President
description:
**About the Opportunity**

Our Credit Control and Operations teams keep premium receivables moving across product lines, geographies and client programmes. The work spans billing, collections, cash application, reconciliations, portfolio management and reporting, and involves close engagement with brokers, reinsurers, MGAs, underwriters and finance teams.

We are looking for a leader who has run operations at scale and wants to lead where the function goes next. You will own delivery and the financial performance of the function today.

**Position Title:**
Associate Vice President – Credit Control & Operations

**Location:**
Gurugram

**Experience:**
15+ years, including significant time in Insurance / Reinsurance operations

**What you’ll be doing**

**Lead operations**

* Own end-to-end delivery across credit control and operations: planning, scheduling, execution and process health.
* Ensure the teams meet or exceed client-agreed service levels, quality and turnaround targets.
* Maintain process documentation, sign-offs and adherence to quality and control norms such as ISO
* Anticipate peak periods, risks and dependencies, and put mitigation in place before they affect clients.

**Own the financials**

* Own the P&L for the credit control and operations portfolio: revenue, margin, cost and headcount, with accountability for budget and forecast.
* Optimise capacity, utilisation, team pyramid and bench to protect profitability while maintaining service quality.
* Support commercial discussions on pricing, scope changes and contract renewals with the account and finance teams.
* Track and report financial performance regularly, and take corrective action early where the numbers move off plan.

**Set direction, manage risk and control**

* Build and own the operations strategy and roadmap for the function, in line with company and client priorities.
* Spot growth opportunities with existing clients, including new geographies, lines of business and services.
* Ensure financial controls, audit readiness and compliance with client, regulatory and information security requirements.
* Identify operational risks early, assign owners, and report them with a clear mitigation plan.

**Drive improvement and automation**

* Continuously review processes to identify waste, rework, manual touchpoints and control gaps.
* Build the improvement pipeline, size the benefit, and take ideas from concept to implementation.
* Use Microsoft Power Automate, Copilot and other tools to automate and simplify routine work, working with digital and technology teams where a larger build is needed.
* Embed the changes through updated procedures, training and ownership, and track whether the benefit shows up in the numbers.
* Build a culture where teams raise ideas and use new tools in their daily work.
* Liaise with AI and technology teams for designing technology solutions for the insurance industry

**Use data to run the business**

* Define and monitor the KPIs that matter: ageing, collection effectiveness, unallocated cash, first-time-right, turnaround and cost per transaction.
* Analyse trends and error patterns to find root causes, and bring clear recommendations to leadership and clients.
* Present monthly dashboards, performance reviews and error trend analysis to senior stakeholders.
* Create reporting that is accurate, timely and easy for non-specialists to act on.

**Manage clients and stakeholders**

* Hold regular governance meetings with client leadership, and escalation management
* Start conversations on process growth, transformation and future strategy, and support new opportunities with the business development and solutioning teams.
* Work with different departments in insurance organisations and Xceedance to resolve issues quickly.
* Gain a thorough understanding of the client’s end-to-end process, not just the part we run.

**Build and lead people**

* Lead managers and their teams, with clear goals, regular reviews and fair appraisals.
* Select, develop and prepare Analysts, Process Experts, Assistant Managers and Managers for their next role.
* Manage attendance, attrition and outages to limit customer impact, and keep hiring cost and bench levels in check.
* Maintain cross-training coverage so that no process depends on a single person.
* Prepare the team for how work will change, including new tools, new skills and new ways of working.

**What you’ll bring to the team**

**Essential**

* Graduate (finance, insurance, business or a related field) with 15+ years of experience in Insurance / Reinsurance operations and a strong operational background. An MBA, advanced degree or professional certification is preferred.
* Proven track record in leadership roles, managing managers and large, complex teams, with accountability for operational and financial results.
* Clear understanding of insurance, including the policy and premium lifecycle, brokers, binders and the basics of financials.
* Working knowledge of credit control and operations processes: billing, collections, cash application, reconciliations and reporting.
* Experience managing a P&L or budget, with the ability to plan strategy, set direction and deliver against financial targets.
* Proven record of improving processes and delivering measurable results, using methods such as Lean, Six Sigma or similar.
* Comfortable with data: advanced Excel and the ability to analyse, interpret and present numbers with confidence. Exposure to Power BI or similar tools is preferred.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Power Automate and hands-on use of Copilot, with the ability to spot where automation and AI can improve a process.
* Strong client management and senior stakeholder communication, including global and multi-region teams.
* Sound judgement, ownership, and the ability to manage change and bring people along.

**Good to have**

* Exposure to the London Market, Lloyd’s or specialty lines, or Billing & Collections experience across multiple geographies such as North America, UK, Europe and APAC.
* Experience with receivables or billing platforms, RPA tools or low-code solutions.
* Process improvement certification (Lean Six Sigma), or insurance qualifications such as CPCU, AINS, ARe or CII.
* Experience handling transitions, system migrations or large change programmes.

title: Manager- Quality
description:
**ABOUT EURONICS**

**Euronics Industries Pvt. Ltd.**
is India’s #1 washroom automation brand. Since 2002, we have built hand dryers, sensor taps, urinal sensors, soap dispensers, washroom panels and allied hygiene solutions trusted by 5,00,000+ customers. With a 2.5 lakh sq ft manufacturing facility in Gurugram, 750+ SKUs and 70–80% of our products Made in India, our solutions are installed at landmark sites including the New Parliament Building, the Supreme Court of India and 18+ airports.

**ROLE PURPOSE**

The Deputy Manager – Quality ensures every product leaving Euronics Industries and Techwork meets specification, certification and customer expectations. You will build one common, data-driven quality system across both entities, reduce the cost of poor quality, and keep ISO 9001 and BIS/ISI compliance audit-ready at all times.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Multi-Entity Quality Governance (Euronics + Techwork)**

* Own and harmonise quality policies, SOPs, inspection standards and acceptance criteria across both entities.
* Run a single monthly Quality Review for both entities with shared KPIs, defect Pareto and action tracker.
* Allocate QC manpower and inspection capacity between entities based on production plans and risk.

**2. Quality Management System & Certifications**

* Maintain the ISO 9001 QMS: document control, internal audits, management reviews and surveillance audit readiness.
* Ensure continuous compliance with BIS/ISI licence conditions, including product testing, marking and records.
* Support other product and green certifications held by the company and new certification projects.
* Act as the main point of contact for external auditors and certification bodies.

**3. Incoming, In-Process & Final Quality Control**

* Define inspection plans, AQL sampling plans and checklists for bought-out parts, sub-assemblies and finished goods.
* Oversee incoming inspection of electrical, electronic, stainless steel, plastic and PVD-finished components.
* Drive in-process controls on assembly lines, including electrical safety, functional and endurance testing.
* Approve final product release (PDI) and block non-conforming lots.

**4. Supplier Quality Management**

* Qualify new vendors through audits, PPAP / first article inspection and sample approval.
* Monitor supplier PPM and rating; run SCAR and development plans for poor performers.
* Coordinate quality checks for imported components with Purchase.

**5. Problem Solving, CAPA & Customer Complaints**

* Lead root cause analysis using 8D, 5-Why, Fishbone and FMEA for internal defects, field failures and complaints.
* Close CAPA within agreed timelines and verify effectiveness.
* Partner with Service and Projects teams on site failure analysis and warranty return trends.

**6. Continuous Improvement & Cost of Poor Quality**

* Track and reduce rework, scrap, rejections and warranty cost (COPQ).
* Deploy SPC, Poka-Yoke, 7 QC tools and Kaizen on critical processes.
* Support New Product Development with design reviews, DFMEA / PFMEA and pilot lot validation.

**7. Digital Quality & Reporting**

* Move inspection records, NCRs and CAPA from paper to a digital system (dashboards, QMS software or ERP module).
* Publish a weekly quality MIS and a monthly dashboard for leadership.
* Identify automation opportunities: digital checklists, test-data capture and auto-alerts for repeat defects.

**8. Team Leadership & Calibration**

* Lead, coach and evaluate QC engineers and inspectors across both entities; maintain a quality skill matrix.
* Train production operators on quality standards, first-time-right and defect awareness; drive 5S discipline.
* Maintain calibration schedule and traceability for all gauges, instruments and test equipment.

title: Analyst Founder's Office
description:
About Boon

Boon makes water purifiers for modern Indian homes. Our promise is simple:
**Water For Every You.**
We're a fast-moving team, and the founders are personally involved in growth, product, operations and service.

The role

You'll work directly with the founder on Boon's most important problems at any given time. One month it might be finding out why sales dropped in a city. The next, it might be launching on a new marketplace or fixing our installation process. You'll turn messy questions into clear answers, then help make them happen. This role is for someone who wants to learn how a company is built, fast, and doesn't mind getting their hands dirty.

What you'll do

* **Run the numbers:**
  Build and maintain Boon's weekly business review, covering sales, marketing spend, CAC, margins, inventory and service metrics.
* **Answer hard questions:**
  Deep-dive into problems like "Which channels are actually profitable?", "Why are returns up?" or "What's our real margin per product?"
* **Own special projects end-to-end:**
  For example, new city launches, Amazon/Flipkart expansion, pricing tests, filter subscription plans, or new partnerships.
* **Prepare founder and investor material:**
  Monthly MIS, board and investor updates, decks and financial summaries.
* **Research the market:**
  Track competitors (Kent, Aquaguard, Livpure, Pureit and newer D2C brands) on pricing, offers, products and service.
* **Drive follow-through:**
  Run action trackers from founder meetings, chase owners, and unblock cross-team work.
* **Fix processes:**
  Write and improve SOPs for areas like installation, service, returns and customer support.
* **Go to the ground:**
  Visit installation sites, call customers, sit with the support team. The answers are often not in a spreadsheet.

Must-haves

* 1–3 years in consulting, investment banking, VC, a startup strategy/ops role, or business analytics. Exceptional freshers are welcome.
* Strong in Excel or Google Sheets: pivots, XLOOKUP/INDEX-MATCH, and building a simple financial or unit economics model.
* Comfortable with business numbers: revenue, gross margin, contribution margin, CAC, LTV.
* Clear, structured writing. You can explain a complex problem in 5 lines.
* High ownership: you finish what you start without being chased.
* Happy to do unglamorous work when it's needed.
* Able to work full-time from our Gurgaon office.

Nice to have

* Experience in D2C, consumer products, consumer durables or hardware.
* SQL, Python, or a dashboard tool (Looker Studio, Power BI, Metabase).
* Using AI tools to speed up research and analysis.
* Comfortable speaking Hindi or a regional language for customer calls and field visits.
* Experience in operations, supply chain or after-sales service.

What you get

* Work directly with the founder and see how every decision gets made.
* Exposure to every function: growth, product, operations, finance, service and hiring.
* A clear path to own a function or a business line as you prove yourself.
* Competitive salary based on experience.

title: Senior Associate, Business Valuations, BTS - Global Capability Center
description:
**Description**
**About Alvarez & Marsal**
Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work - guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity - are why our people love working at A&M.
  
  
**The Team**
At A&M you will have the opportunity to work with a diverse entrepreneurial team of supportive and motivated professionals that love to share their knowledge and depth of industry experience with others. Our culture is characterized by openness and entrepreneurial thinking, with a foundation of mutual respect and high-quality standards for our work. We strive to remove bureaucracy in favor of recognizing effort and results through advancement opportunities and a motivating performance-based reward structure. Our Valuation team works with a variety of large-cap and mid-cap PE houses, corporate clients and financial institutions providing you with broad industry exposure
  
  
**How You Will Contribute**
You will be identifying and evaluating the key financial and operational drivers necessary to ensure a robust valuation partnership with managers and investors. You will address complex valuation challenges from critical investment, regulatory and strategic perspectives to assessing value at the fund, portfolio, and investment level. As part of a select, highly skilled, and entrepreneurial team, you will have the opportunity to work on multiple valuation services. Some of the main responsibilities are:
  
  

* Conduct thorough research on industry trends, market conditions, and competitor performance to support valuation analysis
* Apply valuation approaches (income, market, asset) and concepts, including the use of discount rates, premiums, and Black-Scholes modelling
* Build and review complex financial models, ensuring accuracy, integrity, and adherence to industry standards
* Demonstrate expertise in financial statements, key financial ratios, and forecasting models to support valuation work
* Perform in-depth valuation analyses for public and private entities across multiple industries using accepted methodologies
* Conduct detailed due diligence, gathering relevant data from client interactions, meetings, and site visits to inform model development
* Prepare comprehensive valuation reports and other deliverables for clients, ensuring clarity and precision
* Foster and maintain strong client relationships, providing consistent and clear communication throughout project execution
* Collaborate with the engagement team to ensure the effective, timely, and efficient delivery of all valuation related projects
* Should be capable of manage and/or working on multiple projects at a time, overseeing juniors in the team
* Ability to lead and mentor junior team members.

**Qualifications**

* Experience: 3-8 years in financial due diligence, audit, valuation, corporate finance, M&A, or transaction advisory services
* Chartered Accountant (CA) or Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) with a strong academic record
* Qualified or studying for a professional qualification such as ASA/CPA preferred
* Experience in Financial Analysis and Financial Modelling
* Proficient Microsoft Excel skills
* Strong writing skills and experience with developing presentations and reports using PowerPoint and Microsoft Word
* Excellent oral and written communication skills
* Effective project management and organizational skills
* Ambitious, results driven, self-starter with a desire to thrive in an entrepreneurial culture

**Your journey at A&M**
We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A&M. The possibilities are endless for high-performing and passionate professionals.

title: Mgr, Quality/Training Strategy, GO-AI Operations Integration
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

The Manager, Quality & Training Strategy owns how GO-AI defines, measures, and improves the quality of annotations delivered to Amazon Robotics and Worldwide Operations science teams. You will own the quality model for an AI and ML annotation workforce: how accuracy is measured, how measurement scales across use cases and demand, and how quality standards reflect the customer's perception of the output they receive. You operate as the independent measurement function for the annotation business, providing defect insights to Operations while representing the customer's view of quality.  
  
As GO-AI evolves, this role ensures that quality measurement keeps pace with how annotations are consumed by data scientists inside an ML product development lifecycle, and increasingly alongside model-generated output. You lead a team of program managers and quality managers across India and Costa Rica, and you apply an up-to-date understanding of AI capabilities to identify and drive use cases that improve operational metrics.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Own the GO-AI quality model. Define how annotation accuracy is measured for each use case so that published metrics reflect the customer's perceived quality of the output.

  

* Own quality KPI definition and governance across 70+ use cases, including target baselining, process capability assessment, and the standards applied to new and ramping workforces.

  

* Define the quality measurement strategy, including how coverage and depth of measurement scale with demand, risk, and cost of quality.

  

* Lead deep dives on any degradation of customer-consumed quality metrics, drive to root cause through standardized mechanisms, and publish findings and corrective actions to senior leadership through weekly and monthly business reviews.

  

* Operate as the independent measurement function for the annotation business. Partner with Customer Tech Programs on customer quality and speed expectations, and with Operations business unit leaders on defect insights and remediation.

  

* Translate ML customer needs into quality standards. Understand how annotations feed model training and evaluation so that quality definitions match how data scientists consume the output.

  

* Maintain a current understanding of AI capabilities and how they function. Identify and drive use cases where AI tooling improves quality, speed, and experience.

  

* Lead and develop a geographically distributed team of 6 to 8 program managers and quality managers across India and Costa Rica. Own hiring, onboarding, performance management, career growth, and team structure.

  
About the team  
GO-AI is a technology enablement organization that accelerates the development and enhances the performance of AI-based robotic and automation solutions for Amazon Robotics (AR) and key Worldwide Operations programs. We combine human expertise with machine learning to produce high-quality training data, validate model outputs, and continuously improve AI system performance across many annotation programs and a large global workforce.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of team management experience
* 5+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
* Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
* Experience managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership
* Experience with tools/systems to analyze data including Excel, Access, SQL or other data management systems
* Experience managing programs across multiple geographies and cultures

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in AI/ML operations, data annotation, or ML data quality.
* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or equivalent process improvement certification
* Experience designing measurement or audit frameworks at scale
* Experience applying GenAI or LLM-based tools to improve operational metrics
* Experience operating as an independent quality assurance function alongside an operations organization

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Assurance - Manager- Asset & Wealth Management (WAM)-FS
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-**
**Assurance – Manager**
As part of our EY-Assurance Team, you would be the main point of contact from GDS for the tasks assigned by the global client serving assurance teams and be responsible for the timeliness and quality of deliverables along with managing day to day operations of those engagements.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We’re looking for individuals who are qualified accountants with excellent leadership skills.
  
  
The incumbent gets an excellent opportunity to work virtually or directly with the engagement teams across Americas and Europe, and develop knowledge of international accounting and assurance principles
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Support a portfolio of engagements, by leading a team of Assistant Managers, Seniors and Associates
* Ensure the team delivers timely and high-quality work, as per EY methodology and in line with the engagement team’s expectations
* Demonstrate strong understanding of EY methodology in service delivery and supporting various quality projects, such as pre-issuance reviews, assurance quality reviews, efficiency projects and others.
* Develop and maintain productive relationships with key engagement team counterparts, such as Assurance executives based in Americas or Europe.
* Develop an understanding of EY Risk Management procedures and ensure that these are embedded into the engagement team’s work.
* Work closely with the engagement team to transition new engagements and services to GDS Assurance while maintaining the highest levels of quality of service.
* Proactively discuss work flow management with the engagement teams, allocating resources to the assigned work and monitoring performance against standards. Monitor utilization for one’s team, budget to actuals, and other operational matters.
* Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clarity of communication when dealing with GDS and engagement teams.
* Establish expectations regarding value to be delivered to the respective aligned GDS or engagement teams.
* Identify opportunities to improve the scope of work for GDS Assurance.
* Standardize assurance processes along with leveraging best practices across one’s aligned engagements or beyond.
* Help team members grow by encouraging them to actively contribute to the team.
* Lead by example, delegate work successfully and develop and maintain high performing teams.
* Conduct timely performance reviews and provide performance feedback and training.
* Use technology and tools to continually learn, share knowledge with team members, and enhance service delivery.
* Contribute to technical and soft-skills training to continually develop the team’s skills.
* Actively participate in organizational initiatives, such as recruitment, diversity and inclusiveness, trainings, and others.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Expert knowledge of Indian accounting and assurance standards
* Knowledge of UK GAAP or US GAAP and International assurance standards is an added advantage.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Effective interpersonal, risk management, facilitation and presentation skills
* Project management, leadership, coaching, counselling and supervisory skills
* Ability to spread positive work culture, teaming and live EY values.
* The ability to quickly form strong working relationship with colleagues in India and global teams.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI) with 5-6 years of post-qualification relevant experience
* Qualified ACCA / CPA with 7-8 years of post-qualification relevant experience
* Articleship with other top or mid -tier accounting firms
* Experience in either

+ Mid-or top-tier accounting firm focused on external or Assurance reviews / matters
+ MNC or larger Indian companies, preferably within a Shared Service Environment.
+ Big 4 Firms - Indian & Global practice

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Proficiency in MS – Excel, MS – Office.
* Interest in business and commerciality.

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: FCS People Leader
description:
Step into the role of a FCS people leader at Barclays, where you'll play a pivotal role in shaping the future. Join us in our mission to safeguard our business and our customers from financial crime risks.
  
  
**You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role such as:**

* Support various Financial Crime processes, which might include though not limited to payments / sanctions screening, adverse media screening and other AML related processes.
* Ensure compliance with Barclays Group Sanctions Policy and with Barclays Regulatory responsibilities in respect of the fight against Financial Crime.
* Key leadership role by coaching analysts, challenging poor‑quality outcomes, and embedding a culture of quality ownership and continuous improvement across Payments Screening operations.
* Drives data‑led quality oversight, performing trend and root‑cause analysis, monitoring QC trackers and SLAs, and presenting clear insights in quality forums and governance reviews.

**Desirable Skills Sets**

* Responsible for development, delivery, and maintenance of an effective Operational Risk Control environment to covering all aspects of Functional operational risk.
* Ensures strong quality and regulatory control over sanctions‑related payment decisioning.
* Deep knowledge of sanctions policies, screening alerts, escalation standards, and risk classification, along with accountability for maintaining QC quality thresholds, analyst accreditation, and decision consistency.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.

You may be assessed on key essential skills relevant to succeed in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
This role is based out of
**Noida.**
**Purpose of the role**
To assess the quality of business processes and the execution of processes and develop initiatives to improve quality standards.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Identification of areas for improvement within operations and provide recommendations for change through the quality assurance process.
* Development and implementation of quality control procedures and controls to mitigate risks and maintain efficient operations.
* Collaboration with teams across the bank to develop quality improvement guidelines, initiatives, objectives, and action plans to monitor performance, improve business areas and govern processes.
* Development of reports and presentations on quality control performance and communicate findings to internal senior stakeholders.
* Monitoring of customer-facing colleagues’ performance, and evaluating their performance through reviews, quality reporting, policy development and feedback on customer interactions.
* Execution of quality audits of the bank’s processes and operations, aligned to regulatory requirements and internal policies.
* Identification of industry trends and developments to implement best practice in quality assurance services.
* Participation in projects and initiatives to improve quality control efficiency and effectiveness.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**

* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Solar EPC Head
description:
**Company:**
 Chemi Tech Group

**Position:**
 Head – Solar EPC

**Location:**
 Noida, Uttar Pradesh

**CTC:**
 Up to ₹18 LPA + Target Based incentives

**Experience:**
 8–12 Years

**Industry:**
 Solar Energy / Renewable Energy

**Employment Type:**
 Full-Time

About Chemi Tech Group

Established in 1988, Chemi Tech Group is a leading player in India's renewable energy sector, with a strong presence in solar equipment distribution, manufacturing of solar mounting structures, FRP solutions, and allied solar products.

With operations across India, a growing manufacturing footprint, and a strong customer network, the Group is looking for an experienced Solar EPC Head to lead and expand its solar project execution business.

Key Responsibilities

**1. EPC Business Leadership**

* Lead the Solar EPC division, overseeing projects from initial planning to final commissioning.
* Develop and implement strategies for profitable growth of the EPC business.
* Take ownership of project profitability, timelines, quality, and customer satisfaction.
* Identify new business opportunities in commercial, industrial, and institutional solar projects.

**2. Project Execution & Management**

* Manage end-to-end execution of rooftop and ground-mounted solar projects.
* Oversee engineering, procurement, installation, testing, and commissioning activities.
* Prepare project schedules, budgets, resource plans, and execution strategies.
* Ensure timely completion of projects within approved budgets and quality standards.
* Monitor multiple project sites simultaneously.

**3. Technical & Engineering Oversight**

* Supervise system design, electrical engineering, structural engineering, and BOQ preparation.
* Ensure compliance with applicable BIS, IEC, CEA, and other regulatory requirements.
* Oversee selection of solar modules, inverters, mounting structures, cables, and BOS components.
* Review technical drawings, project specifications, and engineering documentation.

**4. Commercial & Financial Management**

* Prepare and review project costing, quotations, tenders, and commercial proposals.
* Manage project budgets, cash flows, billing, and cost optimization.
* Negotiate with subcontractors, vendors, and service providers.
* Monitor project-level profitability and minimize cost overruns.

**5. Team & Vendor Management**

* Build, lead, and mentor a team of project managers, site engineers, supervisors, and execution personnel.
* Manage subcontractors and installation partners across multiple locations.
* Establish standardized processes for project execution, quality assurance, and safety.
* Coordinate with internal procurement, finance, sales, and logistics teams.

**6. Client & Stakeholder Management**

* Act as the primary escalation point for project-related issues.
* Maintain strong relationships with customers, consultants, DISCOMs, and statutory authorities.
* Ensure timely approvals, inspections, commissioning, and project handovers.

Candidate Requirements

**Education:**

* B.Tech / B.E. in Electrical, Mechanical, Civil, or Renewable Energy Engineering.
* MBA or Project Management certification will be an added advantage.

**Experience:**

* 10–15 years of experience in project execution, including at least 5 years in Solar EPC.
* Proven experience independently managing multiple solar projects.
* Strong exposure to C&I rooftop and ground-mounted solar installations.
* Experience managing EPC teams, subcontractors, and project budgets.
* Good understanding of solar project costing, procurement, engineering, and commissioning.
* Experience handling projects across multiple geographical locations is preferred.

Key Skills

* Solar EPC Project Management
* Technical Engineering & Execution
* Project Costing & Budget Control
* Vendor & Subcontractor Management
* Team Leadership
* Contract Management
* Quality Assurance & Site Safety
* Client Relationship Management
* Problem-Solving & Decision-Making

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Total MW of projects successfully executed
* On-time project completion percentage
* Project gross margins and profitability
* Budget adherence and cost control
* Quality, safety, and customer satisfaction
* Team productivity and execution efficiency

Compensation

**Annual CTC:**
 Up to ₹18,00,000, commensurate with experience and capabilities.

**Work Location:**
 Noida, with travel to project sites across India as required.

How to Apply

Interested candidates may share their updated resumes with the subject line 
**"Application – Head Solar EPC | Noida"**
.

.

title: NSO Head - Operations (New Site Operations)

10+ Years

Operations

Hospitality | Hotels | Co-living | Student Accommodation | Serviced Apartments

COO / SVP

The incumbent will drive operational preparedness across multiple locations, establish robust operating frameworks, build high-performing teams and ensure that every new property is launched within defined timelines, approved budgets and UNILIV's service quality standards.

* Lead end-to-end operational planning, mobilisation and commissioning of new properties.
* Develop comprehensive pre-opening strategies, launch roadmaps, milestones and readiness frameworks.
* Drive seamless transitions from project completion and handover to fully operational properties.
* Oversee pre-opening inspections, infrastructure readiness, snag closure and operational audits.
* Ensure all properties are occupancy-ready within committed launch timelines.

**2. Strategic Manpower Planning & Leadership**

* Develop manpower budgets, organisational structures and deployment strategies for new properties.
* Partner with HR and Talent Acquisition to drive leadership and frontline hiring.
* Establish property-level reporting structures, performance accountability and operational ownership.
* Ensure structured induction, training, leadership alignment and SOP implementation before launch.
* Build and lead high-performing teams across multiple locations.

**3. Vendor, Procurement & Infrastructure Management**

* Drive vendor identification, evaluation, onboarding and performance management.
* Oversee procurement and availability of operational assets, equipment, supplies and consumables.
* Establish vendor governance frameworks, service-level agreements and cost-control mechanisms.
* Ensure readiness of housekeeping, security, maintenance, pest control and other outsourced services.

**4. Operational Excellence & Service Delivery**

* Design, standardise and implement operational SOPs across all newly launched properties.
* Establish operational benchmarks for housekeeping, maintenance, front office and resident experience.
* Drive service quality, operational consistency and resident satisfaction.
* Conduct periodic operational reviews, audits and process improvement initiatives.
* Ensure adherence to internal policies, safety protocols and applicable statutory requirements.

**5. Financial Planning & Cost Optimisation**

* Develop and manage pre-opening operational budgets.
* Exercise financial discipline across manpower, procurement, vendor contracts and operating expenses.
* Monitor budget utilisation, identify cost efficiencies and minimise launch-related financial leakages.
* Establish asset management, inventory control and handover mechanisms.
* Ensure operational readiness without compromising cost efficiency or service standards.

**6. Cross-Functional Leadership & Stakeholder Management**

* Work closely with Projects, Engineering, HR, Finance, Procurement, Sales and Customer Experience teams.
* Establish clear ownership of launch dependencies, timelines and deliverables.
* Present periodic launch progress reports, risk assessments and operational readiness dashboards to senior management.
* Proactively identify execution bottlenecks and drive timely resolution.
* Act as the single point of operational accountability for new property launches.

**What We Are Looking For/ Candidate Profile**

* 10+ years of progressive experience in hospitality, hotel operations, serviced apartments, co-living, student accommodation or related sectors.

title: Senior Merchandiser
description:
**About D2 International**

For over 30 years, D2 International has partnered with leading fashion brands across Europe and the United Kingdom, developing and manufacturing premium leather handbags, accessories, and small leather goods.

Our work sits at the intersection of design, craftsmanship, and commercial execution. Every season, we collaborate with international design, sourcing and buying teams to deliver products that meet exacting standards of quality, craftsmanship, cost and delivery.

**The Opportunity**

We are looking for an experienced
**Senior**
**Merchandiser**
for merchandising operations and oversee the complete product lifecycle, from initial concept and development through production and final shipment.

The role requires strong technical, commercial and operational expertise, along with the ability to manage teams, build buyer relationships and drive cross-functional execution. You will be responsible for ensuring that product development, costing, production planning and order delivery are aligned with buyer expectations, quality standards and business objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Oversee end-to-end merchandising operations, ensuring seamless execution from product development and sampling to bulk production and final dispatch.
* Manage, and develop the merchandising team, establishing clear priorities, accountability and performance standards.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with international buyers, designers and sourcing teams, serving as a key point of coordination for product development and order execution.
* Oversee design interpretation, sampling, technical revisions and buyer approvals, ensuring product accuracy, feasibility and timely closure.
* Guide the team in reviewing product construction, patterns, materials, hardware, trims and finishing in coordination with pattern masters, technicians and craftsmen.
* Drive costing strategies, cost optimisation and commercial negotiations while ensuring product quality and profitability objectives.
* Coordinate with Production, Sourcing, Quality, Stores and external vendors to ensure material readiness, production feasibility and smooth order execution.
* Oversee production planning, order tracking and delivery schedules, proactively identifying risks, resolving bottlenecks and ensuring timely shipment.
* Establish effective monitoring mechanisms for development timelines, sample approvals, production milestones, quality parameters and delivery commitments.
* Ensure adherence to buyer specifications, technical requirements, quality standards and pre-shipment compliance.
* Work closely with senior management and cross-functional teams to improve merchandising processes, operational efficiency and overall order execution.
* Review merchandising reports, order status, costing, delivery performance and team productivity, providing timely updates and insights to management.
* Manage multiple buyer accounts and order portfolios, ensuring effective resource allocation and consistent delivery performance.

**What We're Looking For**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Management, Fashion Management, Merchandising or a related discipline.
* Min 4 years of experience in merchandising, preferably within leather goods, handbags, accessories or export manufacturing, with prior team management experience.
* Proven experience managing the complete product lifecycle, from development and buyer approvals to bulk production and final shipment.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple buyer accounts and drive cross-functional execution.
* Strong understanding of product costing, commercial negotiations, material optimisation, production planning, quality control and delivery management.
* Experience in handling international buyers, interpreting technical specifications and resolving product development and production-related challenges.
* Excellent communication skills in English and Hindi, with confidence in managing international business relationships.
* A strategic yet hands-on professional with strong commercial acumen, attention to detail and end-to-end accountability.

**Why Join D2?**

* Work directly with renowned international fashion brands.
* Lead end-to-end merchandising operations across global product development and manufacturing programmes.
* Work alongside highly skilled craftsmen, pattern masters, technicians and manufacturing professionals.
* Influence products from initial concept to finished goods reaching leading retail markets across the globe.
* Play a significant role in strengthening merchandising capabilities, operational processes and business performance.

**Apply If**

* You can translate creative concepts into technically sound and commercially viable products.
* You have the leadership capabilities to manage teams, buyers and multiple order portfolios.
* You can balance product quality, commercial objectives and delivery commitments.
* You proactively identify risks, resolve bottlenecks and drive stakeholders towards closure.
* You thrive in a fast-paced export manufacturing environment and take ownership of business outcomes.

**Candidates willing to relocate to Kolkata are welcome to apply.**

* **To apply:**
  Please send your resume to
  **hrd@d2international.com**

title: Assurance - Manager- Asset & Wealth Management (WAM)-FS
description:

**Assurance – Manager**

* Demonstrate strong understanding of EY methodology in service delivery and supporting various quality projects, such as pre-issuance reviews, assurance quality reviews, efficiency projects and others.

* Conduct timely performance reviews and provide performance feedback and training.
* Use technology and tools to continually learn, share knowledge with team members, and enhance service delivery.
* Contribute to technical and soft-skills training to continually develop the team’s skills.
* Actively participate in organizational initiatives, such as recruitment, diversity and inclusiveness, trainings, and others.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Expert knowledge of Indian accounting and assurance standards
* Knowledge of UK GAAP or US GAAP and International assurance standards is an added advantage.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Effective interpersonal, risk management, facilitation and presentation skills
* Project management, leadership, coaching, counselling and supervisory skills
* Ability to spread positive work culture, teaming and live EY values.
* The ability to quickly form strong working relationship with colleagues in India and global teams.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI) with 5-6 years of post-qualification relevant experience

* Experience in either

+ Mid-or top-tier accounting firm focused on external or Assurance reviews / matters
+ MNC or larger Indian companies, preferably within a Shared Service Environment.
+ Big 4 Firms - Indian & Global practice

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Proficiency in MS – Excel, MS – Office.
* Interest in business and commerciality.

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Job Title: Team Lead – GIS Data Specialist (Road Annotation)

Domain: GIS / Geospatial Data Annotation / HD Mapping

Role Type: Team Management & Operations

Job Overview

We are looking for an experienced and technically proficient Team Lead – GIS Data Specialist (Road Annotation) to manage and drive a team responsible for GIS-based road annotation activities for an HD Mapping project.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on expertise in road network annotation using JOSM, a strong understanding of GIS concepts and OpenStreetMap (OSM) standards, and the ability to manage team productivity, quality, and delivery timelines. The role involves overseeing annotation workflows, ensuring mapping accuracy, conducting quality audits, and driving continuous process improvements.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead, manage, and monitor a team of GIS Road Annotation Specialists.
* Oversee road annotation activities, including road networks, lane geometries, intersections, medians, sidewalks, and other road infrastructure using JOSM.
* Ensure accurate feature tagging, road connectivity, and alignment with high-resolution satellite imagery.
* Conduct regular quality checks and audits to ensure annotation accuracy and compliance with client guidelines.
* Monitor team productivity, quality metrics, and daily deliverables.
* Allocate tasks, manage workloads, and ensure timely completion of project deliverables.
* Identify recurring annotation errors, provide constructive feedback, and implement corrective actions.
* Drive process improvements to enhance annotation quality and operational efficiency.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders and communicate project progress, challenges, and performance updates.
* Support team members with technical guidance and issue resolution.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Hands-on experience in GIS, Road Annotation, or Geospatial Data Annotation.
* Proficiency in JOSM (Java OpenStreetMap Editor) or similar GIS editing tools.
* Good understanding of GIS concepts, OpenStreetMap (OSM) standards, and road network mapping.
* Experience in team handling, task allocation, productivity monitoring, and quality management.
* Ability to interpret and work with high-resolution satellite imagery.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to manage project deliverables within defined quality and productivity targets.

Preferred Skills (Added Advantage)

* Experience in HD Mapping or Autonomous Vehicle (AV) mapping projects.
* Knowledge of QGIS or ArcGIS.
* Basic knowledge of Python or scripting for GIS-related workflows.
* Understanding of road geometry, lane-level mapping, and geospatial data validation.

Educational Qualification

Diploma / Bachelor's / Master's degree in any of the following disciplines:

* GIS (Geographic Information Systems)
* Geography
* Remote Sensing
* Geomatics
* Civil Engineering
* Surveying
* Any other relevant technical discipline.

You will not be building AI products - you will be making the team dramatically faster and smarter by deploying AI across workflow automation, data visualization, content production, competitive intelligence, and reporting. Location: Kolkata

across the team

performance, marketplace, and brand metrics

content generation, competitive intelligence, and insight extraction

marketplace reviews, Reddit/Quora signals, and category trends

stakeholder-ready outputs.

leverage, not hype

**MUST-HAVE EXPERIENCE**

• Built production-grade automation workflows using Make, n8n, Zapier, or equivalent - not just

templates

daily

• Hands-on with the Claude, OpenAI, or Gemini APIs - not just the chat interfaces

data, write pipeline logic

extraction

**NICE-TO-HAVE**

• Prior experience in a marketing team or agency - understands what performance marketers

actually need

• Experience with Google Sheets / BigQuery as a data layer

• Knowledge of Meta Ads API or Amazon SP-API for programmatic data pulls

• Familiarity with AEO / GEO concepts and AI visibility tracking platforms (Profound, Peec AI,

AthenaHQ)

• Has built a social listening or competitive intelligence system end-to-end

**WHAT WE WILL MEASURE YOU ON**

• Number of manual hours saved per month through automation (tracked, not estimated)

• Time-to-insight: reduction in turnaround time for weekly and monthly performance reports

title: Design Manager Architecture | Interior Design | Design Development
description:
**DESIGN MANAGER

Architecture | Interior Design | Design Development

Company: Silver Storey Quantum Pvt. Ltd.

Location: Kolkata

Experience: 8–12 Years

Department: Design & Technical

About Silver Storey

Silver Storey Quantum Pvt. Ltd. is a growing architecture and interior design company specialising in premium residential interiors, commercial spaces, turnkey interior solutions, modular kitchens, wardrobes and customised furniture.

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Design Manager to lead our design department and establish a high-performance design culture.

Role Overview

The Design Manager will be responsible for leading the complete design team, managing design deliverables, maintaining design standards, ensuring timely project development and coordinating with sales, procurement and project execution teams.

The candidate must have strong leadership abilities, technical knowledge, creative vision and the ability to convert client requirements into practical, cost-effective and executable designs.

Key Responsibilities

1. Design Team Leadership

\* Lead, mentor and manage the complete architecture and interior design team.

\* Allocate projects and responsibilities among designers.

\* Review daily work progress and ensure timely deliverables.

\* Conduct regular design reviews and team meetings.

\* Develop a structured and accountable design department.

2. Design Development & Quality Control

\* Oversee concept development, space planning and interior design.

\* Review 2D layouts, 3D visualisations, elevations and detailed drawings.

\* Ensure design consistency, aesthetics, functionality and technical feasibility.

\* Approve drawings before submission to clients and execution teams.

\* Maintain Silver Storey’s design standards across all projects.

3. Technical & Working Drawings

\* Supervise preparation of detailed working drawings.

\* Review furniture detailing, modular kitchen and wardrobe drawings.

\* Ensure coordination of electrical, plumbing, civil, ceiling and lighting drawings.

\* Ensure drawings are practical, accurate and execution-ready.

\* Coordinate with site and technical teams to resolve design-related issues.

4. Sales & Client Coordination

\* Support the sales team during client presentations and design discussions.

\* Participate in client meetings whenever technical or design expertise is required.

\* Guide designers in understanding client requirements and translating them into design proposals.

\* Help improve design conversion rates and client satisfaction.

5. Project Coordination

\* Coordinate with project managers, procurement and execution teams.

\* Ensure timely release of drawings, BOQs and material specifications.

\* Resolve site-related design discrepancies.

\* Minimise rework through proper design coordination and documentation.

6. Process & Department Management

\* Establish design SOPs, checklists and quality-control procedures.

\* Implement drawing registers, design checklists and revision controls.

\* Ensure consistent use of company ERP/project management software.

\* Monitor design timelines, productivity and departmental KPIs.

Required Skills & Qualifications

\* Bachelor’s degree in Interior Design, Architecture or a related discipline.

\* 8–12 years of relevant industry experience.

\* Minimum 2–3 years of experience leading a design team.

\* Strong knowledge of residential and commercial interior projects.

\* Excellent understanding of materials, finishes, modular furniture and construction detailing.

\* Proficiency in AutoCAD, SketchUp, 3ds Max, V-Ray, Enscape or equivalent software.

\* Strong communication, leadership and problem-solving skills.

\* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

Performance Indicators (KPIs)

\* Timely completion of design deliverables.

\* Quality and accuracy of working drawings.

\* Reduction in design-related site errors and rework.

\* Team productivity and resource utilisation.

\* Design approval turnaround time.

\* Coordination between design, sales and execution.

\* Client satisfaction and design presentation quality.

What We Expect

We are not looking for someone who only creates beautiful designs. We need a leader who can build, manage and scale a professional design department, take ownership of deliverables and ensure that every project reflects Silver Storey’s quality standards.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can share their updated CV, portfolio and details of relevant projects at:

care@silverstorey.com

subham@silverstorey.com

Subject Line: Application for Design Manager – Silver Storey Quantum Pvt. Ltd.**

title: NPD Engineer/ Manager – Weld Cell
description:
**Company Description**
SKH Y-Tec is a manufacturing organization focused on delivering high-quality engineered components and assemblies for the automotive sector and related industries. The company emphasizes innovation in product design and process optimization, with a particular focus on welding and fabrication technologies. SKH Y-Tec promotes a culture of safety, continuous improvement, and collaboration across engineering, production, and quality teams. Team members are encouraged to contribute ideas that enhance efficiency, reliability, and customer satisfaction. The organization offers opportunities to work with advanced manufacturing equipment and participate in new product development initiatives.
  
**Role Description**
The NPD Engineer/Manager – Weld Cell is a full-time, on-site role based in Ahmedabad, responsible for leading new product development activities related to welding processes and weld cells. Day-to-day tasks include planning and executing weld cell projects, coordinating design and process validation, and ensuring weld parameters, fixtures, and tooling meet quality and safety standards. The role involves close collaboration with cross-functional teams such as design, production, quality, and maintenance to integrate new welding solutions into existing lines and to resolve technical issues. The NPD Engineer/Manager will monitor project timelines, manage resources, and prepare technical documentation, reports, and standard operating procedures for weld cell operations. The role also includes continuous improvement activities in cycle time, process stability, cost reduction, and adherence to customer specifications.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Engineering Management and Project Management skills to plan, execute, and oversee weld cell NPD projects.
* Candidates should possess Team Leadership skills to guide technicians, engineers, and cross-functional stakeholders within the weld cell environment.
* Candidates should possess Integration skills to ensure new weld cells, fixtures, and processes integrate seamlessly with existing production systems.
* Candidates should possess basic understanding of Software Development or automation-related software (e.g., robotic welding programming, PLC interfaces) relevant to weld cell control.
* Relevant qualifications include a bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Production, or Welding Engineering (or equivalent technical discipline).
* Experience with welding processes (MIG/MAG, spot welding, robotic welding), weld quality standards, and automotive or heavy manufacturing environments is highly beneficial.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and root-cause analysis abilities, with familiarity in tools such as FMEA, PPAP, APQP, and statistical process control.
* Effective communication skills, ability to work on-site in Ahmedabad, and readiness to collaborate with internal teams, suppliers, and customers.
