title: Consultant – Agri Investment, Structuring & Development Finance
description:
**About SkyQuest**

SkyQuest Technology Consulting is a rapidly expanding global advisory firm specialising in market intelligence, innovation management, and commercialisation strategy. We partner with corporates, governments, and development organisations to turn insights into implementation.

Our
**Development Practice**
runs programmes with governments, global foundations, multilaterals and development finance institutions across
**India and Africa**
, in agriculture, agricultural finance, food systems and health. More and more, that includes helping Indian agribusinesses take proven products and models to African markets, and structuring the capital to get them there.

**Learn more:**
https://www.skyquestt.com

**About the Role**

We are looking for a finance professional with 6+ years of hands-on experience in transaction advisory, investment banking, project finance or DFI / impact investment. You should be able to build a model from a blank sheet, defend a valuation and turn a business plan into a fundable deal.

Your first mandate: a leading Indian seed company setting up operations in Nigeria, under a programme backed by a global philanthropic foundation. The company is investing its own equity and will raise concessional debt alongside it. You will build the financial model, run the valuation, support the deal structuring, prepare the investment materials and work the fundraise through to financial close.

You will also support our technical assistance programme with a Nigerian agricultural development finance institution, and contribute to proposals that help SkyQuest win new advisory mandates.

This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to grow into deal leadership.

**Location:**
India, with travel to Nigeria as required

**Work arrangement:**
Full-time

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Financial Modelling & Valuation**

* Build and maintain the investor-grade financial model for the Nigeria expansion, covering seed production, processing, distribution, capex, working capital and three-statement outputs.
* Model IRR, DSCR, payback, FX (naira) risk and sensitivity / scenario analysis.
* Run the valuation exercise (DCF, comparables, scenarios) and prepare the valuation report.
* Keep the model audit-ready and easy for lenders and the client to review.

**2. Deal Structuring & Capital Stack**

* Model capital-stack options combining promoter equity, concessional and commercial debt, guarantees, and grant or technical assistance funding.
* Support the design of the India → Nigeria holding and operating structure with legal and tax advisors, covering ODI / FEMA requirements, the Nigerian entity or SPV, shareholder arrangements and repatriation.
* Analyse term sheets (interest, tenor, grace period, covenants, security) and model their impact on the business.

**3. Fundraising & Investor Materials**

* Prepare teasers, information memoranda, investment presentations and financial due-diligence packs.
* Map and track potential funders, including DFIs, multilaterals, impact lenders and concessional-finance windows (e.g. IFC, AfDB, BII, FMO, Proparco, Norfund, and Indian export credit lines).
* Manage the data room and respond to lender due-diligence and ESG queries.
* Support the steps to financial close, then track covenants and lender reporting after close.

**4. Programme Support & Business Development**

* Build
  **investment-readiness dossiers**
  and financial models for agribusinesses in the partner institution’s pipeline.
* Model
  **agri lending products**
  , covering unit economics, repayment schedules, portfolio risk and the impact of guarantees or first-loss capital.
* Prepare financial analysis for
  **blended-finance facility design**
  , diagnostics, workshops and programme reports.
* Draft the
  **financial and commercial sections of proposals, EOIs and bids**
  for DFI, multilateral and foundation tenders.
* Research and profile
  **Indian agri and food companies with Africa expansion plans**
  as potential SkyQuest clients.

**Qualifications & Experience**

**Must-have**

* MBA (Finance), CA or CFA (Level II or above).
* 6+ years of relevant experience in transaction advisory, investment banking, project finance or DFI / impact investment.
* Hands-on experience building three-statement financial models and valuations (DCF, comparables), independently and from scratch.
* Experience on at least one debt or equity fundraise, project finance deal or investment appraisal.
* Understanding of deal structuring: debt vs equity, capital stacks, SPVs and term-sheet basics.
* Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills, and the ability to write clear investment memos and information memoranda.

**Good to have**

* Sector exposure to agriculture, seeds, agri-inputs or food processing.
* Exposure to DFI, multilateral or blended-finance transactions (concessional debt, guarantees, first-loss capital).
* Experience with cross-border / outbound investment from India (ODI, FEMA).
* Exposure to Nigeria or wider Africa.
* Experience writing donor- or DFI-funded proposals.
* An FMVA or equivalent certification, and hands-on use of AI tools for research, analysis and modelling.



**Important – Candidate requirement**

Candidates should share examples of financial models and transactions they have worked on, with the sector, deal size, instrument and their role.

Profiles limited to equity research, accounting or corporate FP&A, without hands-on transaction or investment modelling experience, will not be suitable for this role.

title: MIS Executive / Costing Executive
description:
**Company Description**
Amba Multiprint (AMP) is one of India’s leading integrated printing and packaging companies, headquartered in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, with a strong presence across domestic and international markets. Established in 1998, AMP has grown from a small commercial printing unit into a strategic packaging partner offering end-to-end solutions in labels, cartons, shrink sleeves, and flexible packaging. The company serves a wide range of industries, including cosmetics, personal care, pharmaceuticals, food and beverages, FMCG, home care, chemicals, and industrial products. As AMP enters a new phase of growth with advanced flexible packaging and global expansion, it remains committed to trust, innovation, quality, and continuous improvement.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site MIS Executive / Costing Executive role based in Gandhinagar. The role involves preparing, updating, and analyzing daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports to support operational and management decision-making. The MIS Executive / Costing Executive will collect and validate data from various departments, maintain databases and dashboards, and ensure accurate tracking of production, sales, and costing information. Daily responsibilities include preparing cost estimates and quotations, monitoring variance between standard and actual costs, and highlighting cost trends and efficiency opportunities. The role also requires close coordination with production, finance, and sales teams, supporting audits and process improvements, and presenting clear summaries of data and insights to management.

**Qualification:**

- Graduate in B.Com, B.E., BBA, MBA, or a related field.

- Basic knowledge of data management and reporting.

- Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.

- Knowledge of Google Sheets will be an added advantage.

title: Cyber Security Manager
description:
Role Overview:

HireFlex Global seeks an experienced cybersecurity leader to manage its security operations, engineering, threat management, cloud security, innovation and service delivery functions. The role combines strategic oversight with direct technical involvement. The successful candidate will lead multidisciplinary teams, strengthen security controls, manage client commitments and drive continuous service improvement. Hands-on expertise is essential. The candidate must be able to assess security events, investigate SIEM alerts, support threat hunting and guide teams through major security incidents, while maintaining accountability for people, operations and delivery.

Key Responsibilities

• Cybersecurity leadership and governance: Set the technical direction, operating priorities, performance objectives and service standards for the full cybersecurity function. Coordinate security operations, engineering, threat management, innovation and project teams. Establish effective governance, reporting and escalation processes.

• Security monitoring and incident response: Provide hands-on leadership for threat monitoring and response. Analyse SIEM events, security logs and alerts; direct triage, threat hunting, incident investigations and root cause analysis. Guide containment, remediation, escalation and post-incident improvements. Mentor analysts on complex investigations.

• Detection engineering and security platforms: Lead SIEM engineers and security platform teams. Oversee Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender, endpoint security and EDR solutions. Improve log ingestion, correlation rules, detection use cases, dashboards, alert quality, system integrations and platform reliability.

• Threat management and risk reduction: Oversee threat intelligence, vulnerability assessment, threat analysis and risk prioritisation. Work with operations and engineering teams to translate risks into actionable monitoring, security controls and mitigation plans. Track critical threats and corrective actions through closure.

• Cloud security, DevSecOps and innovation: Lead Azure security and secure engineering initiatives. Advance security automation, API integrations, CI/CD security practices and cloud control improvements. Evaluate emerging tools and practical applications of data science, artificial intelligence and machine learning in cybersecurity.

• Project and service delivery: Oversee cybersecurity projects and ServiceNow service delivery. Review scope, project plans, milestones, dependencies, quality, risks and resource needs. Support on-time delivery and strong communication between technical teams, project managers and clients. Resolve complex operational and delivery issues.

• Resources, budgets and team development: Plan resource allocation, capacity, recruitment and staffing across teams. Monitor utilisation, operational costs and delivery performance. Set clear expectations, coach team members, identify skill gaps and lead technical interviews for relevant cybersecurity and engineering positions.

• Client and stakeholder engagement: Serve as a senior technical and operational contact for clients. Lead service reviews, technical discussions and critical escalations. Convert business requirements into practical delivery plans and communicate progress, risks, decisions and improvement actions clearly.

Required Expertise and Experience

• Professional background: At least 10 years of relevant experience in cybersecurity, security engineering, security operations or related disciplines, including leadership of multiple technical teams and complex security services.

• Security operations: Strong practical capability in Microsoft Sentinel, SIEM monitoring, log analysis, alert triage, event correlation, detection rule tuning, threat hunting, incident management and root cause analysis.

• Security technologies: Experience with Microsoft Defender, endpoint protection, EDR, security platform integration, engineering architecture and the implementation and optimisation of security controls.

• Cloud and engineering: Sound knowledge of Azure security architecture, cloud monitoring, identity protection, DevOps, DevSecOps, secure CI/CD, automation and integrations.

• Delivery and leadership: Proven ability to manage client relationships, technical escalations, project delivery, resource planning, operational governance, team development and technical recruitment.

• Additional capabilities: Familiarity with AI/ML applications in security operations is beneficial. Experience in the FMCG sector is an advantage but is not required.

Preferred Certifications

Microsoft SC-200, SC-100 or AZ-500; CISSP; CISM; or equivalent certifications in cybersecurity, cloud security or security operations.

Key Success Measures

Reliable threat monitoring and incident response; improved security platform performance and detection maturity; consistent project and service delivery; effective resource utilisation; strong team capability; and measurable improvements through automation and innovation.

description:

**Job Summary**
We’re seeking a strategic and driven FP&A Finance Associate to join our dynamic Global Finance Team. This Bengaluru-based role is embedded within the nerve center of financial planning and performance reporting. This role will support Finance Business Partners and functional leaders across planning, forecasting, performance reporting, and financial analysis.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines strong FP&A fundamentals, analytical skills, and business acumen to deliver actionable insights and support informed decision-making. This is your chance to be part of a high-impact team where your insights will shape strategy and fuel growth. **Key Responsibilities**

* Business Partnership: Serve as a trusted finance partner to FP&A Partners and leadership teams, delivering actionable insights on business drivers, performance, risks, and opportunities to support strategic and operational decisions.
* Planning, Forecasting & Reporting: Lead budgeting, forecasting, long-range and investment planning, and monthly performance reporting with variance analysis on business performance, resource utilization, and financial outcomes.
* Workforce Analytics: Analyze headcount, hiring, attrition, compensation, and workforce trends to understand financial implications and support resource planning.
* Executive Reporting & Decision Support: Prepare executive-level presentations and business reviews that translate complex financial and operational data into clear, concise insights for senior leadership.
* Financial Data Modelling: Build and maintain models for revenue, expenses, headcount, business scenarios, and sensitivity analysis. Manage capacity models to inform headcount planning and expense forecasting.

* Chartered Accountant (CA), & MBA in Finance from a top-tier institution.

* Experience with headcount, compensation, or workforce-related financial planning is preferred.
* Experience supporting budgeting, forecasting, consolidation, variance analysis, management reporting, and financial modelling.
* Experience working with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams in a deadline-driven environment.

**Technical Skills & Competencies**

* Strong grounding in accounting fundamentals, financial modelling, forecasting, and scenario planning.
* Expertise Excel (modeling, pivots, lookups, arrays)
* Working Knowledge in tools: Snowflake (for data extraction/joins), Alteryx (for workflows and transformations) & Power BI (for visual analytics).
* Experience with Adaptive Planning or similar Planning & Budgeting tools.
* Reasonable understanding of SaaS metrics, financial KPIs, and technology-driven business models.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills

**Preferred Attributes**

* Highly dynamic individual comfortable with rapid changes and evolving priorities.
* Questions the data, understands the “why,” and seeks to improve.
* Commercially minded and able to connect workforce decisions to financial outcomes.
* Detail-oriented and committed to delivering accurate, high-stakes work under tight deadlines.
* Demonstrates strong analytical and problem-solving mindset.
* Known for delivering accurate, high-stake work under tight deadlines with limited supervision.
* Enthusiastic about learning and applying AI, automation, and emerging analytical tools to FP&A.
* Enjoys working with sophisticated financial tools and data analytics platforms.

**Why Join Us?**
At Bottomline, we are transforming the way businesses pay and get paid. As a global leader in business payments and cash management, we provide secure, comprehensive solutions that modernize payments for businesses and financial institutions worldwide. With over 35 years of expertise and more than $16 trillion in payments processed annually, we are committed to delivering innovative financial solutions that add to the bottom line.
  
  
Bottomline is a portfolio company of Thoma Bravo, one of the largest software private equity firms in the world, with more than $166 billion in assets under management. Our success is driven by our passionate, motivated, and resourceful team members who collaborate, innovate, and push boundaries to create world-class financial products and experiences.
  
  
We operate as
**One Global Team**
, empowering one another through our Guiding Principles, which shape our culture and drive our customer-centric approach. By joining us, you will be part of a dynamic environment where ideas are valued, leadership is encouraged, and your contributions help reshape the future of business payments.
  
  

* Be part of a high-growth FinTech company disrupting the industry with innovative solutions.
* Work closely with global leadership and gain cross-functional exposure.
* Lead a high-performing FP&A team and shape the financial strategy of the organization.
* Competitive compensation and career growth opportunities.

We welcome talent at all career stages and are dedicated to understanding and supporting additional needs. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, committed to creating an inclusive and open environment for everyone.

**Company**
: Fundament Capital Investment Management

: Investment Management

: Senior Investment Associate

**Overview**

**Fundament Capital in Dubai is expanding its equity research capabilities and building out our India team. We are hiring a Senior Investment Associate**
to join our team and focus on
**public equities within the natural resources and commodity supply chain ecosystem**
.

This is a unique opportunity for experienced professionals with a
**strong foundation in equity research (buy-side or sell-side)**
and a proven ability to
**own and manage a coverage universe end-to-end**

**Concentrated Natural Resources Strategy**
and
**Broader Buy Side Equity Research / Portfolio Management**
.

**Equity Research & Sector Leadership**

* Serve as primary coverage lead for assigned sectors and companies, with full accountability for research quality, investment conclusions, and ongoing monitoring.
* Independently develop, maintain, and refine end-to-end financial models from first principles, including earnings updates, scenario analysis, and capital allocation sensitivity.
* Continuously track company fundamentals, KPIs, industry structure, competitive dynamics, and inflection points across the coverage universe.
* Conduct rigorous bottom-up fundamental analysis across listed equities in energy, metals and mining, agriculture, industrials, and chemicals.
* Integrate global macroeconomic and commodity cycle analysis into company-level valuation and risk assessment.

**Idea Generation & Portfolio Impact**

* Originate, structure, and defend high-conviction investment ideas with clear articulation of upside drivers, downside risks, and return potential.
* Act as a thought partner to the Dubai-based Portfolio Management team.

**Modeling, Reporting & Investment Communication**

* Build DCF and Relative Valuation models tailored to industry context and firm valuation approach.
* Communicate complex ideas succinctly and credibly to senior stakeholders, including Portfolio Managers and Investment Committee members.

**Team Contribution & Mentorship**

* Provide guidance and constructive review to Junior Analysts, helping elevate analytical rigor, modeling standards, and investment thinking.
* Actively contribute to internal debates, knowledge sharing, and weekly research discussions, helping shape the intellectual culture of the investment team.

**Candidate Profile**

* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Engineering, or a quantitative discipline.
* Required Experience:
  **4–7 years of equity research experience**
  in a
  **buy-side or sell-side**
  environment.
* Demonstrated ability to
  **lead coverage independently**
  , from idea generation through valuation, recommendation, and monitoring.
* Track record of investment ideas that have been implemented or seriously considered in live portfolios.
* Prior experience covering commodities, energy, industrials, or adjacent cyclical sectors strongly preferred.
* Technical Skills: Expert-level financial modeling in Excel, with strong command of valuation methodologies and scenario analysis.
* Comfortable with earnings tracking, KPI analysis, and Bloomberg.
* **Certifications: CFA Charterholder or active candidate preferred.**

**What We Offer**

* A front-row seat to shape and contribute to a
  **concentrated, research-intensive investment strategy**
  .
* Competitive compensation, access to senior decision-makers, and performance-based advancement.
* High-trust, meritocratic culture with real influence on investment direction.
* A fast-paced, collaborative environment where analytical rigor and independent thinking are prized.

title: Semi CA - Investments & Funds
description:
**Company Description**
Arthtattva is a GST and indirect tax consultancy firm led by Chartered Accountants and supported by a team of more than forty professionals. The firm serves a diverse client base across manufacturing, trading, and service industries, providing expert guidance on GST implementation, compliance, and finance management. Arthtattva specializes in GST, GSTR, taxation, and broader financial services, helping organizations navigate India’s dual GST regime introduced in 2017. Through Arthtattva Academy, the firm partners with reputed institutions to deliver both theoretical and practical training programs in GST and indirect taxation. This combination of consulting and education enables professionals and businesses to build strong, up-to-date tax and finance capabilities.

**Role Description**
The Semi CA Executive – Investments & Funds role at Arthtattva is a full-time, on-site position based in Bengaluru. **Responsibilities**
**Job Description:**

* Lead and manage real estate valuation and advisory engagements across a range of property types, portfolios, and entities, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery.
* Analyze and review complex entity-, portfolio-, and property-level financial data, including historical operating performance, budgets, forecasts, and investment assumptions.
* Oversee economic, market, industry, and property-level research and evaluate key factors affecting real estate values, investment performance, and valuation conclusions.
* Develop, review, and enhance complex valuation models using methodologies including discounted cash flow, direct capitalization, sales comparison, and cost approaches.
* Review valuation analyses, financial models, supporting workpapers, and client deliverables for accuracy, consistency, reasonableness, and compliance with applicable professional standards.
* Manage multiple engagements and workstreams, including project planning, resource allocation, timelines, budgets, quality control, and communication with internal and external stakeholders.
* Serve as a key point of contact for clients, communicate valuation findings and technical matters, and support resolution of complex valuation issues.
* Supervise, coach, and review the work of Seniors and Associates, providing technical guidance, performance feedback, and support for professional development.
* Support practice development initiatives, including preparation of proposals, client presentations, thought leadership, and identification of additional client service opportunities.
* Stay current on real estate valuation methodologies, accounting guidance, regulatory developments, industry practices, and market trends..

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Real Estate, Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field; advanced coursework or qualifications in real estate and/or valuation preferred. CPA, CFA, or ASA designation required.
* Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in real estate valuation, financial analysis, advisory, asset management, audit, transaction advisory, or a related field.
* Strong technical knowledge of real estate valuation methodologies, including discounted cash flow, direct capitalization, sales comparison, and cost approaches.
* Demonstrated experience reviewing complex valuation models, appraisal reports, financial analyses, and client deliverables.
* Proven ability to manage multiple engagements, priorities, deadlines, budgets, and project teams.
* Strong leadership and people-management skills, with experience reviewing work and developing junior professionals.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel and financial modeling skills; familiarity with ARGUS and real estate market/data platforms such as CoStar strongly preferred.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and project management capabilities.
* Ability to travel for client-related work as required.

With an edge in economic forecasting, sentiment research, and live market intelligence, we help traders and institutions align with major global moves across forex, commodities, and digital assets.Role OverviewAs a Global Market Analyst Intern at PipRaisers, you'll work closely with our strategy and research team to interpret macroeconomic signals, analyze intermarket dynamics, and identify tradeable global trends. From daily market updates to institutional-style research notes, you’ll develop the mindset and skills of a global strategist.Key Responsibilities1. Assist in backtesting macro-based trade ideas using historical data7. Build concise, data-rich presentation decks and visual summaries for team briefings and client insightsWho Should Apply?1. Students or graduates in Finance, Economics, International Business, or MBA (Finance)2. Passion for global macroeconomics, central bank policy, and cross-asset trading3. * Provides an analytical breakdown of pricing structures.

* Work across multiple teams to implement pricing and deal packaging guidelines.
* Analyzes data from a variety of sources and using it to derive insights into pricing strategies and market trends.
* Supports with designing competitive pricing proposition of specific client deals.

title: Manager, Indirect Tax Planning
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.
  
  
Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.
  
  
**Introduction To Team**
Our Corporate Functions are made up of teams that support Expedia Group, including our Global Finance Org., Traveler and Partner Service Platform, Legal Team, Strategy and Corporate Development Team, and People & Places Org.
  
  
Expedia Group is seeking a Manager, Indirect Tax Planning to join our Tax team in our Bangalore, India office under a hybrid working model. In this role you will provide indirect tax planning support across Expedia Group's many business entities and functions throughout the Asia Pacific (APAC) and global regions, advising on the indirect tax implications of new products, business models, market entries, and intercompany arrangements. You will partner closely with Tax colleagues across Seattle, Sao Paulo, London, and India as well as with Finance, Legal, Other Business stakeholders, and external advisors, to help ensure global business initiatives are structured in an indirect-tax-efficient and compliant manner.
  
  
Expedia Group is a global traveler-technology company whose brands power travel for everyone, everywhere. Through our house of brands and broad partner network, we connect travelers with travel experiences around the world and develop technology solutions for a wide range of partners. The scale, diversity, and pace of change across our APAC markets create meaningful opportunities to shape indirect tax outcomes on high-impact, cross-border initiatives.
  
  
This role is ideal for an experienced indirect tax professional who enjoys partnering directly with the business, translating complex GST/VAT and other indirect tax rules across APAC and other jurisdictions into practical guidance, and building scalable planning processes. You will bring deep expertise in global indirect tax regimes and play a key role in growing the indirect tax planning capability out of our Bangalore office, with clear room for continued career development.
  
  
**In This Role , You Will**

* In partnership with your tax colleagues located in our core offices listed above, provide indirect tax planning advice on new business initiatives, products, and market entries across the many business entities and functions Expedia Group operates throughout the APAC and other regions.
* Serve as a trusted indirect tax planning resource for business and functional stakeholders across our global business, translating GST/VAT and other indirect tax requirements into clear, actionable guidance.
* Analyze the indirect tax implications of intercompany transactions, new entity structures, and evolving business models, and recommend planning approaches that balance tax efficiency, risk, and operational feasibility.
* Partner with the Indirect Tax Operations, Direct Tax, Transfer Pricing, Legal, and Finance teams to ensure planning positions are properly documented, implemented, and reflected in downstream compliance and reporting.
* Monitor and analyze existing and proposed indirect tax legislative and regulatory developments across APAC and other jurisdictions and proactively assess and communicate their impact on Expedia Group's business entities and functions.
* Support due diligence, restructuring, and business advisory projects involving APAC and other entities, including transactional tax data analysis, scenario modeling, and tax research.
* Use and help enhance tax technology tools (e.g., AI and agentic capabilities, Alteryx, Power BI/Tableau, Power Automate, SharePoint, ERP/Oracle) to improve the quality, consistency, and efficiency of indirect tax planning analysis and operational compliance processes.
* Help build and continuously improve indirect tax planning processes, templates, and controls to support a rapidly scaling business footprint.
* Work as an integral part of the broader tax team, contributing to cross-functional initiatives and supporting a culture of continuous improvement across the global tax function.

**Experience & Qualification**

* Bachelor's or Graduate degree in Accounting, Finance, Law, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Chartered Accountant (CA), CPA, or equivalent professional certification preferred.
* Additional postgraduate qualifications in tax or accounting are a plus.
* 5–8 years of tax experience in a corporate tax department or public accounting firm, with a meaningful focus on indirect tax planning, operations, controversy and advisory work.
* Proven experience advising on GST/VAT and other indirect tax matters across multiple APAC jurisdictions (e.g., India, Singapore, Australia, Japan, or similar) and other geographies; experience with U.S. or other international indirect tax regimes like DST and withholding is also valued.
* Experience partnering directly with business and functional stakeholders to assess the indirect tax impact of new products, business models, or market entries.
* Experience supporting cross-border restructuring, intercompany arrangements, or new entity set-up from an indirect tax perspective.
* Experience with indirect tax project work, including business advisory, financial reporting considerations, and tax research.
* Demonstrated ability to act as a senior resource and informal leader for junior colleagues in a team setting, without formal people management responsibility.
* Experience with tax technology and automation tools including agentic and AI workflow development and use.
* Experience supporting indirect tax audits, controversy matters, or revenue authority inquiries across is a plus.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, with experience managing large data sets; experience with Oracle or other ERP systems.
* Experience with indirect tax compliance/planning software and/or data analytics tools preferred.
* Experience leveraging AI, automation, or analytics tools to improve data analysis, documentation drafting, and process efficiency while maintaining appropriate review and controls.
* Ability to analyze, compare, evaluate, reconcile, and draw clear insights from complex indirect tax data across multiple jurisdictions.
* Excellent researcher and problem-solver who can analyze, compare, evaluate, reconcile, and learn from complex tax data to drive practical, accurate planning recommendations.
* Strong communicator who knows when and how to ask questions, raise issues, and provide meaningful updates to business stakeholders and senior leadership, effectively working across cultures and time zones.
* Natural collaborator and informal leader — approachable, engaged, and effective at creating a supportive day-to-day environment for junior colleagues without formal management authority.
* Able to manage multiple priorities simultaneously while meeting strict deadlines in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
* Self-starter who takes initiative on project assignments and actively drives change and improvement across processes and deliverables.
* Receptive to internal and external feedback and able to adapt performance and deliverables accordingly.

**Accommodation requests**
Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job\_accommodation.
  
  
**About Expedia Group**
Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.
  
  
**Important notice**
Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity**
Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.

title: Senior Accountant
description:

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
  
  
Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
  
  
Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

**About The Role**
We are seeking a dynamic, results-driven individual to join our Payments Compliance Accounting team as a Senior Accountant. This pivotal role will focus on maintaining a robust accounting infrastructure to support Rippling’s business expansion in payment processing. You will play a key role in supporting MTL regulators' periodic compliance reporting, introducing new product offerings, and leading expansion into U.S. and global markets.
  
  
**About The Team**
Accounting at Rippling is responsible for supporting and communicating the financial story of Rippling. We assess, track and record every penny that Rippling transacts. **Job Description: Accounts Executive**

Location: Chennai, Tamil Nadu

Department: Accounts & Finance Employment

Type: Full-time, On-site

Experience: 1+ years in accounts and finance Reports To: Accounts Manager / Finance Head

**About the Role**

We are looking for a detail-oriented Accounts Executive to manage day-to-day accounting, statutory compliance and payroll in our Chennai office. You will maintain accurate books of accounts in Tally, ensure timely GST, TDS, EPF, ESI and Professional Tax filings, and process monthly payroll. We also welcome candidates who are curious about using AI tools to automate routine accounting and compliance work.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Accounting and Books of Accounts**

\* Record accounting entries and maintain books of accounts in Tally.

\* Keep ledgers, vouchers and supporting documents accurate and up to date.

\* Support month-end and year-end closing activities.

**Payroll Processing**

\* Process monthly payroll, including salary computation, attendance inputs and deductions.

\* Prepare payslips and payroll reports, and resolve employee payroll queries.

**GST Compliance**

\* Prepare and file monthly GST returns, including GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B.

\* Prepare and file GST annual returns (GSTR-9 and GSTR-9C, wherever applicable).

\* Reconcile books of accounts with GSTR-2B and filed GST returns, and follow up on mismatches.

**TDS Compliance**

\* Compute TDS and ensure timely payment.

\* Prepare and file quarterly TDS returns.

**Payroll-Related Statutory Compliance**

\* Prepare and file EPF returns and handle related compliance.

\* Calculate ESI contributions and file ESI returns.

\* Calculate, pay and file Professional Tax returns.

General

\* Meet all statutory due dates and maintain complete compliance records.

\* Coordinate with auditors, consultants and internal teams during audits and reviews.

\* Identify opportunities to streamline and automate recurring accounting and compliance tasks.

Qualifications and Experience

\* B.Com, MBA (Finance), or CA/CMA Inter completed.

\* More than 1 year of experience in accounts and finance.

\* Hands-on experience with Tally for accounting entries and maintenance of books.

\* Working knowledge of GST (GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-9, GSTR-9C), TDS, EPF, ESI and Professional Tax.

\* Experience in GST reconciliation with GSTR-2B.

\* Good working knowledge of MS Excel.

**Skills and Attributes**

\* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

\* Ability to manage deadlines and multiple compliance calendars.

\* Good written and verbal communication.

\* Sense of ownership and integrity when handling financial and employee data.

**Good to Have (Value Addition)**

\* Interest in working with AI tools for work automation, such as automating reconciliations, data entry, report preparation and compliance tracking.

\* Comfort with learning new software and improving processes.

**What We Offer**

\* Opportunity to work across accounting, payroll and statutory compliance.

\* Exposure to AI-driven automation in finance operations.

\* Learning and growth in a collaborative team.

\* Compensation as per industry standards and experience.

Linedata is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to complying with all federal, state, and local laws providing equal employment opportunities, and all other employment laws and regulations.
  
  
It is our intent to maintain a work environment that is free of harassment, discrimination, or retaliation based on an individual's race, color, religion, religious creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, age, sexual orientation, veteran and/or military status, protected medical leaves, domestic violence victim status, political affiliation, or any other status protected by federal, state, or local laws.
  
  
**Job Description**
You will join a team that directly caters to the front office of Global Asset Managers/Hedge Funds. As a senior Analyst in Linedata’s Risk team, you will work closely with Portfolio Managers and Senior Risk Professionals/CROs. You will be responsible for providing portfolio risk solutions to a buy-side client. The role spans across different aspects of investment risk – generating risk and performance attribution reports, analysing complex scenarios and understanding the drivers of important risk statistics across each aggregation in a portfolio. You are also expected to proactively engage with different stakeholders to ensure well informed and timely investment decision making by the client. You are required to take complete ownership of the deliverables and demonstrate high-quality standards with utmost integrity.
  
  
Job Requirement
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Perform a range of tasks involving analysis of portfolio risk, generating customized dashboards and monitoring risk limits to meet the requirements of clients
* Analyse the drivers of important risk statistics such as exposure concentration, Greeks, value-at-risk, stress tests, historical market views, what-if scenarios and performance attribution

* Understand investment deal memos and build customized financial models
* Prioritize and execute multiple assignments including adhoc assignment within tight deadlines
* Ensure adherence to high-quality standards and industry best practices established at Linedata

* 2-5 years of relevant work experience in Financial Risk Management (Markets and Credit Risk)
* Strong foundation in Mathematics and Statistics used in Financial Modelling
* Good understanding of Fixed Income asset classes including CLO, CMBS and RMBS
* Should be able to demonstrate high level of quantitative and analytical skills
* Excellent communication skills to communicate the risk analysis outcomes in simple language to clients/portfolio-managers located in New York, HK and London
* Ability to work individually and with other financial engineers in a collaborative manner

**Advantageous Skills**

* Knowledge of third-party databases such as Bloomberg, Thomson Reuters, etc.
* Knowledge of MS Excel, VBA macros, MS PowerPoint

Academic Requirements
  
  

* MBA from a Tier-1 college with BE/Statistics or equivalent education
* Any level of CFA or FRM will have preference

title: Vice President - Treasury Liquidity Controllers
description:
**Job Description**
You are a strategic leader passionate about driving solutions across Treasury, Liquidity Risk, and the Investment Bank balance sheet. You have found the right team.
  
  
As a Liquidity Vice President in our Finance organization, you will lead a team responsible for critical internal and regulatory liquidity risk reporting for the Commercial & Investment Bank under Treasury Function, with a primary focus on EMEA (and strong connectivity to US liquidity frameworks). You will apply deep understanding of Investment Banking & Prime Brokerage products and Balance sheet dynamics—spanning Trading and Banking books, securities, secured financing, derivatives, wholesale products, and off-balance sheet items—to deliver accurate reporting, high-quality governance, and meaningful management insights.
  
  
This role requires strong people leadership, stakeholder management, and an ability to translate complex balance sheet movements into clear narratives for senior management, Treasury, Controllers, and Liquidity Risk Oversight partners.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Lead and develop a team: Responsible for producing and leading high-quality liquidity risk reporting team across daily/weekly/monthly/quarterly cycles, ensuring strong controls, reviews, documentation, and timely delivery.
* Own key liquidity Regulatory and Internal reporting deliverables: Including (as applicable by jurisdiction and governance) FR 2052a, LCR, NSFR, RLAP / liquidity stress testing, STWF and CCAR-related liquidity reporting and analysis.
* Drive variance analytics and storyboarding: Identify key drivers of period-over-period movements, explain balance sheet and liquidity impacts, and deliver crisp variance commentary for senior and regional stakeholders.
* Provide EMEA-focused liquidity expertise: While maintaining strong alignment to global (including US) liquidity risk frameworks, methodologies, assumptions, and regulatory expectations.
* Apply deep product and balance sheet knowledge (secured financing, derivatives, prime/wholesale products, securities, commitments, deposits, and other on/off-balance sheet exposures) to assess liquidity impacts and support business decisions.
* Partner with Treasury, LoB Controllers, Liquidity Risk Oversight, and global teams (e.g., FALMA, CTMO and other stakeholder groups) to ensure consistent data, methodology alignment, and escalation of issues/risks.
* Strengthen the control environment by ensuring robust reconciliations, issue management, change governance, data lineage awareness, and audit/regulatory readiness for all owned reports and processes.
* Lead process improvement and transformation initiatives, including standardization, automation, and operational risk reduction across liquidity reporting, analytics, and management information.
* Support senior management communications by preparing liquidity metrics packages, executive-ready dashboards, and briefing materials for CIB Treasury and business leadership.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Significant experience (typically 12+ years) in Treasury, Liquidity Risk, Balance Sheet Management, Product Control / Controllers, or Regulatory Reporting within a large bank
* Deep understanding of the Investment Bank Balance sheet & and its Line of Businesses
* Demonstrated hands-on experience with liquidity reporting and frameworks, including a strong working knowledge of LCR, NSFR, liquidity stress testing / RLAP, and familiarity with FR 2052a, STWF and CCAR liquidity reporting concepts and requirements.
* Proven people leadership skills: ability to coach, develop talent, set clear goals, manage performance, and build an inclusive and accountable team culture.
* Strong analytical capability with comfort working with large datasets; ability to identify root causes, quantify impacts, and translate technical detail into executive-level insights.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present clearly to senior stakeholders and challenge appropriately when needed.
* Strong organizational skills and ownership mindset; ability to manage competing priorities in a time-sensitive, control-focused environment.

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Investment bank experience strongly preferred
* Prior experience supporting EMEA liquidity regulatory expectations and governance, with strong connectivity to US liquidity standards and reporting practices.
* Experience driving automation and data transformation (e.g., Alteryx, Tableau, Python, SQL or similar tooling), including controls-conscious implementation.
* Familiarity with end-to-end reporting operating models (data sourcing, controls, reconciliations, change management, and documentation), and strong audit/regulatory interaction readiness.
* Ability to operate effectively across global teams and time zones, influencing stakeholders without direct reporting lines.

**ABOUT US**
JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.
  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.
  
  
**About The Team**
J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

title: Unit Head
description:
Unit Head – Credit Line on UPI
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
The Unit Head will own the end-to-end business performance of the Credit Line on UPI (CLoU) portfolio. This includes growth strategy, acquisition funnels, partner ecosystem management, monetisation, unit economics, and lifecycle optimization.
  
  
The role is deeply P&L-oriented, requiring strong cross-functional collaboration with product, risk, operations, finance, and partner-bank teams to drive scalable and sustainable business outcomes.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Business Growth & Strategy
* Own overall business performance for Credit Line on UPI—including lines created, active users, activation %, throughput, and revenue generation.
* Craft the go-to-market (GTM) strategy across target customer segments (merchant & consumer), use cases, and distribution channels.
* Develop and execute strategies to grow P2M adoption, repeat usage, frequency, and wallet share.
* Evaluate market trends, competitive landscape, and regulatory context to shape business priorities.
* Ensure predictable, controllable growth aligned with portfolio health and partner expectations.
* Partner & Ecosystem Management
* Manage relationships with partner LSPs, PSPs, TPAPs, distribution partners, and ecosystem players.
* Drive partner onboarding, integration planning, scale-up, and ongoing performance management.
* Align incentives, revenue models, and commercial structures to optimise partner throughput and profitability.
* Lead governance forums with partners—reviewing business volumes, operational issues, funnel leakages, risk metrics, and revenue outcomes.
* Ensure stable and high-performing partnerships that enable predictable business scaling.
* Acquisition & Post-Acquisition Ownership
* Work with growth, marketing, product, and channel partners to optimise acquisition funnels end-to-end.
* Identify drop-off points across onboarding, activation, and early-usage stages; drive initiatives to improve activation and engagement.
* Own lifecycle interventions post-acquisition—nudges, journeys, campaigns, and partner-led programs to improve usage and repeat transactions.
* Drive funnel improvements that translate into higher active base, improved retention, and stronger unit economics.
* Revenue, Monetisation & Unit Economics
* Own all monetisation levers including interchange, MDR, interest income, late fees, and partner-linked revenue streams.
* Analyse and manage CAC, cost-to-serve, collection efficiency, risk-adjusted contribution margin, and overall P&L sustainability.
* Balance growth with portfolio quality, working closely with Risk teams to maintain controlled delinquency and financial discipline.
* Build revenue forecasts, P&L models, and commercial scenarios for planning and partner negotiations.
* Ensure strong visibility into revenue performance, profitability, and economic drivers across customer cohorts.
* Data, Analytics & Performance Management
* Monitor dashboards tracking lines created, activations, active users, repeat usage, transaction value, risk metrics, and revenue.
* Identify performance patterns and proactively address early-warning signals related to risk, conversion, or partner issues.
* Lead business reviews with leadership, presenting insights, strategic decisions, and data-driven action plans.
* Drive controlled experiments, pilots, and A/B tests to unlock new segments, use cases, and monetisation opportunities.
* Use analytics to forecast performance, optimise growth levers, and improve portfolio profitability.

title: Process Lead - OTC
description:
**PURPOSE OF ROLE**
GSC is responsible for the finance execution of OTC. As a Functional Process Lead, you are responsible for ensuring that this is done as per standards in most efficient way for your responsible domain.
  
  
The functional process lead is responsible to continuously ensure that we are track on deliverables and key metrics across the region and for responsible domain. That includes:
  
  

* Daily/weekly check performance management metrics
* Follow up and take actions on any deviations
* Have a clear plan on how to reach the best-in-class targets

As functional process lead you also play an active role in continuously ensure that we are following the standards and that we are process compliant. Equally important is also to challenge the standards and see how we can run our processes even more efficient. For this the functional process lead, as SPOC, plays a key role in the FPO/Key user community and support evaluation and implementation of improvement initiatives.
  
  
**Principal Accountabilities Processes & Standardization**

* Actively drive Standardization of the process domain across Terminals/entities within the region/site responsible. Always with a focus on End-to-End process optimization which also include x-functional work
* Responsible to identify potential improvements for standardization, elimination and automation of the process steps, and improved quality of process output. Actively engage with BPEs and peers in ensuring that as APMT we achieve the standardization goals
* Ensure Process Compliance and perform regular Gemba and process confirmations. Identify process gaps and support to bridge the deviations as per standard
* Ensure that there is work instructions (L4) covering all steps of the processes and that they are fit for purpose. Work actively with the BPEs to improve.
* Lead or participate in Kaizens to ensure that performance is improved or that process gaps are closed
* Proactively propose improvements and efficiency enhancements to the processes
* Work closely with the FPOs and BPEs to implement new processes, new standards and improvement initiatives Ensure that any exceptions to the standard processes are well documented and signed off
* Responsible for ensuring that the execution team for respective domain is rightly staffed and that there is an efficiency as per yearly target in the execution team
* Resolve ad hoc queries / request from Terminal HoFs
* Financial statement review & clarification of concerns / queries from stakeholder for Revenue.
* Provide justification on ICP gaps within group. Financial statement review & clarification of concerns / queries from stakeholder for Revenue.
* Ensure Data governance rules are adopted, assess impact on local Data, create local instructions, SOPs related to Data, conduct PCs and provide improvement ideas
* Responsible to submit local exceptions on Data, ensure proper local cross-functional alignment

**PERFORMANCE MANAGEMENT & COMPLIANCE**

* Track operational metrics/KPIs that measures the success of the responsible domain
* Ensure maximum usage of digital cockpit for performance review
* Owner of the process domains performance and responsible for swift taking actions where there is a risk for underperformance
* Develop clear action plans and closely work with the execution team to improve the performance of operational metrices
* Provide continues feedback to the FPOs on potential gaps and risks in the process execution
* Ensure that the internal controls and baseline controls are covered in the standard processes and that it’s clear on how to execute on them
* Well versed and good understanding of group policies, guidelines, and control framework for adherence
* Ensure that there is a strategic agenda for the year on how to improve execution for respective domain well linked to overall Finance Delivery Promise

**CHANGE MANAGEMENT**

* Work closely with the execution team to identify opportunities to improve processes and reducing waste from existing process landscape according to the WoW10 governance model. Drive best practice sharing within the process domain community
* Engages the minds and hearts of process users to contribute to improvements through Kaizens & Process Confirmations and feedback to respective domain FPO
* Lead or participate in Kaizens (problem solving sessions) to ensure that performance is improved or that process gaps are closed
* Responsible to test any new changes and to implement changes to process or systems coming from the FPOs
* Take an active role as Key User and participate in community/network to where eg. questions about process and systems improvements are discussed
* Take an active role in onboarding and training of employees working in the responsible domain.
* Communicating/ creating awareness of the key changes within their domain
* Bridging the gaps between Functional process leads in same domain, other Finance domains and other functions at local level

**Critical Qualifications/Skills/Experience**

* Minimum 12-14 years’ experience in respective process domain. Chief Accountant/FNA Manager/Controller in respective functional area of expertise, preferable experience of at least 5 years.
* Strong people leadership skills, experience leading leaders
* Qualified Chartered Accountant and good understanding of IFRS
* Expert domain knowledge of respective processes
* Excellent stakeholder management and collaboration skills
* Experience in delivering results through others (both direct and indirect report)
* Level-headed and effective at change management, capable of pushing back when appropriate and face resistance in a calm and respectful manner
* Good English written and verbal communication, presentation, and facilitation skills

Maersk is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we embrace different styles of thinking. Maersk is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applicants without regard to race, colour, gender, sex, age, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy or parental leave, veteran status, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with all legal requirements.

Evolent partners with health plans and providers to achieve better outcomes for people with most complex and costly health conditions. Working across specialties and primary care, we seek to connect the pieces of fragmented health care system and ensure people get the same level of care and compassion we would want for our loved ones.
  
  
Evolent employees enjoy work/life balance, the flexibility to suit their work to their lives, and autonomy they need to get things done. We believe that people do their best work when they're supported to live their best lives, and when they feel welcome to bring their whole selves to work. That's one reason why diversity and inclusion are core to our business.
  
  
Join Evolent for the mission. Stay for the culture.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing:**
Senior Accountant – India Accounting
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
The Senior Accountant will support the India accounting and financial reporting activities, ensuring accurate and timely month-end close, statutory reporting, reconciliations, and audit requirements. The role will work closely with the India Finance, AP and Tax teams and other relevant stakeholders to ensure compliance with applicable accounting and statutory requirements.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Support preparation and review of India GAAP financial statements and related audit schedules.
* Coordinate with the India AP and Finance teams to ensure completeness and accuracy of accounting records.
* Perform and review month-end accounting activities, including accruals, prepaid expenses, fixed assets, leases, payroll-related entries, reclassifications and other journal entries.
* Ensure month-end close activities are completed accurately and within defined close timelines.
* Prepare and review balance sheet reconciliations and ensure timely resolution of reconciling items.
* Support preparation of data and schedules required for Notes to Accounts and statutory financial statement disclosures.
* Support the statutory audit, including audit schedules, sample testing, query resolution and financial statement updates.
* Support tax audit requirements by preparing accounting schedules, reconciliations and supporting documentation.
* Support the Tax team with data, reconciliations, schedules and other information required for direct tax, indirect tax and statutory compliance activities.
* Assist with internal audit and control-related requirements, including preparation of supporting documentation.
* Review accounting transactions and supporting documentation to ensure appropriate accounting treatment and accuracy.
* Assist with budgeting and forecasting activities by providing relevant accounting information and financial data.
* Work closely with cross-functional teams to resolve accounting issues and ensure timely completion of deliverables.
* Identify opportunities to improve accounting processes, reconciliations and financial controls.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Chartered Accountant (CA) mandatory.
* CA with up to 3–4 years of relevant experience in accounting, financial reporting and/or audit.
* Good understanding of India GAAP and statutory financial reporting requirements.
* Experience or exposure to statutory audits, financial statement preparation and balance sheet reconciliations.
* Intermediate to advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
* Strong attention to detail with a focus on accuracy and completeness.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet month-end and statutory reporting deadlines.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with Finance, Tax, AP and other cross-functional teams.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving and organizational skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Articleship or prior experience with a Big Four accounting firm would be an advantage.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to communicate accounting matters clearly and concisely with different stakeholders.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
Company: Index Infotech
  
Position: Sr. Accountant
  
Department: Finance & Accounts (OSG)
  
Reporting To: Finance Manager (FM) / General Manager (GM)
  
Location: Pune/Hyderabad, India
  
Employment Type: Full-Time
  
  
**Position Summary**

The Sr. Accountant will take charge of the end-to-end accounting operations for the company, ensuring accurate data entry, journal posting, ledger and bank reconciliations, accruals and provisions posting, management of fixed asset register, monthly closing, and regulatory compliances (income-tax, GST, etc.) for the Index Group of entities.
  
  
The role requires experience in subscription revenue recognition, project accounting, cloud service cost management, and international transactions. Accounting experience for Saas business model is desirable but not required.
  
  
The Sr. Accountant will work closely with the Finance Manager, the HR Manager, and often liaise with other departments to facilitate smooth day-to-day operations.
  
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
***Accounting & Bookkeeping***
• Undertake day-to-day data entry and journal posting
  
• Generate and assist with finalization of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements.
  
• Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards.
  
• Finalize general ledger, reconciliations, and month-end/year-end closing.
  
• Maintain fixed asset registers and depreciation schedules.
  
***Regulatory Compliance & Taxation***



  
• Undertake compliance with GST, TDS, Income-Tax, and other statutory requirements in coordination with Index’s external consultants.
  
• Assist/support the auditors, tax consultants, and regulatory authorities whenever required.
  
• Prepare schedules for statutory audits, tax audits, and financial due diligence.
  
• Ensure timely filing of all statutory returns.
  
***Payroll***
• Undertake monthly payroll processing.
  
• Assist with employee-related statutory compliance requirements.
  
***Accounts Receivable & Payable***



  
• Prepare customer invoices and record vendor bills.
  
• Prepare aging reports (AR and AP) and ensure timely follow-up on outstanding receivables.
  
• Reconcile customer and supplier accounts periodically.
  
***Cash Flow & Treasury***



  
• Track cash flow and determine working capital requirement.
  
• Optimize fund utilization and investment of surplus funds where applicable.
  
  
**Other responsibilities**
• Ensure data confidentiality and adherence to company policies and guidelines.
  
• Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders for ancillary tasks.
  
• Any other relevant ad-hoc tasks within the OSG department.
  
  
  
  
Requirements
  
  
**Required Qualifications**
• Bachelor’s Degree in Commerce, Finance, or Accounting.
  
• CA/CMA Inter with 4-5 years of relevant experience, including accounting exposure of SaaS, IT Services, or Technology companies.
  
• Experience with SaaS subscription billing and revenue recognition models is desirable.
  
  
**Additional information**

We are extensively looking for semi-qualified professionals. This role is not open for Fully Qualified Professionals (CA/CMA).

With ICyte, Life Sciences innovators are digitalizing labor-intensive processes – freeing up their best talent to identify and resolve coverage and availability hurdles and to manage pricing and forecasting complexity.

* Ability to demonstrate accountability, curiosity, adaptability, and a continuous improvement mindset.

description:

**Senior Manager – Investments (Alts Quants Group – GSD OCIO)**

Team’s primary responsibilities include building cash flow pacing models and leading the private manager fund performance track record analyses. * Prepare performance reports for PIP (Private Investment Partners) investments and support responses to RFP requests.
* Prepare real estate reports for bespoke clients, covering investment performance, fund manager views on fund-level investments, and real estate market insights.
* Understanding of manager selection processes and private markets portfolio modeling and construction across multiple private market asset classes to achieve investment objectives
* Preparing case studies assisting in tracking Mercer PIP Secondaries investment performance across all the asset classes
* Conduct research and transaction analysis related to private markets secondaries and co-investments, along with ad hoc analyses.
* Act as a Subject Matter Expert for Private Equity, Real Estate, Private Debt, Secondaries and Fund of Funds.
* Develop and drive process improvement initiatives to enhance quality and efficiency.

**What You Need to Have:**

* Proven investment industry 7+ years in an investment role with exposure to Alternatives investment strategies
* Master’s degree in finance, Economics, Management, Mathematics, Engineering, or a similar field.
* CAIA, CFA charterholder or any progress towards it would be preferred.
* Experience and knowledge of Private Markets asset classes, including Private Equity, Private Debt, Infrastructure, and Real Estate.
* Proficient in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, with strong analytical skills and the ability to analyze large datasets.
* Experience with tools like Investran, eVestment, Pitchbook, and Dealcloud
* Experience with databases is required with Python, SQL skills and ability to research, self-learn and use, complex Python libraries
* Proactive and outcome orientated with the ability to work well as part of a team and develop positive working relationships across the organization
* Ability to manage multiple projects, stakeholders, and deliverables simultaneously
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence at all organizational levels.

**What makes you stand out :**

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work collaboratively across teams.
* Ability to thrive in a dynamic, high-performing team, supporting colleagues while managing. your own tasks and projects.
* Demonstrates the ability to build relationships with colleagues from a variety of different divisions / demonstrates effective communication skills.
* Structured, detail-oriented approach with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

**Why join our team:**

* Your contributions will impact key decision-making.
* Partner with experienced leaders and cross-functional teams in a collaborative, matrixed environment
* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

description:
**Position Overview**
**Job Title: Credit Risk Data Unit, AS**
**Location: Pune, India**
**Corporate Title: Associate**
**Role Description**

* The Credit Risk Data Unit delivers quality-assured, timely and transparent finance-relevant risk data and analysis to key stakeholders. The team manages end-to-end processes for critical risk metrics, maintaining strong controls, regulatory compliance and operational efficiency while using data, automation and AI-enabled capabilities to improve accuracy, insight and decision-making.
* This role sits within the Global Risk Data Control and Validation Group Function team, which aggregates, validates and submits credit exposure data to FDW in line with BCBS standards. The data supports the Bank’s downstream regulatory and regional reporting, including Credit Risk RWA, Leverage Exposure and Regulatory Capital. RDV-GF is part of the Credit Risk Data Unit within Group Finance and works closely with CRDU, Business Finance, Accounting Close, Book Runners, source-system teams and FDW IT support. The process is centrally managed from Pune and combines strong control execution with continuous improvement, intelligent automation and responsible use of AI.

**What We’ll Offer You**
As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy
  
  

* Best in class leave policy
* Gender neutral parental leaves
* 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
* Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
* Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
* Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
* Accident and Term life Insurance
* Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

**Your Key Responsibilities**
The Risk Data Control group are responsible for :
  
  

* Process relevant feeds and adjustments in strategic systems to ensure high-quality data flows into regulatory reporting platforms.
* Manage transaction, collateral and facility data from strategic source systems and approved manual feeds across all in-scope asset classes and businesses.
* Process risk feeds, branch ledger and sub-ledger data required for monthly reconciliations.
* Produce reconciliations against control checks and the posted balance sheet, investigate exceptions and maintain breaks within agreed thresholds.
* Distribute break details, obtain clear commentary, identify root causes and coordinate timely resolution with product control and other stakeholders.
* Identify opportunities to simplify controls and use workflow automation, analytics and AI-assisted tools to improve data quality, reduce manual effort and strengthen operational resilience.

Responsibilities/Tasks:
  
  

* Act as the subject matter expert for assigned risk data control processes and provide clear guidance on controls, data lineage and issue resolution.
* Ensure data submitted to Group regulatory reporting systems is complete, accurate, validated and correctly mapped to key reference data.
* Deliver reconciliations and control checks against the posted balance sheet, investigate exceptions and keep breaks within approved analytical thresholds.
* Perform supervisory quality assurance reviews within agreed service levels and maintain complete, audit-ready evidence.
* Provide production support during unplanned absences, platform stabilization and business continuity scenarios.
* Serve as the first point of escalation for operational, control and data-quality issues.
* Coordinate issue resolution with the Team Lead, Operations Manager, technology teams and other stakeholders; track actions through to sustainable closure.
* Support post-process reviews of performance, incidents and control outcomes; identify root causes and drive corrective and preventive actions.
* Monitor workload, capability and overtime; escalate capacity or delivery risks and support effective allocation of work.
* Maintain current process, control and data-lineage documentation and support regular control reviews.
* Build team resilience through cross-training, knowledge sharing and effective backup coverage.
* Review management information, trends and key indicators covering monthly submissions, control performance and data quality; translate findings into concise stakeholder insights.
* Use approved automation, analytics and AI-enabled tools to detect anomalies, priorities exceptions, accelerate root-cause analysis and improve reporting, with appropriate human oversight and adherence to data-security, model-risk and governance requirements.
* Identify, assess and document automation opportunities; define requirements, support testing and measure benefits such as reduced manual effort, improved accuracy and faster turnaround.
* Support the Team Lead in setting clear objectives and providing fair, evidence-based performance feedback aligned with organizational standards.
* Support change-the-bank projects and strategic improvement initiatives, including data, automation and AI use cases.
* Partner with Change teams to maintain and deliver a prioritized remediation book of work based on data-quality and process diagnostics.
* Coordinate with project teams to deliver improvements to processes, controls and outputs, including requirements definition, user acceptance testing and implementation readiness.
* Ensure effective audit engagement, evidence coordination and timely closure of findings.
* Support the Team Lead with resource planning, succession planning, training, development and adoption of new digital capabilities.

**Your Skills And Experience**
Experience/Exposure:
  
  

* 6–7 years of relevant experience in credit risk controls, banking operations, finance, audit, change delivery or business process improvement.
* Good understanding of banking products, including debt, securities financing transactions and derivatives, with working knowledge of Global Markets products.
* Working knowledge of credit risk management, Basel requirements and regulatory guidance relating to risk-weighted assets, leverage exposure and IFRS 9 credit loss measures.
* Advanced skills in Microsoft Excel, Word and PowerPoint; practical experience with SQL, workflow automation tools is desirable.
* Hands-on experience identifying and implementing process automation, such as low-code workflows, robotic process automation, scripting or automated controls.
* Practical understanding of AI and machine-learning applications in data quality, anomaly detection, document analysis, root-cause investigation or management reporting.
* Experience using generative AI or AI assistants responsibly to improve productivity and insight, including prompt design, output validation, human oversight and protection of confidential data.
* Strong reconciliation and quantitative analysis skills, with the ability to interpret complex data and communicate clear conclusions.
* Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to work effectively across teams, functions and regions.

Education/Certification:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Business, Economics, Banking, Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Analytics or a related discipline.
* Preferably CFA or FRM qualified.

**Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.**
**How We’ll Support You**

* Training and development to help you excel in your career
* Coaching and support from experts in your team
* A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
* A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs

**About Us And Our Teams**
Please visit our company website for further information:
  
  
https://www.db.com/company/company.html
  
  
We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.
  
  
Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.
  
  
We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.
