title: SAP COPA Consultant (Costing)
description:
**Details**
**Role overview**
We're seeking a senior SAP CO-PA Consultant with substantial hands-on experience in
**costing and profitability analysis**
to support an AMS engagement across SAP ECC and S/4HANA. The consultant will provide functional production support, resolve complex costing and profitability issues, and deliver process improvements in collaboration with Finance, Controlling, and technical teams.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide AMS support for SAP CO-PA and related Controlling processes, including incident, problem, and change management.
* Troubleshoot end-to-end product costing and profitability issues across planning, cost estimates, cost rollups, production settlement, and margin analysis.
* Support costing processes such as standard costing, actual costing, cost component splits, overhead calculation, WIP, variance analysis, and settlement.
* Analyze cost and revenue flows into CO-PA, including derivation, account assignment, allocations, assessments, and reporting.
* Support both costing-based and account-based CO-PA in ECC, and Margin Analysis in S/4HANA, as applicable to the client landscape.
* Investigate integration issues across FI, CO, Material Management, Sales and Distribution, and Production Planning.
* Perform root-cause analysis for discrepancies in product costs, inventory valuation, profitability reporting, and financial postings.
* Evaluate and deliver configuration changes and enhancements through the AMS lifecycle, including impact analysis, testing, documentation, and release coordination.
* Support month-end and year-end close activities, including cost runs, settlement, reconciliation, and issue resolution.
* Partner with business users to clarify requirements, communicate solutions, and recommend improvements to costing and profitability processes.

**Required qualifications**

* Significant senior-level SAP CO-PA and Controlling consulting experience, preferably in an AMS or production-support environment.
* Heavy hands-on costing experience, including product cost planning, standard costing, cost estimates, cost rollups, and cost analysis.
* Strong understanding of cost flows across manufacturing and finance processes.
* Experience supporting SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA environments.
* Knowledge of CO-PA and S/4HANA Margin Analysis, including relevant design and process differences.
* Experience integrating CO-PA and costing with FI, CO-PC, MM, SD, and PP.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, communication, and documentation skills.
* Familiarity with IT service-management practices, including incident, problem, and change management.

Job Requirements
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Material Ledger and actual costing.
* Knowledge of production order costing, WIP, variance calculation, settlement, and profitability reporting.
* Experience with costing and CO-PA impacts from S/4HANA conversions or deployments.
* Familiarity with SAP analytics and reporting for cost and margin analysis.
* Experience supporting complex manufacturing or multi-entity environments.

title: Assurance, Controls & Compliance Sr. Specialist
description:
**Life Unlimited.**
The Assurance, Controls and Compliance Sr. Specialist is responsible to ensure that internal controls over financial reporting are sound and effective to ensure compliance with the S&N SOX and Minimum Acceptable Practices frameworks. This position is recognized across the Group as the point of contact for guidance and support on the S&N policies and procedures listed in the Group Finance Manual, Minimum Acceptable Practices and SOX RACMs/narratives. The role will permanently report directly into the Regional Director, Assurance, Controls and Compliance, EMEA but for an interim period will report to the Sr. Director, Group Financial Controls and Compliance.
  
  
**What will you be doing?**

* The AC&C Sr. Specialist will be responsible for executing and documenting the SOX programme including tests of design and tests of operating effectiveness for his/her assigned control areas / business units within the EMEA region.
* The role will provide guidance to a broad stakeholder base (Finance, Commercial, Supply Chain) on the requirements of S&N Group Finance Manual, Minimum Acceptable Practices and SOX best practices. This role will support the design of finance process & controls to mitigate the risk of misstatement within the accounting records.

title: Senior Legal Counsel
description:
**About BreachLock**
BreachLock is a global leader in Penetration Testing as a Service (PTaaS), Attack Surface Management and Red Teaming. Founded in 2019 and headquartered in New York, we combine AI, automation and certified human pentesters to help enterprises find and fix exposures before attackers do. Our team works across North America, Europe and Asia, serving customers in technology, banking, financial services, insurance and manufacturing.
  
  
**The role**
We are looking for a Senior Legal Counsel to be BreachLock's in-house legal advisor across our global business. Based in Pune, you will advise leadership and teams in the US, Europe and Asia on commercial, corporate, data protection, employment and regulatory matters. You will handle most matters yourself and manage outside counsel where specialist or local advice is needed.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**Commercial contracts**

* Draft, review and negotiate customer, partner, reseller and vendor agreements, including MSAs, SaaS subscription terms, SOWs, NDAs and DPAs
* Build and maintain contract templates, playbooks and approval workflows so sales and procurement can move quickly
* Advise on liability, indemnity, security commitments and service levels typical of cybersecurity engagements, including penetration testing authorizations and rules of engagement

**Corporate and governance**

* Support corporate secretarial and governance work across group entities in India, the US and other jurisdictions
* Support financing, investment and strategic transactions alongside external counsel
* Maintain entity records, intercompany agreements and board documentation

**Data protection and regulatory**

* Advise on privacy and data protection laws, including India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, GDPR, UK GDPR and US state privacy laws
* Advise on Indian IT Act and CERT-In requirements, export controls and other regulations relevant to a global cybersecurity business
* Support customer security and compliance questionnaires, audits and certifications from a legal perspective

**Employment and intellectual property**

* Advise on employment matters across jurisdictions, including contracts, policies, restrictive covenants and terminations, working with HR
* Protect BreachLock's trademarks, software and confidential information, and advise on open-source use

**Disputes and risk**

* Manage pre-litigation disputes, claims and collections, and oversee outside counsel on any litigation or arbitration
* Identify legal risks early and give practical, business-focused advice
* Train teams on contracting, privacy and compliance basics

**Requirements**
**What you bring**

* LLB or BA LLB (Hons) from a reputed law school (National Law University preferred), enrolled with a State Bar Council
* 5-10 years of post-qualification experience, with at least 3 years at a leading Indian law firm with a strong cross-border practice, or at an international law firm
* Strong experience in commercial contracts and technology transactions; SaaS, IT services or cybersecurity exposure is a strong plus
* Working knowledge of data protection laws in India, the EU and the US
* Experience advising clients or businesses across multiple jurisdictions and coordinating with foreign counsel
* Excellent drafting and negotiation skills in English, and the ability to explain legal risk clearly to non-lawyers
* Comfort working across time zones with US and European colleagues
* An LLM, foreign qualification (for example, New York Bar or England and Wales) or CIPP/E or CIPP/US certification is a plus

**Benefits**
**What we offer**

* Competitive fixed pay and performance bonus
* A broad, global in-house role with direct access to leadership at a fast-growing cybersecurity company

, focused on helping organisations build stronger, more capable and future-ready workforces.

We design and deliver practical corporate learning and capability-building programmes across leadership, communication, productivity, digital skills, AI, workplace technology and industry-specific training.

Through a network of expert trainers and facilitators, we partner with organisations to deliver customised learning solutions that create measurable workplace impact.

As we embark on our growth journey, we are looking for an entrepreneurial, proactive and execution-oriented professional to join our founding team.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a
**Business Growth & Operations Associate**
who will work closely with the Founder and take ownership of business development, client relationships, programme coordination and day-to-day business operations.

This is a comprehensive, multidimensional role that brings together business development, relationship management, operational execution and strategic support.

You will be instrumental in building our client base, developing our partner network, establishing operational systems and driving business growth.

**This is not a conventional sales or operations role. We are looking for someone who thinks like a business builder, takes initiative and is comfortable wearing multiple hats.**

Key Responsibilities

**1. Business Development & Revenue Growth**

* Identify and research potential corporate clients, SMEs, healthcare organisations and institutions across Eastern India.
* Build and actively manage a pipeline of prospective clients and business opportunities.
* Initiate business outreach through LinkedIn, email, telephone, professional networks and direct interactions.
* Generate leads, establish connections and schedule business meetings.
* Understand client requirements and identify relevant training and development opportunities.
* Participate in client discussions, presentations and business meetings.
* Coordinate preparation and submission of proposals, quotations and commercial offers.
* Drive follow-ups, negotiations and business opportunities towards successful conversion.
* Work towards defined business development and revenue targets.

**2. Client Relationship Management**

* Build and nurture long-term relationships with prospective and existing clients.
* Understand client expectations and ensure effective communication throughout the engagement.
* Coordinate client onboarding and programme requirements.
* Identify opportunities for repeat business, cross-selling and long-term partnerships.
* Ensure a positive client experience at every stage of engagement.

**3. Programme & Operations Management**

* Coordinate the end-to-end execution of corporate training programmes.
* Liaise with clients and faculty partners to finalise programme requirements, schedules and delivery plans.
* Coordinate trainer onboarding, availability, assignments and scheduling.
* Manage programme logistics, documentation and communication.
* Monitor programme execution and ensure timely completion of deliverables.
* Coordinate post-training feedback, reports and client follow-ups.
* Identify operational gaps and develop processes to improve efficiency.

**4. Faculty & Partner Network Management**

* Identify, engage and onboard trainers, consultants and subject matter experts.
* Maintain a database of faculty partners and their areas of expertise.
* Coordinate assignments, availability, schedules and engagement-related communication.
* Build and nurture a professional network of training and development partners.

**5. Business Operations & Growth Support**

* Maintain the business development pipeline, client database and CRM records.
* Prepare periodic business development and operational reports.
* Support budgeting, quotations, invoicing coordination and commercial documentation.
* Assist in developing standard operating procedures, templates and operational workflows.
* Support the Founder in strategic initiatives, business planning and execution.
* Explore partnership opportunities, new markets and avenues for business expansion.

Who Are We Looking For?

We are looking for someone who:

* Has an entrepreneurial mindset and a strong sense of ownership.
* Is proactive, self-driven and comfortable taking initiative.
* Possesses excellent communication, networking and interpersonal skills.
* Is confident in business development, client engagement and relationship building.
* Is organised and capable of managing multiple responsibilities simultaneously.
* Can interact confidently with senior professionals, business owners and corporate decision-makers.
* Is resourceful, solution-oriented and adaptable in a growing business environment.
* Can work independently while collaborating closely with the Founder and partner network.
* Thinks beyond assigned responsibilities and is motivated by building something from the ground up.



**We value initiative, accountability, execution capability and attitude as much as formal qualifications.**

Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline. An MBA or postgraduate qualification in Business Administration, Sales, Marketing, HR or related fields will be an advantage.
* Preferably 2–5 years of experience in business development, B2B sales, client relationship management, business operations, corporate training or consulting.
* Experience in the corporate training, HR, Learning & Development, consulting or professional services sector will be an added advantage.
* Good working knowledge of MS Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint, and Google Workspace.
* Familiarity with CRM tools, digital communication platforms and AI-enabled productivity tools will be an advantage.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. Knowledge of Hindi and Bengali will be useful.

Compensation, Incentives & Growth Opportunities

We believe that people who contribute directly to business growth should have the opportunity to participate meaningfully in its success.

The compensation structure will include:

* **Fixed monthly compensation**
  providing financial stability.
* **Attractive, potentially uncapped performance-linked commissions**
  on business successfully generated and converted.
* Direct earning potential linked to business development contributions and revenue generation.

Your ability to identify opportunities, acquire clients and generate business will directly influence your additional earning potential.

We are particularly interested in individuals with an entrepreneurial mindset who enjoy taking ownership, building relationships, identifying opportunities and translating ideas into tangible business results.

**Your growth and earning potential will be closely linked to the value you create and the contribution you make towards building UPLYFT.**

Why Join UPLYFT?

* Be part of the founding team of a growing business.
* Work directly with the Founder and gain exposure to strategic business decisions.
* Take ownership of business development, operations and organisational growth.
* Build business systems, processes, networks and client relationships from the ground up.
* Enjoy performance-linked financial rewards with potentially uncapped commissions.
* Develop entrepreneurial, leadership and business management capabilities.
* Grow alongside the organisation as it expands into new markets.

Who Should Apply?

This opportunity is ideal for someone who has outgrown a narrowly defined job role and is looking for greater responsibility, professional independence and the opportunity to build something meaningful.

You could be a business development professional, an operations executive, a client relationship manager or someone working in the corporate training and consulting ecosystem.

You might not have experience in every aspect of this role. That is perfectly fine. What matters most is your willingness to learn, ability to take ownership, confidence in building relationships and determination to get things done.

**We are looking for a business builder, not merely an employee.**

How to Apply

Interested candidates can share their updated CV at:

**altheoswellnessglobal@gmail.com**

**Email Subject:**
Application – Business Growth & Operations Associate | UPLYFT

Please include a brief note explaining why you believe you are suited for this opportunity.

**UPLYFT – Build. Learn. Lead.**

*A Unit of Altheos Wellness Global*

﻿

**Description**
Energy Aspects currently have an exciting opportunity available for an Accounts Payable Specialist to join the Finance team, based out of our Kolkata office, dedicated to supporting our Finance team.
  
We are seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Accounts Assistant to join our team. The ideal candidate should have strong organizational skills, excellent attention to detail, and a solid understanding of accounting principles.

* Preparing monthly supplier statement reconciliations & Maintain accurate and organized financial records and documentation
* Dealing with external and internal queries by phone and email
* Communicating with relevant suppliers to process invoicing or payment queries
* Process bi-weekly payments made to vendors in a timely manner and initiate payment
* Process Staff Expenses claims on expense management system
* Responsible for managing and maintaining financial records, with a particular emphasis on processing invoices and other bills, review and reconcile invoices, obtain any necessary approvals
* Process Fixed Assets/ Prepayments invoices. assist in maintaining the Fixed Assets/ Prepayments, monthly reconciliations
* Posting invoices and credit notes and ensuring they are coded correctly in the system
* Process and manage accounts payable transactions, ensuring accuracy and timeliness and allocate them in ERP as per COA & Department
* Ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously while meeting deadlines consistently
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (particularly Excel) for reporting
* Excellent communication skills both verbal and written
* Good knowledge of Assets / Liabilities and Income / expense and its accounting treatment.
* Willing to engage with internal team and confident to process invoices
* Ownership of AP inbox, responsible for resolution of any Vendor queries. Knowledge of Freshdesk ticketing system helpful but not required
* Contribute to process improvements and efficiency enhancements within the accounts payable function
* Collaborate with internal departments and external vendors to resolve discrepancies and issues
* Awareness on Tax implication - e.g. TDS, GST

**Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

* Proven work experience as an Accounts Payable Specialist/Executive.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously while meeting deadlines consistently.
* Excellent communication skills both verbal and written.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify and resolve discrepancies or errors.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (particularly Excel) for reporting.
* A degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field is preferred.

**Our Culture & Benefits**
Welcome to our unique workplace where a passion for our industry-leading product sits at the heart of who we are.
  
  
Life at EA is completely eclectic, fostered through the global nature of the business and a real appreciation of the many cultures of our diverse team. We unite as a single, cohesive team through an array of social clubs that cater to a spectrum of interests, from running and yoga to football and culinary adventures. These groups create a collegial and dynamic atmosphere that extends beyond work, promoting a healthy and balanced lifestyle for our team.
  
  
Our strategically located offices are all set in prestigious buildings, offering you the convenience of nearby gyms, retail therapy, diverse dining options, and accessible public transport.
  
  
Our office spaces are thoughtfully equipped to enhance your day-to-day experience whether working independently or collaborating with teammates. Enjoy the simple pleasures of a freshly brewed coffee, healthy snacks, and a social space for celebratory moments. One of the unique traits of life at Energy Aspects is the way our international colleagues often delight us with treats from around the globe. It’s safe to say you’ll never go hungry in our offices!
  
  
We recognise your contribution with a competitive compensation package that includes annual bonuses, comprehensive private health insurance, and substantial pension contributions. Additionally, we offer company share options, subsidised gym memberships, and a generous holiday policy to support your financial and personal well-being.
  
  
Join a company that values your professional growth and personal fulfilment, all within a supportive and engaging environment.

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-**
**Assurance – Manager**
As part of our EY-Assurance Team, you would be the main point of contact from GDS for the tasks assigned by the global client serving assurance teams and be responsible for the timeliness and quality of deliverables along with managing day to day operations of those engagements.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We’re looking for individuals who are qualified accountants with excellent leadership skills.
  
  
The incumbent gets an excellent opportunity to work virtually or directly with the engagement teams across Americas and Europe, and develop knowledge of international accounting and assurance principles
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Support a portfolio of engagements, by leading a team of Assistant Managers, Seniors and Associates
* Ensure the team delivers timely and high-quality work, as per EY methodology and in line with the engagement team’s expectations
* Demonstrate strong understanding of EY methodology in service delivery and supporting various quality projects, such as pre-issuance reviews, assurance quality reviews, efficiency projects and others.
* Develop and maintain productive relationships with key engagement team counterparts, such as Assurance executives based in Americas or Europe.
* Develop an understanding of EY Risk Management procedures and ensure that these are embedded into the engagement team’s work.
* Work closely with the engagement team to transition new engagements and services to GDS Assurance while maintaining the highest levels of quality of service.
* Proactively discuss work flow management with the engagement teams, allocating resources to the assigned work and monitoring performance against standards. Monitor utilization for one’s team, budget to actuals, and other operational matters.
* Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clarity of communication when dealing with GDS and engagement teams.
* Establish expectations regarding value to be delivered to the respective aligned GDS or engagement teams.
* Identify opportunities to improve the scope of work for GDS Assurance.
* Standardize assurance processes along with leveraging best practices across one’s aligned engagements or beyond.
* Help team members grow by encouraging them to actively contribute to the team.
* Lead by example, delegate work successfully and develop and maintain high performing teams.
* Conduct timely performance reviews and provide performance feedback and training.
* Use technology and tools to continually learn, share knowledge with team members, and enhance service delivery.
* Contribute to technical and soft-skills training to continually develop the team’s skills.
* Actively participate in organizational initiatives, such as recruitment, diversity and inclusiveness, trainings, and others.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Expert knowledge of Indian accounting and assurance standards
* Knowledge of UK GAAP or US GAAP and International assurance standards is an added advantage.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Effective interpersonal, risk management, facilitation and presentation skills
* Project management, leadership, coaching, counselling and supervisory skills
* Ability to spread positive work culture, teaming and live EY values.
* The ability to quickly form strong working relationship with colleagues in India and global teams.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI) with 5-6 years of post-qualification relevant experience
* Qualified ACCA / CPA with 7-8 years of post-qualification relevant experience
* Articleship with other top or mid -tier accounting firms
* Experience in either

+ Mid-or top-tier accounting firm focused on external or Assurance reviews / matters
+ MNC or larger Indian companies, preferably within a Shared Service Environment.
+ Big 4 Firms - Indian & Global practice

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Proficiency in MS – Excel, MS – Office.
* Interest in business and commerciality.

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Billing Executive
description:

title: Lead – Procurement
description:
**Position Summary**
The Lead – Procurement will be responsible for managing procurement activities to ensure the timely and cost-effective sourcing of materials, components, and services required for business operations. The role will drive supplier development, commercial negotiations, cost optimization, procurement planning, and compliance with company policies while ensuring continuity of supply and effective stakeholder coordination.
  
  
**Work You’ll Do**
**Job Description**
**Primary Objective**

* Lead end-to-end procurement activities for direct and indirect materials, components, and services, in line with business requirements.
* Develop and implement sourcing strategies to achieve cost competitiveness, quality, and continuity of supply.
* Identify, evaluate, develop, and manage suppliers; conduct supplier performance reviews and drive corrective actions where required.
* Lead RFQ processes, bid evaluations, commercial negotiations, and supplier finalization.
* Review purchase requisitions and ensure timely placement and release of purchase orders.
* Monitor open purchase orders and supplier commitments to ensure timely delivery and resolve supply-related issues.
* Drive cost reduction, value engineering, alternate sourcing, and process improvement initiatives.
* Coordinate with Planning, Stores, Production, Quality, Engineering, Finance, and other stakeholders to meet material and service requirements.
* Ensure procurement documentation, contracts, approvals, and records are maintained in accordance with company policies and procedures.
* Monitor procurement risks, market trends, and supplier capacity; develop mitigation plans for critical materials.
* Guide and support procurement team members and ensure effective execution of daily activities.

**Specific Objective**

* Ensure timely availability of materials and services to support uninterrupted business operations.
* Achieve procurement cost, quality, delivery, and supplier performance objectives.
* Strengthen supplier relationships and develop alternate sources for critical requirements.
* Ensure adherence to procurement policies, approval matrix, and documentation requirements.
* Identify and implement opportunities for cost savings and process efficiency.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* Relevant experience in procurement / purchasing, preferably in a manufacturing environment.
* Strong knowledge of sourcing, supplier evaluation, negotiation, and purchase order management.
* Proficiency in MS Office; working knowledge of ERP procurement modules in SAP.
* Strong communication, negotiation, analytical, and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Degree in Engineering or a relevant postgraduate qualification in Supply Chain / Operations Management.
* Experience handling procurement for manufacturing, engineering, or industrial operations.
* Demonstrated experience in cost reduction, supplier development, and strategic sourcing.
* Experience leading or mentoring a procurement team.
* Understanding of commercial terms, contracts, inventory principles, and procurement controls.

**Who We Are**
Mold-Masters (www.moldmasters.com) is a leading global supplier of hot runners, controllers, auxiliary injection and co-injection systems. We design, manufacture, distribute, sell and service highly engineered and customized plastic processing equipment that caters to every market. Mold-Masters is a business unit of Hillenbrand.
  
  
Hillenbrand (www.hillenbrand.com) is a global industrial company that provides highly engineered, mission-critical processing equipment and solutions to customers in over 100 countries around the world. Our portfolio is composed of leading industrial brands that serve large, attractive end markets, including durable plastics, food, and recycling. Guided by our Purpose — Shape What Matters For Tomorrow™ — we pursue excellence, collaboration, and innovation to consistently shape solutions that best serve our associates, customers, communities, and other stakeholders.
  
  
EEO: The policy of Hillenbrand Inc. is to extend opportunities to qualified applicants and employees on an equal basis regardless of an individual's age, race, color, sex, religion, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression or veteran status. Additionally, Hillenbrand Inc. and our operating companies are committed to being an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Employer and offers opportunities to all job seekers including individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to assist with your job search or application for employment, email us at recruitingaccommodations@hillenbrand.com . In your email, please include a description of the specific accommodation you are requesting as well as the job title and requisition number of the position for which you are applying. At Hillenbrand, everyone is welcome to apply and "Shape What Matters for Tomorrow".

title: Growth Strategy & Analyst
description:
**About KeyValue**

KeyValue is a premier global AI-driven product development hub, dedicated to transforming ideas into scalable and impactful software products. With expertise across diverse industries, we deliver high-quality solutions with the power of AI and automation. As an AI-first organisation, we strive to push the boundaries of technology, offering accelerated, flexible, and cost-effective product development.

We have ideated, conceived, strategized and built some of the globe’s most innovative Fintech, Payments, Financial Services, Digital Commerce, Madtech, Edtech, Socialtech, Logistics, High Technology, Blockchain, Crypto, NFT and Healthcare companies, helping them conceive, scale, pivot, and enhance their businesses.

KeyValue’s mission is to be the world’s most trusted product development hub – delivering high-value outcomes for start-ups & scale-ups – with a talented skilled team – in a thriving and inclusive culture.

We are looking for a
**Growth Strategy & Analyst**
to drive data-backed growth initiatives for CoFee, our in-house SaaS product that simplifies fee collection and financial management for businesses.

This role sits at the intersection of
**product, marketing, sales, and business strategy**
. You will analyse the end-to-end growth funnel, identify opportunities for optimisation, and translate data into actionable strategies that improve customer acquisition, conversion, retention, and revenue growth.

**What You Will Do**

* Analyse the complete customer growth funnel, from lead generation and acquisition to conversion, product adoption, and retention.
* Evaluate marketing campaign performance, acquisition channels, customer acquisition costs, and ROI to identify optimisation opportunities.
* Analyse sales pipelines, conversion rates, and funnel drop-offs to identify bottlenecks and recommend improvements.
* Track product usage, customer behaviour, and engagement metrics to identify opportunities for improving adoption and retention.
* Develop data-driven growth strategies to improve customer acquisition, sales effectiveness, and overall business performance.
* Build dashboards, monitor key business KPIs, and provide actionable insights to support decision-making.
* Collaborate with marketing, sales, product, and leadership teams to implement growth initiatives and measure their impact.
* Identify market trends, customer segments, and new growth opportunities to support business expansion.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 3–5 years of experience in Growth Analytics, Growth Strategy, Business Analytics, Revenue Operations, or related roles.
* Strong understanding of marketing analytics, sales funnels, customer acquisition, and conversion optimisation.
* Experience analysing business performance and translating insights into actionable growth strategies.
* Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and working knowledge of SQL and data visualisation tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker Studio.
* Familiarity with growth metrics such as CAC, LTV, conversion rates, retention, churn, and ROI.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and business acumen.
* Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams and communicate insights effectively.

**Good to Have**

* Candidates with an MBA or equivalent qualification from an IIM will be preferred.
* Experience working with B2B SaaS products or technology-driven businesses.
* Familiarity with CRM and product analytics tools such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Google Analytics, Mixpanel, or Amplitude.
* Experience with growth experiments, funnel optimisation, and go-to-market strategies.

title: Audit Manager

description:
**Job Category:** Associate Senior Associate

**Job Type:** Full Time

**Job Location:** Bangalore Chennai Mumbai

**Job Company:** Dvara Holdings

**Number of Position:** 1

### **Job Purpose**

Help build and run Dvara’s new legal recovery practice, which supports partner lenders with legally assisted collections on hard-bucket and delinquent portfolios across multiple states. Handle recovery litigation and pre-litigation action, build and manage a network of local advocates, and support the group’s broader legal function. Reports to the General Counsel.

### **Key Accountabilities and Deliverables**

* Manage end-to-end legal recovery action on delinquent and hard-bucket accounts for partner lenders, from pre-litigation notices to filing, prosecution, settlement and execution
* Handle and supervise civil recovery suits, Lok Adalat and pre-litigation settlements, and arbitration proceedings and enforcement of awards
* Handle cheque dishonour proceedings under Section 138 of the NI Act and NACH/mandate dishonour proceedings under Section 25 of the PSS Act
* Draft, review and issue legal notices, replies, pleadings, applications and settlement documents
* Track hearings, orders and case status across forums, and keep case records and MIS accurate
* Appear before courts, tribunals, Lok Adalats and other forums where required, and coordinate with counsel on matters they handle
* Identify, empanel and onboard local advocates across target locations on a cost-efficient basis
* Allocate matters, monitor turnaround and quality, and review the work of empanelled advocates
* Coordinate documentation, invoicing and periodic reporting with the advocate network
* Travel to field locations across states, including semi-urban and remote areas, to support recovery efforts, working with local advocates, collections teams, lender representatives and, where appropriate, borrowers
* Work closely with partner lenders and internal collections, operations and business teams to identify accounts for legal action and agree on recovery strategy
* Support the group’s broader legal function, including contracts, group transactions and regulatory matters

### **Candidate Profile**

**Educational Qualifications:**

B.L. / LL.B. from a recognized university; enrolled with a State Bar Council

  

**Experience:**

* 3–6 years’ post-qualification experience in litigation; experience in bank or NBFC recovery, debt recovery litigation or arbitration is preferred

  

**Knowledge/Skills required:**

* Working knowledge of the NI Act, the PSS Act, the Arbitration and Conciliation Act and the CPC
* Understanding of recovery procedures and financial services regulation
* Familiarity with SARFAESI and DRT proceedings (a plus)
* Strong drafting, negotiation and coordination skills
* Fluency in spoken and written Hindi (mandatory); other regional languages an added advantage
* Comfortable with MS Excel, case-tracking tools and digital workflows

  

**Competencies required:**

* Ownership and an enterprising, self-driven approach
* Ability to manage a high volume of matters across jurisdictions
* Willingness to travel frequently, mainly across Maharashtra, Odisha and Rajasthan
* High integrity and sound judgement in borrower-facing situations

Interested candidates may write to jobs@dvaraholdings.com with a copy of their resume.

**1. Legal Support & Advisory**

* Provide day-to-day legal assistance to various departments of iSprout Business Centre.
* Ensure business activities comply with applicable laws and regulations.
* Identify potential legal risks and recommend appropriate mitigation measures.
* Coordinate with internal departments and external legal advisors on legal matters.
* Support the implementation of company policies, procedures and compliance frameworks.

**2. Contract Management & Documentation**

Draft, review, vet and negotiate various agreements, including:

* Lease and rental agreements.
* Leave and License Agreements.
* Master Service Agreements (MSAs).
* Vendor and service agreements.
* Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs).
* Memorandums of Understanding (MOUs).

* Support RERA-related registrations, filings and documentation, wherever applicable.
* Coordinate with government authorities, including GHMC, HMDA and other relevant departments.
* Maintain records of licenses, registrations, renewals and statutory compliances.
* Prepare compliance reports and maintain legal documentation for internal audits.

* Maintain records of legal notices, court cases, arbitration proceedings and other disputes.
* Assist in preparing responses to legal notices, notices of default and contractual claims.
* Coordinate the collection of documents and evidence for legal proceedings.

* Work closely with Sales, Finance, HR and Operations teams to address routine legal requirements.

* Support HR in drafting and reviewing employment agreements, confidentiality agreements and employee-related legal documentation.
* Participate in client and vendor meetings to address contractual and documentation-related queries.
* Provide timely legal inputs to ensure smooth business operations across iSprout locations.

**7. Intellectual Property & Corporate Documentation**

* Coordinate trademark searches, applications, renewals and related documentation.
* Maintain corporate legal records, agreements, authorizations and statutory documents.
* Assist in preparing board resolutions, declarations, undertakings and other corporate documentation.

* Bachelor's degree in Law (LLB) from a recognized university.
* 2–5 years of relevant post-qualification experience (PQE).

**Technical Skills**

* Understanding of real estate laws, RERA, lease documentation and commercial agreements.
* Familiarity with the Companies Act, labour laws and other applicable statutory requirements.
* Proficiency in MS Office, Excel and Microsoft Teams.

Familiarity with telecom products is an advantage but not a prerequisite.

**What you’ll be Responsible for?**

* Work with engineering, product and R&D teams to identify, evaluate and capture patentable inventions across software products and platforms.
* Conduct invention disclosure reviews and prior art / patentability searches, and assess novelty, inventiveness and commercial value.
* Draft, file and prosecute patent applications in India and key international jurisdictions, in coordination with external patent counsel and attorneys.
* Manage responses to office actions, examination reports and oppositions through to grant.
* Build, maintain and periodically review the patent portfolio, aligned with product roadmaps and business priorities.
* Conduct freedom-to-operate (FTO) analyses and infringement and risk assessments for new products and features.
* Support IP due diligence in partnerships, licensing, M&A and customer or vendor contracts, including review of IP, licensing and open-source clauses.
* Monitor competitor patent filings and industry IP trends and provide insights to leadership.
* Run IP awareness and invention-harvesting programs, including inventor recognition and training for technical teams.
* Maintain IP records, docket and annuity or renewal timelines, and manage budgets and outside counsel relationships.
* Support protection and enforcement of other IP assets, including trademarks, copyrights and trade secrets, as required.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Exposure to product companies with a strong IP culture and a track record of building and managing sizeable patent portfolios.
* Knowledge of telecom, including core telecom network architecture and network security.
* Understanding privacy and data protection laws and their implications for technology products and inventions.
* Experience with IP management and docketing tools, and with patent landscaping and analytics platforms.
* Understanding of open-source licensing and its IP implications.
* Experience designing invention-harvesting, incentive or IP awareness programs.

* Technical depth combined with sound legal and analytical judgement.

title: Associate Company Secretary [for a CS firm]
description:
**Company Description**
RANJ is a premier Corporate Secretarial and Legal Advisory firm that supports businesses in navigating complex regulatory, governance, and transactional requirements. The firm offers integrated solutions across business structuring, corporate governance, M&A, private equity, venture capital, capital markets, foreign investments, intellectual property, dispute resolution, and regulatory compliance. Guided by the philosophy of “Expect the Exceptional,” RANJ serves entrepreneurs, investors, boards, and management teams with commercially pragmatic advice grounded in professionalism, integrity, and strong governance. In India, RANJ is headquartered in Hyderabad with additional presence in Delhi-NCR, Mumbai and Pune, and aims to expand across major urban centers. Internationally, the firm serves clients from around the world through its presence in Dubai.

**Role Description**
The Associate Company Secretary will support corporate secretarial and governance functions for a diverse portfolio of clients and internal entities. This full-time, on-site role is based in Hyderabad and involves managing a portfolio of clients wrt corporate actions related to fund raising, pre-IPO, IPOs, QIPs, restructurings, M&A, investment, FEMA, corporate governance besides handling other corporate secretarial compliance matters. Must have handled versatile companies' assignments like Pvt, Public, Listed, NBFC, Section 8, Producer Companies etc.

**Qualifications**

* Professional qualification - Shall be an Associate Member of ICSI, with strong knowledge of corporate laws, secretarial standards, and governance frameworks.
* Experience in corporate secretarial work, including board and shareholder meeting support, drafting minutes, resolutions, and maintaining statutory records and registers.
* Familiarity with regulatory filings and compliance processes under Companies Act and related regulations, including ROC filings, event-based compliances, and annual compliances.
* Exposure to transactional work such as M&A, private equity, venture capital, capital restructuring, and due diligence will be an advantage.
* Strong legal and regulatory research skills, with the ability to interpret and apply laws, rules, and guidance to practical business situations.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with attention to detail, accuracy in drafting, and the ability to prepare clear reports and documentation.
* Proficiency with MS Office and secretarial/compliance software or tools, and comfort working with digital documentation and workflows.
* High standards of integrity, professionalism, and confidentiality, with strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple assignments and deadlines.

title: Senior Legal Counsel
description:
**About BreachLock**
--------------------

BreachLock is a global leader in Penetration Testing as a Service (PTaaS), Attack Surface Management and Red Teaming. Founded in 2019 and headquartered in New York, we combine AI, automation and certified human pentesters to help enterprises find and fix exposures before attackers do. Our team works across North America, Europe and Asia, serving customers in technology, banking, financial services, insurance and manufacturing.

**The role**
------------

We are looking for a Senior Legal Counsel to be BreachLock’s in-house legal advisor across our global business. Based in Pune, you will advise leadership and teams in the US, Europe and Asia on commercial, corporate, data protection, employment and regulatory matters. You will handle most matters yourself and manage outside counsel where specialist or local advice is needed.

**What you will do**
--------------------

**Commercial contracts**

* Draft, review and negotiate customer, partner, reseller and vendor agreements, including MSAs, SaaS subscription terms, SOWs, NDAs and DPAs.
* Build and maintain contract templates, playbooks and approval workflows so sales and procurement can move quickly.
* Advise on liability, indemnity, security commitments and service levels typical of cybersecurity engagements, including penetration testing authorizations and rules of engagement.

**Corporate and governance**

* Support corporate secretarial and governance work across group entities in India, the US and other jurisdictions.
* Support financing, investment and strategic transactions alongside external counsel.
* Maintain entity records, intercompany agreements and board documentation.

**Data protection and regulatory**

* Advise on privacy and data protection laws, including India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, GDPR, UK GDPR and US state privacy laws.
* Advise on Indian IT Act and CERT-In requirements, export controls and other regulations relevant to a global cybersecurity business.
* Support customer security and compliance questionnaires, audits and certifications from a legal perspective.

**Employment and intellectual property**

* Advise on employment matters across jurisdictions, including contracts, policies, restrictive covenants and terminations, working with HR.
* Protect BreachLock’s trademarks, software and confidential information, and advise on open-source use.

**Disputes and risk**

title: Internal Control - Vendor Governance & TPRM
description:
**Role Overview:**

We are seeking an experienced and dynamic candidate for GRC Projects & Vendor Governance to join our team. The ideal candidate will play a critical role in managing Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) transformation initiatives and strengthening the Bank's Vendor Governance framework. The role will be responsible for driving GRC projects, process automation, regulatory implementations, and overseeing Third-Party Risk Management activities, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and organizational objectives. The individual will collaborate extensively with cross-functional teams to improve controls, enhance governance processes, and drive technology-led solutions.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Role Allocation:**

The role will entail approximately 70% focus on Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) Projects and 30% focus on Vendor Governance and Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) activities, ensuring effective control oversight, regulatory compliance, and operational governance across the Bank.

**A. GRC Projects, Transformation & Regulatory Initiatives**

**1. Lead Project Deliverables**

* Lead and manage end-to-end GRC projects across different control functions, ensuring alignment with business objectives and regulatory requirements.
* Work closely with internal stakeholders to gather requirements, design project roadmaps, and implement solutions.
* Drive governance, risk, compliance, audit, and control-related transformation initiatives across the organization.

**2. Optimize Existing Applications, Process Automation & Efficiency Enhancement**

* Identify manual, repetitive, and resource-intensive activities across GRC and control functions that can be automated.
* Evaluate existing processes and recommend technology-driven solutions to improve efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.
* Drive automation initiatives in collaboration with business and technology teams.
* Monitor automation outcomes and ensure sustainable benefits through continuous process optimization.

**3. Regulatory Compliance & Circular Implementation**

* Analyze regulatory circulars, guidelines, and compliance requirements issued by regulators and internal governance bodies.
* Coordinate with Compliance, Operations, Product, and Technology teams to ensure timely compliance with regulatory mandates.
* Conduct gap assessments and track closure of identified action items.
* Maintain implementation evidence and documentation to support audits and regulatory reviews.

**4. Project Governance & Delivery Management**

* Track and manage project timelines, milestones, dependencies, and deliverables.
* Provide regular updates to senior management on project status, risks, issues, and resource requirements.
* Proactively identify and resolve project bottlenecks to ensure timely delivery.
* Establish governance mechanisms to ensure effective project execution.

**B. Vendor Governance & Third-Party Risk Management**

**1. Vendor Governance & Risk Oversight**

* Support the implementation and ongoing governance of the Vendor Governance and Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) framework.
* Coordinate Annual Risk Reviews (ARRs) for outsourced and critical vendors through onsite and virtual assessments.

**2. Vendor Assessments, Audit Tracking & Control Testing**

* Track vendors audit observations, risk findings, and remediation actions until closure.
* Conduct periodic follow-ups with stakeholders and vendors to ensure timely closure of observations.
* Support monitoring and reporting of control deficiencies and risk exposures.

**3. Outsourcing Governance & Control Testing**

* Conduct quarterly assessment of the Outsourcing Governance Scorecard
* Identify control gaps, track remediation actions, and ensure timely closure of observations.
* Prepare periodic reporting on control testing results, compliance status, and key risk indicators.

**4. Vendor Agreements & TPRM Tool Enhancements**

* Coordinate with Legal, Product, Procurement, Compliance, and Business teams for execution, renewal, amendment, and closure of vendor agreements.
* Identify opportunities for enhancement of the TPRM platform and governance workflows.
* Drive automation and process improvements within the vendor lifecycle management process.

**5. Vendor MIS & Governance Reporting**

* Prepare and present periodic Vendor Governance dashboards and MIS covering:
* Annual Risk Review status
* Critical vendor assessments
* Open observations and remediation status
* Key vendor-related risks and escalations

**Skills & Qualifications:**

* **Education:**
* Bachelor’s degree in either of these fields engineering, Technology, Information Systems, Risk Management, Finance, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* Postgraduate qualifications such as MBA, PGDM, or master’s degree in risk management, Finance, Information Systems, or related fields will be an added advantage.
* **Experience:**
* 2-4 years of experience in managing GRC projects or similar roles, Vendor Governance, Third-Party Risk Management, Project Management
* Experience with GRC applications (e.g. RSA Archer, Jocata, Trident or similar tools) and TPRM Tool that are familiar with compliance frameworks
* **Technical Skills:**
* Strong understanding of GRC processes, risk management, and compliance requirements
* Proficiency in project management and basic knowledge of data analytics
* Ability to analyze data and generate actionable insights

C. POSH Compliance & Advisory

D. Corporate Legal Advisory & Regulatory Research

* Provide legal research and advisory support on corporate, commercial, contractual and employment-related matters.

title: CS & LLB | Investment Banking Advisory firm
description:
Job Description: Company Secretary (CS + LLB)

The company is an investment banking advisory firm that helps small and medium enterprises across India access growth capital, execute M&A transactions, and prepare for capital markets, including SME IPOs. We are looking for a driven, detail-oriented professional to join our growing team.

Position Details

Position: Company Secretary

Experience: 3–4 years

A qualified Company Secretary (ICSI Member) with an LL.B. / B.A. LL.B. degree and 3–4 years of relevant experience in corporate secretarial practice, statutory compliance, and transaction-related documentation.

This is fundamentally a Company Secretary role embedded within an investment banking advisory practice — not an in-house legal counsel position. The LL.B. qualification is valued for the depth it brings to transaction documentation: a stronger grasp of corporate law and Companies Act provisions that makes deal documents, filings, and agreements more legally sound and water-tight. The candidate will not be expected to represent the firm as legal counsel, appear before any authority as an advocate, or handle litigation — the legal background is meant to strengthen document quality and interpretation, applied alongside the deal team, not in a standalone counsel capacity.

Job Role

A dynamic, dual-focus role combining core Company Secretarial compliance work with active involvement in investment banking transactions. Strong command over regular CS compliance is a must and forms the foundation of this role. However, the candidate should not expect the position to be restricted to routine compliance work — it demands an adaptable, deal-oriented mindset, with core CS and legal expertise applied first-hand across live transactions, evolving in scope and complexity from one deal to the next.

Key Responsibilities

1. Company Secretarial Practice & Compliance (Core Foundation)

●Independently preparing, reviewing, and filing MCA/ROC forms (e.g., PAS-3, SH-7, MGT-14, CHG-1), with a clear understanding of the compliance implications behind each filing.

●End-to-end coordination of Board, Committee, and General Meetings — including agendas, notices, board notes, and minutes.

●Managing share capital changes, allotments, and dematerialisation of shares with depositories (NSDL/CDSL).

●Maintaining statutory registers, records, and the annual compliance calendar across client and group entities.

2. Transaction & Deal Advisory (Core Differentiator)

●Supporting Merger & Acquisition deal structuring, including entity and capital structure design.

●Preparing Information Memorandums for investment banking mandates.

●Conducting research across public domain sources, legal databases, and the MCA portal, and drawing strategic conclusions to support deal evaluation and due diligence.

●Drafting term sheets, Share Purchase Agreements (SPAs), Shareholders' Agreements (SHAs), Share Subscription Agreements (SSAs), and other transaction-related documents.

3. Legal Documentation Support

●Reviewing and strengthening transaction documents from a corporate law and Companies Act standpoint, ensuring they are legally sound and enforceable.

●Working closely with the deal team to identify and mitigate legal and compliance risks embedded in transaction structures.

●This is a documentation-support and advisory function — the role does not involve representing the company as legal counsel or acting as an advocate in any proceeding.

What We Expect From You

●An open mindset, with the willingness to move beyond routine compliance and take on dynamic, deal-driven responsibilities as they arise.

●Comfort working across multiple live transactions simultaneously, with the ability to adapt as each deal's requirements evolve.

●A genuine interest in investment banking, deal structuring, and transaction documentation, not just secretarial compliance.

●Strong research orientation — comfortable drawing conclusions from public domain, legal, and regulatory sources to support deal decisions.

Qualifications

●Qualified Company Secretary (Associate/Fellow Member of ICSI).

●LL.B. or B.A. LL.B. degree.

●3–4 years of relevant post-qualification experience in corporate secretarial practice and/or transaction documentation.

●Working knowledge of the Companies Act, corporate law provisions, and MCA21 portal ecosystem.

●Strong drafting, research, and analytical skills, with clear written and verbal communication.
